jobs.title: Aero/Thermal Engineer
jobs.description: **Join North Wind – Accelerating Hypersonic Innovation** North Wind is a leading independent supplier of complex hypersonic and Research, Development, Test \& Evaluation (RDT\&E) systems and services. Leveraging decades of specialized experience, North Wind delivers hypersonic and RDT\&E capabilities through five complementary business segments: Applied R\&D; Test Articles and Critical System Components; Test Facility Design \& Build; Test Services; Flight Testing \& Flight Systems. The Company’s offerings span the full life cycle of aerospace \& defense and commercial systems, including end\-to\-end turnkey solutions. Learn more at www.north\-wind.com. **Aero/Thermal Engineer** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Aero/Thermal Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in fluid dynamics (both compressible and incompressible) and thermodynamics. They would be responsible for the design, development, and validation of fluid dynamic systems, components, and devices using a variety of tools and software. The Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure that projects are completed efficiently and meet all necessary safety and quality standards. **Responsibilities:** * Provide design solutions, concepts, analysis, and calculations for aerodynamic, fluid dynamic, and thermodynamic systems utilized in ground test facilities * Support marketing quotations with trade\-offs, analyses, and recommendations for optimal and cost\-effective solutions * Perform aerodynamic field surveys of existing facilities and prepare and perform commissioning and validation activities for new or upgraded facilities and components. * Assist in selecting and specifying process equipment for various customer facilities. * Develop and present technical information in customer meetings and design reviews. * Willing to travel for design reviews, conferences, site surveys, and commissioning. **Education:** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in aerodynamics, aeronautics, aeroacoustic, heat transfer or related discipline **Experience:** * 7\+ years of related experience, with a focus on aerospace, hypersonic systems, or test facility design. * Solid background in the principles of aerodynamics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Understanding of wind tunnel low to supersonic airflows, heat exchanger, combustion, CFD, hot wire anemometry, optical measurement methods (such as shadow\-graph, Schlieren, PSP, PIV, LDV) or other related technology. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders. * Must be a self\-starter, able to work on multiple projects, and prioritize workload. * Demonstrated interpersonal skills and positive attitude. * Able to work collaboratively with a multi\-disciplinary team. *North Wind is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. North Wind supports safe and drug free workplace through pre\-employment background checks and drug testing.* *The salary range provided is a general guideline. Actual pay will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, education, experience, training, and other applicable qualifications. North Wind is committed to pay transparency in compliance with applicable state and local laws.* *All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.*

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Engineering, Measurement
jobs.description: **Technology \& Analytics \| The Builders and Translators** We are a 1,000\-piece puzzle. Each of us is essential, interconnected, and intentionally designed. Together, we create something powerful: media that matters, growth that lasts, and a culture we are proud to build. As part of our Technology \& Analytics team, you are one of the Builders and Translators, turning complex data, emerging technologies, and innovative ideas into practical solutions that help our entire agency work smarter. You connect human expertise with the power of technology, building the data foundations that power measurement, attribution, reporting, and more intentional decision\-making. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ At Attention Arc, we believe technology should amplify human expertise, not replace it. And when it comes to media measurement, that starts with data people can trust. As our **Associate Director, Data Engineering, Measurement**, you'll help shape how data is collected, connected, structured, governed, and activated across the agency. You'll bring the technical expertise and architectural judgment needed to build reliable, scalable data systems that support accurate measurement, meaningful insights, and better business decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, measurement technology, and business strategy, partnering with Analytics, Data Science, Media, Product, Engineering, and Technology leaders to ensure our data infrastructure supports how we plan, activate, optimize, and measure media. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who thinks beyond individual pipelines or platforms. You'll help define the architecture, standards, and technical direction of our data ecosystem, ensuring information moves reliably between systems and can be confidently used for attribution, reporting, optimization, and decision\-making. You'll guide the development of scalable data models, oversee data integrations, strengthen governance and quality standards, and help the agency navigate the growing complexity of modern measurement. From cloud data warehouses and data pipelines to conversion APIs and evolving attribution requirements, you'll ensure our technology is built around how data is actually used. You'll also mentor engineers, guide technical decisions, and help teams balance immediate business needs with long\-term platform reliability and scalability. Your impact will be measured by the trust our people place in our data, the strength and scalability of our measurement infrastructure, and the clarity our systems bring to increasingly complex media decisions. ### **Key Responsibilities** **Data Platform Architecture \& Technical Leadership** * Help define and guide the long\-term architecture, technical direction, and evolution of Attention Arc's data engineering and measurement infrastructure. * Oversee the design and integration of modern data platforms, including cloud data warehouses, data lakes, ingestion tools, and transformation frameworks. * Establish and maintain technical standards for data modeling, schema design, pipeline development, access controls, and platform governance. * Guide architectural decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability. * Evaluate existing data infrastructure and identify opportunities to simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and improve operational efficiency. * Ensure data platforms can support evolving business needs, measurement methodologies, and increasing data complexity. * Partner with Technology and Infrastructure teams to maintain appropriate security, privacy, and access management practices. * Provide hands\-on technical guidance and contribute directly to complex engineering challenges when needed. **Measurement Data Engineering \& Attribution Infrastructure** * Guide the development and maintenance of data pipelines and integrations that support media measurement, attribution, conversion tracking, and performance reporting. * Oversee the collection, transformation, and organization of measurement data from advertising platforms, analytics tools, customer systems, and other relevant sources. * Support the design and implementation of conversion APIs (CAPI), server\-side data integrations, and other measurement connectivity solutions. * Partner with Analytics, Data Science, and Media teams to understand attribution requirements and translate them into reliable data engineering solutions. * Ensure measurement data is structured and documented to support consistent reporting, analysis, and optimization. * Help address challenges related to data discrepancies, incomplete signals, platform limitations, and evolving measurement requirements. * Develop scalable approaches to integrating data from multiple advertising platforms, client systems, and third\-party sources. * Support the agency's ability to connect media activity with meaningful business outcomes through accurate, accessible, and we Attention Arc, we combine deliberate media craft with technology designed to amplify it. We build trusted partnerships so every decision stays aligned with what matters most. Media doesn't fail because of technology. It fails when intention is missing. That's why we exist. **To restore intention to media.** At 160 people across four offices in Phoenix, Durham, Irvington, and New York City, we occupy a deliberate sweet spot: big enough to handle major brands and complex business, nimble enough to actually move, make decisions, and drive impact. No unnecessary layers. No slow\-moving bureaucracy. Just sharp thinking, fast execution, and tech\-enabled. Our culture is shaped by our values: * **All In:** We show up with intensity and ownership. * **No Sidelines:** We collaborate without ego or boundaries. * **Move With Curiosity:** We ask why, explore boldly, and learn fast. * **Truth With Heart:** We communicate with honesty and empathy. **OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION** ------------------------------- At Attention Arc, we believe people do their best work when they feel they belong. Inclusion isn't just about representation, it's about creating an environment where people feel seen, supported, and comfortable showing up as themselves. We value different lived experiences and perspectives, and actively create space for those voices to shape our work. We're committed to building an agency where everyone has a genuine seat at the table and is trusted to step in and contribute, fostering collaboration, encouraging curiosity, and creating opportunities for people to take ownership and make an impact. Because when people feel heard, respected, and confident to step forward, we all move forward together. **WHAT WE OFFER** ----------------- **Compensation:** The estimated range for this role is $120,000 to $150,000\. Compensation packages are based on the skill level and experience each candidate brings to the role. We're committed to rewarding our people fairly and supporting their growth with intention. Our salaries are competitive, thoughtfully benchmarked, and designed to ensure equity across roles, experience, and impact. Growth at Attention Arc isn't tied to a calendar, it's driven by performance, progress, and potential. We continuously invest in our people through ongoing feedback, development, and opportunities to take on more, so you can keep building your career in meaningful ways. We know that great work starts with people who feel genuinely supported, inside the office and out. Our benefits are designed with your whole self in mind: your health, your family, your financial future, and your wellbeing day to day. We're committed to making sure that everyone at Attention Arc has what they need to thrive, not just professionally, but personally. Here's what you can expect: * Flexible Paid Time Off * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Competitive Parental Leave that gives you time to bond with your family * Hybrid work model with in\-office collaboration * Mental health support * Annual agency contribution to 401(k) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Healthcare FSA * Commuter benefits and corporate discounts * Carrot Fertility and family\-building support * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Casual work environment, team building, and other social events **LOCATION** ------------ We operate on a hybrid, in\-office model designed to foster collaboration, mentorship, and hands\-on learning. Employees are expected to work from the office three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) to fully experience the energy of our teams and build meaningful connections. Candidates must reside in and be able to commute to one of the following office locations, three days a week: * Irvington, New York **RIGHT TO WORK IN THE US** --------------------------- You must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer. At this time, we are not sponsoring or providing assistance with obtaining work authorization.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The Automation Engineer will be responsible for the design, programming, integration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated assembly and testing equipment, including PLC\-controlled machinery, robotic work cells, and associated controls hardware. This role will work cross\-functionally with manufacturing engineering, maintenance, quality, and production teams to bring automated systems from concept through commissioning (both in\-house and vendor) and provide ongoing production support. We are looking for individuals who have knowledge or experience in assembly/testing and automation processes, a keen eye for safety and quality, the ability to solve problems and troubleshoot, and the desire to develop and expand their skills in a production\-driven environment. The Automation Engineer will report to the PES Value Stream Manager. **What You'll Do** **Controls Design and Programming** * Design, develop, and debug PLC programs (Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, or similar) for assembly automation equipment * Program and integrate industrial robots (FANUC, Universal Robots, etc.) for pick\-and\-place, path planning, material handling, loading/unloading, dispensing, welding, or assembly applications * Develop HMI screens and operator interfaces for machine control and diagnostics * Design and implement vision system integration (Keyence or similar) for part inspection, guidance, and quality verification * Configure and troubleshoot servo motion control systems, VFDs, and motor drives * Collaborate with mechanical and electrical design engineers during the concept and design phases to ensure controls feasibility **Equipment Specification \& Vendor Management** * Develop detailed technical specifications (URS/equipment specs) for new automation equipment, including PLC, robotics, and vision system requirements * Research and evaluate automation equipment vendors, integrators, and component suppliers based on technical fit, cost, lead time, and reliability * Solicit and review vendor quotes and proposals; lead technical evaluation and vendor selection process * Manage vendor\-built automation projects from kickoff through FAT/SAT and installation, including schedule tracking, budget oversight, and change order management * Review vendor\-supplied design packages, electrical schematics, and controls documentation for compliance with internal standards and specifications * Act as primary technical point of contact and lead design reviews, progress meetings, and FAT/SAT activities with external vendors and integrators * Ensure vendor equipment meets safety, quality, and performance requirements prior to acceptance and handoff to production **Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement** * Provide technical support for installed equipment, including root cause analysis and corrective action for downtime events * Identify and implement improvements to improve machine uptime, cycle time, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) * Support preventive maintenance programs and develop troubleshooting documentation for maintenance and production staff * Analyze production data and machine performance to identify optimization opportunities * Integrate mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and controls subsystems into functioning automated work cells **Documentation \& Compliance** * Create and maintain electrical schematics, I/O lists, controls architecture diagrams, and program documentation that complies with all applicable safety standards * Participate in risk assessments and safety validation for automated equipment * Maintain version control and backups of PLC, HMI, and robot programs **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Controls integrating them into automated systems * Working knowledge of electrical schematics, ladder logic, structured text, and function block programming * Understanding of pneumatics, sensors (photo eyes, proximity, encoders), servo/motion control, and machine safety circuits * Experience with HMI development platforms * Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and software issues under time pressure * Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and P\&IDs * Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite **The Ideal Candidate Will Also Bring** * Experience with FANUC and Universal Robots programming/certification * Familiarity with machine vision systems (Keyence or similar) * Experience with industrial networking protocols (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, Modbus TCP) * Experience with Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar 3D CAD software for reviewing mechanical designs * Prior experience in high\-volume assembly and testing automation, packaging automation, or similar * Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or continuous improvement training You should be proficient in: * Bachelor's Degree * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * CNC Machine Installation * CAD Software * Design for Assembly (DFA) * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Conduit Pulling * Conduit Bending * Access Control Systems * Aerospace Manufacturing

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: New York City · Full\-time **Help build the backend that makes better healthcare possible.** ----------------------------------------------------------------- At Nolla Health, we’re building AI\-powered healthcare that connects understanding a patient’s needs with actually delivering care. That takes more than a capable model: it takes software that brings together patient information, clinical decisions, and the systems needed to act on them. We’re looking for an experienced engineer to build and own that foundation. You’ll develop the services behind our patient apps and clinical workflows, connect healthcare systems, and build the infrastructure that lets AI agents work securely and reliably alongside clinicians. This is a hands\-on role with room to shape the architecture, engineering practices, and team as we grow. jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Linux Engineer — Networking \& Connectivity** ======================================================== **EMBEDDED PLATFORM · FULL TIME · ON\-SITE — SANTA CLARA, CALIFORNIA** **About SiFly Aviation** ------------------------ At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast. We are looking for a senior Embedded Linux Engineer to own connectivity on the aircraft: how a Q12 stays reachable over 5G, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow simultaneously, how traffic is routed and prioritized across those links as they degrade, and how video, telemetry, and command\-and\-control survive a handover mid\-flight. Remote beyond\-visual\-line\-of\-sight operation is the product, and the network is what makes it possible. The picture is also wider than the aircraft alone: the same links and routing decisions span the DroneFi ground station and the pilot application, and you will own how they behave as one system. This is a role with real ownership rather than a specification to implement. You will own our Dynamic Routing Engine — the service that decides, in flight, which link carries what — along with the link\-management daemons, the secure overlay back to our cloud, and the test rigs that prove any of it works. The engine is led part\-time today; ownership of it transfers to you as you onboard — and with it, the role of primary technical guide for DroneFi development, supported by the senior architect who owns our low\-level networking foundations. We are hiring two Embedded Linux Engineers with deliberately different centres of gravity: you own connectivity and routing, while a counterpart works broadly across the platform — platform services, integration, and new platform capabilities — alongside the senior engineers who already cover BSP, boot, and the update pipeline. You will work closely together. **The Role** ------------ You will own the networking stack on the aircraft and the software that manages it: multi\-link connectivity across cellular, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow, the Dynamic Routing Engine that selects and blends those links, traffic policy and QoS that keeps command\-and\-control alive when video wants all the bandwidth, the Tailscale mesh and TLS\-secured paths back to our AWS backend, and the behaviour of MQTT, WebRTC video, and the MAVLink router under real loss and latency. Day to day that means writing services in C, C\+\+, and Python on a Yocto\-based platform, living in packet captures, and building the emulation and field\-test setups that turn “it felt better” into a number. You own the connectivity picture in its totality: not just the Linux side, but partnering with the applications team so the software riding on these links is as resilient to degradation and handover as the network beneath it. You will collaborate closely with the rest of the embedded platform team — your generalist counterpart and the engineers who cover BSP, boot, updates, and the low\-level networking foundations — the firmware engineers who own the radios and supervisory MCUs, the part\-time engineer who leads the Dynamic Routing Engine today and will hand it over to you, the applications and autonomy teams whose traffic you carry and whose resilience you help design, the cloud team on the other end of every link, and our hardware and RF engineers in Santa Clara — including on antenna placement and integration on the airframe. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Own the Dynamic Routing Engine.** Design, implement, and harden the service that chooses and blends links in flight — link metrics and scoring, switching policy and hysteresis, failover timing, and behaviour at the edge of coverage — and close out the open risks against it. * **Make multi\-link connectivity dependable.** Own the cellular, Wi\-Fi 6, and Wi\-Fi HaLow links end\-to\-end on the Linux side: modem management, association and roaming, bonding and make\-before\-break handover, and graceful degradation rather than a cliff edge. * **Own routing and traffic policy.** Policy routing across multiple tables and interfaces, nftables, tc\-based QoS and shaping, VLANs, bridges, and network namespaces — so command\-and\-control, video, and bulk transfer each get what they need on a link that is shrinking. * **Keep video and telemetry alive under degradation.** Tune WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) and RTP video, adaptive bitrate and congestion control, MQTT keepalive and reconnect behaviour, and MAVLink routing on lossy, high\-latency links — and make reconnection invisible to the operator. * **Make the applications resilient with you.** Own the contract between the network and everything riding on it: expose link state, quality, and bandwidth signals that applications can act on, and work with the applications team so onboard and ground\-side software handles degradation, handover, and offline periods by design rather than by surprise. * **Own the secure overlay.** The Tailscale/WireGuard mesh, TLS, per\-aircraft identity and certificate provisioning, NAT traversal, and an addressing plan that still works when the fleet is an order of magnitude larger. * **Instrument the network.** Per\-link metrics for signal quality, latency, loss, jitter, and throughput; structured connectivity logging that makes a post\-flight “why did the link drop” answerable from data rather than guesswork. * **Build the test rigs.** Network emulation with netem and programmable attenuators, shielded and bench setups, and structured field and drive testing — quantify handover time, packet loss, and throughput versus range, and reproduce field failures on the bench. * **Integrate on the platform.** Package your services into our Yocto\-based image as containerized or systemd\-managed services with proper configuration and device management, and work with the platform team and firmware owners on modem, Wi\-Fi, and radio drivers. * **Support the connected subsystems.** Provide the network\-side integration and debugging for Remote ID, ADS\-B\-In, and the ground\-side apps — Pilot, Crew, HQ, and mobile — working with the owners of each. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * Minimum 5\+ years of professional experience in embedded Linux development with a networking or connectivity focus. * A bachelor’s degree or higher in a related program — Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. **Compensation \& Location** ---------------------------- **Compensation range:** $150–$180k **Location:** On\-site in Santa Clara, CA. Small team, high ownership, and real hardware in the building.

jobs.description: **SQA (Software Quality Assurance) Lead** ========================================= **QUALITY ENGINEERING · FULL\-TIME · ON\-SITE — SANTA CLARA, CA** We are looking for a hands\-on SQA (Software Quality Assurance) Lead to anchor quality across the SiFly Aviation software stack and grow quality engineering into a first\-class discipline as we scale toward production flight. This is a senior, deeply technical role: you will set the testing strategy, build the automation and end\-to\-end suites that gate our releases, and mentor a small, growing QA team spanning Turkey and Santa Clara — while staying close enough to the code and the aircraft to write and debug tests yourself. **About SiFly Aviation** ------------------------ At SiFly, we’re building a new category of aircraft: vertical\-takeoff, long\-endurance drones that deliver helicopter\-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA\-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It’s an ambitious mission, and we’re a small team that moves fast. **The Role** ------------ You will own how SiFly Aviation decides a build is ready to fly. Today one QA engineer covers end\-to\-end system testing; you will take that foundation and turn it into a coherent quality practice — a shared definition of "release\-ready," automated regression that runs on every change, and a simulation\-and\-bench workflow that lets any engineer trust a green result. You will do this primarily as a builder: designing and writing tests, standing up the infrastructure that runs them, and triaging the failures — while setting the standards and mentoring the engineers who join you. The team is intentionally split by strength: one engineer focused on QA test\-automation development and another on manual, end\-to\-end test execution, across Turkey and Santa Clara. You will shape how those roles work together, review their test plans, and grow the group into an organization that scales with the product. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Own the QA strategy end\-to\-end.** Define what "release\-ready" means for the Q12, set pass/fail criteria and release gates, and make quality a measurable, non\-negotiable part of the development and release workflow rather than a step at the end. * **Build the automated regression suites.** Design and write automated tests covering flight software, autonomy features, MAVLink interfaces, camera and video pipelines (H.264/HEVC, WHIP/WHEP), the detect\-and\-avoid stack, telemetry, and operator workflows — and keep them fast and trustworthy enough to run on every change. * **Make simulation and bench testing first\-class.** Own the SITL/HITL test workflow and keep it faithful to real aircraft behavior; build scenario\-based tests for takeoff and landing, mission execution, failsafes, detect\-and\-avoid, GPS degradation, sensor noise, comms delays, and the long tail of edge cases. * **Stand up the test infrastructure.** Wire QA into CI so tests trigger automatically, run nightly and batch validation jobs, and deploy simulator and test instances locally and on remote servers so any engineer can run a meaningful test without booking aircraft time. * **Validate the full connected system.** Test multi\-link connectivity and failover (5G, Wi\-Fi 6, Wi\-Fi HaLow), OTA update and rollback via Mender, cloud/backend integration over MQTT and REST, and the Pilot, Crew, HQ, and Mobile apps against the embedded platform. * **Close the loop between real flights and the lab.** Capture and organize logs, MAVLink and telemetry, video, and perception outputs; reproduce bugs seen in real flights as automated regression tests; and quantify where simulation diverges from reality in dynamics, sensors, timing, and control response. * **Make results legible.** Build dashboards, log summaries, failure artifacts, and reports so a release lead can trust a green build — and so failures route quickly to the right owner. * **Lead and grow the team.** Mentor the automation\- and manual\-focused QA engineers across Turkey and Santa Clara, review their test plans, set standards and coding practices for the group, and help hire as the QA organization expands. * **Partner across engineering.** Work closely with flight software, embedded platform, autonomy, perception, and applications teams so QA is part of everyday development, not a downstream gate. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * Minimum 5\+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test engineering, or a closely related field. * A bachelor’s degree or higher in a related program — Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. * Senior QA / test engineering experience, with a track record of building automated test systems, CI pipelines, or QA infrastructure for complex software — and setting the practices around them. * Strong Python for test automation, log analysis, orchestration, and tooling. * Comfortable owning quality across a distributed system: debugging across processes, containers, networks, and hardware/software boundaries on Linux. * Hands\-on experience with MAVLink, ROS, or comparable autopilot/robotics stacks — or the ability to demonstrate you can get there quickly. * Direct experience with SITL, HITL, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, or hardware/software integration testing of robotic or embedded systems. * Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing test plans, or otherwise leading quality work — formally or informally — for a team. * Working knowledge of aircraft, robotics, or embedded behavior — sensors, control loops, coordinate frames, and timing/synchronization — enough to know when a test result is suspicious. * Comfortable deploying and operating test services on remote machines and servers. * Advanced English language skills and strong written and verbal communication — able to coordinate clearly across a distributed team in Turkey and Santa Clara. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Isaac Sim, Gazebo, AirSim, or game\-engine\-based simulators. * Camera simulation, RTSP/GStreamer or WebRTC video testing. * Docker and cloud\-based CI/CD. * OTA testing (Mender) and Yocto/embedded Linux. * XRCE\-DDS or DDS\-based robotics middleware. * Prior sim\-to\-real correlation work. * QA dashboards, log viewers, or failure\-triage tooling. * Familiarity with UAV regulatory context (Remote ID, ADS\-B). * Experience standing up or leading a QA function from an early stage. * A valid SHGM (Turkish DGCA) remote\-pilot licence for the Q12’s İHA weight class — İHA1 (4–25 kg) or İHA2 (25–150 kg) depending on take\-off weight — ideally with beyond\-visual\-line\-of\-sight (BVLOS) operational authorization. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * SiFly has a real QA organization with clear ownership — and a shared, trusted definition of what "ready to fly" means. * Simulation and end\-to\-end tests gate every release, not just nightly, and any engineer can spin up a representative test locally or remotely in minutes. * Field bugs land in the regression suite within days, not quarters, and stay fixed. * Detect\-and\-avoid scenarios, camera and video workflows, connectivity failover, OTA updates, and operator actions are exercised safely and repeatably before any real flight. * Flight logs, telemetry, video, and simulation outputs are stored, searchable, and replayable from one place. * The QA engineers you lead are growing, unblocked, and trusted by the rest of engineering — and the team treats quality as something they rely on, not a demo. **Compensation \& Logistics** ----------------------------- * **Gross salary range:** $160K–$180K. Salaries are paid in USD. * **Job type:** Remote contract\-based employment. * **Location:** On\-site position in Santa Clara, CA — working closely with our Europe team.

jobs.title: Security Lead
jobs.description: ### **TRELLIS BUILDS AND DEPLOYS SELF\-IMPROVING AGENTS TO GET PATIENTS ACCESS TO LIFE\-SAVING MEDICINE.** Our AI agents process billions of dollars worth of therapies annually with patients in all fifty states. We do this by automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale to streamline operations and accelerate care. We classify medical referrals, understand chart notes, and automate contract and reimbursement search to provide patients with accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. Think of us as the infrastructure behind how patients get their medications. Trellis is a spinout from Stanford AI Lab and is backed by leading investors including YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft Partners, and executives at Google and Salesforce. ### **THE ROLE** We're hiring our first Security Lead to own security at Trellis end to end. Our agents read and write to electronic health records, fill out insurance portals, and handle protected health information for some of the largest healthcare providers in the country. Customers trust us with that data, and you'll make sure that trust is earned without slowing down how fast we ship. This is a hands\-on role. You'll set the security strategy, build the controls yourself, test them like an attacker would, and be the person customers talk to when they want to know how we keep their data safe. You'll report to Jacky (Co\-founder \& CTO). ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Own security end to end:** Set the roadmap across cloud, application, endpoint, and data security, and decide what matters most right now * **Balance security with speed:** Build guardrails and paved roads so engineers can ship quickly and safely, rather than adding gates that slow the team down * **Run offensive security:** Pen test our own agents, infrastructure, and Windows session fleet; run red\-team exercises and fix what you find * **Lock down the cloud and identity:** Own AWS security posture, IAM, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and trust boundaries between customers, agents, and internal systems * **Manage vulnerabilities:** Stand up scanning, triage, and patching across code, dependencies, containers, and hosts, with clear SLAs * **Be the voice of security to customers:** Answer security questionnaires, join diligence calls, and lead audits and certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST as needed) * **Plan for incidents:** Build logging, detection, and an incident response plan, and run the response when something happens ### **ABOUT YOU** You've been the person responsible for security, not just a contributor to it. You're as comfortable reviewing an IAM policy or writing an exploit as you are walking a hospital CISO through our architecture. You care about real risk more than checklists, and you know that a security program engineers route around is not a security program. ### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 6\+ years in security engineering, with time owning security at a startup or high\-growth company * Deep experience with AWS security, IAM, and cloud infrastructure * **Hands\-on offensive security experience:** penetration testing, red teaming, or bug bounty work * Experience running vulnerability management and incident response programs * Experience leading SOC 2 and/or HIPAA compliance efforts and answering customer security reviews * Comfort with Windows Server and Active Directory environments is a plus * Healthcare or other regulated\-industry experience is a big plus * Clear communication with engineers, executives, and customers * High ownership and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast\-moving startup ### **WHY WORK WITH US** * **Real impact at massive scale:** We serve patients in all fifty states and are scaling to hundreds of healthcare locations. The systems you protect carry the health data of patients waiting on treatment. * **Incredible growth and traction:** We've grown revenue 10x in the past few months alone. * **Work with the founding team:** Partner directly with founders and F500 customers, alongside healthcare operations leaders who have overseen 50\+ locations. * **Be at the forefront of AI in healthcare:** Work on production\-grade agentic systems that make critical healthcare decisions, not a demo. * **World\-class team:** Join teammates who have won international physics olympiads, published economics research, were founding engineers at unicorn startups, and taught AI classes to hundreds of Stanford graduate students. Compensation Range: $198K \- $221K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Plastics have become indispensable for nearly every major industry, but conventional plastics impose an unsustainable burden on the environment. Plastic production currently accounts for 8% of global oil and gas use and nearly 5% of GHG emissions. More than 250 million tons of plastic waste accumulates annually, the vast majority of which will persist for centuries. ReSource's proprietary technology will produce the first bioplastic that is made from truly sustainable feedstocks and outperforms incumbent materials without the environmental burden or health risks. We are commercializing an industrially scalable process for producing FDCA, which is a naturally occurring chemical that serves as a replacement for the petrochemical monomer PTA used to make polyesters such as PET. Polyester represents a \>$100B industry, with applications spanning packaging, bottles, and fibers. Polyesters made using FDCA have superior gas barrier, thermal, and mechanical properties compared to the petrochemical incumbents, which translates into better performance with less material, including increased shelf life for perishable goods. They are also 100% recyclable and degrade much faster than conventional polyester if released into the environment. Beyond polyesters, FDCA is a platform molecule that can be used to make a wide range of other polymers and specialty chemicals. Past efforts to commercialize such products have been hampered by the high complexity and cost of the manufacturing pathways chosen to make FDCA, all of which use edible sugars as raw materials. In contrast, ReSource produces FDCA from CO2 and inedible biomass and removes two thirds of the conventional process steps, resulting in dramatically reduced production cost that enable rapid scale\-up and high\-volume applications. Bioplastics made using ReSource FDCA have the potential to eliminate \>250 Mton yr\-1 GHG emissions. The company is in Oakland, CA and was founded on technology developed at Stanford University. Backed by leading investors including Khosla Ventures, Fathom Fund, Chevron Technology Ventures, and Mitsubishi Gas Chemical, we are currently preparing to commence pilot and demo\-scale production. To date, ReSource has raised \>$25M, including nearly $9M in R\&D grants from the Department of Energy and National Science Foundation. **Position Overview**: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated chemical engineer to join the team. The ideal candidate is an innovative thinker with a passion for problem\-solving and an ability to build out robust chemical processing equipment. The successful candidate will be responsible for: * Conducting engineering studies and preparing design packages. * Designing and evaluating system configurations for heat transport and water/steam handling. * Supporting component specification and procurement for pumps, valves, instrumentation, mixing tanks, and heat exchangers. * Designing and fabricating custom equipment that is tailored to different products. * Contributing to process hazard assessments (PHAs) and mitigation. **Qualifications and Skills:** * BS or higher degree in Chemical Engineering or related field with \>10 years of industry experience. * Experience in repairing and reconfiguring used equipment to use with different processes. * Experience in configuring 480V electrical systems. * Experience in designing or analyzing thermal\-fluid systems such as coolant loops, heat exchangers, or pressure vessels is required. * Experience with AutoCAD, Bluebeam, or similar software for drafting is required. * Experience with PLC\-based automation (Rockwell, Siemens, etc.) is required. * Experience configuring user interface and HMI screens is required. * Experience configuring DDC, PLC, and/or DCS control algorithms is required. * Experience in configuring networks to interface with equipment is required. * Must have experience designing control panels: design and implement control upgrades. * Prior experience in installing and troubleshooting motor controls, VFDs, and Soft\-Starts is required. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure. * Prior chemical pilot\-plant build\-out is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $230K – $250K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **The Role** ------------ Every buyer, seller, and lender on Alt is acting on a number our models produced. Alt Value prices the card. The underwriting model sizes the advance. Those two systems are the difference between a marketplace and a handshake, and they are the closest thing we have to a moat. We've proven model\-driven pricing works. This role takes it from working to excellent: more coverage, better accuracy, lower cost to run, faster to refresh. You'll own the full lifecycle — feature generation, training, validation, deployment, serving, and the monitoring that catches drift before a customer does. This is not a research seat. The models exist. What they need is someone who treats production as the deliverable. **The metric you own: Model\-Based Pricing Coverage** — the percentage of cards confidently priced by models rather than by hand. Supporting KPIs: pricing accuracy (% error), pricing freshness (end\-to\-end orchestration time), and underwriting performance (advance disbursement rate against target default rate). Most people who are great at this have owned a model in production where being wrong cost money — pricing, risk, credit, or fraud — not a notebook that got handed to someone else to deploy. **What You'll Own:** -------------------- * **Leaner, sharper pricing.** Cut infrastructure cost meaningfully while improving accuracy, especially on high\-value assets where being wrong is expensive. * **Underwriting from good to great.** Iterate the model to maximize cash advance disbursements without breaching risk thresholds or default targets. * **The full ML lifecycle.** Feature generation and training through deployment and monitoring. No handoff, no throwing it over a wall. * **The production path.** The models' AWS infrastructure and the pricing APIs themselves — capacity planning, autoscaling, latency, and diagnosing the memory and timeout failures that only show up at scale. * **Experiments that settle arguments.** Design and run backtests to find and validate features that actually move predictive power and coverage. * **Domain depth.** Work directly with our Expert Pricers until your model changes reflect real market judgment, not just what the data allows. **What Great Looks Like (6 Months):** ------------------------------------- * **Shipped leaner, more accurate pricing models.** Infrastructure cost is meaningfully down and accuracy is up, especially on high\-value assets. * **Moved underwriting from good to great.** More disbursement, no breach of risk thresholds. * **Earned trust with Expert Pricers.** You're their go\-to partner, and they can tell your changes reflect the market. * **Hardened the production path.** The pricing APIs are faster, more observable, and easier to reason about, with drift monitoring in place before it reaches customers. **How You'll Use AI Here:** --------------------------- We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role: * Build an **agent that reads a batch of new comps and flags the ones our model is likely to price badly**, before a pricer has to catch it by hand * Use **foundation models for feature extraction from unstructured card and listing data** — condition language, provenance notes, auction descriptions — and get real lift out of it * Stand up a **backtest harness you can talk to**, so evaluating a feature idea is a conversation rather than a two\-day branch * Put an **MCP server over the model registry and prediction logs** so "why did this card price move" is a question, not a query * Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you work through a refactor or an infra migration, not as autocomplete If you've built agents, worked with the API directly, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team depends on — lead with that **What You Bring:** ------------------- * **7\+ years** engineering, with **5\+ years building and shipping production ML/AI models** * **Production\-grade Python and SQL**, including custom feature\-engineering pipelines — not just off\-the\-shelf scikit\-learn. Time\-decay weighting, leakage\-safe k\-fold cross\-validation, cascading fallback and imputation logic * **Gradient\-boosted or ensemble estimators** trained and validated against strict accuracy tolerances, with segment\-specific tuning by category or asset type * **LLMs and foundation models in production**, for both internal tooling and user\-facing product * **MLflow** or a comparable tool for experiment tracking and model registry/versioning * **Production model\-serving on AWS that was yours** — capacity planning, autoscaling, and diagnosing memory and timeout failures at scale * **CI/CD, production workflow orchestration, and IaC** * **A pragmatic bias.** Value delivered incrementally over the perfect rebuild **Bonus:** real\-time or low\-latency serving at scale. Startup experience. You collect, or you have opinions about the collectibles market. **How We'll Interview You:** ---------------------------- We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, buy, bid, and sell. Explore our industry. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. **1\. Recruiter screen — 25 minutes.** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp. **2\. Hiring manager with Dae, Head of Data — 45 minutes.** Be ready to go deep on a model you took to production and kept there: the systems design, what you owned, where it broke, and what you'd do differently. **3\. System design— 45 minutes.** Design a model\-serving path under real constraints. We'll push back on at least one of your choices on purpose — how you take that matters as much as the design. **4\. Team interview\- 45 minutes.** How you work with the people who depend on your models, including our Expert Pricers. **5\. Dae — 30 minutes**, then **Leore, our founder and CEO — 30 minutes.** Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take our pricing intelligence. **Compensation:** $230,000 \- $250,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $230K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Venrollment** Venrollment helps retirement advisors and employee benefits consultants communicate benefits through branded websites, videos, documents, and educational resources. Our tools help advisors create and manage educational content that makes complex benefits information easier for employees to understand. **The role** You'll help decide what to build and take features from an initial idea through to release. Working across the frontend and backend, you'll build tools that help advisors communicate benefits and websites that help employees understand them. We're a small team, so you'll take ownership of problems that may arrive without a clear solution. You'll investigate customer needs, recommend a scope and technical approach, and drive delivery. You'll work with the existing developers on decisions that affect other parts of the product and help strengthen how the team builds software. The work spans tools for creating educational content and interactive experiences that use video, animation, and clear visuals to explain benefits. You’ll help make content easier for advisors to create and easier for employees to explore and understand. We're also developing AI capabilities for document processing and internal tools, with plans to extend their use into customer\-facing features. You'll help explore those opportunities alongside the broader product work. **What you will do** \- Work with the team and customers to understand problems, question assumptions, and agree on a useful scope. \- Build complete features across the interface, backend, and database, with attention to usability and accessibility. \- Improve how advisors create and manage educational content and how employees find, explore, and understand it. \- Keep the product reliable through testing and code review, and help improve team practices around security, performance, and maintainability. \- Support features after release, investigate issues, and use customer feedback to guide improvements. **What you bring** \- 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or an equivalent track record of shipping and maintaining production applications. \- Product judgment: you can investigate customer needs, question assumptions, and turn an unclear problem into a useful, achievable scope. \- Ability to build across the frontend and backend. You may be stronger in one area, but you're comfortable taking responsibility for a complete feature, from understanding the problem through release and improvement. \- Care for usability and accessibility, with confidence making everyday UX decisions and collaborating on larger design questions. \- Sound engineering judgment: you balance delivery speed, reliability, and maintainability, consider the wider product, and know when to involve others. \- Ability to get comfortable in an existing codebase, investigate unfamiliar problems, and make practical improvements. \- Clear communication: you explain tradeoffs, raise blockers early, and collaborate well with technical and nontechnical colleagues. You welcome feedback and can disagree constructively. \- Startup experience, or a willingness to work in a small team where responsibilities overlap and priorities can change. We work primarily with TypeScript, React, Fastify, and PostgreSQL. Experience building interactive learning experiences, educational modules, or tools that help people understand complex information is a plus. You’re curious about practical uses of AI and willing to experiment with new tools and approaches. You can assess what works, recognize limitations, and bring useful ideas back to the team. Hands\-on experience applying AI to software, internal tools, or automation is a plus. **Why join** You'll work closely with the people using and supporting the product, with a direct voice in what we build. This is an opportunity to shape solutions, build them, and see their effect on customers while helping improve how a small team develops software. Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robotics Data
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Frontier AI is going physical, and the labs building it are bottlenecked on one thing: high\-quality data from the real world. We pair operational scale with the specialized engineering that physical\-world data demands. As a Software Engineer on Robotics, you'll sit between our data systems and our customers' infrastructure. Every frontier lab wants something different: container format, schema, fields, and quality requirements. You'll build infrastructure general enough that a new customer becomes a quick configuration, and you'll work directly with customer engineering teams on bespoke requests, feeding what you learn into scalable platform architecture decisions. An example might be modifying the segmentation model derived from a customer request for stricter filtering on hands being in frame and building this into a configurable pipeline feature. Prior robotics experience is not required. This is a backend and data engineering role at its core, developing pipelines, formats, and storage methods. If you've built high\-volume data infrastructure anywhere and want depth in robotics data, working directly with the engineers and researchers at the labs and robotics companies building physical AI, this role is for you. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the reusable infrastructure behind robotics data deliveries: the processing, packaging, and delivery systems * Format and transform datasets to per\-client specification: MCAP and other container formats, custom schemas, field mappings, metadata, and versioning * Work directly with customer engineering teams to scope and build bespoke schemas, custom fields, and one\-off transforms where requirements are custom * Build and operate the pipelines that move data from our systems into customer storage reliably at petabyte scale * Partner with operations and product to turn evolving requirements into shipped data deliveries, and prototype quickly when a new data type or customer arrives * Build automated validation techniques ### **What We're Looking For** * Strong backend and data engineering fundamentals in a modern language (Python, Go, Rust) and comfort operating production systems on AWS and GCP * Experience building and owning high\-volume data pipelines, not just contributing to them * Experience with large binary formats, streaming ingestion, distributed batch processing, and object storage economics * Customer\-facing instincts: you can lead a technical conversation, ask the right questions, and push back when a request is unreasonable * Comfort working through ambiguity and shipping iteratively with a product team, where requirements evolve with the customers and data types ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with robotics/AV data formats and tooling such as MCAP, ROS, protobuf, Foxglove * Prior work on data engines, pipelines, or delivery for multimodal data * Multi\-sensor data experience across video, depth, inertial, and audio, including calibration and synchronization * Forward\-deployed, solutions, or delivery engineering experience at a data or infrastructure company * Computer vision or multimodal ML exposure: detection, tracking, or VLM\-based labeling and QC Compensation Range: $130K \- $400K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Ledger
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $300K – $500K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **THE NORTH STAR** 99\.99% reliability on gateway and banking integrations, and a ledger where every cent is accounted for and every entry says who created it and when. Supporting KPIs: reconciliation exception queue depth at daily close, gateway and banking integration uptime at 99\.99%, P90 time from auction close to seller funds available, share of ACH returns and reversals handled with no manual correcting entry, and time to bring a new PSP or rail to production. **TH ROLE:** This is a builder's seat, not a manager's seat. You will write the ledger, the rails, and the reconciliation yourself. You will make the build\-versus\-buy call and defend it. You will tell the business no when correctness demands it, and you will be right often enough that they keep asking. The people who are great at this have owned a ledger somewhere it mattered, and they think in idempotency, race conditions, and reconciliation. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN:** * The ledger as system of record. Entries, lines, balances, holds, reversals, and the states between: pending, posted, available, canceled, declined, reversed. Immutability and audit trail as design constraints, not features. Point\-in\-time balances that show a customer where they stood on any past date. Done looks like an auditor pulling a trial balance without asking you for help. * Rails and money movement. ACH origination and returns, RTP and other instant rails, wires, cards, and stablecoin settlement. A credit\-push rail changes what you can auto\-charge and when funds are final, and you own those product consequences, not just the integration. Done looks like the fourth PSP costing a sprint, not a rewrite. * Reconciliation. When the ledger and the processor disagree, you own the answer. Automated matching, an exception queue a human can actually work, and breaks caught before a customer finds them. Every point of automation here is a point on the north star. * Payouts and lending infrastructure. Getting sellers and borrowers their money faster than anyone else in this market: instant payout options, batch payouts at auction close, and the settlement timing that makes them safe. Then the full loan lifecycle, disbursement through repayment, partial payment, delinquency, and collateral release. * Risk posture on high\-value flows. Holds, limits, and settlement windows set with data, and you will know what each one costs in conversion. Step\-up verification triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. * The trade\-off calls. Shipping speed against uncompromising correctness, build against buy. You set the planning cadence with Robbe, you work across Finance, Risk, Ops, and Support, and you are the one who explains upward why a number moved. **WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE IN 6 MONTHS:** * The reconciliation automation rate is materially higher than the day you started, and you can show the weekly series. * The exception queue at daily close is worked to zero by a human in under an hour, on a system you built for that. * A new rail or PSP has gone to production on the provider architecture you designed, and it did not require a ledger migration. * Pending, posted, and available are modeled cleanly enough that Support answers "where is my money" off the customer\-facing surface instead of escalating to engineering. * Corrections post as reversing entries. Nobody has edited history, and an auditor can say so. * At least one thing you shipped is running with AI in the loop, and the team depends on it. * Finance trusts the close. **HOW YOU'LL USE AI HERE** * Turn a payment provider or bank partner integration spec into a typed client and a test suite in an afternoon instead of a sprint, including the ACH return codes and reversal paths nobody wants to hand\-write. * Stand up a rail simulator that produces the failures a sandbox won't: a late return, a duplicate callback, a partial reversal, a webhook that arrives twice out of order, a settlement that lands after the window closed. Then run your ledger against it. * Build an agent that triages the reconciliation exception queue overnight, clusters the breaks, and hands you a ranked list with a proposed cause for each instead of a wall of unmatched rows. * Put an MCP server over the ledger so "where did this discrepancy come from" is a question you ask in plain language rather than another  real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is, why NACHA return windows matter, and why a credit\-push rail changes the product flow and not just the API call. * You have handled large transactions, where the failure mode is a five\- or six\-figure problem and somebody notices immediately. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and a transaction that holds under load at auction close and during scheduled auto\-pay batches. Python, Postgres, and AWS are our stack. * You're API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary, not terms you looked up. * You've built real things with AI, not just used it. Agents, skills, MCP servers, connectors, internal tooling people depend on. * Product\-owner thinking. You don't just build a pay button. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried customer what happened to their money. * Restraint. The most common way this seat fails is overengineering. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. **We read the work, not the years. Most people who clear this bar have five to ten years behind them, and we have no interest in screening out the person who got there faster.** Strong plus: enough React and TypeScript to ship the customer\-facing surface that reads off your ledger. This is not a fullstack seat, but the person who can take a ledger change all the way to the UI will go further here. Backgrounds that fit: payments or ledger infrastructure at a pre\-IPO fintech, core banking or money movement at a marketplace, a founding or early engineer who built the money layer, or an infrastructure engineer who took ownership of financial correctness because nobody else would. Bonus: distributed systems, credit or risk modeling, direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Airwallex, PayPal, Modern Treasury, or Increase, evaluating or implementing a third\-party ledger service (Modern Treasury, Fragment, Formance, TigerBeetle or similar), stablecoin or on\-chain settlement, KYC/KYB, bank partnership, or SOX and audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. US\-based, remote. **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU:** *We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, look specifically at the cash advance, deposit, and payout surfaces.* * Recruiter screen, 25 minutes, Google Meet. The metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We align on comp here and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Robbe Simon, 45 minutes, Google Meet. * Technical screen, 60 minutes. * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. How you work with the people who depend on your systems: operations, finance, support, and the customer on the other end of a held transfer. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's ledger and money movement first. * Reference check(s), 15 minutes, with a former manager. **Compensation: $200,000 \- $500,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees.** **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $300K \- $500K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Augmented Development
jobs.description: **At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference** Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for inclusivity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better \- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose. ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which every team member has an equal opportunity to grow. We want our team members to have the well\-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, to help us fulfill that mission. The **Senior Software Engineer** applies advanced knowledge, skill, and expertise to software delivery. Work is both independent and collaborative in nature. This role emphasizes using AI coding tools to develop software efficiently, while owning the judgment calls AI can't make, including reviewing, testing, and correcting AI\-generated work, and taking end\-to\-end ownership of delivery from specification through production. Beyond using AI tools well, this role is expected to actively drive how the team adopts new AI\-assisted development practices by piloting new tools and techniques, and championing what actually works. This is primarily a hands\-on senior engineering role within the team, with the opportunity to grow into a cross\-team responsibility for advancing how the broader engineering organization uses AI\-assisted development tools as the role matures. The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. **For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary between $110,000 and $135,000**. ACT manages salaries within this range based on relevant factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity. This position is not incentive eligible. **Location:** This is a remote position, based in the United States. **Visa:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship. **What you will be working on:** * Technical Leadership \& Complex Problem\-Solving + Solve complex technical problems across the team's core systems, using AI\-assisted approaches to move faster, including integrations with related platforms. + Contribute senior\-level technical judgment to active modernization initiatives within the team, using AI tools to accelerate legacy\-to\-modern platform migrations. * AI Tooling Strategy \& Adoption + Pilot new AI\-assisted development tools, models, and techniques within the team (e.g., new agentic coding workflows, MCP integrations, updated model versions), evaluating them against real delivery work rather than vendor claims. + Propose and champion new use cases for AI in the team's engineering practice, backed by a measured before/after comparison — time saved, defect rate, or review burden. + Feed adoption learnings back into team practice, updating norms, playbooks, or tooling recommendations as new approaches prove out (or don't). * Deep Domain Knowledge + Apply deep familiarity with the team's platform architecture, history, and constraints to guide technical decisions, including where AI\-assisted approaches can speed modernization work. * AI\-Directed Development \& Delivery Ownership + Direct AI coding tools and agents to implement features from specs, tickets, or requirements, and own end\-to\-end delivery of the feature from specification through production. + Review, test, and correct AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit; catch both subtle errors (a plausible\-but\-wrong calculation, an approach that won't scale) and obvious ones. + Act as a steward against AI\-specific security and supply\-chain risk, scrutinizing AI\-suggested dependencies, flagging unfamiliar or unverified packages before they're accepted, and treating AI\-generated code that touches auth, data access, or external integrations with elevated review. + Write specs detailed enough for an AI tool to implement correctly on the first or second pass; for ambiguous problems, exercise judgment on whether to escalate or proceed independently. + Maintain and extend I\-specific security risk, e.g., unverified or malicious dependencies suggested by AI tools, injected logic in auto\-accepted code; and habits for catching it before it reaches production. * Strong engineering fundamentals (programming, data modeling, API design, security, and distributed systems) that hold up independent of AI tooling; treats AI tools as an amplifier of skill. * Demonstrated ability to work from ambiguous specs, with sound judgment for when to escalate and when to proceed independently. * Experience working (or ability to work) across a mixed legacy and modern technology stack. * Experience owning delivery end to end, from specification through production, including writing specs clear enough for an AI tool to implement correctly. * Bachelor's degree in computer or data science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired. **It’s a plus if you have:** * Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and colleagues outside of a direct reporting relationship, or interest in growing into this scope. * Experience evaluating or comparing multiple AI coding tools or models for team fit. * Familiarity with test administration or assessment delivery systems, or a comparable domain is valued as a plus alongside strong engineering fundamentals and AI\-directed development skill. * Experience mentoring or setting technical standards across multiple teams. * Background in education technology or a similarly regulated, integration\-heavy domain. * Experience building or extending eval or guardrail frameworks for AI\-generated code. **About ACT** When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. By leveraging our expertise and authority in assessment and research, we will again disrupt the industry—helping more people learn, better measure their progress, and improve their navigation through life’s transitions. More than ever before, ACT is fulfilling its mission of helping people achieve education and workplace success. We’re doing it by pushing the boundaries of learning innovation through the work of our people, who we call team members because we’re all in this together. We know transformation does not come without challenge. That’s why ACT invests in a variety of experiences for team members to strengthen their connections, explore ideas, learn from customers, and celebrate success. Learn more about working at ACT at act.org! *ACT is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. ACT participates in E\-verify. ACT's online position announcements are intended only to provide general descriptions of employment opportunities; none of the information provided for any position should be interpreted as a commitment by ACT to specific terms and conditions for employment.* Completion of the ACT National Career Readiness Certificate is recommended. Find a testing site near you to register for the WorkKeys assessments. Finalists for this position will be subject to a criminal background check as a condition of employment. **\*\*If you have received an ACT employment\-related communication from an email address that is not affiliated with @act.org and/or that requests personal or financial information, please do not reply. Instead, reach out to us at** **careers@act.org** **with the details. ACT's recruitment team appreciates your interest in working with us to transform college and career readiness pathways for all learners and wishes you the best of luck in your career journey.\*\***

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking to hire a highly skilled **Junior Level** **Mechanical Engineer** for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. This role will support the design, coordination, documentation, and delivery of mechanical systems for data center and other mission\-critical facilities and will work under the guidance of senior engineers and helps ensure systems meet performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and operational requirements. ***This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.*** **Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.** **Key Responsibilities:** **Mechanical Systems Design** * Assist in the design and development of HVAC, cooling, ventilation, and mechanical utility systems for data centers and mission\-critical facilities. * Support the design of chilled water systems, cooling towers, pumps, piping networks, air handling units, and computer construction documents, design narratives, technical specifications, and equipment schedules. * Use engineering software and design tools, such as AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and relevant HVAC calculation
