jobs.title: Agentic Application Developer
jobs.description: AGRILAND FS is a fast\-growing energy company delivering diesel, gasoline, propane, and other petroleum products to customers nationwide, with a full agronomy business alongside. Our small technical team builds and runs the ELEVATE application suite and the ATLAS data platform, using AI as a core part of our daily workflow rather than an occasional shortcut. We are looking for a developer early in their career who is ready to build modern, AI\-accelerated, cloud\-native applications. This is not a role where you spend years on boilerplate before touching anything real. We do not put team members in isolated boxes. Your center of gravity is our AWS serverless platform, where we build the custom applications in the ELEVATE suite. You will also touch the commercial platforms our business runs on today, Salesforce among them, but this is a cloud developer role, not a platform\-specific one. As you master the fundamentals, your role will have the opportunity to expand into owning the full path to production and, eventually, whole applications. **What You'll Do** **Phase 1: Core Development (Day 1 Focus)** * **AWS Applications:** Build, test, and deploy custom applications on our AWS serverless stack (Lambda, S3 and CloudFront, DynamoDB, API Gateway) as the core of the ELEVATE suite. * **Commercial Platforms:** Contribute to the systems the business runs on today where code is needed, including Lightning Web Components in Salesforce, without making any single vendor's platform your identity. * **AI\-Accelerated Workflow:** Use AI assistants to prototype quickly, generate and critically review code, write test suites, and document components as you go. * **Bug Resolution:** Troubleshoot and resolve bugs in existing components and applications, learning the codebase by fixing it. **Phase 2: Delivery Ownership (Ramping around Month 6\+)** * **Path to Production:** Own the road from working code to production: Git\-based version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and closing out the last 10% that gets nearly finished work over the finish line. * **Requirements Translation:** Partner with stakeholders to translate operational pain points into structured user stories, technical requirements, and working solutions. * Release Discipline: Help formalize and enforce our review\-and\-deploy process as more people across the company gain build access. * Reusable Foundations: Contribute to a growing library of reusable components and patterns across the ELEVATE suite, so the next build is faster than the last. Phase 3: Expanding the Stack (Growing into the Platform) * **Data Engineering:** Go deeper on ATLAS: pipelines, warehousing, and the analytics layer that runs the business. * **Platform Engineering:** Take on infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, and the deployment machinery itself. * **Agentic Development:** Push past code assistance into agents, automation, and AI\-native ways of working, and bring what you learn back to the team. **Where This Role Grows** We build our own applications, and we view early\-career development as the launching pad for long\-term technical and professional growth. As you advance past your first year, your trajectory can evolve into: * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Owning an application from roadmap through stakeholders, build, deployment, and user adoption, not just tickets. * **Delivery Leadership:** Becoming the team's authority on how software ships: pipelines, environments, and release standards for everything we build. * **Specialized Career Tracks:** Deep\-diving further into serverless application architecture, data platform engineering on ATLAS, or front\-end craft and user experience across the ELEVATE suite. **What We're Looking For** * **Development Foundation:** Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus exposure to Python or Apex. Coursework, personal projects, and professional experience all count. * **Cloud\-Native Mindset:** Curiosity about consumption\-based cloud platforms and how serverless applications are designed, built, and paid for. Exposure to any commercial platform (Salesforce or comparable) is helpful but not required; we would rather teach a platform than unteach config\-only habits. * **AI Fluency:** Comfort using AI coding assistants in a real development workflow: prompting effectively, reviewing generated code critically, and iterating rather than accepting output blindly. * **Finisher's Instinct:** Energy for the unglamorous last mile: testing, deployment, documentation, and follow\-through until users are actually using the thing. * **Strong Communication:** Ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and build trust across the business. * **Range:** A refusal to be boxed into one discipline; you are curious about how the whole system fits together, not just your corner of it. **Why This Role Is Different** Most early\-career development jobs lock you into one vendor's ecosystem for years. This role starts with real code shipped early on a modern serverless stack, then gives you a direct path to own delivery end to end and grow into data, infrastructure, or product ownership. Because we build our own applications, the skills you develop are portable: cloud architecture, AI\-accelerated development, and delivery discipline travel anywhere. Backed by an AI\-first workflow and a small, collaborative team, you will get to know the whole business and build a career without boundaries. **What we offer our team:** * Paid, in\-house training and certification for DOT License and Endorsements for a Class A CDL with tanker and hazmat endorsements * Work with updated and modern equipment * Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and more * Paid time off, sick pay, and paid holidays * Solid retirement future with a 100% company\-funded Pension Plan at no cost to you, ***plus*** an additional 401k with company match * Recognition and pay incentives for good job performance **Are you a good match to join the AGRILAND FS Team? Apply now!** *AGRILAND FS is an equal opportunity employer*

jobs.title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI\-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing. **The Opportunity at Altana** ----------------------------- Altana's AI Deployment team gets our platform into production inside customers' businesses, taking each engagement from signed contract to realized value. As an AI Deployment Strategist, you'll shape what we deploy for each customer: you'll lead discovery with stakeholders from trade compliance analysts to operations leaders to enterprise IT, identify where Altana's platform and agentic AI will change outcomes, and design the solution that AI Deployment Engineers build and run. You'll be the customer's strategic counterpart on how AI fits their business, and you'll work closely with Altana's sales, customer success, engineering, machine learning, and product teams so that what we commit to is what we deliver. ### **You Will** * Run discovery to map how each customer's work gets done today, assess their data, systems, and process maturity, and prioritize the use cases intent. * Define measurable success for each engagement (adoption, decision quality, time saved, risk reduced), drive adoption through training and enablement, and build the business case for design, all in the same day. * Product instincts and structured thinking: you ask what problem a request solves, look for the smallest thing that solves it, and make progress with partial information. retrieval\-augmented generation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design) and where they succeed or fail in practice. * Hands\-on skill with prompt design and evaluation: you can write prompts and evaluation data pipelines, cloud\-hosted systems, and ML systems to judge feasibility. Additionally, Altana offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: * Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time off s  coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency. * 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program. * Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre\-tax funds for public transit or parking! * Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the \#1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness. * Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable. * **Resilience:** In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward. * **Stewardship:** We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission. * **Courage:** Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It's the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it's demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects. At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. jobs.description: **Description** Engineering Design Manager This position can work out of any of our regional offices or fully remote. About ArchKey ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible. We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future. Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale. About the position The Engineering Design Manager provides strategic, technical, and people leadership to multiple teams of engineers and designers responsible for delivering high\-quality electrical engineering drawings, specifications, 3D models, and construction documents that support complex electrical installations in the field, in alignment with all Company policies, procedures, key objectives and regulations. This role requires a proven leader with a strong track record of mentoring, training, and developing engineering talent while ensuring consistent delivery of accurate, code\-compliant, and constructible designs under demanding schedules. The Engineering Design Manager oversees engineering execution across projects ranging from small Design/Build efforts to some of the largest hyper\-scale projects in the country. In addition to technical oversight, this position plays a key role in job solicitation, estimating, scheduling, quality control, and problem resolution in alignment with department policies, business objectives, and regulatory requirements. Our Ideal Candidate * Is a proven leader, able to hire, coach, and develop a strong team of high performers. * Has strong negotiation, conflict management, and persuasion skills, able to influence at all levels of the organization. * Has a growth mindset and is always looking to continually learn and grow. Day in the life * Leads and manages multiple teams of engineers and designers, overseeing the development of detailed electrical engineering permit drawings, specifications, 3D models, and construction installation documents. * Provides technical leadership in the development of conceptual designs, design alternatives, and value engineering solutions in collaboration with field leadership, project managers, and estimators. * Oversees and as required, prepares and/or reviews electrical calculations, engineering studies, specifications, reports, and technical correspondence throughout all phases of construction. * Provides oversight and technical approval for engineering studies including arc flash, short circuit, overcurrent protective device (OCPD) coordination, duct bank ampacity, load lighting, and power factor correction. * Coordinates with field teams to support data collection and implementation as needed. * Monitors and evaluates the performance of engineering teams to achieve high levels of quality, productivity, and schedule adherence. * Resolves escalated technical issues, approves plan revisions, and supports complex problem resolution. * Provides coaching, mentoring, and regular performance feedback to engineers and designers. * Plans and coordinates team workloads across multiple concurrent projects to ensure staffing efficiency, balanced utilization, and on\-time delivery of design packages. * Establishes, enforces, and continuously improves engineering standards, design criteria, and QA/QC processes to ensure consistent quality across all deliverables. * Demonstrates expert knowledge of local and national energy codes and standards (e.g., IECC, ASHRAE 90\.1, California Title 24\), including leading development and review of drawings for energy code compliance, evaluating lighting fixtures, controls, and systems for regulatory compliance, utilizing energy compliance software and documentation processes, and advising project managers and clients on compliance strategies and risk mitigation. * Identifies and implements improvements to engineering standards, workflows, tools, and procedures. * Promotes continuous learning and professional development within the department. * Stays current with evolving electrical and safety codes, materials, technologies, and industry best practices. * Proactively identifies opportunities to expand and deploy engineering services across the ArchKey platform. * Consistently makes decisions in an attentive  ues through exercising sound and ethical business practices, championing all elements of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) and providing high quality services and programs as they relate to clients, subcontractors, co\-workers, suppliers, and the public. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program; Professional Engineer (PE) license required, with the ability to obtain licensure in multiple states. * 11\-12 years of experience in facilities power design, including lighting, receptacle layouts, circuiting, panelboard schedules, load calculations, and equipment sizing. * Demonstrated experience successfully leading, mentoring, and developing engineering teams across projects of varying size and complexity. * Experience in healthcare, heavy industrial, and/or data center projects is highly desirable. Controls experience is a plus. * Advanced ability to read, interpret, and apply electrical contracts, drawings, and specifications, with extensive knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and applicable building codes. * Proficiency with Revit, Autodesk tools, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office. * Experience performing and reviewing engineering studies using SKM or ETAP. * Strong commitment to electrical construction, engineering excellence, and people leadership, with a collaborative and accountability\-driven management style. * Proven experience supporting field electricians through all phases of construction, including troubleshooting and complex issue resolution. * Demonstrated experience proposing, scoping, estimating, and scheduling engineering design efforts. * Proven ability to manage the workload and performance of teams of four or more professionals across multiple projects. * Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities with strong organizational and decision\-making skills. * Strong mathematical, analytical, and systems\-level problem\-solving capabilities. * Demonstrated sound judgment, customer focus, and effective conflict resolution skills. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to lead teams and collaborate across disciplines Travel * Occasional travel may be required. Salary Range * $120,000 – $185,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications. Benefits At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well\-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work\-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We are an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. \#CA30\-1 Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description: **This is a full\-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.** Launch your software engineering career at the intersection of **Python, full\-stack development, and Generative AI**. We are seeking a motivated, early\-career **AI\-Native Software Engineer** who is excited to build modern software solutions while learning how artificial intelligence is changing the way applications are designed, developed, tested, and delivered. **No prior professional experience is required.** This opportunity is designed for recent graduates and emerging engineers whose experience may come from coursework, internships, hackathons, research, open\-source contributions, or personal projects. jobs.title: Siemens MES Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Join a Great Place to Work certified company at ATS Global! ATS Global is the Independent Solution Provider for Smart Digital Transformation. We are a passionate automation, quality and IT enterprise delivering tangible business value to our customers world\-wide. A career at ATS Global is your chance to make a lasting impact on the future of technology. We work across several industries, applying proven standards and processes that shape the technological landscape while driving positive change in our customers’ operations. Join us and be a part of something bigger, where your skills and ideas can truly make a difference. **Job Summary** As a Siemens Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Engineer, you’ll connect production operations with digital systems to improve how manufacturing work is planned, tracked, and analyzed. You’ll collaborate across engineering, operations, quality, and automation teams to troubleshoot issues and support reliable production. Your impact: By improving MES workflows and production data visibility, you help manufacturing teams identify problems sooner and keep work moving safely and consistently. **Responsibilities** * **End\-to\-End Opcenter MES Delivery** – Lead implementations from requirements gathering and discovery through solution design and configuration, development, testing, deployment, commissioning, and production support. * **Opcenter Solution Configuration \& Development** – Configure and extend Opcenter Execution , Opcenter Execution , Opcenter X, , and Intelligence to support production execution, WIP, material tracking, genealogy/traceability, quality, and shop\-floor workflows. * **MES Integration \& Architecture** – Design and implement integrations between Opcenter and ERP, databases, IT/OT systems, automation equipment, and manufacturing data platforms, including technologies such as SAP, Connect MOM, MQTT, and UNS architectures. * **Manufacturing Process \& Solution Design** – Translate discrete and process manufacturing requirements into scalable MES solutions, producing functional specifications, technical designs, interface definitions, data mappings, and production workflows. * **Customer \& Technical Leadership** – Facilitate discovery workshops and assessments, lead technical discussions across manufacturing, IT/OT, ERP, and automation teams, and support solution architecture, pre\-sales, stakeholder communication, and customer training. **Qualifications** * Must demonstrate strong working knowledge of the manufacturing transaction life cycle within MES. * Ensure expertise/familiarity in database architecture, Transact\-SQL, REST APIs, JSON/XML, OData, OPC UA. * Familiarity with all Opcenter MES offerings is a bonus. * CORE expertise is preferred as is Discrete and Process. * Knowledge of new Siemens solutions and roadmap is preferred, especially if less than 7\-10 years of solution design experience. * Experience practicing in industrial, manufacturing, or process engineering, with factory or manufacturing facility experience; assembly line experience is valuable. * Knowledge of manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial equipment, and engineering troubleshooting. * Experience with project scheduling or project management in manufacturing, cross\-functional collaboration, and team leadership. * Exposure to programmable logic controllers, robotics, robot programming, tooling, quality improvement programs, lean management, Six Sigma manufacturing, or quantum engineering is welcome. Pay: $98,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off Experience: * Solution Design: 7 years (Preferred) * CORE: 1 year (Required) * Siemens: 2 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. **Job Description** Conceive and implement novel experimental approaches to answer scientific questions. Investigate, identify, develop, and optimize new methods and techniques. Contribute to project science in area of expertise. Develop productive collaborations and communications with other groups across science disciplines. Responsibilities: * Develop robust downstream processes for early\-stage and late\-stage pipeline molecules to support CMC activities for various programs and improve tech transfer workflows. Drive commercial process development for purification within project timelines * Drive continuous improvement initiatives and next\-generation platform development, including identification and modeling of COGs, process fits, and intensification gains * Optimize downstream purification unit operations using experimentation and modeling approaches and identifying avenues for process characterization acceleration * Design and execute process development and characterization activities. Highly independent and productive in performing laboratory experimentation. * Play a key role in deeply understanding downstream unit operations to build a deep scientific understanding of existing platform processes and impact on manufacturability * Exhibit a strong motivation to implement and advance various innovative technologies in relevant areas across AbbVie (such as AI, automation, and digital transformation) * Routinely demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity in research/development activities. Act as primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents, and/or become the primary inventor of patents * Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, controlled substances, and GxP compliance **Qualifications** * BS or MS in Biological science with focus in Immunology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline with typically 7\+ (BS) or 5\+ (MS) years of relevant lab experience. * Possess thorough theoretical and practical understanding of own scientific discipline. * Education background in chemical engineering, biochemistry, biochemical engineering, or biotechnology is preferred. * Experience in downstream process intensification or modeling is preferred * Experience in areas of purification process development is strongly preferred. * Demonstrate excellent communication skills and specifically illustrate strong oral and written technical communications. * Seamlessly present research outcomes to multifunctional teams * Play a strong team player in a cross functional collaborative environment thriving for world class excellence and maintains strong working relationships with internal, global, and external collaborators. * Demonstrated problem\-solving skills and capability to overcome complex issues. * Demonstrated success in coordinating and executing important projects to achieve business goals. * Must have a “results\-oriented” work ethic and a positive “can\-do” attitude with a strong sense of urgency and self\-motivated desire to achieve. **Additional Information** Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: * The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. **Working at Abbott** At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to: * Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. * Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. * An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution. * Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. * A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. * A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. **The Opportunity** This position works on site out of our **Irving TX** location in the Core Diagnostics Division. This role is on site daily. We are seeking a highly skilled and independent **Senior Software Engineer** to lead the design, development, and integration of software features within a complex system. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to mentor junior engineers while collaborating across cross\-functional teams. You will leverage approved AI development tools, agentic workflows, software factory capabilities, and cloud\-native technologies to build, test, deploy, and support scalable solutions that help customers manage assets, monitor equipment, automate operational workflows, and maintain regulatory compliance. jobs.title: Platform Engineering and Operations Lead (Palantir)
jobs.description: The Platform Engineer \& Operations Lead is the hands\-on internal technical owner of Acosta Group’s enterprise Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) ecosystem within the AI Center of Excellence. This role engineers and operates a secure, reliable, governed, reusable, and cost\-effective platform while supporting product, program, and project teams from solution design and build through deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing production support. The role owns platform administration, DevSecOps, identity and access management, observability, enterprise integration, ontology governance, and FinOps. It provides technical direction to vendor engineers, sets engineering standards and priorities, reviews deliverables, manages escalations, and retains critical platform knowledge and decision\-making within the enterprise. * **Platform engineering:** Own Foundry and AIP administration, configuration, environment strategy, releases, upgrades, capacity, and operational health. Engineer shared services, automation, and reusable patterns for AIP applications, agents, workflows, and model/tool integration. * **Solution delivery:** Partner with delivery teams on architecture, hands\-on build, integration, testing, deployment, go\-live readiness, and stabilization. Coordinate environments, access, release windows, cutover, and post\-production support ownership. * **Production reliability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, service levels, runbooks, incident response, problem management, and escalation paths. Lead complex incidents, root\-cause analysis, service restoration, and continuous improvement; define and test recovery and continuity practices. * **DevSecOps:** Establish repeatable development, testing, promotion, and deployment practices for code, configuration, data products, ontology changes, and AIP capabilities. Implement quality gates, traceability, segregation of duties, rollback plans, and production\-readiness controls. * **Security and access:** Own identity and access management (IAM) and role\-based access control (RBAC), including least privilege, privileged access, approvals, periodic reviews, and auditable permissions. Partner with Cyber and enterprise teams on vulnerability management, policy compliance, and control remediation. * **Ontology governance:** Define design standards, stewardship, lifecycle management, documentation, and controlled change for shared objects, relationships, actions, interfaces, and business concepts. Promote reuse and assess downstream impacts, lineage, data quality, security, testing, and versioning. * **Enterprise integration:** Establish secure, resilient, observable integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, identity services, analytics tools, and cloud services. Partner with data engineering on pipeline reliability, orchestration, performance, and cross\-platform issue resolution. * **FinOps:** Establish consumption and cost visibility, allocation, forecasting, budgeting inputs, and optimization reviews where data is available. Translate cost drivers into architecture, processing, scheduling, retention, and configuration improvements; support vendor/SOW and renewal decisions. * **Vendor technical leadership:** Set vendor engineering priorities, capacity, service expectations, quality standards, and escalation procedures. Review designs, code, configuration, operational changes, and incident analysis; ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, coverage, and internal technical ownership. * **Enablement and partnership:** Create onboarding guidance, reference implementations, templates, and engineering playbooks. Partner with Palantir, product teams, Cyber, Infrastructure, Data Governance, Finance, and business stakeholders to balance delivery speed, reliability, reuse, governance, and cost. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software, data, platform, or cloud engineering; DevSecOps; site reliability engineering (SRE); enterprise integration; or related technical domains. * 5\+ years building or operating enterprise data, analytics, AI, developer, or cloud platforms in production. * Demonstrated hands\-on Foundry platform engineering or administration and AIP solution delivery or operations experience, including production support—not solely application development, architecture advisory, or vendor contract management. * Experience supporting multiple delivery teams through build, deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing operations in environments requiring security, reliability, governance, auditability, and cost management. * Experience technically leading vendor engineers, managed\-service teams, consultants, or distributed engineering resources. * Deep technical capability in Foundry administration, AIP enablement, ontology design and governance, data pipelines, applications, actions, and integrations. * Proficiency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, release controls, environment promotion, IAM/RBAC, least\-privilege design, and enterprise security practices. * Strong troubleshooting and production engineering skills, including observability, SLAs/SLOs, incident response, resilience, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. * Understanding of APIs, enterprise integration, data movement, cloud services, and cross\-platform ownership and support. * Ability to connect platform consumption and solution design to allocation, forecasting, optimization, and cost\-to\-serve. * Hands\-on technical leadership, sound prioritization, and the ability to direct vendor teams while balancing delivery, reliability, security, governance, and cost. * Strong stakeholder partnership and written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical risks and investment needs into business decisions, clear documentation, and executive\-ready updates. * Adaptability in an evolving, multi\-team environment. Experience with shared enterprise Palantir environments, Palantir partner organizations, major cloud/identity/data integrations, and reusable platform services is advantageous. jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** We are currently seeking an AI Engineer to join our AI Platform team. The AI Platform team is focused on enabling and building disruptive, innovative solutions to transform the wealth technology landscape with AI across our product suite and is growing quickly. As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and productionizing the core AI capabilities that power our platform. This is a hands\-on role where you will be on the frontier of applied AI with research and engineering, working directly with LLMs and agentic frameworks to translate cutting\-edge concepts into robust, scalable products and capabilities. You will own the full lifecycle of AI\-native products, from prototyping and evaluation to building the scalable backend systems that deliver them to our clients. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Design and build end\-to\-end AI\-native products, from initial prototype all packaging technologies: 2\.5D/3D\-IC, silicon interposers, fan\-out wafer\-level packaging, RDL, TSVs, and microbump interconnects * Experience analyzing and modeling decoupling technologies including jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Want to help drive the success of Machine Learning technologies at AWS? Do you have the skills and motivation to own the infrastructure that enables peer teams to ship high\-quality ML networking software? We want to talk to you! We seek a Senior Software Development Engineer for the Machine Learning (ML) Infrastructure team to own and evolve the platforms used to guarantee top performance of AWS ML and High Performance Computing (HPC) technologies developed by our organization. Our performance data directly influences launch decisions for new EC2 instance types and has visibility at the highest levels of the company. Bring your exceptional knowledge of CI/CD automation, cluster management, and ML/HPC workloads to bear on the cutting\-edge software we develop. Join us as we expand the AWS offerings for AI, including Trainium, Neuron and the Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA). Build and operate CI/CD systems using Jenkins, internal Amazon tools, Linux, and public AWS products to automate the testing and delivery of ML networking libraries — including collective communication frameworks, network transport layers, and GPU communication libraries. Write Python code that orchestrates large clusters, runs benchmarks and ML applications across a wide matrix of instance types, operating systems, and software stack versions. Use AWS Managed Grafana and Athena to digest the massive amount of performance data generated by these workloads and build dashboards and alarms that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach customers. jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand\-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer, AI Business Automation, Prime Video
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and live sports, offering a vast library of content to a global audience. We are constantly innovating to enhance the customer experience, from how content is discovered and consumed to how we produce and deliver it at scale. Our mission is to be the premier entertainment destination, and we achieve this through a relentless focus on the customer, a passion for storytelling, and a commitment to technical excellence. We are forming a new organization within Prime Video to redefine our operational landscape through the power of artificial intelligence. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will play a key role in building the next generation of business automation. You will collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and scientists to design, develop, and deploy the agentic AI solutions that will power this transformation. This is an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a new initiative, work with complex distributed systems, and see your contributions directly improve how Prime Video operates for our customers worldwide. For this team we are hiring, we are building an AI\-powered creative production platform for one of the world's largest entertainment studios — a browser\-based tool where creative professionals compose marketing key art using 50\+ layers, AI\-generated characters, dynamic lighting, and real\-time image manipulation. The product is a professional\-grade, canvas\-based creative editor — closer to Photoshop or Figma in complexity than a web application with forms and tables. Key job responsibilities * Design and build a high\-performance, browser\-based creative editor with multi\-layer canvas compositing, real\-time image manipulation, and GPU\-accelerated rendering for professional\-grade creative workflows. * Architect and optimize rendering pipelines for complex layer stacks, handling high\-resolution assets, blend modes, masking, and non\-destructive editing with fluid performance. * Integrate AI/ML model outputs into interactive UI workflows, enabling users to generate, edit, and compose visual content through intuitive creative controls. * Implement production file export capabilities (including PSD with preserved layer structure) and asset management features that serve downstream creative teams. * Collaborate with backend engineers, applied scientists, and product managers to deliver on our product roadmap and solve customer problems across the full creative production pipeline. * Own performance, reliability, and quality of the frontend platform — profiling, measuring, and optimizing to ensure the application feels responsive under demanding workloads. * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, and architectural decisions that will define the platform's technical foundation. This role offers a unique opportunity to build professional creative tooling powered by AI — the kind of software where rendering performance, pixel\-level precision, and deep browser expertise matter as much as product intuition. If you're passionate about building visually intensive, high\-performance applications that push the boundaries of what's possible in the browser, we want to hear from you. About the team Prime Video is a first\-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios\-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add\-on subscriptions such as Apple TV\+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM\+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best\-in\-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end\-to\-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state\-of\-the\-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast\-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- About OpsTech IT Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. OpsTech IT provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations as a vital piece to the puzzle. We are looking for self\-motivated individuals to take on new challenges and motivate teams in fostering solutions to the hurdles we face. Together, we take ownership for what we do — whether supporting IT infrastructure, developing new technology in\-house, launching a new Amazon Operations facility, or delighting our customers by delivering packages directly to them. About The Role As an IT Support Engineer I, you will use your knowledge and specialized skills to implement technical solutions and provide high quality support for computer hardware, operating systems, or enterprise application software. You are able to determine when it is appropriate to deviate from a standard practice to accomplish the desired result. You can troubleshoot and solve straightforward problems that do not have defined SOPs. What Do We Offer? jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Security Automation, AWS Security Epoxy
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account. AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security]\[ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it. You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver. Key job responsibilities * Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified. * Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil. * Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work. * Participate in the team on\-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high\-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes. * Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade\-offs between short\-term needs and long\-term maintainability. * Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post\-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers. * Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices. A day in the life You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place. You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written. On an on\-call week, you triage a high\-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow\-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur. You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back. You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. including mission systems and developing software architectures to meet those requirements with reusable software. * Experience writing embedded C  space, mechanical, computer science or similar engineering or technical field * Demonstrated High ownership and autonomy across the entire cradle\-to\-grave lifecycle of a spacecraft or space system. * Demonstrated ability to work in an extremely fast\-paced, nimble, environment with programs that have limited, broad, Level\-0 requirements * 3\+ years working in a classified environment * Experience designing, integrating, and flying Cubesat spacecraft meant to operate in LEO through GEO environments The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Starting rate will depend on experience, education, and qualifications. Advancement opportunities exist for individuals motivated to move up within Anoka County. This includes 24 days of paid flexible time off and up to 12\.5 holidays your first year. In order to be considered for this position, information to support your answers must be included in your application. A resume attachment is optional and cannot be used in place of this application. Applications must be received by the closing deadline of 11:59pm on 11/02/2026 in order to be considered. **Position Description** The Anoka County Information Technology Department’s mission is to align and deliver cost\-effective technology strategies and services in partnership with County divisions, departments and offices, other local jurisdictions, and the public. The department has an immediate opening for a Lead End User Support Engineer. We're looking for a hands\-on engineer who identifies gaps in our endpoint environment, initiates the work to close them, and leads new technology initiatives that reach every user and device across a co\-managed fleet of approximately 2,500 Windows devices, plus Mac and mobile devices. Some of the critical responsibilities of this position include engineering and administering the County’s Windows endpoint platform; supporting domain, directory, and authentication services; administering Microsoft 365 client applications and services; and providing escalated support for virtual desktop infrastructure. This is a full\-time, exempt, hybrid position. Interviews will take place the week of November 9th, 2026, for those selected to move forward in the hiring process. **Pay \& Benefits** * Anoka County Salary Schedule Grade 35: $79,788\.80 to $111,696\.00 annually ($38\.36 to $53\.70 per hour). * 24 days of paid flexible time off and up to 12\.5 paid holidays. * Comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, flex benefits and more at https://www.anokacountymn.gov/benefits * Medical and dental clinic exclusive to employees, located at the Anoka County Government Center. * Pension plan and other retirement investment options. * Advancement/professional development opportunities. **Work Location** * This position will work at Anoka County Government Center, located at 2100 3rd Ave, Anoka, MN 55303\. * This position may be eligible for flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work, with some days working remotely and some days working in the office. * Business hours are Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. * This position participates in a rotating on\-call schedule, approximately one week every 5 weeks, providing after\-hours and weekend support for critical county end user systems. **Job Duties and Responsibilities** *These examples are not all inclusive and are intended to be illustrative of primary responsibilities of an Anoka County Lead End User Support Engineer.* * Lead processes to ensure all enterprise desktop engineering systems perform reliably, efficiently, and securely. * Research and recommend emerging enterprise level technologies that support end user needs. * Lead technical discussions regarding existing and new solutions. Recommend strategies to meet future end user technology needs. * Procure, design, develop, implement, and administer enterprise level end user technology. * Lead enterprise project initiatives and meet deliverables, including project plans and schedules with resource estimates, defined acceptance criteria, and completion through handoff to operations. * Proactively identify gaps and risks in the endpoint environment, and initiate and lead the work to close them. * Establish policies, procedures, processes and documentation for computers, mobile devices, operating systems, end user productivity applications, auditing, configuration management, anti\-malware, third\-party patching, mobile device management and virtual desktop technologies. * Determine standards to ensure all systems remain functional, reliable and secure. * Act as an escalation point for the most complex technology issues partnering closely with network and systems engineers. * Ensure routine maintenance is provided on hardware and software. Ensure systems and workstations are compliant with organizational policies and security standards. * Receive referrals from help desk support and troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve more complex operating errors. * Provide leadership, coaching, and/or mentoring to a subordinate group, and may act as a lead providing daily work direction and managing timeline of weekly activities depending on assignment. * Participate in a rotating on\-call schedule providing after\-hours escalation and support for critical end user technolog ving, prioritization of tasks, short\- and long\-term memory, interpreting and understanding written documents, and general mathematical skills. * Assignments may require several hours of varied physical activity in addition to viewing a computer screen, sitting at a desk, or walking/standing to assist county employees. * Physical activity may include repeated bending, stooping, reaching, frequent wrist and finger manipulation to complete computer work, and occasionally pushing carts to transport equipment. * Regular lifting of 20\-50 lbs. while moving materials. * Equipment used includes computers, phones, and standard office equipment in addition to IT maintenance equipment depending on assignment. * IT maintenance equipment may include but is not limited to hand and power tools, electrical and electronic installation and testing tools/instruments, and personal protective equipment. * Occasional travel to other county work sites as needed. * Travel between work sites may require driving a county vehicle and/or a personal vehicle. * Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. **Selection Process** It is important that your application shows all the relevant education and experience you possess. jobs.title: Data Science Tech Lead Manager, Model Experience
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data\-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high\-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world. You'll be the senior data science leader for Model Experience and a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders. Working where frontier AI research reaches the public, you'll help shape model roadmap and launch decisions, bringing a point of view on how users experience our models and what good looks like beyond benchmark scores. As a tech lead manager, you'll also hire and manage a team of data scientists, setting their agenda, personally leading the highest\-stakes analyses, and raising the bar for how data shapes model and product decisions. **Responsibilities:** * Act as a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders, helping shape model roadmap priorities, launch decisions, and the major bets the team makes * Set the data science agenda for Model Experience, deciding where the team can have the most impact on model development and launch decisions and what it should deprioritize * Hire, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions * Frame the most important and ambiguous questions about model quality and user experience, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction * Define how Model Experience measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks across external products and internal testing that align teams and leadership on what matters * Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Model Experience, including where launches lack a clean A/B test, and personally lead the highest\-stakes analyses * Turn complex analyses of model and user behavior into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross\-functional partners * Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Model Experience needs to support rapid iteration and decision\-making as our models and products evolve **You may be a good fit if you:** * Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product or research area at significant scale * Have 3\+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction, hiring, and developing senior data scientists * Have been a trusted partner to senior product, research, and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high\-stakes decision * Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information * Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands\-on and guide others' technical work * Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences * Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress * Care about the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI * Strong candidates may also have: * Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem * Experience as a tech lead manager or player\-coach, balancing hands\-on technical work with people management * Experience building or scaling a data science team in a fast\-growing organization * Experience working closely with Product or Research teams, especially on LLM or AI products * Comfort working with unstructured data The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $380,000 \- $460,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Manipulation
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** The Software Engineer \- Manipulation is a core contributor to our robot's ability to interact with the world reliably and precisely. This role is responsible for developing and deploying learning\-based manipulation policies, with a focus on post\-training methods that adapt and improve those policies on real tasks and physical hardware. This role will bridge the gap between cutting\-edge research and scalable, reliable production software. Working closely with the simulation, data, hardware, and systems teams, this engineer will take manipulation policies from demonstration data through post\-training to robust deployment across our fleet. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Implement and deploy state\-of\-the\-art learning\-based manipulation policies to achieve reliable, world\-class performance on real\-world tasks with physical hardware. * Adapt and improve policies for new tasks and hardware using post\-training methods such as RL fine\-tuning, policy distillation, and interactive imitation learning (e.g., DAgger). * Build and maintain the data pipelines that support post\-training, including teleoperation and demonstration collection, retargeting, dataset aggregation, and curation. * Drive the development cycle from simulation and offline evaluation to robustly transferring and fine\-tuning policies on the robot. * Develop visuomotor policies for grasping, in\-hand manipulation, and whole\-arm manipulation, with reliable, low\-latency execution on hardware. * Define evaluation metrics and regression tests for policy performance in simulation and on hardware, and use the results to guide technical decisions. * Collaborate closely with the simulation, data, hardware, and systems teams to diagnose system\-level issues and co\-develop solutions. * Maintain high standards for the codebase through testing, documentation, and peer code reviews. **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** **Technical Skills (Must\-Have)** * **Manipulation:** Strong experience in robotic manipulation, including grasping, in\-hand or whole\-arm control, and high\-DOF motion, with a track record of hardware deployment. * **Learning\-Based Control:** Hands\-on experience training and debugging learned policies, including post\-training methods such as RL fine\-tuning, distillation, and imitation learning (e.g., DAgger). * **Software Engineering:** Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, and PyTorch or JAX, with experience building real\-time robotic software stacks. * **Data \& Evaluation:** Experience working with demonstration and teleoperation data, and building evaluation pipelines for learned policies. **Good to Have** * **Simulation Environments:** Experience with physics engines such as IsaacSim, MuJoCo, or Drake for policy training and validation. * **Generalist Policies:** Experience adapting large, general\-purpose manipulation policies to specific tasks and embodiments. * **Teleoperation:** Experience with VR/haptic interfaces and retargeting algorithms for human\-in\-the\-loop control. * **Tactile Sensing:** Experience integrating tactile/haptic feedback into manipulation pipelines. * **Computer Vision:** Familiarity with 6D pose estimation, point cloud processing, or visual\-servoing. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * An MS with 3\+ years of relevant experience, or a recent PhD, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Relevant experience specifically focused on learning\-based manipulation or a closely related area. * A proven track record of taking learned policies from a research/simulation environment and successfully deploying them on physical hardware. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate The annual salary range is $180,000 \- $240,000 * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Solutions, Inc., we offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
