jobs.title: Solution Engineer, Data & AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Arctiq is a global, intelligence\-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking \& Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data \& AI, Autonomous Operations \& Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer\-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries. **Position Overview:** **The Solution Engineer, Data \& AI** is a hands\-on builder who designs, delivers, and operates production\-grade data and AI solutions. You will join a team of engineers who bring real software engineering discipline to data work — version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability are how we work, not afterthoughts. We also expect our engineers to embrace agentic engineering, using tools like Claude Code to dramatically accelerate how software gets built without compromising quality. Depending on business need and your strengths, you will be aligned to one of two paths: **Path 1 — Client Delivery:** Support delivery of fixed\-price, outcome\-based data and AI projects for clients across a wide range of industries and problem domains, on Azure, AWS, and GCP. In a fixed\-price model, engineering quality and delivering within agreed scope directly affect client outcomes and project margin. **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics:** Bring order to our internal data on Azure Databricks — integrating, cleaning, and modelling data from our business systems so the organization has trusted analytics and reporting and helping automate core business processes such as quote\-to\-cash. Both paths share the same technical foundation, and engineers may move between paths over time as priorities and interests evolve. **Responsibilities:** **Data Pipeline Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads * Apply proven lakehouse architecture patterns, with clear data contracts and well\-managed schema evolution * Build data quality checks, testing, and monitoring into every pipeline from day one **Data Modelling \& Analysis** * Design analytical data models that reflect business requirements and perform at scale * Profile, explore, and analyze data to validate assumptions, surface quality issues, and share meaningful insights with stakeholders * Apply sound data governance practices so data assets are secure, traceable, and discoverable **AI \& Machine Learning Engineering** * Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and generative AI solutions — from classical ML to LLM\-based and agentic applications * Establish rigorous evaluation approaches tied to clear, business\-aligned success criteria * Take models from experimentation to production, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and maintainable **MLOps \& DevOps** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for code, data, and models * Manage cloud and platform resources through infrastructure as code * Implement full model lifecycle management — versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining * Champion engineering best practices across the team: code reviews, branching strategies, automated testing, and documentation **Agentic Engineering** * Use agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, documentation, and refactoring * Provide AI agents with effective context through clear specifications, project instructions, and reusable workflows * Apply rigorous review, testing, and validation to AI\-generated code — you own the quality of what ships, regardless of who or what wrote it * Share effective agentic workflows with the team and help codify them into repeatable practices and accelerators **Path 1 — Client Delivery** * Deliver engineering workstreams on fixed\-price client engagements, from technical discovery through outcome acceptance * Work across client environments on Azure, AWS, and GCP, adapting patterns to each client’s cloud, security model, and constraints * Partner with Architects and your Engineering Manager to deliver solutions within agreed scope, timeline, and commercial constraints * Participate in client workshops, demos, and technical working sessions, building credibility with client technical teams * Identify scope creep, technical risks, and blockers early — and raise them promptly and constructively * Leave clients better off: document solutions clearly, transfer knowledge, and help build client\-side capability * Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates, and patterns that make future engagements more predictable **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics** * Integrate data from our core business systems (e.g., CRM, PSA, finance/ERP, HR) into our Azure Databricks environment * Clean, reconcile, and standardize messy internal data — resolving duplicates, aligning definitions across systems, and establishing a single source of truth for key entities such as customers, projects, contracts, and revenue * Coordinate with internal teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve data quality issues at the source, and put processes in place to prevent them from recurring * Build trusted, well\-documented data models that power internal analytics, KPIs, and executive and operational reporting * Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and leadership to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data products * Help design and automate quote\-to\-cash workflows, connecting data and handoffs from opportunity through quote, contract, delivery, invoicing, and collections **Qualifications:** * 4\+ years in software and platform engineering, including meaningful time on a collaborative software development team * Hands\-on experience building production data and ML solutions in the cloud * Strong, demonstrable experience with the Databricks platform in production environments * Practical experience using agentic coding tools to accelerate software development — with examples of how it has changed the way you work **Technical Skills** **Software Engineering \& DevOps** * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL * Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git workflows, code review, unit and integration testing, modular design * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code * Comfortable with containerization, environment management, and automated deployment **Cloud Platforms** * Working knowledge of all three major clouds — Azure, AWS, and GCP — with deep hands\-on experience in at least one * Understanding of how data platforms are deployed and integrated on each cloud, including storage, identity, networking, and security * Familiarity with each cloud’s native data and AI services and when to use them alongside Databricks **Databricks** * Deep, hands\-on experience across the Databricks platform, including data engineering, governance, and ML/AI capabilities * Experience deploying and managing Databricks solutions using software engineering and DevOps best practices **Data Engineering \& Modelling** * Proven ability to design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines * Strong data modelling skills across dimensional and modern lakehouse patterns * Experience with data quality frameworks, testing, and observability **AI / ML \& MLOps** * Practical experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML models to production * Experience with generative AI patterns such as retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, and LLM evaluation * Strong MLOps practices across the full model lifecycle **Agentic Engineering** * Hands\-on proficiency with agentic development tools such as Claude Code * Ability to decompose work, write clear specifications, and manage context so agents produce high\-quality results * Sound judgment on where AI\-assisted development adds leverage and where it introduces risk, with a disciplined approach to reviewing and testing its output Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. *We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.*

You’ll own it end to end: configuration, Apex code, releases, integrations, administration, vendors and data protection. This is a high\-autonomy role in a HIPAA\-regulated environment. You’ll work daily with our R\&D team in Israel and with Operations and Product in the U.S. Our R\&D team is AI\-first, and AI coding agents and assistants are part of how we build, test and support every day. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Salesforce platform ownership:** Own two Salesforce apps (AgeAssured and Wellness): Apex, LWC, Flows, Omni\-Channel, case creation, email processes and scheduled batch jobs. Monitor batch health and fix failures. Find where Salesforce AI features (Agentforce, Einstein) can save coaches time. * **Releases and SDLC:** Package and deploy releases to production with our scripts and scratch orgs. Manage the sandbox estate (Full, Partial, QA, email). Use AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Agentforce for Developers) to write, review and test Apex, Flows and scripts faster. Publish release notes to the business, drafted with our AI release\-notes skill. * **Telephony and messaging integrations:** Own Five9 (auto dialer, list sync, users, holidays, DST changes) and Twilio. Keep call recordings, tasks and SMS correctly linked to member records. * **Campaigns and engagement:** Support campaign builds and uploads, automated email journeys and the fulfillment queue. Investigate mis\-sent emails and data issues, use AI to speed up root\-cause analysis, and run the fixes. * **Admin, security and compliance:** Manage users, permissions and SSO federation across Salesforce, Five9 and Twilio. Rotate AWS keys. Run member data deletion and OwnBackup restore under HIPAA and SOC 2\. * **Vendors and contracts:** Own the vendor relationship for the systems you are responsible for (Salesforce, Five9, Twilio, OwnBackup): contracts, licenses, renewals, cost optimization and support cases. * **Operations partner:** Act as the R\&D point of contact for US Ops, coaching leads and Product. Triage requests, build reports and turn needs into Jira tickets with clear requirements. Automate repetitive Ops requests with AI agents where it is safe to do so. **Requirements** ---------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development and administration (Service Cloud preferred): Apex, batch and scheduled jobs, LWC, Flows, Omni\-Channel * Proven experience with Salesforce DX, packaging, sandbox strategy and CI/CD release management * Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems through REST APIs, Named Credentials and middleware * Working knowledge of AWS (Lambda, IAM) and Git\-based workflows (GitLab preferred) * Experience administering users, permissions and SSO in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2 or similar) * Ability to work autonomously, own a broad system surface and debug production issues end to end * Strong communication with non\-technical stakeholders; jobs.title: Full-Stack Robotics & AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Astera** ---------------- Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in\-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision. **About the Robotics Lab** -------------------------- We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. **Position Summary** -------------------- We are looking for an engineer who can take a learning\-based robotics system from model development to reliable operation on a physical robot. You will work across perception, policy learning, inference, and robot integration, connecting what a model predicts to what a robot actually does. This is a hands\-on engineering role in our Robotics Lab in Emeryville, California. You will work closely with researchers and hardware engineers to develop manipulation capabilities, investigate failures on real robots, and improve the software and models together. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **Develop models for robotic manipulation.** Fine\-tune and evaluate vision and action models for robotic manipulation, using pretrained models and robot data. * **Connect perception to action.** Build the software that connects cameras and other sensors to model inference and robot commands, including calibration, coordinate transforms, action representations, and control interfaces. * **Optimize models for deployment.** Deploy models on robot hardware and optimize inference latency, memory use, and throughput through profiling, distillation, compilation, and precision changes. * **Build responsive policy execution.** Implement responsive policy execution, including asynchronous inference and action chunking where appropriate. * **Diagnose failures across the stack.** Debug failures across the full system—from observations and model outputs to middleware and physical motion—and build logging, replay, and evaluation tools to understand them. * **Build reusable robot software.** Package robot capabilities with clear interfaces, reproducible configurations, and tests so other team members can use and extend them. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * **Machine learning engineering.** Strong Python skills and practical experience training or fine\-tuning models in PyTorch or a comparable framework. * **Physical robot integration.** Experience integrating learning or perception systems with physical robots, including coordinate frames, sensor calibration, and action or control interfaces. * **Systems debugging and optimization.** Ability to profile software, identify runtime bottlenecks, and debug problems that span models, robotics software, and hardware. * **Practical engineering experience.** A record of building working systems and evaluating them on real tasks, with a clear understanding of your own technical contributions. * **Technical collaboration.** Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers, making practical tradeoffs, and iterating from experimental results. * **Robot learning experience.** Robot learning frameworks such as LeRobot or openpi, imitation learning, or vision\-language\-action models. Helpful, but not required. * **Inference optimization experience.** Model distillation and inference optimization with tools such as ONNX or TensorRT. Helpful, but not required. * **Manipulation and policy execution experience.** Dexterous or contact\-rich manipulation, asynchronous policy execution, or reusable robot skill interfaces. Helpful, but not required. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- Work on both sides of embodied AI: improve the models and build the systems that turn their outputs into useful behavior on physical robots. You will contribute across model development, deployment, and robot integration, with direct access to the physical systems your software controls. You will work alongside robotics researchers, AI engineers, and neuroscientists in a lab that connects practical robot capabilities with deeper questions about learning and intelligence. The role offers broad technical ownership and close collaboration across disciplines. Compensation Range: $180K \- $280K

jobs.description: **Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R\-262892 **Date posted** 26/10/2026 **WHY JOIN US?**Evinova is a health\-tech business focused on accelerating better health outcomes by advancing digital transformation across the life sciences sector. By combining science\-based expertise, evidence\-led rigor, and deep human insight, we design digital solutions that enable healthcare to work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are helping unlock the full potential of digital health, transforming how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience healthcare. Our solutions are built to scale, driving efficiency, improving decision\-making, and ultimately delivering better outcomes for patients worldwide. At Evinova, we are driven by a shared purpose to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex challenges, continuously learning and evolving in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment. We also recognize the importance of flexibility and balance. Our ways of working support both individual needs and team collaboration. To foster connection and collaboration, **employees are expected to work from the office three days per week**, creating opportunities for in\-person teamwork, innovation, and meaningful connection.**This role is located in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Gaithersburg or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.** **About the Role** We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help design, build, and evolve the backend services and APIs that enable clinical trial teams to configure, deploy, and maintain digital study experiences. You will develop business\-critical software that helps global clinical trial teams configure studies, manage changes, and operate digital study experiences safely and efficiently. This is a **hands\-on, primarily backend\-focused role** with significant product impact. You will own technical outcomes, contribute to technical design and engineering decisions, and collaborate with engineers, UX designers, product colleagues, and study delivery teams to solve complex problems across the study lifecycle. The team is distributed. You will work alongside colleagues based in Gaithersburg and with teammates in other locations and time zones, including Europe. In practice this means some early\-morning overlap with European colleagues, and a need to be flexible and deliberate about how you coordinate, communicate, and document decisions across locations. We expect engineers to use **approved AI tools** responsibly in their development workflow. You remain accountable for reviewing and validating AI\-generated output and for meeting security, privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements. **What you will do** * **Build software:** Design, develop, and maintain reliable tools for study configuration, deployment, operation, and maintenance. * **Develop backend services:** Build TypeScript and Node.js services, REST APIs, integrations, and data models. * **Contribute to technical design:** Evaluate technical options and trade\-offs and contribute to reusable engineering patterns and standards. * **Own technical outcomes:** Take significant features, services, or technical initiatives from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. * **Collaborate across locations:** Work with engineers, UX designers, product colleagues, and study delivery teams — locally and across time zones — to turn complex problems into practical solutions, keeping decisions transparent and well documented for colleagues who are not online at the same time. * **Build quality and security in:** Develop clean, maintainable, testable, and secure software with appropriate automated testing. * **Support reliable systems:** Design for scalability, observability, resilience, and performance, and contribute to monitoring, troubleshooting, and release support in line with the team’s production\-support model. * **Improve the team and platform:** Reduce technical debt, strengthen automation, share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and improve engineering practices. **What success looks like** Success in this role means delivering reliable capabilities that make study setup and maintenance simpler, safer, and more scalable. In your first year, you will: * **Ship capabilities study teams rely on:** Deliver features that measurably reduce the manual steps and rework involved in setting up and maintaining a study. * **Cut time to configure a study:** Remove friction from configuration and change workflows so study teams reach a working setup faster and with fewer errors. * **Raise the platform’s reliability bar:** Improve test coverage, observability, and incident response for the services you own, so regressions are caught before release. * **Establish reusable ing with relational or document databases; MongoDB a plus. * **Engineering practices:** Experience with automated testing across multiple levels — unit, component, integration, and end\-to\-end — and with the collaborative practices that support reliable delivery, including branching, code review, and continuous integration in a shared repository * **AWS and containers:** Experience developing, deploying, or operating containerized services in AWS using Docker and Kubernetes. **Preferred qualifications** * **Domain\-Driven Design:** Experience applying DDD principles to complex business domains. * **DevOps:** Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, logging, and production support. * **Regulated environments:** Experience in healthcare, clinical research, safety\-critical systems, or other regulated domains. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to learn quickly. **Technology environment** Our technology environment includes TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, MongoDB, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, with React and related frontend technologies used across the wider product. The role is primarily backend\-focused, although you will collaborate closely with frontend engineers and may contribute across the stack when appropriate. You are not expected to have experience with every technology listed. **SO, WHAT’S NEXT?** To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them. **Where can I find out more?** * Explore what we’re building: www.evinova.com * Stay connected and see our impact in action: https://www.linkedin.com/company/evinova/ **Apply today to bring smarter, faster clinical trials to life!** Evinova is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion and providing a workplace that is free from discrimination. Evinova is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Such accommodation is available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment, assessment and selection process and may be requested by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com. \#LI\-Hybrid*The annual base pay for this position ranges from $127,352\.00 \- $167,149\.50 USD. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.* *In addition, our positions offer a short\-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity\-based long\-term incentive program. Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program \[401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.* *Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.* **Date Posted** 27\-Oct\-2026 **Closing Date** 02\-Nov\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the  ity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Show us your work** --------------------- We will ask every candidate for a list of projects or code repositories that demonstrate the ability to do this job. Public GitHub repos, private repos you can grant read access to, a Loom walkthrough of a system in production, or a written case study with architecture and results all work. We are looking for: * At least one build against a marketing platform API (Meta, TikTok, Google, Shopify, or similar) that ran in production. * At least one AI agent or automation that replaced real manual work, with the before and after. * Evidence of your coding practice: how you structure a project, handle secrets, test, and document. * If you have led a team, an example of a standard you set and how you enforced it. Candidates who cannot share any work product will not advance. **Your first 90 days** ---------------------- **Days 1 to 15: Learn the work** * Meet the paid media, creator, CRO, and ecommerce leads and the AI builders across service lines. * Get read access to the ad accounts, the platform apps, and the existing agent codebases. Audit what is live, what is half\-built, and what is broken. * Map the highest\-friction, highest\-frequency workflows and prioritize three to five to build or fix first. * Agree success metrics and reporting cadence with the CTO. **Days 16 to 45: Build fast** * Ship your first agent or automation into live use on a named client account. * Review the open work of the existing builders and set the code review and design review standard. * Document logic, approvals, edge cases, and operating rules for everything you ship. **Days 46 to 75: Expand and standardize** * Extend what works to more accounts and teams. Build reusable patterns, templates, and shared tooling. * Introduce a clear framework for human review and escalation, especially for anything that touches spend or client\-facing output. * Take over intake and prioritization of automation requests. **Days 76 to 90: Prove impact** * Present before and after results, adoption, and measured time or money saved to the CTO and CEO. * Recommend the next wave of builds. * Have a team that ships to your standard without you in every review. **Success metrics** ------------------- * Three to five high\-value systems live on real client accounts in the first 90 days. * Measurable reduction in manual work on targeted processes, with the baseline captured before the build. * Strong internal adoption by the teams using the systems. * Reliable performance with clear exception handling. Nothing touches a live ad account or a client without a logged action and a named approver. * The AI builders across service lines shipping to a single documented standard. * A clear roadmap for the next phase of agent development tied to revenue, retention, or cost. **Daily reality** ----------------- * Review a manual process in paid media or creator ops and redesign it into a system. * Build or refine an agent based on yesterday's feedback from a media buyer. * Review another builder's pull request and send it back with what to change. * Wire a new platform endpoint, handle the token refresh, and ship it. * Monitor what is running, fix what failed overnight, and improve reliability. * Ship again. **Reporting** ------------- * Daily: async update to the CTO on builds, blockers, and wins. * Weekly: working session with the CTO on priorities, decisions, and impact. * Monthly: summary of automation impact, adoption, and next opportunities to the CEO. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Axis Residential is a forward\-thinking, property management organization, specialized in operating 55 and older active adult communities. We have set ourselves apart as an industry leader who genuinely cares for the well\-being and success of our people while creating an environment of meaningful community for our residents. Our success is a result of our team and culture– we take a relational and entrepreneurial approach to business, and our team members are authentic, curious, natural leaders who value the greater team. We love what we do, and we are committed to excellence in our work. **The Position:** We are hiring for an **IT Operations Manager** to join our growing team in **Spokane, WA** ***(this is an in\-office position).*** The IT Operations Manager will lead the day\-to\-day operations of the IT Service/Help Desk, ensuring employees across the organization receive timely, high\-quality technical support. This role will manage the service desk team, ticketing processes, and support standards, and partners closely with the Director of IT on broader technology initiatives and projects. * Oversee day\-to\-day service desk operations, ensuring tickets, calls, and requests are triaged, assigned, and resolved within established SLAs. * Establish, monitor, and report on service desk KPIs (response times, resolution times, ticket backlog, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement. * Manage the IT ticketing/helpdesk software system, including workflows, categorization, and knowledge base content. * Serve as an escalation point for complex or high\-priority technical issues that front\-line technicians cannot resolve. * Assist coordination of hardware and software support, including desktop/laptop deployment, mobile device management, and end\-user application support. * Own the employee onboarding/offboarding technology process, ensuring new hires have equipment and system access on day one and departing employees are deprovisioned promptly. * Develop and maintain service desk documentation, standard operating procedures, and self\-service resources for end users. * Contribute to IT policies and procedures aligned to enterprise governance and security frameworks, and support internal and external audits. * Partner with the Director of IT and other IT team members on projects such as system rollouts, upgrades, and site technology needs. * Track and manage IT asset inventory (laptops, phones, peripherals), including procurement, deployment, and retirement. * Provide end\-user training and communication on new systems, tools, and IT policies. * Identify recurring issues and recommend process, tooling, or infrastructure improvements to reduce ticket volume. * Administer and secure Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Okta, and related identity management systems, including group policies, SSO, and MFA. * Partner with IT Systems Engineer on network operations, including firewalls, VPNs, switches, wireless systems, and WAN connectivity. * Monitor system performance, capacity, and security posture; propose improvements and drive automation to increase efficiency. * Automate routine administration and configuration management using scripting and infrastructure\-as\-code tools where appropriate. * Lead or co\-lead infrastructure projects such as upgrades, migrations, hardware refreshes, and SaaS/PaaS integrations, including planning, risk assessment, and documentation. **Other Duties:** This job profile is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of job duties and responsibilities, as one may be asked to perform additional tasks in order to meet the needs of the organization. **What We Are Seeking:** * Must be a team player who takes a “we over me” approach to building and sustaining relationships with others. * Must be determined, ambitious, and self\-motivated. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field strongly preferred. Equivalent combination of education and experience required. * 7\+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, and engineering roles, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead capacity. * Experience supporting a workforce of 300\+ employees across multiple departments and/or locations preferred. * Hands\-on experience with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, FreshService, Zendesk) and remote support tools. * Strong working knowledge of Windows/Mac OS, Microsoft 365, networking basics, and common business applications. * Expert\-level experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365/Azure AD; Linux experience is a plus. * Strong communication skills and customer service orientation, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across departments in a growing organization. Must be proficient in speaking, reading, and writing in English. * Strong leadership and coaching skills with the ability to develop a team. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment. * Solid troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across hardware, software, and connectivity issues. * Experience developing and maintaining clear, accurate IT documentation, procedures, and technical resources. * Familiarity with IT security best practices (password management, phishing awareness, endpoint protection). * Valid driver’s license and insured, operable vehicle. **Compensation and Benefits:** * Competitive salary, $125,000 \- $140,000 (based on experience). * Annual bonus incentive. * Annual performance review with potential merit increase. * Medical, Dental, \& Vision insurance \- with 100% employer paid monthly premiums for associates. * Flexible Spending Accounts\- for healthcare and dependent care. * Disability, AD\&D, and Life insurance. * 401(k) with 3% company contribution. * Accrued vacation time, sick pay, 12 paid holidays per calendar year, personal day, and paid volunteer day. * Employee Assistance Program. * Charitable giving program and community involvement. **Physical Requirements:** * Sitting: 2\-7 hours/day. * Walking: 1\-2 hours/day. * Climbing (stairs): 1\-3 hours/day. * Lifting: 20\-40 lbs. regularly. * Endurance: light to moderate energy requirements. * Manual Dexterity: frequent fine motor skills. * Near Vision: minimal near vision. **Environmental and Safety Factors:** * Weather: work is primarily indoors in a temperature\-controlled office environment with occasional exposure to outdoor weather conditions, including uneven and slippery surfaces. * Noise: frequent exposure to typical office environment noise levels including conversational voice levels; jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Now **We are the people who give possibilities purpose** ---------------------------------------------------- BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. **Job Description** =================== **Summary** We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help advance next\-generation medical technologies for continuous physiological monitoring, disease detection, and predictive clinical decision support. In this role, you will develop clinically meaningful algorithms using multi\-modal healthcare data, including physiological sensor signals, medical device data, electronic health records, imaging data, and other real\-world clinical datasets. You will work in a highly cross\-functional environment with algorithm engineers, data scientists, clinicians, systems engineers, software teams, regulatory specialists, and product leaders to translate complex clinical and physiological problems into validated, deployable algorithmic solutions. This is a senior technical role suited for an engineer with deep expertise in classical machine learning, modern AI/deep learning, physiological signal interpretation, and real\-world deployment across both cloud\-based platforms and edge medical devices. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, validation and deployment of AI/ML algorithms for continuous physiological monitoring, novel vital sign and physiological parameter development, disease detection and risk stratification and early warning systems. * Develop algorithms using multi\-modal data sources, including physiological waveforms and time\-series data such as PPG, blood pressure, capnography and other monitoring signals, bedside and wearable sensor data, electronic health records and structured clinical data, etc. * Apply advanced analytical approaches, including: * Classical machine learning models * Statistical modeling and probabilistic inference * Time\-series modeling * Signal processing and feature engineering * Deep learning architectures * Multimodal AI models * Transformer\-based models and foundation\-model approaches where appropriate * Translate clinical and physiological understanding into robust algorithm design, including feature selection, model architecture, performance targets, and clinically interpretable outputs. * Build end\-to\-end algorithm development pipelines for data ingestion, signal quality assessment, annotation, feature extraction, model training, validation, robustness testing, and post\-market performance monitoring where applicable. * Partner with clinical, medical affairs, regulatory, quality, and product teams to ensure algorithms are developed with appropriate clinical context, usability, safety, and regulatory considerations. * Develop and optimize algorithms for cloud environments and for edge or embedded medical devices, accounting for latency, memory, compute, power, cybersecurity, and reliability constraints. * Support verification, validation, documentation, risk analysis, and design controls for regulated medical technology products. * Contribute to intellectual property generation, technical strategy, research roadmaps, and external scientific engagement. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related engineering or quantitative field. * 7\+ years of industry experience in AI/ML, algorithm development, biomedical signal processing, healthcare analytics, medical devices, or related technical areas. * Deep expertise in machine learning and AI model development, including both classical and modern approaches. * Strong hands\-on experience with physiological time\-series data, biomedical signals, medical device data, or clinical datasets. * Understanding of human physiology, especially as it relates to patient monitoring. * Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from early feasibility through productization or deployment. * Experience working with multi\-modal healthcare data, such as sensor signals, EHR data, imaging data, lab data, and clinical outcomes. * Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or equivalent tools. * Experience with cloud\-based algorithm development and deployment using platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience optimizing models for deployment on constrained environments, including embedded systems, edge devices, or near\-real\-time medical technology platforms. * Strong understanding of model evaluation, including sensitivity, speci ring, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related engineering or quantitative field. * Experience developing AI/ML algorithms for regulated medical devices, digital health products, clinical decision support tools, or Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). * Familiarity with medical device development practices, including design controls, risk management, jobs.title: AI Deployment Lead, Financial Services
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. **About Brain Co.** =================== Brain Co. builds AI\-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. **Why Now** =========== Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. **About the role** ================== Brain Co. builds applied AI products for enterprises. We’re building our AI Deployment team in San Francisco, with a focus on financial\-services clients across the U.S. You’ll work at the intersection of AI product delivery and client engagement, helping define, shape, and deliver solutions for asset managers, investors, lenders and other financial institutions. You’ll own the end\-to\-end delivery of your engagements: leading the team, building client relationships, and turning deployed AI into adopted, durable workflows. You’ll be accountable for program execution and measurable customer value, and help grow each account by earning trust and identifying the next valuable problem to solve. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and senior client stakeholders to translate complex business needs into working products. This is a hands\-on leadership role: you’ll stay close to users, make scope decisions, and use AI tools and prototypes to move the work forward. **Core responsibilities** ========================= * **Lead end\-to\-end delivery:** coordinate the cross\-functional team from discovery through production and sustained use. Set priorities, run delivery cycles, manage dependencies and risks, and keep the client and team aligned on commitments. * **Define what to build:** work with practitioners and sponsors to understand the workflow, prioritize valuable problems, and translate requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Decide what to build, defer, or stop. * **Drive adoption and change:** build relationships with users, win over skeptical stakeholders, and lead the people\-and\-process changes required for new ways of working to take hold. Use direct feedback to improve the product and verify sustained use. * **Deliver measurable value:** agree outcomes and a baseline with the client. Track whether the deployment improves the work, surface risks early, and address quality or adoption problems after launch. * **Grow the account:** own the day\-to\-day client relationship, communicate with senior sponsors, and connect delivered results to new opportunities. Partner with commercial colleagues on expansion proposals and commitments. * **Improve the next deployment:** build or adapt prototypes, test consequential AI output, and work with engineers on technical trade\-offs. Partner with product managers to turn recurring customer needs into reusable capabilities and implementation practices. **What you’ll bring** ===================== * **Delivery ownership:** a track record of owning complex enterprise programs through production and adoption, with clear examples of your own decisions and results. * **Team and client leadership:** experience leading cross\-functional teams, coordinating multiple workstreams, and building trusted relationships with senior clients and the people doing the work. * **Hands\-on AI fluency:** you use AI in your work, understand its limitations, and can discuss data flows, evaluation, human review, and technical trade\-offs with engineers. * **Product and commercial judgment:** you can turn an ambiguous problem into a useful first release, make scope trade\-offs, and connect delivery to customer value and account growth. * **Change management:** experience driving behavioral and process change in large organizations, aligning competing incentives, and earning adoption without direct authority. * **Communication and initiative:** clear written and verbal communication, a willingness to learn an unfamiliar domain, and the drive to resolve gaps yourself. Financial\-services experience is a strong plus. We also welcome commercially minded operators from consulting, enterprise software, and other complex industries who can show how they learned a domain and delivered lasting results. **Location and travel** ======================= This role is based in San Francisco. Regular travel to customer sites is expected, particularly during discovery, launch, and adoption.

monitoring systems to track performance with sufficient lead time for intervention. + Design sustainable analytics frameworks to maintain performance improvements. **Analytics and Modeling** * methodologies to solve complex quality performance challenges, continuously seeking new ways to leverage data for organizational improvement. * Develops and implements predictive analytics models to analytical approaches and methodologies to solve complex quality performance challenges, continuously seeking new ways to leverage data for organizational improvement. **Data Visualization and Communication** * Creates and maintains dashboards and other visualizations that clearly communicate quality performance metrics to various stakeholders. * Presents complex analytical findings to Intermediate Level Advanced Level Process Improvement: Training in data\-driven improvement processes and methodologies to evaluate the effectiveness of quality improvement initiatives. Basic Understanding Formal Certification (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.) **Special Skills** **Description** **Minimum Required** **Preferred/Desired** Technical Skills: Proficiency with data analysis platforms, ability to work with large complex datasets, experience with programming languages, and SQL query development. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: We are a high\-growth company transforming how businesses operate by integrating AI, IoT, and cloud\-native services into scalable, real\-time platforms. As a Platform Data Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our products, services, and insights. You’ll join a multidisciplinary team focused on ingesting, processing, and managing massive streams of sensor and operational data across a wide array of devices—from drones and robots to industrial systems and smart environments. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high\-throughput data ingestion pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data. * Implement robust and secure data lake and SQL\-based storage architectures optimized for performance and cost. * Develop and maintain internal tools and frameworks for data ingestion using Python, Golang, and SQL. * Build and maintain inference pipelines to support model serving and near real time prediction workflows * Develop and maintain internal tools and deployment processes to support ML development workflow , including experimentation, testing, deployment and monitoring. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Cloud, Edge, Product, and AI teams to define data contracts, schemas, and retention policies. * Use AWS cloud infrastructure (including Argo Workflows, S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS) to support end\-to\-end data workflows. * Employ Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform to manage data platform infrastructure. * Monitor data pipelines for quality, latency, and failures using tools such as CloudWatch, SumoLogic, or DataDog. * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that land curated sensor and operational data into Delta tables on Databricks to support ML experimentation and model training. * Continuously optimize storage, partitioning, and query performance across large\-scale datasets. * Participate in architecture reviews and ensure the platform adheres to security, compliance, and best practice standards. **Skills and Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering or data engineering. * Strong programming skills in Python and Golang. * Deep understanding of SQL and modern data lake architectures (e.g., using Parquet, Iceberg, or Delta Lake). * Hands\-on experience with AWS services including but not limited to: S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS. * Proficiency with Terraform for automating infrastructure deployment and management. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks for ML workflows: MLflow experiment tracking and model registry, Model Serving, and building training datasets in Delta Lake (PySpark/Spark SQL). * Experience working with real\-time or batch data ingestion at scale, and designing fault\-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines. * Familiarity with DVC for dataset versioning and management. * Familiarity with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems like Kafka or Kinesis. * Strong debugging and optimization skills across cloud, network, and application layers. * Excellent collaboration, communication, and documentation skills. **Bonus Points** * Experience working with time\-series or IoT sensor data at industrial scale. * Exposure to gRPC and protobuf\-based data contracts. * Experience supporting ML pipelines and feature stores. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes concepts. * Databricks Machine Learning certification (Professional) * Prior startup experience and/or comfort working in fast\-paced, iterative environments.

jobs.title: Department Manager, Data Engineering & AI
jobs.description: **Description** Lead the enterprise Data Engineering \& AI delivery organization, building and operating shared, reusable capabilities that turn prioritized business demand into secure, scalable, production\-grade data and AI products. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data \& AI, this leader is one of three Data \& AI leadership pillars and partners with IT on enterprise platforms while owning Data \& AI engineering execution, talent, standards (including the engineering playbook and training approach), the enterprise ontology and AI brain, the technical controls for AI governance, and delivery performance. Because Burns \& McDonnell runs multiple data and AI platforms (including Azure, AWS, GCP, Palantir, and Databricks), this hands\-on technical leader brings working depth on each of them to drive consolidation into one delivery system. The Director delivers against the Shared Business Backlog and portfolio priorities set through the Operating Model \& Strategy function, and commits technical capacity to those priorities. **Key Responsibilities** Organization \& Talent * Lead and develop the Data \& AI technical organization, including data engineering, integration, analytics engineering, applied AI/ML, technical pod leadership, and product support/run capabilities in the approved structure. * Attract, hire, and retain top Data \& AI engineering talent, and build enduring capability through career paths, succession depth, mentoring, and knowledge sharing so the function does not depend on a few individuals. * Lead and unify teams across multiple geographies and time zones, with consistent standards, ways of working, and collaboration. * Drive build\-versus\-buy decisions, vendor/SI performance, technical workforce planning, and skills development. Delivery * Own the technical delivery roadmap and turn prioritized backlog demand into capacity plans, pod assignments, and production releases. Stay hands\-on enough to set the technical bar and unblock teams. * Run all approved platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Palantir, Databricks, and others) as one delivery system working from one backlog, with common standards, reusable components, and shared ways of working rather than separate platform teams. Lead consolidation where platforms overlap. * Make sure every product has a named owner and a funded support/run model before launch, so nothing is left unsupported after go\-live. * Deliver AI to production through agents and agentic workflows, with evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost tracking for AI usage built in from the start. * Set and report engineering quality, reliability, delivery, and capacity metrics. Raise technical risks and constraints early, with a recommended path. Standards \& Engineering * Define engineering standards and reusable patterns for ingestion, integration, transformation, modeling, data products, analytics, AI/ML, testing, CI/CD, observability, and production support. * Partner with IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security/Privacy, and platform teams on architecture decisions, cloud/platform services, access controls, resilience, and enterprise guardrails. * Own the Data \& AI Engineering Playbook and the training approach across the organization, including onboarding, skills paths, and certification, so teams, pods, and partners/SIs build to the same practices. * Build and operate the Burns \& McDonnell ontology and enterprise AI brain: the shared knowledge, semantic, and context layer that grounds AI in business definitions, relationships, and rules. Build it at the enterprise level and support local ontologies and AI context for portfolios and business units, kept aligned through common standards and governed reuse. * Implement the technical controls for AI governance (access controls, guardrails, evaluation, lineage, logging and audit, and human oversight). Work with the Director, Operating Model \& Strategy, who orchestrates AI governance decisions and workflows across IT, Security, Legal, and Risk. * Promote reuse across portfolios so capabilities are built once and leveraged enterprise\-wide. Stakeholder Influence * Influence senior business, IT, Enterprise Architecture, and Security stakeholders to align on technical direction, guardrails, and platform decisions. * Manage business and executive expectations transparently on capacity, feasibility, sequencing, and trade\-offs, and reliably deliver on committed plans. * Build credibility with sponsors and portfolio leaders through predictable, production\-grade delivery and early, honest surfacing of risks and constraints. * Champion reuse and enterprise standards across autonomous portfolios through persuasion and demonstrated value rather than mandate. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) * **Roadmap and standards:** Technical delivery roadmap and engineering standards approved and published, aligned to the enterprise Data \& AI roadmap. * **One delivery system:** All approved platforms running through one backlog and   ontology and AI brain foundation live, with agreed approach for local ontologies and a first set of business domains modeled and used by AI applications. * **AI governance:** Technical AI governance controls (access, guardrails, evaluation, audit logging) operating on production AI, with exceptions visible to the governance forums. * **Reuse:** Reuse targets set and tracked, with reusable patterns adopted across portfolios. Targets to be set with the Managing Director at the start of the role. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field from an accredited program and a minimum of 15 years of related professional experience in data engineering, data platforms, integration, analytics engineering, AI/ML engineering, or related hands\-on technology disciplines, with a track record of building and shipping production data and AI solutions; substantial people\-leadership experience. * Experience leading enterprise\-scale data engineering/platform teams and multiple concurrent delivery streams in a complex organization. * Deep knowledge of modern cloud data architectures, ingestion/ELT/ETL, data modeling, orchestration, APIs/integration, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. * Hands\-on, current experience building and delivering production solutions on Azure, AWS, GCP, and Palantir (Foundry/AIP), and experience with Databricks, in enterprise environments. Burns \& McDonnell runs these platforms today; this is a hands\-on technical leadership role, and management experience without hands\-on delivery experience on these platforms is not sufficient. * Hands\-on experience building ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic layers and the agentic AI solutions that run on them (for example Palantir Ontology and AIP), at both enterprise and local (portfolio) scale. * Experience implementing AI governance controls in production, including guardrails, evaluation, access control, and audit logging. * Working knowledge of AI/ML delivery patterns, MLOps/LLMOps, model/product lifecycle, responsible AI controls, and the data foundations required for AI at scale. * Strong experience managing internal talent and external partners/SIs, with accountability for capacity, quality, delivery, and technical standards. * Proven track record of hiring and retaining top technical talent and leading distributed, multi\-location teams. * Strong stakeholder leadership with the ability to partner across business, IT, architecture, security, and executive teams. * Proven stakeholder engagement and delivery leadership: able to build and sustain senior business, IT, and executive relationships and reliably deliver committed technical outcomes end to end. * Proven ability to work directly with business customers in shaping value (defining outcomes, use cases, and success measures) and to deliver material, measurable impact to the business P\&L by leveraging data. * Ability to deal with ambiguity: comfortable operating, deciding, and delivering in a fast\-evolving environment. * Preferred / Differentiating Experience * Experience in engineering, construction, EPC, professional services, or other project\-centric enterprises preferred. * Experience with data product, lakehouse/data fabric, metadata/catalog/lineage, and MDM patterns preferred. * Experience with AI governance, responsible AI controls, or enterprise technology governance preferred. * Experience managing AI consumption cost (FinOps), including usage visibility, cost allocation, and model selection trade\-offs preferred. * Relevant cloud, data engineering, or AI certifications preferred. jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: Junior Software Developer \[NO RELOCATION] PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. WE ARE ONLY HIRING IN PHOENIX. Phoenix, AZ — onsite · $60,000–$80,000 BusinessRate turns public customer reviews into scores and rankings for local businesses. We collect review data at scale, score each business, rank it against its local competitors, and recognize the top performers in their market. We're profitable and growing, with an engineering team of six. Everything — the data pipelines, the web applications, the payment flows, the internal tooling, the infrastructure — is built and maintained in house. The role You'd be writing code day to day, working closely with our senior engineers, who review your pull requests and are there when you get stuck. We're a small team, so you won't be handed a narrow slice of the product and left there — you'll see how the whole thing fits together, and you'll get more ownership as you show you're ready for it. The work is genuinely interesting. The data side involves large partitioned tables, queries that need to stay fast as volumes grow, and pipelines processing substantial amounts of data. There's also a customer\-facing web application, payment flows, and internal dashboards, all of which need to be reliable. We're looking for someone who wants to get good at this, not just someone who can already do it. What you'll do \- Build and maintain backend services and APIs, with support on the design decisions \- Work on our Next.js and tRPC frontends — customer\-facing pages and internal dashboards \- Write SQL against large datasets and learn what makes queries fast or slow \- Fix bugs and ship improvements across the product \- Have your pull requests reviewed carefully, and start reviewing others' as you grow \- Take smaller projects from idea through to production What we're looking for You should have: \- Working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js, and something real you've built with them — a job, an internship, a personal project you can walk us through \- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases; you don't need to know how to optimize a query against a partitioned table yet, but you should want to learn \- Experience building with React, ideally Next.js \- Comfort with AI\-assisted development tools alongside solid engineering practices — we use them regularly and expect the same care with code written that way \- A willingness to ask questions early rather than disappear for three days Nice to have: \- tRPC, Fastify, or similar typed API layers \- Docker and modern deployment pipelines (we use Render) \- Stripe or other payments experience \- Any exposure to data pipelines or ETL \- A CS degree, a bootcamp, or no formal background at all — we care about what you can do Compensation and process Base salary is $60,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Health insurance included. This role is onsite in the Phoenix area. Our process is only two steps: an intro video call, an onsite visit PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. WE ARE ONLY HIRING IN PHOENIX. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * We are ONLY looking for people CURRENTLY living in Phoenix Metro area \- no relocation. Are you currently located in the Phoenix Metro area? Ability to Commute: * Tempe, AZ 85282 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About CANImmunize:** CANImmunize is a Canadian\-owned technology company with over a decade of experience building best\-in\-class digital health solutions for public health. As a fully remote company, we embrace flexibility while staying closely connected across Canada. Our platforms help make immunization programs more efficient, effective, and accessible across Canada. We’re a small but mighty team that values curiosity, accountability, and kindness. Collaborative and innovative by nature, we thrive in a fast\-moving environment and take pride in the real\-world impact of our work. **The Opportunity:** We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you'll help build and improve the software that public health teams across Canada rely on every day. This opportunity is particularly well\-suited to someone early in their software development career, including recent graduates or developers with approximately zero to three years of professional experience. We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, a willingness to learn, and the curiosity to grow into a well\-rounded engineer. You'll write real code that ships to real users, with support from experienced engineers who will help you develop your skills through code reviews, pairing sessions, and day\-to\-day mentorship. **As part of the team, you’ll:** * Build and maintain features and fixes across the front end and back end. * Learn our engineering standards and best practices, and put them into practice. * Work alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to understand what we’re building and why. * Grow quickly with support from a team that genuinely invests in your development. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves solving problems, is eager to develop their skills, and wants their work to make a real difference in public health. **Key Responsibilities::** * Build \& Ship: Develop, test, and maintain well\-scoped features and bug fixes, with attention to quality, security, and reliability. * Learn the Craft: Implement solutions following the design and architectural direction set by senior engineers, and ask questions early when something is unclear. * Code Quality: Write and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end (E2E) tests. Participate in code reviews and help identify issues before release. * Collaboration: Work from well\-defined tickets, keep your work visible, and communicate proactively when you hit blockers. * Production Support: Help investigate support tickets and resolve issues with guidance from senior teammates. Shadow on\-call, building toward joining the rotation over time. * Growth: Actively seek out and apply feedback from code reviews, pairing, and mentorship to keep levelling up. * Participate in on\-call rotations to support system availability and incident response. * Other duties as required. **What You Need to Succeed::** * A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience such as co\-op, internships, a bootcamp, or substantial personal projects. * Foundational skills in TypeScript, with hands\-on experience in React and Node.js. * A basic understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and API development. * Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows: branches, pull requests, and code reviews. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Clear communication skills, including being comfortable asking questions and explaining your thinking in a remote\-first environment. * A growth mindset and openness to feedback. **Nice to Have:** * Exposure to React Native or mobile development. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD, or containerization tools like Docker. * Experience on an agile/scrum team through co\-op, internships, or school projects. * An interest in healthcare technology or public health. **What’s in it for You?:** * Competitive compensation: a strong salary, comprehensive health and dental benefits, and a profit\-sharing program so you share in our success. * Generous time off: 3 weeks paid vacation, plus 3 extra CANI Days to recharge, and a paid winter shutdown in December. * Growth that matters: a professional development budget, in\-house coaching, and mentorship to help you level up your career. * Work anywhere in Canada: we’re a fully remote team, and we’ll equip you with the tools and tech you need to do your best work. * Culture that energizes: join a high\-performing, fast\-moving team that values curiosity, kindness, and accountability. * Impact that lasts: your work will directly contribute to making healthcare more effective, accessible, and people\-focused across Canada. **Compensation:** At CANImmunize, we’re committed to paying fairly, transparently, and for growth. This role has an annual base salary range of $70,000 to $155,000\. While the broader salary band accommodates engineers at varying stages of their careers, this particular opportunity is intended for someone early in their development career, and we anticipate compensation will align with that level of experience. Where you land within the range will depend on your skills, experience, and the contributions you bring to the team. We support continued growth through regular career development conversations and performance\-based compensation reviews. **Be Yourself at Work:** At CANImmunize, we know that diverse teams build better solutions. No matter who you are or where you come from, you’ll be valued, supported, and respected as part of our community. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, just let us know. We’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We can’t wait to meet you. Come help us build the future of digital health in Canada! **Please Note:** At this time, this position is only available to applicants located in Canada. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
