jobs.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi\-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com. ***The Role:*** You'll join a small, highly collaborative team in San Francisco building the cloud platform behind some of the world's most advanced radar systems. You'll design, build, and operate both the infrastructure and the backend services that move mission\-critical sensor data from radars in the field to the operators who depend on it. The platform is in production and growing fast, and your job is to scale it as our fleet of sensors, customers, and deployments grows. ***Responsibilities:*** * Cloud Infrastructure \- design and operate our Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform: networking, Azure Container Apps, managed databases, and the CI/CD pipelines that deploy to them. * Backend Platform Services \- build and own high\-throughput Python (FastAPI) services and the data layer behind them (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, Cosmos DB) that ingest and stream real\-time sensor data. * Platform Architecture \- work with engineering teams across the company to define the architecture of the next generation of the platform. * Operations \- own security, reliability, and observability across the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network isolation, monitoring and alerting (Datadog), and incident response. **Minimum Requirements:** * Have built and operated production infrastructure in at least one major cloud \- Azure, AWS, or GCP \- defined in code with Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or CloudFormation. * Have run containerized production workloads (Docker) on a managed platform such as Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS or Fargate, Google Cloud Run, or Kubernetes. * Have strong cloud networking fundamentals: virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancers, private endpoints, and firewalls. * Have built and operated production backend services in Python, Go, or a similar language, and understand what happens under load \- concurrency, async I/O, connection pooling, and resource limits. * Are fluent in distributed systems: consistency and replication, partitioning, caching, back\-pressure, idempotency, and how systems fail \- and how to design so that they degrade gracefully. * Have scaled a production system well beyond its original design, and fixed what broke on the way. * Build securely by default \- least\-privilege access, secrets kept out of code, and patched, hardened systems \- and can explain the trade\-offs behind those choices. **Preferred Requirements:** * Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or other regulated environments (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800\-171 or 800\-53\). * Real\-time and streaming data systems: WebSockets, server\-sent events, pub/sub, and message queues. * Identity and cloud security: Entra ID, OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC, managed identities, service\-to\-service authentication, and policy as code. **Why CHAOS?** * **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company * **Additional benefits**: 401k (\+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more * **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully\-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code * **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre\-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses * **Team Growth:** 500\+ employees and counting across 5 global offices ***Salary Range: $140,000 \- 240,000*** *The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.* ### **Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.** *\#LI\-onsite*

business\-critical workflows from Python/Airflow to Go services and durable job processing, without breaking live markets. * Design pipelines that take in data from multiple providers, match the same event across them, and reconcile differences accurately and idempotently. * Build settlement logic that holds up when things go wrong, including: + Late or corrected results + Cancellations + Voided markets + Provider outages + Race conditions * Write and review design docs, set engineering standards, and lead technical decisions across teams. * Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback. * Take part in on\-call, lead incident response, and remove the causes of recurring incidents. * Work with trading, operations, compliance, and product teams across time zones. ### another backend language plus a clear willingness to work primarily in Go. * Deep Postgres knowledge, including: + Schema design + Migrations + Query performance + Transactions + Isolation levels * Experience designing distributed systems, including: + Concurrency + Idempotency + Retries + At\-least\-once processing + Failure handling * A record of leading projects that span teams and making sound architecture trade\-offs. * Clear writing, good judgment, and comfort when requirements are unclear. #### **Nice to have** * Experience with prediction markets, sportsbooks, exchanges, or sports AI, cloud technologies, platform engineering, and reliability practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, governance, security, and developer experience. * Champion modern engineering practices including automation, observability, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and AI Operations (AIOps). **Required Experience, Education and Ski Ops practices including model deployment, monitoring, governance, experimentation, and lifecycle management. * Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry. * Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, model risk management, and operational controls. * Relevant cloud, AI/ML, DevOps, or platform engineering certifications * jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer** **Monday\-Friday 8:00\-5:00** **Remote** CSC Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world, handling provision, compliance, planning, and strategy all in the same solution. In addition to tax, we pioneer new solutions in the corporate software space. We are looking for a software engineer to help us build the next generation of revolutionary tax preparation products. The Team We're a driven team that works test first, so quality belongs to everyone rather than to a separate function. Development is agent\-led, using tools like Claude Code. However, we stand behind every line of code we ship. Tech Stack We choose tools to fit the problem, so the stack is flexible. Today it centers on Python, Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.Net, and React, running on cloud infrastructure with modern CI/CD. Experience with these specifically is a plus, but strong engineers who pick up new tools quickly are what matter most. **Some of the things that you will be doing:** * Design, build, and maintain core product systems across data ingestion, computation, user interfaces, and regulatory output. * Own features end\-to\-end, from shaping requirements with the team through design, build, release, and iteration based on client feedback. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, and own the tests and tooling the team depends on. * Work with systems where data security is of utmost priority. * Turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable production code. * Write and review design documents and take part in code reviews. * Contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards, and engineering practices. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, security, and reliability. * Document systems and decisions so the team can move quickly and safely. **What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field with at least 1\-3 years of industry experience (equivalent practical experience will be considered as well). * Have contributed to shipping production systems where you helped design, build, and maintain the solution. * Proficiency in one or more modern languages, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C\#/.Net. * Experience with agent\-led development tools, such as Claude Code. * Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, relational databases, version control, and CI/CD. * Quality tests written as you build, not as an afterthought. * A product mindset: you care about whether what you build solves the user's problem, not only whether the code works. * Comfort learning an unfamiliar, complex domain quickly and independently. * Experience working alongside researchers or on problems without settled answers. * Clear written and verbal communication. **Nice to Have** * Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks. * Experience building data\-dense interfaces for expert users. * Experience with systems where correctness is audited or regulated. * Experience with containerization, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling. * Experience in an early\-stage product or startup environment. * Experience integrating with ERP, general ledger, or other financial systems. * Background in tax, regulatory, legal, accounting, or another rule\-governed domain. **What You Get Out of This** * A funded product with real regulatory stakes. * Ownership of meaningful parts of a product from early on. * A small team that shares ownership of quality. * Daily access to researchers, tax experts, and the world\-class team behind the Corptax product suite. * The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly. * Fully remote in the U.S., with occasional on\-site time or time\-zone overlap as needed. A Note from the Team Corporate software is unforgiving. A wrong number is a real problem for a real client, so everything we ship must be correct and traceable. We need engineers who test by habit, own their work, and learn a challenging domain quickly. If that sounds like the team you want to join, go ahead and apply! *Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.* \#CSC \#CSCCareers \#LI\-HL1

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · San Francisco SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. **About the role** The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10\+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences. This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next. **What you'll do** * Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales\-Led revenue lines * Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide * Stand up and maintain our media\-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation * Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it * Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self\-reported source, promo codes, click\-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue **You may be a fit if** * You have 7\+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition * You have strong SQL and python skills and are comfortable building both data pipelines and predictive models * You've run hold\-out or incrementality tests and worked with MMM and attribution models in production, and you know the limitations of each * You understand how ad platforms report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and you don't take platform\-reported numbers at face value * You communicate clearly with channel managers, Finance, and leadership, and you're honest about what the data does and doesn't support * You're self\-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** -------------------- **The Senior Software Development Enginee**r will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable enterprise applications and automation solutions. This role will contribute to Java and Spring Boot services, modern frontend applications, REST API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. The engineer will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to modernize development processes, improve application delivery, create technical documentation, and implement secure, reliable solutions comparable programming languages. * Experience developing backend services or REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular. * Working microfrontends or reusable application\-scaffolding frameworks. * Familiarity with PostgreSQL, audit logging, identity and approval workflows, or enterprise security and compliance requirements. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (Geospatial Team)
jobs.description: As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer at CMT, you'll design, build, and maintain scalable web applications that power our telematics platform. You'll work across the tech stack—from intuitive user interfaces to robust backend systems—solving complex problems in collaboration with product, design, and data teams. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, mentors others, and brings a strong sense of ownership and curiosity. Your work will directly impact how users experience CMT's products and contribute to our mission of making roads safer around the world. CMT is looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life\-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT. In this role you'll help build innovative new products such as StreetVision on top of CMT's massive body of aggregated, anonymized driving data to enable traffic safety officials, transportation planners, research institutions, and engineers to improve road safety and reduce crashes. You'll be part of a small, agile team driving new product development for our newly formed Geospatial product group. **Responsibilities:** * Solve complex problems and transform them into business solutions in collaboration with team members * Analyze and translate business and functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications suitable for implementation * Able to independently transform complex technical requirements into smaller implementable pieces; able to implement performant software solutions that are maintainable, scalable, reliable and testable * Participate in code and design reviews * Participate in the hiring process * Train and guide junior developers on proper software development procedures and methods * Follow company defined development and operational standards and processes * Provide on\-call support during business critical emergency scenarios. Support and troubleshoot production issues as needed. * Complete any additional tasks as they arise **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in a technical field * 4\+ years of relevant experience * Experience developing web applications and proficiency in web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript). * Experience with web frameworks like React and Django is a plus. * Experience designing or developing Restful APIs or web services * Knowledge of a backend development language like Python * Comfortable working with AWS services: EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS (Postgres), NoSQL * Understanding of Agile development methodologies (specifically SCRUM) * Excellent communication and collaboration skills * Customer obsessed, demonstrates initiative, has a learning mindset, takes ownership * Proven ability to deliver results * An analytical mindset **Nice to Haves:** * Experience with React UI and Typescript/Javascript * Experience creating modern web applications * Experience with Geospatial and/or map\-based visualization (Deck.gl, Google Maps) * Experience with data visualization frameworks (eCharts) **Compensation and Benefits:** * Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus * Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) * Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short\-term \& long\-term disability and parental leave * Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days \& public holidays * Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities **Base Salary Range** * The base salary range for this position is: $139,300 to $174,100\. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA **A****dditional Perks:** * Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world * Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140\+ programs across 25 countries * Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified * Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety * Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters * High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact * Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match * Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge * Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA\+, Women, Book Club, and Health \& Wellness * Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:** At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai **A****bout Cambridge Mobile Telematics:** Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world's largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world's roads and drivers safer. The company's AI\-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT's technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life\-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

2\) * Large\-scale data processing patterns * Experience handling high\-volume, high\-velocity datasets **Platform \& Operational Skills:** * Databricks job orchestration and scheduling * Cluster sizing and performance tuning * CI/CD for data platforms * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Experience with enterprise OneData / Data Mesh programs * Exposure to jobs.description: Director AI Engineer At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. jobs.title: Identity Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Senior Software Engineer \- Identity Resolution \& Master Data Management designs, builds, and operates the production identity capabilities that regulated clinical workflows depend on: matching, linking, merging, and separating identity records under auditable controls, so that clinical information lands on the correct patient and provider records across complex healthcare data flows. The engineer improves resolution quality, data integrity, and operational reliability, and every change ships through controlled, testable delivery practices. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay serve as executable evidence, and onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends those tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. The specific technology stack is discussed during the interview process. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager in Clinical Software Engineering, this senior individual contributor leads technical delivery in the identity\-resolution domain, participates in architecture and design decisions, and maintains software subject to SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site/hybrid, minimum three days per week on campus; co\-located with Caris's laboratory and clinical operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, and maintain identity\-resolution and MDM services for patient and provider data. * Develop and tune deterministic and probabilistic matching across names, addresses, dates of birth, contact information, identifiers, and other approved attributes. * Implement workflows to merge, unmerge, link, and separate records, with durable audit trails and safeguards for downstream clinical use. * Define and monitor resolution\-quality, data\-quality, performance, and reliability measures; investigate anomalies and strengthen controls. * Own the data models, APIs, and integration patterns that connect upstream and downstream clinical systems. * Partner with product management, data governance, clinical operations, compliance, and engineering to refine requirements and manage identity\-related risks. * Write and maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, data\-flow documentation, and operational runbooks. * Review code and submit work for review; contribute automated unit, integration, regression, and performance tests. * Automate recurring engineering and operational tasks: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation rather than standing process. * Instrument and support production services; participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action work. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * 3\+ of those years designing or operating entity\-resolution, record\-linkage, MDM, or comparable identity systems in production. * 2\+ of those years building system integrations through APIs, event\-driven patterns, or batch data pipelines. * A track record of implementing matching logic across multiple identity attributes and evaluating it against measurable quality controls. * Experience designing data models and remediation workflows jobs.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer who brings deep proficiency across both frontend and backend technology. As a high\-agency operator who seamlessly bridges Angular micro\-frontends with Java Spring and Python microservices on GCP, you will partner with product leadership to build complete 0\-to\-1 experiences and drive end\-to\-end execution for millions of users. If you are a true jack\-of\-all\-trades who naturally operates as the ultimate escape hatch when execution speed matters most, we want to talk to you. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A True Full\-Stack Engineer:** Jack\-of\-all\-trades and master of them too. You operate comfortably across the entire technology stack—from deep backend architecture in Java Spring and Python to fluid micro\-frontends in Angular, seamlessly switching context where others see boundaries. * **Unapologetically High\-Agency:** You don't wait for rigid handoffs or endless alignment meetings. If a feature needs a new API endpoint, a microservices update on GCP, and an intuitive UI component, you take full ownership and ship it end\-to\-end. * **Obsessed with End\-to\-End Craft:** You care just as much about the micro\-interactions and responsiveness of a web application as you do about the throughput, resilience, and latency of the microservices powering it. * **The Ultimate Escape Hatch:** When time is critical and something needs to be built or shipped *right now*, you are the engineer we call. You cut through red tape, figure out a path forward, and deliver under pressure without missing a beat. * **Mission\-Driven \& Relentless:** You embrace nimble, fast\-moving environments. You seek to eliminate unnecessary friction, navigate complex systems effortlessly, and take pride in building software that directly impacts millions of people. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Staff Individual Contributor driving end\-to\-end technical execution across our consumer health products. You will be equipped with modern tools, given clear ownership, and empowered to build complete user experiences from the database layer to the frontend UI. In this role, you will: * **Build End\-to\-End Solutions:** Architect, write, and deploy complete product slices—building scalable Java Spring / Python backend services on GCP and crafting white\-labeled micro\-frontends in Angular. * **Drive Rapid POCs \& Prototyping:** Partner directly with Product Managers to take raw 0\-to\-1 ideas and rapidly transform them into polished, production\-ready experiences. * **Elevate Engineering Standards:** Raise the bar for code quality, deployment speed, and system architecture across both frontend and backend domains. * **Optimize Full\-Stack Performance:** Bridge the gap between server response times and client\-side rendering to create ultra\-fast, seamless consumer experiences for millions of users. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Experience:** 8\+ years of software engineering experience spanning both frontend and backend software development at scale. * **Backend Mastery:** Strong expertise in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and/or Python, with a track record of building resilient, high\-throughput RESTful microservices on GCP. * **Frontend Mastery:** Deep expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks (Angular preferred, but React/Vue expertise welcomed) with experience building scalable micro\-frontends or design systems. * **Full\-Stack Ownership:** Proven capability to take complete ownership of complex features, delivering both backend endpoints and UI components end\-to\-end. * **Systems \& Architecture:** Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (GCP), CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments, and micro\-frontend architectures. * **Communication:** Exceptional ability to articulate end\-to\-end architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and product requirements across both technical and non\-technical teams. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and benefits package. * **Unmatched Autonomy:** Full freedom to operate across the entire stack with minimal bureaucracy and zero context\-switching friction. * **High\-Visibility Impact:** Direct ownership over key consumer features that scale to millions of healthcare users. * **Work That Matters:** Build technology where seamless user experience and backend efficiency directly enable people to access the healthcare they need. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. As an AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize advanced AI interactions to power production\-grade software applications. You will move beyond basic prompt drafting to build robust, scalable, and reliable AI systems utilizing state\-of\-the\-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Your role is critical in orchestrating autonomous AI agents, implementing **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines, and establishing **rigorous testing and observability frameworks**. You will bridge the gap between complex business logic and machine intelligence, ensuring high\-quality, safe, and deterministic AI behaviors. **What You Will Do:** **Prompt Architecture \& Tuning** * **Design Advanced Prompts:** Architect, version, and refine highly effective system, contextual, and dynamic prompts using advanced techniques (e.g., Chain\-of\-Thought, Tree\-of\-Thoughts, ReAct, Few\-Shot learning). * **Mitigate Risks:** Minimize model hallucinations, jailbreaking, and prompt injections through programmatic guardrails and robust adversarial prompting strategies. * **Model Agnostic Tuning:** Adapt, benchmark, and fine\-tune prompt structures across diverse open\-source and proprietary frontier models. **Agentic Workflows \& RAG Systems** * **Build AI Agents:** Design and orchestrate multi\-agent systems and multi\-step reasoning workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain. * **Optimize RAG Pipelines:** Integrate and fine\-tune Retrieval\-Augmented Generation architectures, managing semantic search, chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database queries. * **Tool Execution:** Implement precise function\-calling and tool\-use prompts enabling LLMs to interact reliably with external APIs, databases, and legacy codebases. **Testing, Evaluation \& Observability** * Build automated testing suites using RAGAS and **Evals** frameworks to assess RAG accuracy and enable continuous validation and benchmarking of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation outputs across datasets and Models . * **Agent Testing:** Build automated regression testing suites and CI/CD pipelines to validate prompt stability, agent trajectory correctness, and tool\-calling accuracy. * **Implement LLM Observability:** Set up production monitoring and observability systems using platforms like Azure Application insights, Microsoft Foundry. * **Monitor Metrics:** Track, analyze, and optimize production runtime metrics including semantic drift, token usage, cost efficiencies, and end\-to\-end latency. **Collaboration \& Continuous Innovation** * **Cross\-Functional Delivery:** Work alongside Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to translate commercial requirements into deterministic AI capabilities. * **Technology Scouting:** Keep pace with rapid weekly advancements in LLM capabilities, evaluation frameworks, and orchestration libraries to sustain a competitive edge. **What You Have:** * Core Prompt Engineering: Expert\-level mastery of structured prompt formats (XML, JSON wrappers), system\-level steering, and context\-window optimization. * Production Programming: High proficiency in Python or TypeScript for constructing backend AI logic, processing asynchronous data streams, and handling API integrations. * Orchestration Frameworks: Hands\-on experience building apps using LangChain, LangGraph, native SDKs. * Vector Infrastructure: Solid experience working with vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, AWS Open Search) and hybrid search retrieval methods. * Data \& ML Fundamentals: Strong capabilities in data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), data cleaning, token handling, and foundational understanding of NLP transformers. **Top Candidates Will Have** * **AI Observability Stacks:** Prior implementation of Application Insights, OpenLLMetry, or custom evaluation/guardrail layers. * **Machine Learning Systems:** Knowledge of deep learning architectures, fine\-tuning frameworks (QLoRA, PEFT), and platforms like Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience deploying containerized AI microservices using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP. * **Education:** Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, Mathematics, or a highly technical discipline. * **Experience:** 2\+ years of dedicated professional experience developing production software integrated with GenAI/LLM pipelines. * **Track Record:** Proven portfolio demonstrating successfully deployed RAG systems or operational AI agents in commercial environments. **Additional Info**: * The required location for this role is East Peoria\-IL, Irving\-TX **About Caterpillar –** For more than a century, Caterpillar has helped build a better, more sustainable world. With 2025 sales and revenues of $67\.6 billion, Caterpillar Inc. is shaping the future as the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off\-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel\-electric locomotives. Backed by one of the largest independent global dealer networks and financing services through Cat Financial, the company’s primary business segments: Power \& Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries are solving customers’ toughest challenges through commercial excellence and advanced technology, driven by a highly skilled, dedicated global team. Learn more at www.caterpillar.com. **Summary Pay Range:** $97,530\.00 \- $158,480\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. **Benefits:** Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision benefits\* * Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\* * 401(k) savings plans\* * Health Savings Account (HSA)\* * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\* * Health Lifestyle Programs\* * Employee Assistance Program\* * Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\* * Career Development\* * Incentive bonus\* * Disability benefits * Life Insurance * Parental leave * Adoption benefits * Tuition Reimbursement * These benefits also apply to part\-time employees This position requires working onsite five days a week. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:** October 27, 2026 \- November 8, 2026 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve the ML API layer that makes this heterogeneous serving system accessible, reliable, and easy to use. You will own significant features and components across our inference APIs, model integration layer, and request\-routing services, delivering a consistent experience across models and accelerator backends. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning systems, API design, model serving, and distributed systems. You will translate evolving model capabilities and customer requirements into clear designs, lead implementation across multiple components, and carry features through validation, rollout, and production operation. Your work will help ensure that streaming, sampling, tool use, structured outputs, multimodal inputs, and model configuration behave correctly and consistently. You will work closely with model enablement, compiler, runtime, cloud infrastructure, product, and customer\-facing teams, as well as customers directly. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role with opportunities to lead small project teams, mentor engineers, and improve the quality and reliability of production inference software. **Responsibilities** * **Own features end to end.** Design, implement, test, and operate features for chat completions, text generation, streaming, model configuration, tool calling, structured outputs, multimodal inputs, and emerging inference capabilities. * **Lead multi\-component delivery.** Write clear design documents, evaluate technical tradeoffs, break projects into deliverable milestones, and coordinate implementation with a small group of engineers and partner teams. * **Deliver consistent API behavior.** Implement clear request and response semantics across GPU prefill, Cerebras decode, and other inference backends. Maintain compatibility with widely adopted inference interfaces and evolve owned APIs through validation, versioning, and deprecation best practices. * **Enable new models and capabilities.** Integrate foundation models, tokenizers, chat templates, generation configuration, sampling methods, and model\-specific features into the serving platform. * **Integrate serving components.** Extend inference services and their integration with frameworks and runtimes such as vLLM, PyTorch, Hugging Face libraries, LLGuidance, and Cerebras runtime components. * **Support disaggregated inference.** Implement routing, state\-transfer integration, error handling, retries, cancellation, and request lifecycle management to coordinate GPU prefill with Cerebras decode. * **Deliver measurable performance improvements.** Diagnose bottlenecks and improve time to first token, streaming latency, throughput, and resource efficiency through changes to tokenization, serialization, batching, scheduling, and communication. * **Own correctness and release quality.** Build conformance tests, model\-validation suites, numerical comparisons, integration tests, and performance benchmarks that catch regressions in owned features and support safe releases. * **Strengthen production reliability.** Improve service metrics, tracing, logging, alerts, and diagnostic tools. Investigate production incidents, resolve root causes, and follow through on improvements to resilience and incident response. * **Improve customer and developer experience.** Partner with product, support, and solutions teams to understand user needs and make practical tradeoffs. Improve configuration, documentation, examples, and debugging workflows. * **Raise the engineering quality bar.** Provide thoughtful design and code reviews, mentor less\-experienced engineers, share domain knowledge, and proactively remove delivery roadblocks. **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including independent ownership of production services, distributed systems, or substantial software components. * Strong programming ability in Python and proficiency in Go, C\+\+, Rust, or another language used to build production services. * Experience designing and delivering features that span multiple components, including documenting designs, evaluating tradeoffs, and coordinating implementation with other engineers. * Experience building and evolving production APIs, with sound practices for validation, error handling, compatibility, and testing. Familiarity with REST, gRPC, or streaming protocols. * Experience integrating software across service, framework, runtime, or infrastructure boundaries. * Experience operating services on Linux using containers, Kubernetes or comparable orchestration systems, and CI/CD. * Ability to diagnose correctness, reliability, and performance issues across distributed components and deliver measurable improvements. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience leading technical delivery for a small project and supporting other engineers through reviews or mentorship. * Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into maintainable software while balancing customer needs, delivery timelines, and operational quality. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building or operating production ML or LLM inference APIs, including OpenAI\-compatible interfaces. * Experience extending or contributing to vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Triton, TensorRT\-LLM, or another ML systems project. * Understanding of tokenization, chat templates, generation configuration, logits processing, stopping criteria, tool calling, structured generation, or constrained decoding. * Experience with disaggregated prefill/decode architectures, KV\-cache transfer, prefix caching, chunked prefill, or inference request scheduling. * Experience building API conformance, model\-quality, numerical\-comparison, determinism, or performance\-regression test systems. * Experience with multi\-model or multi\-tenant serving, including routing, admission control, quotas, rate limiting, or capacity\-aware scheduling. * Experience developing performance\-sensitive or highly concurrent services in Go, C\+\+, Rust, or a similar language. * Familiarity with GPU inference, AMD Instinct accelerators, ROCm, CUDA, collective communication, or multi\-node model serving. * Familiarity with reduced\-precision inference and quantization formats such as BF16, FP8, FP4, INT8, or INT4\. * Experience building SDKs, developer tools, configuration systems, or self\-service ML workflows, or collaborating directly with customers and open\-source communities. **Why Join Cerebras** People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: * Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. * Publish and open source their cutting\-edge AI research. * Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. * Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. * Our simple, non\-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. **Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!** *Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

jobs.title: Support Engineer (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
jobs.description: *(Remote, US East Coast or the same time zone. Series B. DevTools SaaS. Synthetic monitoring. 40h/week)* The best developers don’t wait for a customer to tell them something’s broken. They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly’s whole reason to exist. Now that agents write and ship more and more code, they can carry that instinct too. Agents write, run, and maintain the monitoring setup that guards production, while developers stay in control. Everything is defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, and versioned and reviewed like everything else that ships. From pull request to post\-mortem, in one place. AI agents are shipping more code than any team can review, and reliability is lagging behind. Checkly closes this gap. As a Support Engineer, you’ll support our most valuable customers, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password on that journey. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. We’re a remote\-first startup that is low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love actually listening to and working with customers, working async, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in! We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a flexible and async\-first startup environment with inclusive benefits and full transparency about how we pay. **What you’ll do** ================== Support has always been about solving real problems for real people. What’s changing at Checkly is how we do it: AI lets us automate routine work and assist us with troubleshooting, so we can go deeper on hard cases and bring what customers tell us straight back to the product. Here’s where you come in: * **Resolve customer issues.** Debug Playwright tests (flaky selectors, timeouts, auth flows). Dig into API check failures with packet captures (PCAPs), traceroutes and timing breakdowns. Set up single sign\-on (SSO) and SAML. When it’s a bug, bring engineering a clean reproduction, or open the pull request (PR) yourself. * **Build an outstanding AI support process.** Our internal and external support agents already resolve 80% of tickets. You’ll help lift the bar: what the agent answers, when it hands off to a human, and how good those answers are. * **Turn tickets into product.** Spot patterns across customers and bring product and engineering a reproduction. Your work becomes bug fixes and features. * **Own the docs.** If you’ve answered something twice, it belongs in the docs and in the agent, so customers and AI get the same right answer. * **Work with modern tooling.** We are continuously updating our workbench, and you’ll have modern tools like Plain, Linear, and Mintlify. ### **This won't be the right role if you...** * Want a clear process for every situation before you act. * Would rather code all day than talk to customers. * See AI tools as something you’ll get around to eventually. * Want the structure and pace of a large company. **What you should have** ======================== You will often speak with developers who need assistance understanding if their applications work well and if not, what caused the issue. This requires a solid technical background and a genuine motivation to help and learn. * Empathy: You love working with customers and solving their problems. For this role, the range is * $57,500 \- $70,000 for someone in the US * $71,910 \- $87,000 for someone in US Tier 1 locations like NYC, Boston * $43,000 \- $52,000 for someone in e.g. South America **Apply** ========= If this sounds interesting, please apply! jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Circleback** -------------------- Circleback is building the source of truth for everything said at a company–starting with best\-in\-class AI meeting notes, action items, and search. Every company runs on conversations — meetings, calls, emails — but almost none of that context is usable after the fact. We’re building the platform that captures, organizes, and acts on all of it, so teams can actually use what they know. We're a small team backed by Y Combinator. Profitable, growing virally, and thousands of paying customers including PostHog, Browserbase, Gumloop, and more. **Why join** ------------ * We ship fast with a high bar for quality. * Small team, large problem: the category we're building didn't exist a few years ago. * Profitable and growing virally through word of mouth, not paid acquisition. * Build software people actually love and use every day. * Free lunch and dinners, competitive salary and equity. * Flexible health coverage and 401K matching. **The Role** ------------ Circleback grows through the product itself. People get notes from a meeting with someone already using it, like what they see, and try it — then it spreads inside their company. This is a growth engineering role for someone who wants to make that loop work better. You'll work closely with our Founding Marketer, who owns channels and brand, while you focus on what happens inside the product. You'll work directly with the founders and ship across the stack as part of a small team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Improve every step of the product\-led loop: the notes a non\-user receives after a meeting, signup, onboarding, and activation. * Figure out why Circleback spreads to the whole team at some companies and stays with a few people at others, and build the product changes that close that gap. * Build and maintain our analytics and experimentation foundation: event instrumentation, attribution, dashboards, and A/B tests the whole team trusts. * Improve retention by learning what keeps people using Circleback long term and getting more people there. * Ship in\-product growth surfaces like upgrade flows, referral tools, and integrations. You'll work in web (React, Next.js, Prisma, SWR), desktop (Electron, Swift), and mobile (React Native). * Work with the Founding Marketer on what to test, and share what you learn. **You might be a good fit if** ------------------------------ * You've shipped production software, including growth experiments, and you've instrumented a funnel yourself (signup conversion, activation, or retention). * You're comfortable digging into data yourself, whether that's writing queries or reading a funnel, and you're as happy doing that as shipping a feature. * You care about users as much as implementation. * You have strong product judgment and care about experiments that move signup, activation, or retention. * You're low ego, direct, and comfortable operating without much process. People who've thrived here have often been former founders, early startup engineers, or engineers who've owned features end\-to\-end. You don't need that exact background—we care much more about how you think and what you've built. **Interview Process** --------------------- * Recruiter screen * Hiring manager conversation, including a walkthrough of a growth experiment you've shipped * Technical interview * Paid two\-day work trial in San Francisco Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

appropriate secrets management. * Containerize and deploy services through CI/CD pipelines to Azure Container Apps (ACA), with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) where workload requirements justify it. * Integrate Azure Monitor and application telemetry for logs, metrics, tracing, incident investigation, and operational support. * Review code, guide implementation decisions, troubleshoot complex production defects, and mentor other engineers while remaining an active developer. * Work with AI leadership, application teams, architecture, cybersecurity, model risk, legal, and business stakeholders to deliver governed banking AI solutions. Service. * Experience with PostgreSQL or Azure Database for PostgreSQL, persistent workflow state, and object storage. * Experience with enterprise document processing and financial data extraction. * fraud, or risk workflows. * Experience with model governance, explainability, human oversight, and responsible AI practices. jobs.title: Software Engineer, PowerClerk
jobs.description: ### **Who Are We?** Looking for a job that makes a real difference in our world today and one that you’ll be proud of when you look back in 20, 30 or 40 years? This is it. Clean Power Research® is advancing the energy transformation through cloud software that informs, streamlines and values energy\-related decisions and processes for utilities, energy professionals and consumers. We’re a growing company that counts 10 of the top 10 Fortune 500 utilities and many of the largest renewable energy companies in the U.S. as our customers. We’re focused on expanding our market reach and impact with new software technologies that help solve the energy industry’s hardest problems. At Clean Power Research, every employee has a seat at the table and an important role. ### **Why Work Here?** * Go from building solutions to being part of the solution * Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas \& Electric * Bring your passion and ideas to the table * Use your creativity to solve hard problems and make tough decisions * Work in a start\-up like environment coupled with the stability and customer base of an established, profitable company * Realize work\-life balance; we like to see our families, friends and pets at night! * Join a growing company that expects you to grow with us and invests in your growth Clean Power Research offers competitive compensation and benefits to full\-time employees including medical/dental/vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, a bonus plan and 401(k) plan with matching. ### **What You’ll Be Doing as a Software Engineer** Our Engineering Team develops Software\-as\-a\-Service (Saas) solutions hosted in the cloud using sophisticated development tools and cutting\-edge cloud infrastructure. As a software engineer, you’ll be learning and contributing to the development of highly scalable, reliable, performant and secure software products. One of the interesting and fun challenge you’ll face here is: **Energy resource workflow automation** On the PowerClerk® team, you’ll work on the leading software service for utility program automation. PowerClerk powers the rollout and adoption of distributed energy resources (e.g., solar, batteries/storage and electric vehicles) at some of the largest utilities in the U.S. by digitizing utility programs through intuitive, self\-service interfaces that enable extensive process automation as well as utility back\-end system integration. You’ll be writing code used by hundreds of thousands of utility employees, utility customers and energy industry professionals that helps these energy technologies get installed and have an impact. This is a full\-stack position where you’ll design, build, and own features end\-to\-end. You’ll be using C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks and SQL in a cloud\-hosted (AWS) environment. You’ll be part of an agile, empowered and high\-performing team. You’ll have exposure to customers and the business, and be an important participant in product, design and technology decisions. ### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Deliver high\-quality code and features with a high\-degree of ownership * Participate in writing test automation (unit tests and integration tests) and be part of a combined engineering team * Collaborate with other team members to define the product and make it great * Participate in release testing, monitoring of performance and functionality of the service in production * Effectively use modern AI\-assisted development tools to support software development activities including writing and understanding code, troubleshooting issues, developing tests, and improving developer productivity ### **Who You Are** * 1\+ years of professional software development experience * Someone who has strong aptitude for problem solving and consistently delivers high quality code * BA/BS or MS degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline * Experience in building web applications/services using C\#/ASP.NET/SQL and running in a cloud\-hosted environment is a plus * Some experience with AI\-assisted development tools and a strong interest and willingness to learn, adopt, and become proficient with AI tools as part of the software development process * Passion for renewables and for advancing the energy transition to clean energy ### **Pay Range and Benefits** * Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 annual depending on experience * Benefits: Performance\-Based Bonus, Company Equity Plan * Benefits: Paid Time Off, Sick Time, Holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision/Life and Disability Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Commuter Benefits ### **How To Apply** Click the link below to submit your resume. Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position and the renewable energy space along with your resume. Due to the large number of applicants for our positions, we regret that we can only respond to candidates who meet our requirements. Clean Power Research is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. The company’s employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

jobs.title: Associate AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Description: CleanSlate Technology Group (CSTG) is a modern technology consulting firm transforming how organizations use Data, AI, and Cloud Modernization to fuel innovation. As a top\-tier cloud partner, we design and deliver AI solutions and modern data platforms that unlock the power of data, accelerate transformation, and enable businesses to build what's next. We help clients accelerate their AI journey with security and governance built on a strong data foundation. With an operational mindset, we break through legacy limitations, simplify complexity, and create future\-ready technology foundations that inspire new possibilities. At CSTG, you'll be part of a team that empowers organizations to innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and compete boldly in a rapidly evolving digital world. Through our Data and AI Practice, we partner with clients to build scalable, reliable data foundations across AWS and Azure. Our focus is on modern data engineering, developing data platforms and pipelines that enable analytics, machine learning, and AI in real world production environments. We believe strong data engineering is critical to making AI useful, trustworthy, and sustainable. CSTG consultants combine proven engineering practices with a hands\-on consulting mindset, helping clients move from strategy to implementation while delivering solutions aligned to real business needs. **What does your team look like:** Our teams bring together CSTG consultants and client stakeholders to solve complex data and AI challenges. As an Associate AI/ML Engineer, you will collaborate with AI/ML, data, and application engineers, developing your primary skills in AI and machine learning while learning how data platforms and applications support reliable, production\-ready solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem\-solving, and a willingness to learn from others. **What does your role look like:** As an Associate AI/ML Engineer in CSTG’s Data and AI Practice, you will support client delivery by completing well\-defined development, testing, and documentation tasks with guidance from experienced engineers. Your work will contribute to AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based use cases, that become part of client production systems. Associate AI/ML Engineers apply established techniques and learn AI and ML engineering best practices through assigned project work, code reviews, and feedback from experienced team members. You will communicate progress, ask questions, and raise blockers within the delivery team. As you build familiarity with the work, you will participate in client discussions with support from more experienced consultants. Success in this role means completing assigned work with increasing independence, incorporating feedback, documenting results, and building sound engineering habits. Your focus will be on reliable contributions to team delivery while developing experience with real\-world AI solutions. **Responsibilities:** * Development and integration: Complete assigned development tasks for client AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based capabilities, using established approaches and guidance from experienced engineers. * Build and test defined components of AI workflows, services, and integrations alongside data and application platforms, following team designs and review processes. * Apply established AI techniques, patterns, and tools to solve well\-defined problems. * Testing and evaluation: Run established tests and evaluation procedures, document results and model limitations, and raise unexpected outputs or data quality concerns for review. * Participate in design discussions, reviews, and team feedback sessions. * Production delivery support: Collaborate with data and application engineers on assigned tasks that help prepare AI solutions for production, following established testing, deployment, and review procedures. * Responsible AI: Follow project guidance for data usage, bias, transparency, and privacy. Document concerns and seek guidance before using data or sharing outputs when requirements are unclear. * Code quality and documentation: Write clear, maintainable code for assigned tasks, participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and document implementation details and test results. * Continue developing skills in AI, machine learning, and production delivery practices. Requirements: * Foundational hands\-on experience building or supporting AI or machine learning solutions through professional work, internships, coursework, research, or personal projects. * Foundational Python skills, including the ability to write, read, and debug simple code for data preparation or AI and machine learning tasks; experience may come from work, coursework, or projects. * Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, or agent\-based approaches. * Foundational experience preparing or working with structured or unstructured data for AI use cases, including checking data quality; coursework and project experience are welcome. * Foundational understanding of version control and tooling such as Git * Exposure to deploying solutions across multistage environments (development, test, and production) * Familiarity with AWS, Databricks, or Azure services. * Understanding of foundational data engineering concepts, such as data pipelines and data quality. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly within a team and with client stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to LLM platforms or tools such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or similar. * Agentic tooling like AWS Quick/Claude/Copilot/OpenClaw/Dots/Grok Bot. * Exposure to Agentic development with tooling like Claude Code/Kiro/Cursor. * Exposure to MLOps practices, including model versioning or monitoring. * Experience working alongside data engineering teams on shared solutions. * AWS, Azure, or entry\-level AI/ML certifications. * Databricks or Snowflake certifications or willingness to obtain them. * Claude certifications or a willingness to obtain them.

jobs.title: Senior Smart Contract Engineer
jobs.description: **About CoinList** CoinList is building the distribution network for onchain capital markets. Through its Passage platform, CoinList provides the infrastructure that lets any wallet, app, or platform embed access to tokenized assets, from equities and funds to token sales and other real\-world assets, through a single integration. With a network of over 12M investors and more than $1\.2B in transactions, CoinList connects asset issuers with the platforms and investors who want access to them. Today, CoinList is scaling two core businesses: * Passage (B2B Infrastructure) (passage.coinlist.co): "Onchain Infrastructure for Capital Markets." Passage allows issuers to run compliant raises on our platform or embed CoinList’s deal flow into their own products via APIs and SDKs. * The Consumer Marketplace (coinlist.co): The world's leading destination to invest in token sales, pre\-IPO stocks, tokenized equities, and on\-chain funds. Through its token sale platform, CoinList has launched many of the leading crypto protocols including Solana, Near, USD.AI, and Ondo. **About This Role** We have a strong engineering team with deep expertise in infrastructure, blockchain, and specialized domains. We are looking for a smart contract engineer who can **build smart contracts** to integrate with different asset providers (Ondo, Centrifuge, etc.). Those smart contracts act as a proxy between our users and the underlying assets. They offer a common interface so we can build similar products on top of them. You'd be joining a small engineering team and directly reporting to the CTO in a greenfield\-heavy environment where your work directly affects velocity, company direction, and revenue. **What You'll Do** * **You’ll ship contracts to mainnet.** We are investing in Solidity on EVM chains. This is where most of your work will live, reviewed by external auditors, deployed, and holding user funds. We move fast while keeping the technical bar as high as possible. * **You’ll design contract systems, not just functions.** As a senior engineer, we expect you to design systems from the ground up, including boundaries, interfaces, storage layout, upgrade strategy, access control, and emergency paths. You’ll also help decide what even belongs onchain at all. * **You’ll be an owner.** As part of a small team, everyone owns meaningful work, whether it’s the contracts behind a critical token sale or leading our onchain work on a new product. * **You’ll treat security as the job.** Adversarial review of your colleagues’ contracts and of external audit findings, fuzzing and invariant tests, deployment rehearsals on testnets, and monitoring and incident response are all expected. * **You’ll rapidly grow and improve.** You’ll be working with incredibly smart engineers who love to learn and teach each other. And if you want to extend your craft to Rust and the Solana runtime, we’ll invest in that with you. **Requirements** **What We're Looking For** * You bring over 7 years of professional working experience, including at least 2 years of writing Solidity that reached production. * You know the EVM from the inside. Storage layout and packing, gas mechanics, memory versus calldata versus storage, ABI encoding, events and indexing, contract size limits, and the tradeoffs hiding inside each one. * You know the modern Solidity patterns. Proxies and upgradeability, role\-based access control, signature verification and replay protection (EIP\-712\), reentrancy and oracle or price\-manipulation defenses. * You have real tooling and testing discipline. Foundry (preferred) or Hardhat, fork tests, fuzzing and invariants, and a testing workflow you can justify from first principles rather than because it’s what the tutorial did. * You think like an attacker before you ship. You ask what a flash loan, an MEV bot, or a malicious token does to your code, and you write down what you find. * You like to ship high\-quality code. You make deadlines for yourself, and you move fast. You focus on the things that matter and push back on things that don’t. People know they can count on you to get things done. **How You Work** * You're AI\-fluent. You integrate AI tools into your daily workflow naturally (not for token\-burning, just for moving faster). * You're product\-minded. You care about what you're building and why, not just how. * You're independent but collaborative. You can move fast on your own and know when to loop others in. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need perfect requirements to start building. * You have strong written communication, which is especially important in a distributed, remote\-first team. **Other Preferred Qualifications** * Rust and Anchor, or Solana programs in production: SPL tokens, program\-derived addresses, token extensions, compute\-unit optimization. * DeFi protocol depth: lending, AMMs, vaults (ERC\-4626\), staking and reward accounting. * Account abstraction (ERC\-4337\): smart accounts, paymasters, bundlers. **Benefits** Remote Work \& Time Zones * Fully remote, U.S. based * We're primarily based on the US East and West Coasts, but you should be comfortable overlapping some hours with non\-US time zones to work with employees abroad. Compensation \& Benefits * Base Salary: $170,000 – $190,000 (based on experience and jurisdiction) * Equity: CoinList is a high\-growth startup, and equity is a significant part of your total compensation. * Benefits: * + Medical, dental, and vision at no monthly cost (US only) + Unlimited PTO + Monthly AI tool budget At CoinList, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
