jobs.description: **EAM System Engineer** Help strengthen the systems that keep manufacturing operations running. As ConMet’s EAM (Equipment Asset Management) System Engineer, you’ll support the launch and ongoing improvement of our equipment and asset management platform, working closely with maintenance, purchasing, operations, and IT teams. Initially, you’ll help set up and deploy the system. As it evolves, you’ll take responsibility for its administration, maintenance, updates, user support, and continuous improvement. You’ll help keep information about manufacturing equipment, employees, and spare\-parts inventory accurate and current so teams can manage assets effectively and make informed operational decisions. **Work location:** This is an on\-site position at ConMet’s corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Washington; it is not hybrid or remote. Candidates outside the area must be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance is available. **Work authorization:** ConMet is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role, including H\-1B, TN, or other work visas. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship. **Key Duties** * Work cross\-functionally with plant teams, corporate manufacturing engineering, and corporate IT to maintain, update, and improve the EAM system. * Develop and produce total cost\-of\-ownership and operating reports and data. * Serve as a first\-line resource for employees by providing coaching and training on EAM use, deploying new hardware, troubleshooting issues, and responding to user requests. * Travel regionally and internationally as required. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering and at least three years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment, including experience with software that supports operations. * Experience with relational databases; Microsoft SQL is preferred. * At least three years of CMMS/EAM experience * Travel regionally and internationally as required. **Preferred** * Ultimo experience is a plus. * Knowledge of or experience with MRP/ERP systems; SAP is preferred. * Experience planning, engineering, and integrating data exchanges among EAM, MRP/ERP, MES, and Tableau. * Experience preparing financial estimates and proposals for software systems or modifications, writing purchase orders, and managing subcontractors. * Knowledge of or experience with manufacturing quality systems. **About ConMet** ConMet, an Amsted Industries company, has advanced the commercial vehicle industry since 1964\. Designed, engineered, tested, and manufactured in\-house, our portfolio is built to enhance vehicle efficiency, performance, and sustainability. jobs.title: Information Security Operations
jobs.description: Looking to make a meaningful impact on your community? At Connex Credit Union, we’re seeking passionate and diverse individuals who are driven to help improve the financial well\-being of others. At Connex, you’re more than an employee, you’re part of a team that values trust, collaboration, and delivering exceptional service. With a strong history of success and a commitment to our employees, members, and communities, we continue to grow while creating opportunities for our team members to thrive. If you’re looking for a rewarding career where you can make a difference, grow professionally, and be part of an inclusive organization, we encourage you to join us on our mission. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * Paid time off * 401(k) plan with company match * Tuition reimbursement opportunities * Opportunities to participate in community outreach and make a local impact Join a team where your work matters and your contributions make a difference. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as the Information Security Operations Leader. The Information Security Operations Leader is a hands\-on leadership role that is responsible for the design, performance, planning, budgeting, securing, monitoring, and integration of Cybersecurity initiatives across Connex. You will play a crucial role in refining and creating processes related to the Risk Management Framework (RMF), threat/vulnerability analysis, penetration testing, and reporting exercises. Your primary objective is to enhance Connex’s cybersecurity capabilities and incident threat response processes to ensure they meet company requirements and industry standards. As the Information Security Operations Leader, you will be responsible for safeguarding the organization's information systems and data assets. You will play a key role in implementing and maintaining security measures to protect against cyber threats, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of their systems. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Deliver on cybersecurity initiatives at the credit union. Coordinates with internal teams and external vendors to ensure the cybersecurity resilience of the credit union is tested frequently. * Oversees audits and evaluations of the cybersecurity environment. Manages the planning, documentation, testing, integration, and execution of cybersecurity projects including annual budgeting and coordination of vendor responsibilities. * Conduct risk assessments, analyze security controls, and provide recommendations for improvements. * Assist in the development and maintenance of our Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes and documentation. * Collaborate with the internal teams and external vendors to assess, document, and authorize information systems using the RMF. * Develop and implement information security policies, procedures, and standards. * Monitor and defend our systems against cyber threats. Provide incident detection, analysis, and response, helping to improve our overall security posture. * Participate in conducting regular vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on our IT infrastructure, applications, and networks. * Provide support in identifying vulnerabilities, reporting findings, and assisting with remediation efforts. * Provide support in analyzing security incidents and breaches. Monitor security logs and respond to security incidents in a timely manner. * Proactively search for threats and vulnerabilities within our environment. Conduct incident handling and coordination, ensuring a rapid and effective response to security events. * Ensure that all cybersecurity activities are conducted in accordance with government policies, standards, and requirements relevant to national security systems. * Collaborate with IT and development teams to integrate security measures into the design and implementation of systems. * Maintain accurate records of all activities, including findings, actions taken, and recommendations for improvement. * Contribute to the development of reports and documentation related to cybersecurity exercises. * Stay informed about the latest security threats, technologies, trends and best practices. * Conduct security awareness training for employees. * Design and implement security controls for networks, systems, and applications. * Security Policies: Establish and enforce security policies, procedures, and guidelines to protect digital assets, sensitive trade data, and intellectual property. * Risk Management: Conduct regular risk assessments and vulnerability scans to identify and address potential risks and develop risk mitigation plans to safeguard the organization against cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Be responsible for the business fraud investigation and mitigation. * Incident Response: Create and maintain an effective incident response plan, ensuring timely and efficient recovery from security breaches and disruptions. * Incident Investigation and Forensics: Carry out thorough research and investigation on security incidents. Work with internal teams and external vendors to conduct research and forensics. * Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with all related regulatory bodies. * Security Awareness: Develop and oversee a security awareness program to educate employees, members, and stakeholders about best practices in cybersecurity. * Vendor Security: Evaluate and monitor the security practices of third\-party vendors, partners, and service providers. * Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, such as customs authorities, shipping partners, and regulatory bodies, to ensure security standards and trade compliance. * Reporting: Provide regular reports and updates to executive management and the board of directors on the state of cybersecurity and compliance. **Performance Measurements (if applicable):** * Establish reasonable timeframes for completion of all projects and tasks and completes projects and tasks within that timeframe. * Ensure clean audits or audit resolutions within departmental service metrics. * Maintains service desk response(s) to departmental service metrics. * Ensures clean annual disaster recovery testing and responds to disasters according to departmental service metrics. * Oversees day to day monitoring and management of cybersecurity projects, tools, technologies and vendors and responds to incidents and issues in a timely and thorough fashion. * Anticipates system and network risks and assures adequate safeguards. * Works collaboratively and effectively with other teams and departments. **Qualifications and Requirements:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or equivalent and appropriate work experience. * Industry\-recognized certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA. * Knowledge of threat/vulnerability analysis, penetration testing, and red\-team/blue\-team exercises. * Excellent communication and teamwork skills. * Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies and methodologies. * Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work accurately. * A collaborative mindset and willingness to work with colleagues to achieve shared goals. * Proven experience as an Information Security Engineer or similar role. * Strong knowledge of information security principles and best practices. * Experience with security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and encryption. * Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR). * Hands\-on experience with security tools and technologies. * Proven experience in a leadership role in information security, with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience. * Strong understanding of banking/credit union operations, regulatory requirements, and financial procedures. * In\-depth knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, tools, and best practices. * Exceptional communication and leadership skills. * Ability to adapt to a dynamic environment and make critical decisions under pressure. * Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) security. * Experience with DevOps and security automation. * Experience with security awareness training and education. * Experience evaluating and managing cyber risk and working within industry\-standard frameworks (e.g. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Top 20, NIST 800\-XX, etc.) * Knowledgeable of methodologies such as Cyber Kill Chain and Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis models. * Experience with cloud computing, networks, servers, operating systems and PCs is mandatory. * Experience with ATM/ITM networks is preferred. * Ability to solve complex analytical and/or project related problems. * Lifting boxes up to 50 lbs. * On call after hours.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Platform and AWS
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer \- Digital Platform and AWS (260807\)**Our Commitment to You** At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it. All official communication from Consumer Cellular will come from a @consumercellular.com email address or through our verified texting platform, which will only be used to schedule interviews. We will never ask for personal and financial information during the recruiting process. If you receive outreach that doesn't match these criteria, please do not engage and feel free to verify directly at talentacquisition@consumercellular.com. **Job Summary** Consumer Cellular is building a new cloud\-native platform on Amazon Web Services, and we are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the services that run on it. This is a hands\-on product engineering role. You will design and ship the APIs and event\-driven services behind our customer\-facing digital experiences\- account management, activation, billing, and self\-service \- using a serverless\-first architecture on AWS. You will work in Python and TypeScript, make substantive data modeling decisions across several purpose\-built data stores, and own your services in production. Two things make this a compelling time to join. The platform is new, so the patterns are not all set yet and your design decisions will outlive your first year. And we are migrating a large group of experienced colleagues onto it, so Senior Engineers here have real influence on how the whole organization builds\- not only on their own backlog. We serve millions of customers who depend on us for something that matters staying connected to the people they care about. Our customer base skews older than the industry average, which makes clarity, reliability, and accessibility engineering requirements rather than afterthoughts. If you like the idea of your work being judged by whether it works for people who are not power users, you will fit in well here. **You will need to reside within 50 miles of our Corporate Headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ as this role has the option of hybrid or onsite.** **Responsibilities** * **Design and build production services.** Develop serverless APIs and event\-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon EventBridge, written in Python and Node/TypeScript. * **Make and data modeling decisions.** We use several data stores deliberately: Amazon DynamoDB, Aurora DSQL, Amazon DocumentDB, and Amazon S3\. You will select between them based on access patterns, and you will be expected to explain why. * **Own what you ship.** Instrument your services, build the dashboards and alarms, author the runbooks, and participate in an on\-call rotation for the services your team owns. * **Build for failure.** Asynchronous systems fail in ways request/response systems do not. You will design for retries, idempotency, duplicate delivery, and partial failure as a matter of course. * **Work in a modern delivery pipeline.** GitHub and GitHub Actions, OIDC\-federated deployments, infrastructure as code, Ansible for configuration management, and service\-to\-service connectivity via Amazon VPC Lattice. * **Raise the bar through review.** Provide thorough, constructive, and useful code and design review. A meaningful share of your impact in this role shows up in other people’s work. * **Support colleague migration.** Pair with engineers moving onto the platform from our existing stack, and help turn what you learn into documentation and reusable patterns. We have built a structured enablement program, and Senior Engineers are central to it. * **Contribute to platform standards.** Logging conventions, error handling, IAM patterns, repository structure, and data store selection guidance. **Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills)** **Required** ------------ * Five or more years building and operating backend services in production. We care about depth of ownership rather than the number itself; if you have shipped and supported real systems that people depended on, tell us about it. * **Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node**, and willingness to work in both. Most of our engineers arrive strong in one. * **Hands\-on AWS experience**, including a working understanding of IAM, networking fundamentals, and at least one managed AWS data service. * Experience designing REST APIs and integrating distributed systems. * Practical experience with relational data modeling and SQL, including how schema choices affect performance. * Comfort with Git\-based workflows and CI/CD, and an established habit of automated testing. * Demonstrated debugging skill in distributed systems — you can work a problem from logs, metrics, and traces rather than by guessing. * Clear written communication. Design documents, decision records, and review comments are a substantial part of this  things: the platform is new, some patterns are still being set, and there is legacy to migrate. That is the work. If you want a finished system to maintain, this is not it. If you want to help shape one, it is. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * **First 90 days:** shipped several changes to production, comfortable in the delivery pipeline, on\-call with a backstop, and contributed to at least one design discussion. * **Six months:** owning a service or significant surface area, making independent design decisions, and mentoring at least one engineer migrating onto the platform. * **Twelve months:** setting patterns that others follow, trusted on ambiguous problems, with visible influence on platform standards. **About Consumer Cellular** Founded in 1995, Consumer Cellular is the first wireless provider unapologetically built for Americans 50\+. An approved wireless partner of AARP, Consumer Cellular is trusted by more than 4 million subscribers for affordable plans, popular phones and devices, and great nationwide coverage, all backed by top\-rated, 100% U.S. based customer support. Based in Scottsdale, AZ, with 3,000 employees in company locations throughout the U.S., Consumer Cellular has earned recognition as the most awarded wireless brand for customer service. The company has been honored as \#1 in customer service in its industry numerous times and, in 2024, ranked \#1 in network coverage and customer satisfaction among wireless carriers by American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI). Additionally, the company has been featured 12 times on the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest\-growing privately held U.S. companies. Consumer Cellular phones, devices and plans are available nationwide through our company\-owned neighborhood stores, online at ConsumerCellular.com, by phone at (888\) 345\-5509, and at leading retailers including Walmart. Connect with Consumer Cellular on Facebook, Instagram, and Youtube for tutorials, features, applications, and company news. **Pay \& Benefits Data** * Minimum Salary: $111,300 * Maximum Salary: $161,700 This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. Our Talent Acquisition team are able to answer any additional questions you may have as you move through the selection process. As part of our Total Rewards package, Consumer Cellular, Inc. offers a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle and other benefits and perks that enhance your physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing. * Competitive base pay with potential for shift differential, overtime and bonus pay * Medical insurance (98% company\-paid for full\-time employee only coverage) * Dental and Vision insurance (100% company\-paid for full\-time employee only coverage) * 401(k) company match of 100% up to 6% of your pay * Discounted Consumer Cellular wireless phone plan for employees * Paid Time Off (PTO) available following a 30\-day waiting period\* * 6 company\-paid holidays plus 16 hours of floating holiday accrual per year * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health care and dependent care expenses * Life and AD\&D insurance equal to 1x your annual earnings (100% company\-paid) * Long\-Term Disability insurance (100% company\-paid) * Employee Assistance Program (100% company\-paid) * Education reimbursement * Employee rewards program * *Accrue up to 40 hours in 1st year for hourly positions and up to 120 hours for salaried positions.* **Pre\-employment background check and drug screen is required.** **Primary Location** -------------------- : United States\-Arizona\-Scottsdale 9363 E Bahia Dr 9363 E Bahia Dr Scottsdale 85260**Job** ------- : Information Technology**Schedule** ------------ : Full\-time**Travel** ---------- : No**Job Posting** --------------- : Oct 27, 2026**Unposting Date** ------------------ : Nov 2, 2026

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description: **About CreateMe** CreateMe is an AI robotics company pioneering automated manufacturing for soft materials, starting with apparel. Built on the belief that the Future of Fashion is Bonded™, the company has developed a unified platform that combines advanced robotics, proprietary adhesive bonding, and Physical AI to deliver a new standard of precision, consistency, and speed. By replacing stitch\-based construction with digitally applied adhesives and automated material handling, the platform enables localized, on\-demand production that reduces waste, shortens supply chains, and improves recyclability by design. Core technologies include Pixel™ micro adhesive bonding, the MeRA™ robotic assembly system, and Thermo(re)set™ reversible adhesive science, advancements that make scalable, automated production possible within compact, localized facilities. CreateMe partners with brands and manufacturers seeking to modernize how products are made. With more than 95 patents across robotics, adhesives, and Physical AI, the company is defining the infrastructure for bonded manufacturing globally. **Role Overview** CreateMe is seeking an Engineering Technician with strong electrical and wiring expertise to support the development, integration, and continuous improvement of our next\-generation automated apparel assembly systems. You will work hands\-on with prototype machinery, electro\-mechanical subsystems, control panels, sensors, motion components, and custom tooling—helping the engineering team diagnose issues, optimize designs, and push our automation platform toward commercialization. This is a critical, lab\-floor technical role for someone who loves wiring, debugging, building, documenting, and making complex systems behave. You will contribute directly to turning R\&D concepts into reliable, scalable automated manufacturing equipment. **Responsibilities** *Electrical \& Controls (Primary Focus)* * Assemble, wire, route, and terminate electrical panels, prototype control boxes, junctions, and harnesses following engineering schematics. * Troubleshoot electrical issues (power, signal, grounding, noise, sensor wiring, motor drivers, PLC/IPC\-connected components). * Test, validate, and document electrical subsystem performance, including suggested wiring or hardware improvements. * Support electrical safety, labeling, organization, and preventive maintenance of prototype automation systems. *Prototype System Operation \& Debug* * Operate prototype automation equipment, log system behavior, and identify repeatable bugs, gaps, or failure modes. * Collect, organize, and present experiment data—photos, wiring notes, test logs, parameter sets, timing data—for engineering debug and root\-cause analysis. * Assist in system bring\-up for new prototypes, including alignment, calibration, and integration of updated components. *Mechanical, Electro\-Mechanical, and General Lab Support* * Perform routine maintenance on R\&D equipment; maintain logs; identify needed spare parts; track inventory. * Create or update SOPs, maintenance instructions, wiring diagrams, and troubleshooting guides. * Assist with technician\-level mechanical build tasks (mounting hardware, panel layout, fasteners, brackets, cable routing). * Support quality, safety, and lab operations standards at all times. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of technical experience aligned with the responsibilities of this role. * AS degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Automation, or related field or equivalent hands\-on industry experience. * Strong wiring experience: control panels, low\-voltage systems, sensors, motor drivers, power distribution, cable management. * Experience troubleshooting electro\-mechanical systems, including reading schematics, interpreting electrical drawings, and using diagnostic tools (DMMs, continuity testers, oscilloscopes—basic level). * Hands\-on experience operating, maintaining, or repairing automated or semi\-automated machinery. * Ability to run experiments, follow test procedures, capture accurate data, and communicate findings clearly. * Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, and measurement equipment. * Comfortable in a fast\-paced R\&D environment; able to work independently and collaborate effectively with engineers. * Ability to stand for extended periods, climb/stoop/push/pull, perform repetitive tasks, and occasionally lift up to 30 lbs. **Preferred Qualifications** * BSEET, BSMET, or similar. * Experience with industrial electrical control systems, wiring best practices, and panel build standards. * Familiarity with sensors, motion components, PLC/IPC control, robotics, or electro\-adhesive/automation systems. * Basic understanding of mechanical design, fabrication processes, tolerances, and prototyping workflows, including 3D printing. * Experience with CAD or ECAD tools (SolidWorks, Onshape, AutoCAD Electrical). * Experience documenting ECOs, assemblies, or prototype updates in an engineering environment. * Prior work in R\&D, early\-stage hardware development, or fast\-moving prototype shops. **Working at CreateMe** * Stay healthy and happy through our comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, life and disability coverage, and supplemental health and wellness benefits and perks. * Save for the future with our 401(k) retirement program. * Take time away from the office through our Flexible Paid Time Off program. * Be an owner! CreateMe’s equity program offers the opportunity to own stock in the company that we’re building together. * Be rewarded for your innovation through our Inventor Award and Recognition program. * Learn and grow through formal and informal learning opportunities, and a culture of feedback and development as you grow your talent and career. *At CreateMe Technologies, we value diversity and treat all employees and job applicants based on merit, qualifications, competence, and talent. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Story:** Crisis Prevention Institute Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence\-based de\-escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people within service\-oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long\-term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail. At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the *Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security* of everyone. We believe the power of empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. It’s a philosophy that is central to everything we do, and traces back to our beginning. **As a member of the team, you can expect to:** * Make a difference through your work – You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends about what you do. * Gain significant career experience only obtained within a fast\-growing organization – Entry\-level roles through executive leadership. * Feel fulfilled and have fun – We work hard but make the time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate the wins. **The role:** The Principal Software Engineer is the senior\-most individual contributor in CPI's Product Engineering organization and is responsible for the technical architecture and long\-term health of the Integrated Training and Learning (ITL) platform: a cloud\-native learning platform composed of 30\+ C\#/.NET microservices built on CQRS and event\-driven patterns, communicating over Azure Service Bus, backed by Azure SQL, and delivered through a React single\-page application to CPI's learners, Certified Instructors, and customer administrators worldwide. This is a hands\-on principal role. The Principal Software Engineer sets the technical vision for the platform, owns cross\-cutting architectural decisions, and works directly in the code with product squads and the Platform team to make that vision real: prototyping, pairing, reviewing, and shipping. The role is measured by outcomes the platform enables (deployment frequency, reliability, cost efficiency, and speed of feature delivery), not by documents produced. The Principal Software Engineer is a multiplier for the whole organization and a visible role model for the culture CPI is building: curiosity, ownership, drive, experimentation, learning from failure, and continuous improvement. **Architecture \& Technical Vision:** * Own the target architecture for the ITL platform and the roadmap to get there: service boundaries and bounded contexts, event and API contracts, data ownership, integration patterns, and front\-end architecture. · Lead the architectural strategy for decoupling ITL domain data from upstream enterprise systems so that ITL owns its production data, deploys independently, and can ship to production multiple times per day. * Design and evolve the platform's event\-driven backbone: event taxonomy and routing on Azure Service Bus, filtering and prioritization, idempotency, saga and retry strategies, and throughput and cost optimization. * Define the standards for CQRS, domain\-driven design, API design, data modeling, security, and observability across all services, and make them easy to follow through templates, reference implementations, and tooling. * Evaluate build\-versus\-buy and platform decisions with clear cost, risk, and time\-to\-value analysis; produce lightweight architecture decision records (ADRs) so decisions and their reasoning are durable and revisitable. * Keep the architecture honest by measuring it: partner with the Platform team on distributed tracing, service\-level dashboards, and cost visibility, and use that data to prioritize architectural investments. **Hands\-On Engineering:*** Write production code: prototype new patterns, build reference implementations, pair with engineers on the hardest problems, and contribute directly to critical initiatives. * Lead technical design reviews for significant changes across squads; review code for architectural consistency and teach through the review. * Run time\-boxed experiments and proofs of concept to de\-risk major decisions before committing the organization to them; kill ideas that the evidence does not support. * Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex production incidents; lead blameless reviews of systemic failures and drive architectural remediation. **AI\-First Engineering:*** Lead the technical strategy for AI\-assisted software development across Product Engineering: tooling selection, guardrails, evaluation of quality and productivity impact, and shared practices. * Identify and architect opportunities to apply AI within the ITL product itself where it creates measurable value for learners, instructors, and customers. **Leadership, Mentorship \& Culture:*** Raise the technical bar of the entire organization: thic system of record (ERP/CRM or legacy application) without a big\-bang cutover * Deep experience architecting on Azure: App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Azure Monitor / Application Insights, Key Vault, networking and identity, and cost management * Yearly personal development demonstrated by successfully completing an accredited software engineering course, acquiring a software engineering\-related certification, or presenting a completed learning project to the team * Curiosity: asks why before how, digs into unfamiliar code and systems, and seeks to understand the learner, instructor, and customer problem behind every request * Ownership: treats the services and features they touch as theirs to keep healthy, from design through production support, and does not wait to be assigned a problem before to hold a long\-term architectural vision while delivering pragmatic, incremental steps toward it alongside ongoing feature work * Ability to translate architecture into business terms (cost, risk, This team is responsible for core sensor components in user space (C\+\+, Swift). The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. jobs.title: Lead AI & Automation Engineer – Business Process & Healthcare Operations
jobs.description: ### **About the role** We operate multiple businesses, including pharmacy and senior\-living operations, and are building an internal AI and automation capability. We are looking for **one highly hands\-on engineer and problem solver** who can work directly with ownership and employees to identify inefficient processes, repair existing automation, build better systems, integrate software and deploy practical AI throughout the organization. This is **not a strategy\-only AI position and not a prompt\-engineering position**. You should be someone who can observe a broken business process in the morning, understand the systems and data behind it, troubleshoot logs and APIs, build or improve the solution, test it, deploy it and then teach employees how to use it. One of your first priorities will be evaluating and improving existing third\-party bots and automations used in our pharmacy operations. You will become our internal technical owner: understanding what vendors have built, diagnosing problems, determining what should be fixed versus replaced, and making sure our company owns and understands its technology. ### **What you will do** * Spend significant time with employees observing real workflows and identifying repetitive work, data\-entry problems, bottlenecks, errors and opportunities for automation. * Audit, troubleshoot and improve existing bots and vendor\-built automations, including workflows currently supported by outside vendors. * Build production AI and automation solutions using software, APIs, workflow platforms, databases and appropriate AI models. * Integrate business and healthcare systems through APIs, webhooks, database connections, secure file exchange and, where necessary, RPA/UI automation. * Automate document and data\-processing workflows involving PDFs, forms, structured files and other operational information. * Build AI\-assisted workflows with appropriate validation, evaluation, exception handling and human review. * Create reliable systems with logging, monitoring, retries, alerts and clear failure states. * Work with regulated healthcare information and follow company HIPAA/security policies. * Maintain all source code, workflows and documentation in company\-controlled repositories and systems. * Quantify the impact of projects: labor hours eliminated, cycle time, error rates, automation success rate and employee adoption. * Train employees to use AI safely and productively in their own work. * Create reusable AI tools and standards so improvements spread across our pharmacy, senior\-living and other businesses. * Manage technical vendors and hold them accountable for documentation, access, reliability and deliverables. * Work directly with ownership to turn ideas into operating systems rather than presentations. ### **What we are looking for** **Required** * Approximately 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, systems integration, automation engineering or equivalent real\-world experience. * Demonstrated history of personally building and deploying production software or automation—not just managing developers. * Strong Python or comparable software\-development skills. * Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication and systems integration. * SQL and practical data\-processing experience. * Experience debugging production systems using logs, error traces and systematic root\-cause analysis. * Experience with Git and professional source\-control practices. * Experience with at least one workflow/automation platform such as n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make, Zapier, UiPath or similar. * Hands\-on experience integrating modern LLM/AI APIs into real workflows. * Understanding of testing, AI evaluation, exception handling, observability and production reliability. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical employees. * Curiosity about how businesses actually operate and willingness to sit with employees and watch the work being done. * Willingness and ability to work regularly on\-site in Milton, PA. **Strongly preferred** * Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, senior living or another regulated environment. * Experience handling PHI or other sensitive regulated data. * Familiarity with HIPAA security considerations and Business Associate Agreement requirements. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability such as FHIR, HL7 and/or NCPDP. * Document\-processing/OCR experience. * RPA experience for legacy systems without modern APIs. * Experience with Docker and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Experience with process mapping, Lean/Six Sigma, root\-cause analysis or operational improvement. * Experience managing outside development or automation vendors. ### **Hybrid schedule** This is **not a fully remote job**. During approximately the first 60–90 days, we expect the successful candidate to spend about four days per week on\-site learning our systems and observing workflows. After the initial discovery and implementation period, we expect the normal schedule to transition to approximately two to three days per week on\-site, depending on active projects. Relocation or signing assistance may be available for an exceptional candidate. ### **What success looks like** Within your first 90 days, you should understand our critical automation environment, establish visibility into existing bot failures, improve several high\-value workflows, put company ownership/documentation standards in place, and provide ownership with a prioritized roadmap of additional AI and automation opportunities. Over time, your job is simple to describe: **Find work that should not require as much human effort as it does today, design a safe and reliable better way, implement it, measure it and make it stick.** ### **Compensation** **Base salary: $150,000–$180,000**, depending on demonstrated capability and experience. Performance bonus. Benefits. Relocation/signing assistance available where appropriate. ### **To apply** Please submit your resume and, where available, links to GitHub, technical projects, portfolio material or other examples of systems you have built. In your application, briefly describe one automation or integration that you personally took from problem identification through production deployment. Tell us what systems were involved, what you personally built, what went wrong along the way and what measurable result the project produced.

jobs.description: **About us** ============ Datasite is the essential infrastructure for M\&A. Also comprising Grata, Blueflame AI, and Sherpany, we help dealbreakers find opportunities, manage transactions, and make key decisions. Whatever your talents, you can find a place for them here. Get involved in some of the biggest business ventures today. Work with other gifted people around the world. Follow your ambitions, or discover a whole new path. Can you help us simplify the complex, create great experiences, and deliver better outcomes? Then let's talk. **Job Description:** **Why Engineering at Datasite** Datasite's engineering organization builds the software the world's dealmakers depend on to find, evaluate, negotiate, and close transactions: secure virtual data rooms, AI\-assisted diligence, deal sourcing, and private\-company intelligence. We're looking for a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to shape the foundational infrastructure for enterprise AI agents. You'll evolve our custom agent harness, build layered memory and secure isolated execution, and make sophisticated agent workflows dependable at production scale. This is an opportunity to solve challenging problems in distributed systems, applied AI, security, and platform engineering \- not simply wrap APIs around models. Help define how agents reason, plan, remember, use tools, delegate work, and recover from failures across complex, high\-stakes business workflows. You'll own architecture decisions and collaborate across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, and Security to deliver meaningful capabilities for dealmakers. **Location**: We are hiring in **New York City** and **Minneapolis.** Datasite is a hybrid company, with in\-office collaboration on **Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.** **What You Will Do** * Lead the architecture and evolution of Datasite's custom agent harness, including reasoning and execution loops, planning, tool selection, state transitions, structured outputs, and runtime controls. * Design layered agent memory spanning working context, episodic history, semantic knowledge, and durable workflow state; build retrieval, consolidation, compaction, provenance, retention, and access controls. * Architect isolated, containerized agent execution environments for code, files, and tools, with ephemeral workloads, tenant boundaries, resource quotas, restricted networking, and secure credential handling. * Build resilient agent orchestration: asynchronous tasks, specialized subagents, delegation, checkpoints, resumability, retries, failure recovery, and human approvals. * Create secure, extensible tool integrations using MCP and related interfaces, with authentication, authorization, least\-privilege permissions, and safeguards against prompt injection and unsafe actions. * Establish agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and regression testing to measure task quality, correctness, reliability, latency, and cost; drive measurable improvements * Make high\-impact technical tradeoffs between probabilistic model behavior and deterministic application logic, validation, or human review. * Partner with Product, Machine Learning, Security, and platform teams to turn diligence, research, and deal workflows into production\-grade agent experiences; mentor engineers while remaining hands\-on in critical implementation. **What You Bring** * Experienced in building and operating production software, with a track record of leading complex technical initiatives across teams. * Deep expertise in backend platforms, distributed systems, asynchronous execution, APIs, fault tolerance, and stateful services. * Strong hands\-on Python proficiency and experience with a modern language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, Kotlin, or Rust. * Experience developing production LLM applications involving tool calling, multi\-step workflows, retrieval, agent orchestration, or context management. * Practical understanding of containers, cloud\-native infrastructure, workload isolation, and secure execution patterns. * Strong foundations in data persistence, caching, event\-driven architectures, permissions, multi\-tenancy, and secrets management. * Excellent product and architectural judgment: able to evaluate emerging techniques, balance speed with reliability, and turn ambiguous problems into maintainable platforms. * Ability to influence technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and communicate complex tradeoffs clearly to engineering and product leaders. **Nice to Have** * Custom agent runtimes or orchestration frameworks; agentic coding systems or autonomous development environments. * Persistent or hierarchical agent memory, context engineering, retrieval architectures, or long\-running agent workflows. * Secure code execution, sandboxing, Docker, Kubernetes, microVMs, or ephemeral compute. * Multi\-agent coordination, MCP servers, tool registries, capability\-based permissions, model routing, or agent evaluation and tracing. * Enterprise SaaS, M\&A, virtual data rooms, regulated data, financial services, or complex document\-centric workflows. jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Zürich, Switzerland**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in Red Teaming, Offensive Security, or Adversarial Machine Learning. * Experience with Large Language Model (LLM) architectures, agentic workflows (e.g., chain\-of\-thought reasoning), and AI vulnerability classes. * Experience developing exploits for GenAI models (e.g., prompt injection, adversarial examples, training data extraction). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience working in a consulting capacity with product teams or in a "startup\-like" environment. * Familiarity with AI safety benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and fuzzing techniques. * Ability to translate complex probabilistic risks into actionable engineering fixes for developers. * Excellent coding skills in Python, Go, or C\+\+ with experience building security tools or automation. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. As a part of the Agentic Red Team, you will be a specialized, high\-velocity unit within DeepMind Security. Your mission is to close the Agentic Launch Gap—the critical window where novel AI capabilities outpace traditional security reviews. As a Senior Security Engineer on the Agentic Red Team, you will be the primary technical executor of adversarial engagements. You will work with product builders, identifying architectural flaws during the design phase long before formal reviews begin. Your core focus will be to perform multi\-turn attacks on production\-level AI models, specifically targeting agentic behaviors like tool usage and reasoning chains. You will not only find vulnerabilities but also help close the loop by contributing to Auto Red teaming frameworks and defensive strategies, ensuring that your findings are codified into reusable guardrails for all Google agent developers. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Conduct rapid, security assessments on agentic services, focusing on vulnerabilities unique to Generative AI such as prompt injection, tool\-use escalation, and autonomous lateral movement. * Engineer and execute attack sequences that exploit non\-deterministic model behaviors, agentic logic errors, and data poisoning vectors. * Write code to transform manual vulnerability discoveries into automated regression testing frameworks ("Auto Red Teaming") that prevent regression in future model versions. * Partner directly with developers during the design and build phases to provide immediate feedback, effectively shortening the feedback loop between offensive findings and defensive engineering. * Maintain and expand a library of agent\-specific attack patterns and exploit primitives to establish release criteria for new models. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: RF Systems Deployment Engineer (5G / AI-RAN)
jobs.description: **Type:** Full\-Time (W2\) On\-Site/Hybrid, Arlington, VA, with travel to customer and test sites as deployments require **Description** DeepSig Inc. is a venture backed and product centric technology startup building revolutionary wireless processing software solutions using cutting edge machine learning techniques to transform baseband processing, wireless sensing, and other key wireless applications. We are seeking an RF Systems Deployment Engineer to be the hands\-on engineer between our AI\-RAN products and the customers, partners and test sites that deploy them. This person will take those products out of the lab: integrating them into customer environments, standing them up at field sites, running them through test events and demonstrations, and bringing what they learn back to the engineering team. The role centers on 5G RAN deployment work and builds on a strong radio and SDR background. You should already be comfortable with RF hardware, software\-defined radios and the signal\-level debugging that comes with them. Prior RAN experience is helpful but not required; you will have a team of RAN and ML specialists behind you for the deep details. The day\-to\-day work is hands\-on systems integration, troubleshooting, and optimization. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own customer and partner integrations of DeepSig software end to end: scoping the deployment, configuring radios, timing and networking, installing and configuring the OCUDU stack and dApps, and carrying the system through acceptance * Plan and execute site visits: pre\-visit surveys and bills of material, on\-site installation and bring\-up, over\-the\-air validation, and on\-site support during test events and demonstrations * Bring up and troubleshoot deployed systems across the whole chain, from antennas, cabling and RF front ends through SDR and O\-RU hardware, timing and fronthaul, to the software stack and the dApps running on it * Capture and analyze RF data in the field (IQ recordings, spectrum sweeps, link measurements) to validate performance, debug issues and feed datasets back to the ML team * Reproduce field issues in the lab, isolate them to a subsystem and hand well\-characterized defects to the owning software, RAN or ML engineer * Write and maintain deployment procedures, configuration baselines, site documentation and runbooks so that installs are repeatable and supportable by others * Build and maintain lab test setups and integration benches alongside the lab engineer, including interoperability testing with partner radios, UEs and test equipment * Act as a technical point of contact for customers and partners during integration, translating their requirements and constraints into clear asks for the engineering team * Support product managers and business development with demonstrations, trial deployments and customer feedback on deployability and operability **Requirements** * BS in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 4\+ years deploying, integrating or supporting radio frequency machine learning, software\-defined radio or other RF systems in real environments * Significant hands\-on experience with software\-defined radios (USRP, Epiq, or similar) and the RF hardware around them: antennas, cabling, filters, amplifiers, power and grounding * Comfortable with RF test equipment and measurement: spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, basic link budget and interference analysis * Working knowledge of wireless systems fundamentals, including OFDM, time and frequency synchronization, and the practical effects of RF impairments on a deployed system * Strong Linux skills: networking, drivers, system configuration, log and packet capture; familiar with programming basics and able to read, run and adapt shell and Python scripts (a software engineering background is not required) * Experience with containers (Docker or Kubernetes) sufficient to deploy, configure and debug containerized software in the field * Willing and able to learn 5G NR and O\-RAN deployment on the job: gNB and O\-RU configuration, PTP timing, fronthaul, UE attach and basic performance validation * Methodical troubleshooting approach: able to isolate a problem across hardware, RF, timing, network and software layers and document what was found * Strong communication and teaming skills to work directly with customers and partners and collaborate productively in a small company environment * Able to travel to customer sites, test ranges and partner labs; travel varies with deployment schedules and can peak at 25 percent during installs and test events **Bonus** * Prior experience deploying or operating 5G NR, LTE or O\-RAN systems (srsRAN, OCUDU, OAI, or commercial gNBs), including PTP/SyncE timing chains and eCPRI fronthaul * Familiarity with GNU Radio or similar SDR frameworks and with IQ data capture and analysis workflows * Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms in deployed systems: driver and container runtime setup, Kubernetes and Helm * Exposure to machine learning for RF (spectrum sensing, signal classification) and to collecting and labeling RF datasets * Field experience with CBRS, private 5G or tactical communications deployments, including spectrum coordination and site RF surveys * Experience with vendor O\-RUs and radio hardware integration (Foxconn, WNC, Eridan or similar) * Python or C\+\+ experience beyond scripting, for building test and automation tooling In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $110,000\-$170,000 annually. This range represents DeepSig’s good\-faith estimate of the compensation for the role at the time of posting. Actual compensation within this range may vary based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, job responsibilities, internal equity, and other job\-related considerations. **Working at DeepSig** DeepSig is growing its technical team while cultivating a collaborative, agile, and fun small\-team culture. We value creativity, knowledge sharing, and employee growth, and we encourage participation in scientific publications, conferences, and open\-source software. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental and vision insurance, employee stock options, a 401(k) match, performance\-based bonuses, commuter benefits, referral bonuses, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. At DeepSig, you’ll have the opportunity to help transform and redefine signal processing through cutting\-edge AI/ML technologies in a welcoming, inclusive, and collaborative environment that values flexibility and work\-life balance. DeepSig is an equal\-opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive, diverse, and engaging workplace where individuals feel fulfilled, inspired, and motivated. We value the unique perspectives that our team brings. DeepSig is an E\-Verify Employer. Please click here for the E\-Verify Poster in English(opens in new window) or Spanish(opens in new window). For information regarding your Right To Work, please click here for English(opens in new window) or Spanish(opens in new window).

experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **A bit about this role:** In our mission to take care of every member like they were our own family,, we believe that data is a super power to deliver great service and clinical care. Our Data Platform team designs and builds the infrastructure to support this capability. In this role, you will write tools to make it easier for our Data Scientists and Engineers to build and deploy scalable, reliable data pipelines, machine learning models, and LLM powered tools. You will help develop and improve a Data Platform built with tools like Snowflake, Apache Airflow, dbt, Kubernetes, Terraform, and all the leading AI labs. You will work on a wide range of impactful projects. Examples of our work include a Change\-Data\-Capture solution to stream data to Snowflake, a custom Snowflake SQL formatter, an internal Semantic Layer and Data Agent that lets users ask questions about our data in plain language and develop dashboards and analyses. We write most of our tools in Go. You will be joining a team that values using the right tool for the job with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability. We also believe in continuously evaluating decisions and striving for improvement as a team. Additionally, we value sharing knowledge, eliminating silos, and collaboration. We use AI coding agents as part of our everyday workflow and are always looking for ways to work smarter. **Responsibilities will include:** * Design, develop and maintain a robust, scalable data platform that serves analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads * Build and evolve the infrastructure behind our Semantic Layer and Data Agent, including how LLMs discover, understand, and safely query our data * Establish evaluation, observability, and quality practices for AI systems that depend on the data platform, so we can measure accuracy and catch regressions * Collaborate with Data Science and Product Engineering on tooling to develop and deploy reliable data and AI products * Ensure data availability, quality, and reliability in the data platform * Identify areas for improvement with the platform * Propose new/improved solutions and lead them from design to implementation * Develop best practices for data modelling, pipelines, and testing **Attributes to success:** * Experience coupled with a willingness to learn new things, especially in a fast\-moving AI landscape * Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to be close to business problems * Pragmatism about AI. Excitement for what it can do, paired with clear thinking about where it isn’t the right tool * Desire to work in a collaborative environment and improve as a team * Desire to contribute individually with the ability to self\-direct work **Required skills and experience:** * Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment * 5\+ years working as an individual technical contributor * 5\+ years' experience with data platforms * Experience working with Cloud Data Warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.) * Experience developing in Python or Go * Experience with a Workflow Orchestrator (Airflow, Luigi, Dagster, Prefect, etc.) * A strong understanding of data warehousing and data modelling principles * Experience with semantic or metrics layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML, etc.) **Desired skills and experience:** * Regular use of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in your development workflow * Hands\-on experience building or supporting applications that use LLMs (via Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar APIs) * Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems, such as text\-to\-SQL accuracy Salary range: $131,000\-200,000 plus cash bonus and equity The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. Our Total Rewards package includes: * Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium * Generous paid time off * $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend * Stock options for all employees * Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles * Parental leave program * 401K program * And more.... * *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.* Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well\-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world\-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience. Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment. We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by individuals purporting to represent Devoted Health. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for “start up costs” or “equipment”), or seek to collect sensitive personal information. These job postings and offers are **NOT**authorized by Devoted Health and Devoted is not responsible for fraudulent offers, personal information that you may have disclosed, or payments made to third parties purporting to represent Devoted. We have reported this matter and are cooperating with law enforcement agencies. Devoted Health will never ask for financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Sr Director - AI Engineering, Discovery and Co-Design
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** At Dexcom, we are reimagining how innovation happens across engineering, science, and product development through the power of Artificial Intelligence. The AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design team is responsible for building the platforms, tools, and capabilities that accelerate knowledge discovery, engineering excellence, scientific investigation, and cross\-functional collaboration throughout our R\&D organization. As the Sr. Director, AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design, you will define and execute the vision for AI\-enabled innovation across engineering and scientific disciplines. You will build and scale a world\-class team focused on creating reusable AI capabilities that help engineers and scientists solve complex problems faster, make better decisions, and unlock new opportunities for innovation. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of how Dexcom discovers, designs, and develops life\-changing technologies. **Where you come in:** * You define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and vision for AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design capabilities across Dexcom's R\&D organization. * You lead the development of AI\-powered platforms, engineering workflows, knowledge systems, and scientific reasoning capabilities that accelerate innovation and engineering effectiveness. * You establish scalable co\-design environments that enable collaboration across sensor, hardware, firmware, algorithm, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams. * You partner with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Product Development, Data \& Analytics, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, IT, and Executive Leadership teams to identify and deliver high\-impact AI solutions. * You evaluate emerging technologies and drive build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner decisions that maximize business value and competitive advantage. * You build, lead, and develop a high\-performing organization of AI engineers, research engineers, architects, scientists, and technical leaders. * You establish strategic relationships with universities, research institutions, and technology communities to strengthen innovation pipelines and attract exceptional talent. You foster a culture of experimentation, technical excellence, continuous learning, and responsible innovation while delivering measurable business outcomes. * **What makes you successful:** * You bring deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, scientific computing, engineering platforms, or related technology domains. * You have a proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing technical organizations and developing future leaders. * You demonstrate success translating emerging technologies into practical, enterprise\-scale capabilities that generate measurable business impact. * You have strong experience evaluating technology investments and making strategic decisions related to internal development, commercial solutions, and external partnerships. * You excel at influencing executive stakeholders and driving organizational transformation through vision, data, and execution excellence. * You possess outstanding communication and collaboration skills and can effectively convey complex technical concepts to technical, scientific, business, and executive audiences. * You have experience recruiting and retaining exceptional talent from industry, startups, research institutions, and academic environments. * You have experience building AI\-enabled environments that support engineering innovation, scientific discovery, simulation, optimization, knowledge management, or collaborative design workflows. * You maintain credibility as a hands\-on technology leader with a passion for innovation and continuous advancement of AI capabilities. Your experience establishing external partnerships, participating in industry communities, and contributing to thought leadership is highly valued. * **What you’ll get:** · A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . · A full and comprehensive benefits program. · Growth opportunities on a global scale. · Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. · An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** 5\-15% * **Experience and Education Requirements:** * Typically requires a Bachelors degree in a technical discipline with 17\+ years of industry experience. 13\+ years of years of successful leadership experience in relevant industry. * **Remote Workplace:** Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). *If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.* Please note: The information contained herein is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: At Didero, we’re building the autonomous supply chain, starting with agentic supplier management. Global trade has never been more complex or more critical. Teams are underwater, reacting to a flood of challenges — from geopolitical risk to tariffs. Didero helps by automating time\-intensive workflows with AI agents, deploying cutting\-edge technology into one of the world’s most vital domains. We’re backed by some of the world’s best venture funds and leading figures across AI, supply chain, and enterprise software. **About the role** ================== As an AI Deployment Strategist, you'll help customers transform how procurement teams work by deploying AI agents into real\-world operations, partnering directly with stakeholders to map their workflows, design implementation plans, and guide deployments from kickoff through long\-term success. The role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, AI, and product. You'll be directly configuring, testing, and tuning AI agents, not just managing the relationship, and you'll work closely with Product and Engineering to shape both our customers' success and the future of the platform. We're looking for someone with the instincts of a strong project manager: someone who can walk into a customer's messy process, dig into the details, map it out precisely, and run a tight, structured implementation, not someone whose background is primarily relationship management. **Please Note:** This role will involve occasional on\-site work with customers, approximately 2x per month, to support discovery sessions, technical workshops, and deployment phases. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own the end\-to\-end post\-sale journey, from deployment scoping through onboarding, production, full adoption, and value realization, leading AI agent implementations that translate customer supply chain workflows into scalable automations. * Dig into customer processes in detail: map the workflow, identify exactly where automation should be applied, then configure, test, and tune agent behavior directly without always waiting on an engineering sprint. * Act as a strategic advisor to procurement and operations stakeholders, identifying where expanded automation drives the most ROI and making the business outcomes explicit — cost savings, cycle time reduction, supplier risk mitigation. * Partner with Product and Engineering to surface customer insights that shape the roadmap, and with Sales to drive renewals and expansion within your book of business. * Build repeatable implementation playbooks and best practices as the team scales. **You’ll be successful in this role if you…** ============================================= * Think like a builder, not just a relationship manager, you want to get inside the product and understand how it actually works. * Are exceptional at running tight processes: structuring ambiguous problems, mapping workflows step by step, and driving a deployment to a clean finish. * Are energized by working directly with AI products and solving ambiguous customer problems with technology. * Have a strong instinct for where AI can drive ROI in complex operational workflows. * Thrive in fast\-moving startup environments, default to action over deliberation, and can simplify complex concepts for non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications** ================== * 3\+ years of experience across product management, strategy consulting, customer success/deployment, solutions engineering, or a related analytical/customer\-facing role. Ideal backgrounds include candidates who began in consulting and later moved into product management or a product\-adjacent operating role; technical experience or a CS background is a plus, but not required * Comfortable with APIs, integrations, and agentic AI, CS foundation means you can get up to speed fast and go deep when needed. * Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive execution. * Proven experience (or clear aptitude) for leading complex, customer\-facing initiatives from kickoff through full adoption. * Strong communicator with the ability to present to senior stakeholders and navigate large organizations. **Bonus Points For:** * Background in procurement, supply chain, ERP systems, or enterprise operations. * Prior experience at a top\-tier consulting firm (e.g., MBB, Big 4 strategy arm) or in a Forward Deployed Engineer–style role. * Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or APIs. * Startup experience in high\-growth B2B SaaS. **What we value at Didero** --------------------------- * **We go beyond OTIF.** We’re obsessed with our customers and go above and beyond to ensure we’re their top supplier. We work hard to earn and maintain their trust. * **Own it.** We own what we do. We stand behind the quality of our work and do the right thing, especially when it costs us. * **Move fast. Learn faster.** We have a strong bias to action and shorten the cycle by following our curiosity to improve as we go. * **Be relentless.** When one route closes, we find another. * **Disagree, then commit.** This is an open contest of ideas. We’re direct, but with respect. We’re decisive, and everyone commits because we win together. **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody * Unlimited PTO — we trust you to take the time you need * Monthly wellness stipend via ClassPass * Tech equipment for your setup * Catered lunches (for those in the office)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Didero, we’re building the autonomous supply chain, starting with agentic supplier management. Global trade has never been more complex or more critical. Teams are underwater, reacting to a flood of challenges — from geopolitical risk to tariffs.
