You will work directly with customers to understand their end\-to\-end procurement and operations workflows including ERP integrations, data pipelines, workflow automation, supplier communication flows, reporting, and custom deployment needs. You will translate messy real\-world processes into reliable, maintainable technical systems. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will build backend systems, integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and workflow automations using the best technical approach for the problem. While our core platform is built with Django, we care more about solving customer problems than using any single technology. You'll use the right tools and technologies for each integration or deployment. You will work with systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Business Central, Zip, and other procurement, ERP, finance, and operational platforms. You will also partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Forward Deployed teams to ensure customer deployments are scalable and aligned with our product direction. We are looking for someone who is not just an implementer. The right person is a systems thinker who asks why, challenges assumptions, pushes back on unclear requirements, and helps customers arrive at better solutions. **Please Note:** This is a hybrid role based in NYC and may involve occasional on\-site work with customers, approximately 1\-2 per month, to support discovery sessions, technical workshops, and deployment phases. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Work directly with customers to understand their procurement, finance, ERP, and operational workflows. * Question and clarify customer requirements, identifying the underlying business need rather than blindly implementing requests. * Design and build integrations with ERP, procurement, finance, and operational systems. * Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, workflow automations, and customer\-specific technical solutions. * Translate ambiguous customer processes into structured, scalable system designs. * Partner with Product and Engineering to identify repeatable patterns that should become part of the core platform. * Debug complex integration issues across customer systems, third\-party APIs, data models, and internal services. * Support customer discovery, deployment planning, and technical implementation. * Help define best practices for forward\-deployed engineering, customer pipelines, and integration architecture. **You’ll be successful in this role if you…** --------------------------------------------- * Thrive in ambiguity and make steady progress without perfectly defined requirements. * Think in systems, connecting customer workflows, data, and software into scalable solutions. * Partner directly with customers to uncover root problems rather than simply implementing requests. * Challenge assumptions and refine requirements before writing code. * Exercise strong engineering judgment, knowing when to build custom solutions, create reusable abstractions, or push back. * Balance customer\-specific needs with long\-term product thinking by identifying repeatable patterns. * Debug complex integration and distributed systems problems methodically. * Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong backend expertise. * Strong experience building backend services using Python and/or Django (or comparable backend technologies). * Experience designing and building integrations with external systems, APIs, enterprise software, or data pipelines. * Experience working directly with customers or cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, debugging, and systems architecture. * Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills. **Bonus Points For:** --------------------- * Experience working in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation Engineering. * Prior experience integrating multiple ERP systems. * Familiarity with SAP OData services, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteScript, Microsoft Business Central APIs. * Experience with async processing (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ) for large data sync jobs. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment (AWS/Azure/GCP). * Knowledge of financial/accounting workflows and supply chain processes. **Tech Stack** -------------- Django · Python · React · TypeScript **What we value at Didero** --------------------------- * **We go beyond OTIF.** We’re obsessed with our customers and go above and beyond to ensure we’re their top supplier. We work hard to earn and maintain their trust. * **Own it.** We own what we do. We stand behind the quality of our work and do the right thing, especially when it costs us. * **Move fast. Learn faster.** We have a strong bias to action and shorten the cycle by following our curiosity to improve as we go. * **Be relentless.** When one route closes, we find another. * **Disagree, then commit.** This is an open contest of ideas. We’re direct, but with respect. We’re decisive, and everyone commits because we win together. **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody * Unlimited PTO — we trust you to take the time you need * Monthly wellness stipend via ClassPass * Tech equipment for your setup * Catered lunches (for those in the office) Compensation Range: $180K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description: THE OPPORTUNITY Join our Customer 360 development team at a pivotal moment in our technological evolution. We are building the next generation of our customer database, moving toward a unified source of truth that powers critical enterprise applications. In this role, your work will directly influence the customer experience by ensuring that every interaction—from personalized shopping recommendations to enterprise support—is informed by accurate, comprehensive data. We are looking for a forward\-thinking developer who is passionate about data integrity, excellence in software development, and creating tools that drive measurable business growth. THE TEAM The Customer 360 team is a cross\-functional, collaborative group dedicated to building the definitive "source of truth" for Dillard's customer intelligence. We are a high\-trust, self\-driven team that values curiosity and adaptability as we modernize our customer data strategy to provide a holistic, full\-view understanding of our customers. Our scope encompasses the full data lifecycle—from initial research and data modeling to designing robust APIs and developing complex, scalable batch processes. We are looking for a senior developer who is ready to take ownership of foundational systems, champion architectural integrity, and thrive within a team that is as passionate about software development as it is about the success of our colleagues. WHAT YOU WILL DO The responsibilities below represent the core functions of the role and are not an exhaustive list of all duties: * Design \& Model Data: Architect and implement scalable data models that serve as the foundation for a unified "source of truth" for Dillard's customer data. * Architect Ingestion Pipelines: Develop and maintain complex, high\-throughput batch processes to ingest, standardize, validate, and deduplicate customer data from disparate sources. * Build Robust APIs: Design and develop high\-performance backend services and APIs using Spring Boot and Java to power enterprise\-wide customer engagement applications. * Modernize Infrastructure: Drive the architectural integrity of our platforms by creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and leveraging containerization for deployment across multiple\-environments. * Champion Development Standards: Uphold technical excellence through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and proactive vulnerability remediation. * Collaborate \& Innovate: Engage actively within our cross\-functional, co\-located team, leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and continuous research to stay ahead of industry standards and deliver new features. THE "MUST\-HAVES" * Expert Java Development: Deep proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and associated ecosystems; or similar tech stack. * Data Modeling Proficiency: Demonstrated experience in architecting, developing, and optimizing data ingestion pipelines, batch processes, and complex data models. * System Design \& Architecture: Strong understanding of scalable architectural patterns, API design, and best practices for creating maintainable, high\-throughput backend services. * Version Control \& CI/CD: Advanced proficiency with Git\-based source control and the ability to maintain robust CI/CD pipelines in a containerized environment. * Strategic Problem\-Solving: A proven ability to own the full lifecycle of a feature, from research and design to implementation, testing, and deployment. * Collaborative Mindset: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of thriving in cross\-functional, co\-located teams and mentoring junior developers. * AI\-Enabled Development: A forward\-thinking, adaptive mindset with a strong desire to integrate AI\-assisted development tools (like Copilot/Gemini) into all facets of the software development lifecycle. THE "NICE\-TO\-HAVES" * Data Strategy Expertise: Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) concepts, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or data governance strategies in an enterprise environment. * Relational Database Depth: Proficiency in IBM Db2 (LUW) or similar relational database management systems. * Distributed Systems \& Big Data: Familiarity with high\-volume, distributed data processing frameworks or NoSQL database patterns. * Observability \& Performance Tuning: Experience designing systems with comprehensive monitoring and logging, or a track record of performance tuning for complex, high\-throughput batch processes. * Data Security \& Privacy: Familiarity with secure data handling techniques and compliance standards, ensuring sensitive information is protected throughout its lifecycle. * Containerized Development Experience: Familiarity with containerized environments, container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and best practices for packaging and deploying enterprise applications. *Location \& Hours: This is a full\-time, on\-site position located at our Little Rock, Arkansas headquarters. A high level of attendance is required as an essential function of this position.* *No immigration sponsorship (ex. H\-1B, TN, STEM OPT) is available for this position*

jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineer with deep expertise in Snowflake's modern AI and data platform capabilities. The ideal candidate goes beyond traditional data engineering — they are proficient in Snowflake Cortex AI, building intelligent agents, developing Streamlit\-based data applications, and leveraging Snowpark for advanced analytics. This role is central to our healthcare data modernization strategy and requires someone who can architect, build, and scale next\-generation data and AI solutions on Snowflake. **Responsibilities: Snowflake AI \& Cortex (Core Focus)** * Design and deploy AI\-powered solutions using Snowflake Cortex, including LLM\-based functions (COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, SENTIMENT, TRANSLATE, CLASSIFY) for healthcare data use cases. * Build and orchestrate multi\-step AI agents using Snowflake Cortex Agents and Cortex Analyst to automate data workflows and enable natural language querying of structured healthcare datasets. * Leverage Cortex Search for semantic and hybrid search capabilities across unstructured clinical and operational data. * Implement RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines using Snowflake's native vector embeddings and VECTOR data type for domain\-specific LLM grounding. Use Arctic Embed and other Snowflake\-native embedding models to build scalable, cost\-effective AI features within the Snowflake perimeter. * **Streamlit \& Application Development** * Build interactive, production\-grade data applications and internal tools using Streamlit in Snowflake (SiS) for business stakeholders and data consumers. * Develop self\-service analytics dashboards and AI\-assisted exploration tools embedded directly in the Snowflake environment. Create Streamlit\-based front\-ends for Cortex\-powered features — enabling clinical users and analysts to interact with AI outputs without leaving the Snowflake ecosystem. * **Snowpark \& Data Engineering** * Develop complex data transformations, feature engineering pipelines, and ML preprocessing workflows using Snowpark for Python. * Build and manage scalable ELT pipelines leveraging Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and Snowpipe for real\-time and batch ingestion. * Optimize Snowflake performance through micro\-partition pruning, clustering keys, materialized views, search optimization, and warehouse right\-sizing. * Design and implement Data Vault or Medallion architecture patterns for healthcare data platforms. Integrate Snowflake with upstream healthcare data sources and downstream BI platforms. * **Data Governance \& Security** * Implement Snowflake\-native governance including row\-level security, column masking policies, object tagging, and data classification. * Ensure HIPAA compliance and PHI data handling best practices across all Snowflake data assets. Manage data lineage, cataloging, and access control in alignment with organizational governance frameworks. * **Collaboration \& Platform Ownership** * Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, clinical analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust Snowflake\-native solutions. * Act as a Snowflake subject matter expert and internal champion — driving best practices, onboarding teams, and evangelizing new platform capabilities. * Participate in platform roadmap planning and contribute to Snowflake feature adoption strategy. * Qualifications: 5\+ years of data engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years of hands\-on Snowflake expertise. * Proven experience with Snowflake Cortex AI features: LLM functions, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and AI agent orchestration. * Hands\-on experience building Streamlit in Snowflake applications deployed in production environments. * Proficiency in Snowpark for Python — including custom UDFs/UDTFs, stored procedures, and DataFrame API usage. * Strong SQL skills with deep understanding of Snowflake's execution engine, query profiling, and optimization techniques. * Experience with Snowflake data sharing, Marketplace, and cross\-cloud/cross\-region replication. * Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, and RAG architecture patterns within or integrated into Snowflake. * Good to have experience with cloud platforms: Azure, and GCP — and connecting Snowflake to cloud\-native services. * Strong understanding of data modeling for analytics (star schema, Data Vault, Medallion/Lakehouse patterns). * Knowledge of Medicare Stars Patient Safety is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Data Scientist – Market Access
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Do you want to build agentic AI systems that reach real patients and inform real business decisions? The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Market Access team is seeking a Senior Principal Data Scientist to design and build the next generation of agentic AI and machine learning solutions across our employer\-intelligence and real\-world\-evidence initiatives. You will work with internal business and Technology at Lilly partners to solve complex, high\-volume problems with intelligent, autonomous, and measurable AI systems that scale horizontally across use cases. **What You'll Be Doing:** As a Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will analyze complex data, develop predictive and generative models, and design agentic AI systems that solve genuine business problems in the employer and real\-world\-evidence spaces. You will own the AI reasoning layer end to end, from framing the problem and designing multi\-agent workflows to building the models and evaluation frameworks that make these systems trustworthy. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand business problems, develop hypotheses, and test them with data and rigorous evaluation. You will build reusable, horizontal capabilities rather than one\-off solutions. **How You'll Succeed:** * Design and build agentic AI systems, including agent\-to\-agent orchestration, multi\-agent workflows, tool and environment use, and autonomous reasoning loops that act on real systems. * Build rigorous AI evaluation frameworks, including groundedness and hallucination measurement, benchmark design, regression testing, confidence and uncertainty estimation, and human\-in\-the\-loop review, so AI behavior is measurable and defensible. * Apply ML fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, natural language processing, time\-series, and statistical inference, to the employer\-signal and real\-world\-evidence domains. * Develop, fine\-tune, and distill models, including small, specialized models trained on proprietary data, with appropriate governance and data controls. * Apply modern LLM techniques, including prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge\-graph methods, to ground AI reasoning in trusted, cited sources. * Design reusable, horizontal AI capabilities that can be surfaced across multiple downstream experiences and teams, rather than rebuilding logic for each use case. * Ensure data quality, reproducibility, and auditability across all models and agentic workflows, consistent with a regulated environment. * Translate business problems into solvable AI problems and communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Conduct research and stay current with the AI frontier, bringing emerging agentic, evaluation, and model\-training techniques into the team's work. * Provide technical leadership, including setting the technical direction for agentic AI work, mentoring other team members, and defining evaluation and model\-development standards for the team. * Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously. **What You Should Bring:** * Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry. **Business Analysis and Technical Leadership, including:** * Engaging with This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure\-first, multi\-cloud fluent), energy\-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre\-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof\-of\-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding. The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post\-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States\-based Director\-level position, a people\-leader role that still expects individual\-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and lead a forward\-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions. * Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products. * Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections. * Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on te  **Skills and Experience** * 12\+ years in enterprise technology, including 7\+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid\-sized organizations. * Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward\-deployed, field engineering, or customer\-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover. * Strong customer\-facing pre\-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses. * Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services. * Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance. * Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations. * Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization. * Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers. * A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. **Desirable Experience** * Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior\-level experience. * Current professional\-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect. * Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO\-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data\-governance expectations that come with CEII and market\-sensitive data. * Direct experience with energy market simulation, production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy tools (PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, GridView, EnCompass, or similar), or with ETRM platforms such as Adapt2\. * Experience migrating on\-premises, compute\-intensive analytical software to cloud or SaaS delivery, including customer change management and license\-model transitions. * Experience building or scaling a pre\-sales architecture capability and supporting cloud adoption across enterprise customers. **Measures of Success** * Strong technical win rates and effective resolution of architecture and security objections in supported opportunities. * Proofs of concept meet agreed success criteria and help customers technical capability. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more. We are one of the fastest\-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com. **Life as an Engineer at EvenUp** ================================= **Location \& Work Model** ========================== This is a hybrid role, with the expectation that you will work from one of our hubs in either Toronto or San Francisco. **About the Team** ================== EvenUp’s document products empower attorneys to represent their clients more effectively and secure better outcomes. With over $1\.5B in damages claimed to date, the Product and Engineering team is developing an industry\-leading, AI\-native platform for generating legal documents in personal injury law. As Engineering Manager in the Engineering department, you will lead a high\-impact team building the systems at the core of EvenUp’s business. You’ll balance strategic leadership with hands\-on technical contribution, collaborating closely with founders, product, and cross\-functional partners to scale AI\-native workflows that directly advance EvenUp’s mission to ensure personal injury victims receive fair compensation. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Lead and grow a team of software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development. * Own the roadmap and delivery for Autofill and Smart Workflows, balancing new AI capabilities with reliability and operational health. * Direct and supervise every stage of the software development lifecycle, from scoping and design through release and monitoring. * Partner with Product to turn agentic and orchestration ideas into shipped features, with clear tradeoffs and measurable customer outcomes. * Work with principal engineers on architecture, data modeling, and the boundaries between AI pipelines and the core case platform. * Build strong incident response and ownership practices: clear escalation paths, root\-cause reviews, and fixes that remove whole classes of problems. * Set a team operating rhythm built on written planning, documented decisions, and recorded demos, so the team works well across locations. * Collaborate across engineering teams on shared platform dependencies, customer launches, and migrations. and 2\+ years managing engineers. * Experience shipping AI\-powered product features in production, such as LLM\-based extraction, orchestration, or agentic workflows. * Comfort with the realities of AI systems: evaluation, non\-determinism, data quality, and the operational load that comes with them. * A track record of running teams that carry escalations and incidents while still delivering verbal communication. * Bonus: experience in vertical SaaS, legal tech, or workflow and case management products. \#LI\-Hybrid **Benefits \& Perks:** As part of our total rewards package, we offer jobs.title: AI Product Lead (Senior Product Manager)
jobs.description: **Location** Remote **About Us** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the Role** As the AI Product Lead you will own a product unlike anything we have built: an insurance marketplace that AI agents use to shop on a person's behalf. When an AI agent shops for insurance, you will make the AI\- insurance shopping experience the one it trusts and can buy through. You will help shape what agentic insurance shopping looks like before the market arrives. You own the agent\-facing product: the data an agent sends and gets back, the recommendation and reasoning we return, the MCP server and skill that let AI platforms connect to us, and the trust signals that make an agent willing to rely on us. You own the roadmap, the testing of how well the agent performs, and the relationships with the AI platforms whose agents call us. Often your customer is another AI agent rather than a person, and the product has to earn that agent's trust **What You'll Do** * Define and own the product roadmap for the marketplace, balancing what agents need, what the architecture allows, and where the business is going. * Own testing and quality: build and maintain the eval sets, name the ways the agent can go wrong, and decide what counts as a good agent interaction. * Track how the agent is doing: completion, accuracy, speed, and how often a handoff is followed through. * Build quick prototypes while the problem is still fuzzy: stand up agent flows and put them in front of real and test agents to learn before engineering commits. * Take what we learn about how agents shop and turn it into real changes in the data model, the reasoning we expose, and the architecture. * Work with the AI technical lead and engineers on architecture trade\-offs, cost, and speed, and keep the shopper's and the calling agent's interests in every decision. * Build relationships with AI platforms to learn how they find and route to agents, and bring that back into our design. * Work in the open. Help publish our mission, experiments, and findings. * Give leadership clear, regular visibility into progress, what we are learning, and risks. **What You Bring to the Team (Qualifications)** * Experience building and shipping real AI products, ideally from an AI lab, an AI\-native company, or a team that has put LLM or agent products into production. You have done this, not just studied it. * Comfort with testing AI: you can take a fuzzy goal and walk through how you would test it, where it would fail, and when you would roll it back, before reaching for a model. * A working understanding of agent systems: LLMs, how agents are put together, retrieval, orchestration, guardrails, and the cost and speed trade\-offs that come with them. You do not need to build the models, but you need to talk about them with engineers. * Enough technical depth to hold your own in an architecture or code review and ask a sharp question. Comfort with light Python or SQL to look at data and prototype. * Strong product instincts and comfort with ambiguity. You can make progress on loosely defined problems. * Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical people, and the habit of leading with data. * A continuous learner, with grit and a bias for action in a space where the standards change month to month. * 8\+ years in product management, engineering, or closely related work at a technology company, including senior ownership of a product area. * A track record of leading large, ambitious projects with a small team and delivering them. We care more about what you have shipped and the judgment you showed than about the size of your org. * Proven experience building and shipping AI or agent products to production, ideally from an AI lab or an AI\-native team. * Detail\-oriented, with a history of strong, dependable delivery in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment. * Fluency in SQL for your own data analysis, and comfort reading or writing light Python to prototype. * Strong strategic thinking paired with methodical execution. You can set the direction and then deliver it. * Excellent communication across all levels of an organization, technical and non\-technical. * Experience defining requirements for complex technical systems or platforms. * A history of teamwork and a bias for action. **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** * Insurance or fintech experience. * Familiarity with MCP, A2A, agent registries, or the emerging agentic\-commerce standards. * Experience working or publishing in open developer communities. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job\-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full time remote role is $174,800 \- $205,700\. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your role during the hiring process. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must have current, unrestricted work authorization in the United States. EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy\-related condition, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request. For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior NPI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **The Elevator Pitch** Evolv is seeking a Senior New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer to lead the manufacturing introduction of complex new products from early development through production launch and ramp. Evolv’s mission is to help make places safer for people to live, work, learn, and play. We help organizations detect potential threats, mitigate risk, and enhance safety using AI\-powered security solutions, connected analytics, and practical insights that support real\-world security operations. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer who can operate as the principal NPI technical leader within the group, take ownership of difficult launches, and bring structure to ambiguity. You will work directly with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturing partners to ensure new products are manufacturable, testable, scalable, and ready for production. We are looking for someone who has personally launched complex hardware products, preferably in a small, fast\-moving organization where ownership extends beyond a narrow engineering discipline. The ideal candidate has worked extensively with third\-party contract manufacturers and knows how to lead DFM/DFA, process development, build preparation, readiness reviews, issue closure, and production ramp. ### **Success in the Role:** **In the first 30 days, you will:** * Develop a strong understanding of Evolv products, product architecture, manufacturing processes, supply chain, and current NPI programs. * Build working relationships with Product Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, and key contract manufacturing partners. * Learn Evolv’s NPI Stage\-Gate process, build\-readiness expectations, engineering change processes, and manufacturing\-release requirements. * Review active programs, open manufacturing risks, DFM/DFA issues, tooling status, test readiness, material constraints, and outstanding actions. * Begin participating in engineering design reviews and manufacturing\-readiness reviews as the senior manufacturing and NPI technical voice. **Within 3 months, you will:** * Take technical NPI leadership for one or more active product introductions. * Establish clear build\-readiness criteria and drive open actions to closure before prototype, engineering, validation, and production builds. * Lead DFM/DFA reviews with Evolv engineering teams, suppliers, and contract manufacturers, identifying design and manufacturing risks early enough to influence the product. * Establish and maintain structured manufacturing risk tracking with clear owners, closure criteria, and escalation paths. * Drive contract manufacturer readiness across materials, tooling, fixtures, documentation, process definition, test, quality controls, training, and capacity. * Lead manufacturing issue resolution during builds and ensure significant findings are converted into corrective actions rather than carried forward. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other NPI and Manufacturing Engineers on launch strategy, manufacturing problem solving, and risk management. **By the end of the first year, you will:** * Independently lead complex product launches from development through production ramp and stable volume manufacturing. * Be recognized as the principal NPI engineering resource for difficult manufacturing, build\-readiness, and product\-introduction problems. * Establish a repeatable approach to DFM/DFA, build readiness, risk management, manufacturing validation, and launch execution that can be applied across Evolv programs. * Demonstrate measurable reduction in late manufacturing issues by identifying and closing risks earlier in the development cycle. * Ensure products entering production have mature manufacturing processes, appropriate process controls, capable test strategies, complete documentation, trained production resources, and clear ownership of remaining risks. * Strengthen the working model between Evolv and its contract manufacturers so the CM actively participates in manufacturability and process development rather than simply receiving a released design. * Capture lessons learned from launches and turn them into improvements to future product development and NPI execution. ### **The Work: What type of work will you be doing?** **NPI \& Launch Leadership** * Serve as the lead NPI engineer for complex hardware and integrated\-system product introductions. * Develop manufacturing launch plans from early product development through production ramp. * Define build objectives, entrance criteria, exit criteria, deliverables, and readiness requirements. * Lead manufacturing readiness reviews before major builds and production release. * Coordinate technical activities across Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. * Drive launch risks and build issues to documented closure. * Lead post\-build reviews and ensure lessons learned ar d equity offerings * Insights into how compensation decisions are made, including factors that influence starting pay We are committed to fair pay practices, and we regularly review our compensation programs to ensure they are competitive, equitable, and aligned with our values. **Requirements** * Demonstrated history of successfully launching complex hardware products into production. * Significant hands\-on experience in New Product Introduction, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Proven experience working directly with third\-party contract manufacturers through product introduction and production ramp. * Strong practical experience leading DFM/DFA activities and influencing designs before release. * Experience planning and executing prototype, engineering, validation, pilot, and production builds. * Demonstrated ability to identify manufacturing risks, establish corrective actions, and drive issues to closure across multiple organizations. * Broad knowledge of manufacturing processes and the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, assembly, test, tooling, and supplier\-manufacturing disciplines. * Strong technical problem\-solving skills, including structured root\-cause and corrective\-action methods. * Ability to lead through influence across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. **Nice to Have** * Experience launching electromechanical or complex integrated hardware systems. * Experience in a small or rapidly scaling hardware company where NPI Engineers have broad technical and operational ownership. * Experience moving products from internal engineering development into outsourced manufacturing. * Experience establishing or improving NPI processes, build\-readiness reviews, manufacturing risk systems, or Stage\-Gate processes. * Experience with manufacturing process validation, process capability, PFMEA, control plans, PPAP, first\-article inspection, and structured root\-cause methods. * Experience working internationally with contract manufacturers and suppliers. * Experience with PLM/ERP\-controlled BOMs, engineering changes, manufacturing documentation, and configuration management. * Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers. **Benefits** At Evolv, we’re on a mission to help make public spaces safer through innovative security technology. So, we're looking for future teammates who embody our values, people who: * Do the right thing, always; * Put people first' * Own it; * Win together; and continue to * Be bold, stay curious. **Our Benefits Include**: * Equity as part of your total compensation package * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) * A 401(k) plan (and 2% company match) * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)\- take the time you need to recharge, with manager approval and business needs in mind * Quarterly stipend for perks and benefits that matter most to you * Tuition reimbursement to support your ongoing learning and development * Subscription to Calm Evolv Technology (“Evolv”) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace, and all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected by law in the locations where we operate. Evolv will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Evolv is committed to offering an inclusive and accessible experience for all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of the job application process, please connect with us at careers@evolvtechnology.com. Evolv participates in E\-verify for all employees after the completion of Form I\-9\.

jobs.description: FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. **We are currently seeking** **Principal Software Engineer** **to design, build, and ship AI\-powered products that leverage large language models (LLMs) and agentic technologies. In this role, you will move quickly from prototype to production, turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, high\-quality solutions for FactSet’s clients. You will be a technical leader and force multiplier who sets engineering standards for applied AI, mentors other engineers, and helps shape the direction of our AI product portfolio.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- You possess deep expertise in software engineering and best practices and hands\-on experience **building LLM\-based and agentic systems** , spanning orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and observability. Proficient in AI\-assisted development, you leverage tools such as **Claude Code** within your daily workflow and have a strong command of the modern **AI\-driven development lifecycle** — from planning and development to review, testing, and deployment. You thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments where models, requirements, and tooling evolve rapidly, and you bring the technical rigor and autonomy to navigate them effectively. A collaborative and constructive voice, you set a high technical bar, drive architectural excellence, and actively contribute to the long\-term direction of both product and platform. **What You'll Do** **Build, test, and deploy AI\-powered software:** * Design and develop production\-grade LLM and agentic applications, including multi\-step agents, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, and workflow orchestration. * Deliver stable, high\-quality features adhering to best practices in testing, CI/CD, and operational readiness. * Build and maintain evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring to optimize quality, safety, latency, and cost of AI\-driven features. * Rapidly prototype and iterate on emerging approaches, hardening successful solutions for production. Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery while upholding quality, security, and maintainability standards. * **Technical leadership, mentorship, and AI development standards:** * Lead code and design reviews, providing feedback that elevates team quality, including rigorous evaluation of AI\-generated code. * Mentor engineers on applied AI patterns, agent design, and effective use of AI coding assistants, including prompting, task decomposition, and output verification. * Define and evolve team standards for AI\-assisted development, encompassing code review, testing, security, and responsible use of AI tooling across the development lifecycle. Stay current with advances in LLMs, agent frameworks, and developer tooling, translating insights into actionable practices for the team. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** * Partner with product managers, designers, architects, direct managers, and engineering peers to define the right solutions and scope. Plan and drive projects effectively, communicating tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Support and continuous improvement:** * Respond to bugs, incidents, and feature requests, engaging effectively across the full development and feedback lifecycle. Diagnose and resolve AI\-specific issues, including non\-deterministic behavior, hallucinations, model regressions, and prompt or tool failures. * **Design, strategy, and innovation:** * Lead and participate in architecture discussions and brainstorming to shape new features and platform capabilities. * Evaluate and introduce new AI\-enabled development tools and workflows that improve team productivity and product quality. Develop deep proficiency in FactSet’s products and data and contribute to the forward direction of our AI strategy. * **What We're Looking For** **Required Skil  including building scalable, observable, and maintainable systems. * Experience designing evaluation approaches for non\-deterministic systems and iterating on quality using data. * Demonstrated ability to give and receive code review feedback and to contribute forward\-looking design ideas. * Proven ability to mentor and coach other engineers on using **AI coding assistants** effectively, and to help establish AI development standards and guardrails for a team or organization. Ability to articulate FactSet’s business, client base, and how your work fits into the bigger picture. * **Desired Skills** * Experience with financial data, analytics, or investment workflows. * Familiarity with **cloud platforms** , containerization, and modern **MLOps/LLMOps practices.** * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, or optimization for latency and cost. * Experience building custom tooling for AI\-assisted development, such as MCP servers, reusable skills, subagents, or agent configuration conventions. * Contributions to AI developer tooling, internal platforms, or open\-source projects. * Proven ability to thrive in dynamic environments: adapting to shifting requirements and quickly learning new models, tools, and practices. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence without direct authority. Track record of mentoring other engineers and raising team standards. * **What's In It For You** At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: * The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up. * Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and flexible “moments that matter” days. * Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives. * A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions. * Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. * Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications. The budgeted salary range for this position in the states of Connecticut and New York is **$180,000\.00 \- $235,000\.00** **Company Overview:** FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn . At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. across team goals, product capabilities, and technical systems. * Take ownership of semi\-annual and annual technical objectives, consistently delivering high\-quality, mission\-critical systems on schedule. * Define and shape the long\-term architectural vision for core full stack and microservices platforms. * Architect technical solutions for complex, ambiguous engineering challenges, making sound trade\-offs between immediate velocity and long\-term system health. * Lead cross\-team technical initiatives to extend software standards and platform impact across the engineering organization. * Mentor engineers, influence organizational design standards, and champion best engineering and operational practices. * Proactively manage technical dependencies and align architectural strategy across external engineering teams. * Partner with product and business stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, clarify requirements, and address technical risks early in the scalability, efficiency, and critical business outcomes. * Architect and build applications that are resilient, secure, and maintainable under high traffic loads. * Develop high\-performance front\-end interfaces and back\-end microservices utilizing modern frameworks and design patterns. * Design, build, and optimize high\-throughput GraphQL APIs to power seamless client applications and backend integrations. * Lead rigorous code reviews, establish testing strategies, and enforce engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5\+ years building and shipping production software. * Deep expertise in modern web frontend architecture with TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), and React — including component design, state management, and hooks. * Mobile development with React Native, plus readiness to work natively: we're migrating our mobile apps to native (Swift/iOS and Kotlin/Android) with the help of AI tooling, so you're either comfortable in native mobile or a strong engineer eager to pick it up fast. Existing Swift or Kotlin experience is a plus. * Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and cross\-browser/cross\-device compatibility across web and mobile. * Proven track record of frontend performance optimization: code splitting, lazy loading, bundle/asset optimization, rendering performance, and Core Web Vitals. * Test\-first mindset with hands\-on frontend testing experience (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library) and a commitment to code quality, maintainability, and observability. * Working knowledge of backend services in Java and Spring Boot — enough to build and extend APIs and collaborate closely with backend teams. * Experience consuming and integrating APIs on the client, including GraphQL. * Solid grasp of software design patterns and architectural best practices for reliable, scalable, maintainable systems. * Hands\-on use of AI development tools (AI coding assistants, agentic IDEs, LLM\-based testing or review tools) in real projects. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Proven technical leadership: mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards across a team. Preferred Skills * Experience with design systems, reusable component libraries, and accessibility (WCAG) best practices. * Familiarity with relational databases, messaging/streaming concepts (e.g., Kafka), and GraphQL federation (e.g., Cosmo). * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (e.g., Gradle, Buildkite). * Cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes); exposure to Helm and Terraform a plus. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. defenses. * Leverage AI to augment threat hunting, vulnerability scanning, and triage, using it to surface signal faster and reduce manual review load. * Design and build AI agents to perform in\-depth testing and analysis of our infrastructure and code. **What We Look For** * 6\-8\+ years in application security, product security, or a security\-focused software engineering role. * Strong coding ability in one or more languages used in modern web/backend development (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Kotlin) — enough to read unfamiliar code, build tooling and automation, Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning) and tuning it for signal over noise. * Familiarity with software supply\-chain security and dependency vetting (e.g., SCA platforms, tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Socket, or comparable). * Deep knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, secure coding patterns, and common vulnerability classes, with the ability to teach them to other engineers. * Extensive experience leading threat modeling and security design reviews. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive remediation across teams without owning the code yourself. * Track record of leading application security initiatives end to end, from strategy and roadmap through rollout and measurable results. * leadership. * Deep expertise in at least one area, such as authentication and authorization, cryptography, API security, or cloud\-native application security. * Relentless curiosity and persistence in investigating root causes and driving long\-lasting improvements. * Cloud security exposure (GCP a plus) and prior blockchain/Web3 security experience are pluses, not requirements. * Familiarity with security and compliance requirements in regulated financial services (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA) is a plus. * Hands\-on proficiency with AI\-assisted security tooling and a practical sense of its strengths and limits. * Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. * Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. * Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. **Salary** * Base Compensation Range: $112,320 \- $168,480/yr * 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly * Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. jobs.title: Senior AI Application Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT FIRST COUNTY BANK** First County Bank is a 175\-year\-old mutual savings bank with approximately $2\.3 billion in assets, serving Fairfield County, Connecticut through 13 branches. As a mutual, we answer to our depositors and our community rather than to shareholders, which lets us take a long\-term view. Relationship\-focused, Community\-dedicated, and High\-performing are at the heart of who we are, and they will not change. What is changing is how we work. The bank has launched a multi\-year transformation to grow, modernize its operations and make better decisions with data. We have created a Data \& AI Office from the ground up, and this role is central to turning that ambition into working software. **THE OPPORTUNITY** We are looking for a hands\-on builder who can take a business problem from a whiteboard conversation to a secure, production\-ready application. You will design and ship internal applications, data pipelines and AI\-enabled tools on Microsoft Azure, using modern web front ends, relational databases and AI\-assisted development with Claude Code. This is not an architecture\-only or vendor\-management role. You will write code, own outcomes and work directly with bank leaders in finance, lending, wealth management, operations and compliance. Because the team is small, your work will be visible, your judgment will be trusted, and your impact on a 173\-year\-old institution will be real. **WHAT YOU WILL BUILD** You will build web applications and AI agents for the kinds of problems common across banks. Typical examples include replacing spreadsheet\- and Access\-based reporting with governed data and dashboards; building a unified view of the customer across core banking, lending and wealth platforms; deposit retention and pricing analytics; commercial and wealth relationship analytics and referral tracking; credit monitoring and underwriting support; automating BSA/AML and other compliance workflows with human review; streamlining document, payment and reconciliation processing in operations; and secure AI assistants and agentic workflows for staff and executives. Priorities will be set with the CDAO and business owners and will evolve as the roadmap matures. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *Build and Deliver* * Design, build, test and deploy full\-stack internal web applications on Azure, from data model to user interface. * Write well\-structured, performant SQL; design relational schemas, views and stored procedures that others can understand and maintain. * Own the databases behind our web applications and AI agents: design for reliable reads and writes, tune queries and indexes, manage schema changes and migrations, and secure application and agent access to data. * Integrate large language models (Anthropic Claude) into business workflows, including prompt design, retrieval over internal documents, tool use and structured outputs. * Use Claude Code. MS CoPilot and other AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while reviewing, testing and owning every line that ships. * Build Power BI datasets and reports, and interactive HTML dashboards where they are the right fit. * Deliver working prototypes in weeks, not months, and harden the ones that prove their value into production. *Secure and Govern* * Apply security by design: Microsoft Entra ID single sign\-on, role\-based access, secrets in Azure Key Vault, encryption in transit and at rest, and least\-privilege service accounts. * Follow the bank’s data classification and AI governance including using only approved data in approved AI tools. * Produce documentation that eliminates key\-person risk: architecture notes, data dictionaries, runbooks, lineage and change logs that an examiner or a new colleague can follow. * Support model validation, audit and regulatory examinations with clear evidence of how applications and models work. *Partner and Enable* * Work directly with business owners to understand processes, quantify the manual effort involved and define what success looks like before building. * Translate technical choices into plain language for executives and front\-line staff. * Evaluate vendor tools objectively and recommend build, buy or integrate based on cost, risk and fit. **TECHNICAL SKILLS** We do not expect every candidate to have every skill below. We value depth in a few areas, working knowledge across the stack and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly. **Domain** **Required** **Preferred** **Microsoft Azure** Hands\-on delivery with App Service or Container Apps, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault and Entra ID Azure Data Factory or Fabric, API Management, Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, Bicep or Terraform, Azure certifications (AZ\-204, DP\-203 or equivalent) **Front end** Modern JavaScript or TypeScript; React (or comparable framework); responsive HTML and CSS; building clean, usable internal tools Accessibility (WCAG) standards; component libraries; data visualization (D3, Chart.js, Re lutions, and align recommendations with organizational objectives. Adapts effectively to evolving business needs, priorities, and emerging technologies. * **Collaboration, Communication, and Influence:** Establishes and maintains effective working relationships across departments and organizational levels. Communicates complex information clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, promotes collaboration, and influences decisions to achieve shared business objectives. * **Accountability and Results Orientation:** Demonstrates initiative, sound judgment, and accountability in fulfilling responsibilities. Effectively manages competing priorities, delivers quality results, and provides guidance to colleagues while promoting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. * **Integrity, Ethics, and Risk Awareness:** Demonstrates professionalism, ethical judgement, and a commitment to confidentiality, information security, and regulatory compliance. Recognizes potential risks and promotes responsible use of AI and emerging technologies. **QUALIFICATIONS** * **Experience:** 10\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, including at least 3 years building and deploying applications on a major cloud platform (Azure strongly preferred). * **Delivery record:** A portfolio of shipped applications or data products used by real people, with examples you can walk us through in detail. * **AI\-assisted development:** Demonstrated, current use of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools in real projects, with a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Industry:** Financial services or other regulated\-industry experience is a strong plus but not required for an exceptional builder who learns quickly. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** **Timeframe** **Outcomes** **First 90 days** Understands the bank’s systems, data sources and priority processes; Azure development environment, source control and deployment pipeline established; first application or automation delivered to real users **Six months** Two to three production solutions in use with measurable hours saved or risk reduced; documented, examiner\-ready architecture and data lineage for everything shipped; trusted partner to at least two business units **Twelve months** Core components of the data platform and Customer 360 in production; reusable patterns for secure AI\-enabled applications adopted across the team; mentoring analysts or interns on AI\-assisted development **Note:** All exercises use synthetic data only.
