jobs.title: Highway Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Highway Engineer – Civil \- Rochester, NY** **Build Your Career in Highway and Transportation Engineering** Rochester, NY, offers opportunities to contribute to transportation infrastructure that connects communities across the Finger Lakes and Western New York. From roadway improvements to drainage and geometric design, highway engineering plays an important role in supporting safe, reliable travel throughout the region. As a Highway Engineer on Fisher Associates’ Highway Team within the Infrastructure \+ Mobility Group, you’ll support roadway and transportation projects from design development through project delivery. You’ll work with experienced engineers, project managers, clients, and public agencies to develop plans and construction documents that meet applicable standards and project requirements. If you’re ready to build your technical skills, learn from experienced transportation professionals, and take ownership of meaningful design work, this role offers an opportunity to grow your career while contributing to infrastructure improvements that benefit local communities. **What You'll Do** * Support highway design projects involving roadway alignments, drainage systems, and geometric design using industry\-standard roadway design software. * Develop design plans, construction documents, technical specifications, and cost estimates. * Apply state and local design standards, regulations, and safety codes to support compliant, reliable roadway designs. * Maintain organized highway design documents, reports, and budget records. * Apply and support quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes to produce accurate, high\-quality deliverables. * Assist with field inspections and roadway data collection. * Support project managers with schedules, project documentation, and presentations while coordinating with internal teams, clients, subconsultants, and agencies. Requirements: **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. * 0–5 years of transportation experience. * Strong organizational and planning skills with attention to detail. * Ability to prioritize work, manage deadlines, and take ownership of assigned tasks. * Critical thinking, problem\-solving, and sound judgment. * A collaborative approach to building trusting relationships through integrity, respect, and active listening. * An improvement\-minded attitude and willingness to learn, accept feedback, and develop better solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or the ability to obtain it. * Highway design engineering experience. * Experience with MicroStation, OpenRoads, and AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Familiarity with state DOT design standards, particularly NYSDOT or PennDOT. **Why Join Fisher** * Shape meaningful infrastructure, environmental, and community outcomes through work that has visible local and regional impact. * Grow in a collaborative culture where accessible leaders welcome ideas, feedback, ownership, and professional development. * Build your career through mentorship, technical learning, leadership opportunities, and exposure to multidisciplinary project teams. * Thrive in a flexible, team\-driven environment that values quality, accountability, work\-life balance, and long\-term success. **Compensation \+ Benefits** **Salary range: $75,816\-$88,000** * Competitive compensation; actual pay varies based on experience, qualifications, education, and other factors and excludes the value of benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) plan. * Company\-paid life and disability insurance. * Hybrid work schedule, generous PTO, paid holidays, and strong work\-life balance. * Shareholders program, professional development opportunities and reimbursement, supplemental benefits, and employee groups focused on community, inclusion, and employee voice. **Location Flexibility** This role is aligned to the Rochester, NY, market for highway and roadway design supporting regional transportation infrastructure. Fisher may also consider strong candidates located near Buffalo, NY, Syracuse, NY, Albany, NY, and Canonsburg, PA, based on project needs, client alignment, team growth priorities, and business development opportunity. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Fisher Associates is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are respected, valued, and empowered to thrive. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under federal, state, or local law. ***No unsolicited agency submissions. Fisher Associates does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or staffing agencies.*** *Any unsolicited resume becomes the property of Fisher Associates, and no fee will be paid for resulting hires. Only agencies with a signed agreement are authorized to submit candidates.* \#LI\-DNP \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Storage Platforms
jobs.description: Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Storage Platforms** to design, implement, and support **Software Defined Storage (SDS)** and **Kubernetes platforms** in a private cloud environment. This role focuses on **scalability, resilience, automation, and performance** using Infrastructure\-as\-Code and GitOps practices. This is a deeply technical role requiring **expert\-level understanding of Software Defined Storage, Kubernetes, and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems.** You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi\-tenant\-isolated services that serve high\-throughput, mission\-critical applications. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and operate **large\-scale Software Defined Storage architectures** across private and public cloud regions within ITIL methodology. * Deploy and support **enterprise storage platforms** (Pure Storage, HPE, NetApp) and SDS solutions (Ceph, Longhorn). * Build self\-service storage workflows for Kubernetes CSI and OpenStack consumers (VM and Baremetal). * Develop **Infrastructure\-as\-Code** using Ansible, Terraform, Helm and Git, with Python/Bash automation. * Implement **CI/CD pipelines** for infrastructure updates, patching, upgrades, testing, and rollback. * Build **observability, alerting, and auto\-remediation** using GitOps and tools such as Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana. * Architect and maintain **high availability, disaster recovery, and scale\-out** infrastructure. * Develop and review **high\-level and low\-level design documents** for storage infrastructure * Perform deep troubleshooting across **storage, Kubernetes, hypervisors, networking, and Linux systems**. * Participate in **on\-call rotations**, incident response, and root cause analysis. * Collaborate globally on **change management**, documentation, and operational best practices. **Minimum Qualifications** * 6\+ years of experience managing **enterprise storage and Kubernetes platforms** on Linux. * Strong hands\-on experience with **SDS solutions** (Ceph, Longhorn) and storage migrations from legacy systems. * Experience with **block, file, and object storage**, including Fibre Channel and IP\-based protocols. * Experience with NVMe\-oF or iSCSI fabrics. * Expert knowledge of **Kubernetes** and **Linux systems** (Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS). * Proficiency with **Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC)** (Ansible, Terraform). * Strong scripting skills in **Python and Bash** (Golang (GO) a plus). * Strong working knowledge of Enterprise DNS and **integrations with Kubernetes** * Experience operating **24x7 mission\-critical production environments**. * Hands\-on experience with **KVM hypervisors (Suse Harvester, OpenStack)**. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks** * Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases. * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * OpenStack Cinder multi\-backend administration. * Backup platforms (Rubrik). * Understanding of **CIS/NIST** security and infrastructure lifecycle management. * ITIL Foundation/advanced certifications in support of ITSM standard methodology. * Background in telco, edge cloud, or large enterprise environments. * CNCF Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) or Red Hat specialist in Ceph Storage Administrator (EX125\) certifications. * Master's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience and relevant industry certifications will also be considered. **What You'll Get** * A collaborative team that's deeply invested in infrastructure excellence. * Complex technical challenges that require creative, scalable solutions. * The opportunity to shape a next\-generation private cloud platform\-built reliability. * Access to the latest tools, frameworks, and upstream project developments. **Skills and Attributes:** * **Analytical Thinking \& Problem Solving:** Demonstrated ability to translate complex, cross\-domain requirements into scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure and automation solutions. * **Collaboration \& Teamwork:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a proven track record of effective collaboration across multidisciplinary teams, including developers, operations, security, and product stakeholders. * **Mentorship \& Leadership:** Passionate about knowledge\-sharing and mentorship, with experience guiding junior engineers and fostering a team culture of continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence in cloud engineering and DevOps practices. Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9\.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal. jobs.title: Civil Engineer (Vacuum Systems)
jobs.description: Flovac is a global leader in vacuum sewer technology, delivering innovative wastewater solutions across municipal and utility markets. As we expand in the United States, we are building a team that combines technical excellence with real\-world application to support engineers, owners, and contractors. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are looking for a Civil Engineer to provide technical leadership and system design capability across our U.S. projects. This is not a back\-office design role. You will work directly with consulting engineers and project stakeholders to ensure vacuum sewer systems are correctly applied, well designed, and successfully delivered. You will play a key role in shaping projects early, building engineering confidence, and converting opportunities into practical, buildable solutions. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** System Design \& Technical Leadership * Develop vacuum sewer system concepts and layouts * Support network design including profiles, zoning, and valve placement * Ensure alignment between collection systems and vacuum stations * Provide technical input into proposals and early\-stage project development **Engineering Firm Engagement** * Work directly with consulting engineers and design teams * Review and guide system designs * Provide practical, experience\-based advice * Help engineers understand and confidently apply vacuum technology **Project Development Support** * Participate in early\-stage meetings with engineering firms and clients * Translate opportunities into clear technical concepts * Support specification development and design inclusion * Strengthen Flovac’s technical credibility in the market **System Integrity \& Risk Management** * Identify and prevent poor system design decisions * Ensure systems are treated as integrated networks, not individual components * Support internal technical review prior to supply * Protect system performance and long\-term reliability **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering * 7–15 years of relevant experience * Professional Engineer (PE) preferred or in progress **Experience** * Sewer collection systems or utility infrastructure * Consulting engineering or design environments * Working with municipalities, utilities, or developers **Key Traits** * Practical and solutions\-focused mindset * Strong communication skills with technical and non\-technical audiences * Comfortable working externally with consulting engineers and stakeholders * Understands real\-world system behavior, not just theory **HOW YOU’LL WORK** You’ll work closely with our Business Development team: * Business Development opens opportunities and builds relationships * You provide technical depth, credibility, and design leadership Together, you will engage engineers early, shape project direction, and help secure specifications and project wins. **COMPENSATION** * Base Salary: $110,000 – $170,000 (target range $120,000 – $150,000\) * Performance Bonus: 3–20% based on project support and successful outcomes * Benefits: Competitive package including health, PTO, and travel support **WHY THIS ROLE MATTER**S Engineering firms control system design and specification. Vacuum systems are often misunderstood or misapplied. Your role ensures Flovac systems are correctly designed, integrated, and perform as intended, protecting both project outcomes and our reputation in the market. You won’t just be designing systems. You’ll be a technical partner to engineers and a key contributor to winning work. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Civil engineering: 2 years (Required) * AutoCAD: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer (3-5 Years Experience)
jobs.description: **About Foji** Foji automates the revenue cycle for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). Front offices lose hours every day to insurance verification, benefits breakdowns, claim follow\-up and payment reconciliation. Foji does that work for them. Our platform plugs directly into practice management systems like Open Dental and Dentrix. It handles insurance verification and benefits, claim tracking, payment posting and bank reconciliation. Next up: claim submission, pre\-authorization submission and automated denied\-claim appeals. We're a small, fast\-moving team with real revenue and multi\-location DSO customers who rely on Foji every day. **The role** We're hiring a Software Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to own features end to end, from database to UI. You'll work directly with the founders and ship code that customers use the same week. This is not a ticket\-taking job. You'll talk to customers, help shape what we build, and work on hard problems: syncing data from practice management systems, automating insurance payer portals, and turning messy remittance data into clean, reconciled payments. **What you'll do** * Design, build and ship full stack features across our web app, APIs and data pipelines * Build AI into the product: use LLMs to read benefits documents, interpret claim and remittance data, draft denied\-claim appeals and answer support questions * Work AI\-first every day: use AI coding agents and assistants (like Claude Code or Cursor) to plan, write, test and review code, and help the team get more out of them * Build evaluation and guardrails so AI outputs are accurate, auditable and safe to use with patient data * Build and maintain integrations with dental practice management systems (Open Dental, Dentrix) * Develop browser automation that pulls eligibility, benefits and claim data from insurance payer portals * Build workflows for payment posting and bank reconciliation * Debug production issues across systems and data sources you don't fully control * Improve reliability, observability and test coverage as we scale to more practices * Handle protected health information responsibly and help keep us HIPAA compliant * Work with sales and support to understand customer pain and turn it into product **What we're looking for** * 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, building and shipping production web applications * Strong skills on both the frontend (modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a framework like React) and the backend (APIs, services, background jobs) using primarily NodeJS and Python * Solid SQL and relational database experience, including data modeling and debugging data issues * Experience integrating with third\-party systems and APIs, and handling the messy edge cases that come with them * Comfort owning a feature from spec to production, including deploys and monitoring * Clear written communication and good judgment working with little process * A bias for shipping: you'd rather deliver something useful this week than something perfect next quarter **Nice to have** * Browser automation experience with Playwright * Experience with HIPAA, SOC 2 or other compliance\-driven environments * Experience building ETL or data sync pipelines * Experience with CRM or support tool integrations (for example, HubSpot) * Experience building products on LLM APIs (prompting, tool use, evals) * Prior startup experience Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Dependent health insurance coverage * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid holidays * Partner benefits * Unlimited paid time off * Vision insurance * Work from home Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Software Engineering: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The **AI \& Automation Engineer** is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company\-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI. **This position will require regular (every week) in\-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work\-from\-home opportunity. At this time, fully\-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.** **What you will do:****Solution Design and Development*** Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams. * Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model\-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams. * Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365\) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections. * Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions. * Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or JSON) where low\-code tooling falls short and use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization. **AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering*** Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company\-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations. * Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role\-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries. * Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release. **Security, Governance, and Responsible AI*** Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least\-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations. * Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end\-user, maker, and agent\-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content\-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions. * Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation. **Operations, Support, and Enablement*** Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend. * Provide third\-tier support and root\-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after\-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures. * Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices. * Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production. * Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders. **Our ideal candidate:*** Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, automation, low\-code/no\-code development, and practical business process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role\-based access control as they apply to AI workloads. * Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git. * Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels. * Must be well\-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail. * Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required. * Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes. **Work Environment** (The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Senior Supplier Engineer, Structural Components to support the transfer of structural assemblies, including stamped, laser cut, welded, plated, and bent parts to our suppliers. This role reports into our Global Supply Management team. As part of our Supplier Industrialization Engineering team, you will support new product introduction from concept through production at supplier facilities with a focus on cost\-effectiveness and lead design for manufacturing (DFM) analysis to identify and mitigate potential manufacturing issues in collaboration with Program Managers, Cell/Module Engineering, and Advanced Manufacturing, teams. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast\-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission! *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Collaborate with Design and Advanced Manufacturing teams to co\-develop Pack\-level structural designs (e.g., Base, Roof, Tower, Cabinets) optimizing for structural integrity, heavy\-gauge fabrication, and modular system integration. * Lead Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and APQP reviews with structural suppliers, focusing on welding feasibility, tube/C\-channel bending constraints, and large\-scale assembly tolerances. * Own the Quality Maturation Level (QML) and PPAP roadmap, systematically qualifying supplier Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and Welder Performance Qualifications (WPQ). * Partner with suppliers to establish robust weld verification programs, defining requirements for weld characterization, destructive testing (e.g., macro\-etch, tensile), and Non\-Destructive Testing (NDT) such as ultrasonic, magnetic particle, or liquid penetrant. * Proactively identify and mitigate program schedule risks unique to heavy manufacturing, including long\-lead raw steel mill runs, supplier crane/handling limits, and large\-component shipping/validation constraints. * Drive closed\-loop Non\-Conformance Management by issuing SCARs, leading suppliers through formal RCA for structural or weld defects, and verifying process control plans via on\-site audits of welding, fixturing, and coating processes. ### **What you'll bring:** * 5\+ years of experience in supplier quality, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering specializing in heavy\-gauge structural steel and large welded assemblies. * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Welding, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field. * Demonstrated expertise in structural fabrication processes, including heavy plate/structural steel forming, laser/plasma cutting, and multi\-pass welding. * Strong working knowledge of welding standards (e.g., AWS D1\.1, ASME Section IX), weld inspection methods (NDT/destructive), and the qualification of WPS/PQR documents. * Strong understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) principles as applied to large, multi\-part structural weldments. * Proven ability to manage technical supplier relationships, lead on\-site process control audits, and drive robust root cause investigations (8D, 5\-Why). *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Software Engineer II** **About us:** At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As an AI\-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. This junior role involves understanding problems, developing solutions, and engaging with key stakeholders to refine approaches. The successful candidate will write complete, efficient, and well\-commented code that meets customer experience needs and project requirements. They will also create unit and feature tests to ensure compliance with performance, scalability, and security standards. Additionally, the engineer will address bugs within the product, continuously learn, and explore in\-depth project requirements. **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities:** * You develop a design (including system architecture, layout of services, APIs, backend and frontend changes) for your project and area, consider possible options to solve the problem, drive estimations while considering cost and long term impact of the design. You address currently planned use cases as well as required extensibility to support future applicable use cases. You review your design with your peers and collect feedback, incorporate it. You set a high bar for the content and completeness of your design document, and the organization can use these as great examples and best practices * You develop software that delivers on Scalability, Performance, Security, Accessibility, Localizability and other horizontal requirements. You are a practitioner and knowledgeable user of the underlying system Infrastructure (e.g Cloud Infrastructure) that the Product is based on, and you propose and adapt your solution to the company’s design fundamentals, frameworks and 3rd party software infrastructure. You address key dependencies required for your design and code in other applications, systems and services and ensure they are available and present as you deliver code. * You develop high quality code that is efficient (address space and time complexity), is modular, follows coding guidelines including naming conventions and other code etiquette. Your code is production\-ready. You learn from your past mistakes and any future feedback reflects improvement in the quality of your code. The code reviews of your code progresses smoothly and with no fundamental issues in the logic, semantics and syntax. * You solve problems that have ambiguity in requirements, substantial risks and conflicting constraints along multiple dimensions. You make good tradeoffs between short\-term delivery and long\-term maintainability of your organization’s architecture. You identify risks that are not readily apparent and proactively take action to prevent problems before they occur. * You drive bug fixing and resolution throughout the Product life cycle to ensure the stakeholders have a view of what sequence and order we fix issues. This includes all sources of bugs including feature testing and QA testing issues found, customer issues and pain points reported * You test your work by creating unit and feature tests needed to complete the work and ensure it is ready for handing off to QA. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Lead Data Cleanup and Verification (Fintech / Business Lending)
jobs.description: **About us** Fundmate is a fast\-growing business funding company in Brooklyn. We have millions of business leads and years of real bank statement data. We need one sharp data person to turn that into a small, verified list of high\-revenue businesses our sales team can trust. **The mission** Cut a database of millions of leads down to the best 200,000–300,000 businesses: real, operating, high\-revenue, reachable, and clean. Then build a system that filters every new lead list automatically, so only the good ones get through. **What you’ll do** * Audit and dedupe millions of records across AWS (RDS/Postgres, S3\) and Salesforce. Match the same business across different names, phones and emails. * Validate every phone number: active, mobile vs. landline, carrier, disconnected. Remove bad and wrong numbers. * Remove anything that isn’t a real business. Verify businesses using public records (Secretary of State filings, business registries). * Pull real monthly revenue from years of bank statement PDFs, using AI document extraction (LLMs or OCR) at scale. * Remove defaults, blacklisted merchants, low\-revenue businesses and opt\-outs. Flag Do Not Call numbers. * Score and rank every business on revenue, history and reachability. * Deliver the verified list within the first 30 days. * Build an automated pipeline: when we upload a new vendor list, it gets cleaned, scored, and only the qualified leads go to sales. * Keep the list fresh every month. **What you need** * Strong SQL and Python (pandas or similar), working with millions of rows * AWS experience: RDS, S3, Lambda * Real experience with record matching and deduplication * Experience with phone and data validation APIs * Experience using LLM APIs to pull data from documents (PDFs, statements) * Bonus: Salesforce API, B2B lead data, lending or fintech * You move fast and ship. We want results in weeks, not months. **Job details** Full\-time. Open to contract\-to\-hire. On\-site or hybrid in Brooklyn, NY 11213\. Starting at $120,000/yr. **How to apply** Send a short note about the largest messy dataset you cleaned up: how many records, what you did, and what the result was. Finalists do a paid 48\-hour test on a sample of our data. Pay: From $120,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * What’s the largest dataset you’ve deduplicated, and how did you match records? * Which phone validation tools have you used? * Have you pulled data from PDFs using AI or OCR? At what scale? * Can you start within 2 weeks? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11213

jobs.title: Staff, Data Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands\-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in. At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them. The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI. * **Owns the governed context layer** as the shared foundation every human and digital worker in EAI relies on, accountable for its architecture, implementation and evolution. * **Defines the system digital workers engineer within** through the standards, frameworks, contracts and guardrails that let them build and operate pipelines safely, consistently and at scale. * **Raises the standard of data engineering for AI** across EAI through the architecture, governance and engineering practices others adopt, and through the senior engineers the role develops. **Key Responsibilities:** Context \& Semantics * **Implement and evolve the governed context layer** as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time. * **Build the capabilities the layer depends on:** reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI\-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources. * **Make certified meaning machine\-readable** so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage. Agent\-Operated Data Engineering * **Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks** that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative. * **Set the operating model for agent\-generated engineering work:** what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution. AI Data Infrastructure \& Lifecycle * **Shape EAI's AI data infrastructure strategy** across feature engineering, vector and retrieval infrastructure, streaming data flows and evaluation data design, building shared components that multiple AI initiatives depend on in production. * **Define EAI's MLOps data practices:** versioning, lineage, drift monitoring, evaluation dataset governance and model data lifecycle management, extended to the context and evaluation data that digital workers rely on. Governance \& Responsible Data * **Define EAI's responsible data governance standards for AI pipelines,** covering privacy, consent, PII, auditability and bias controls, and encode them in the governed context layer so humans and digital workers apply them by default. * **Shape data quality and lineage at scale** across multiple data domains, with measurable outcomes in error rates, downstream AI performance and audit readiness. Platform \& Infrastructure * **Design EAI's data platform architecture** with infrastructure as code throughout and platform\-as\-product thinking, so new data and AI projects start quickly and consistently. * **Build shared platform components** that AI initiatives, engineering teams and digital workers depend on in production, and own their reliability, performance, cost and security. Standards \& Technical Leadership * **Define data engineering standards** for code, documentation and review, written to be followed by humans and digital workers alike, and drive their adoption across EAI. * **Develop senior engineers** towards greater architectural independence, and partner with forward deployed engineers (FDEs), ML engineers, platform engineers and domain experts on the data requirements of production AI systems. **Why You?** **Basic Qualification** We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of data engineering experience, including experience defining data architecture for production AI or machine learning (ML) systems. * Experience building data infrastructure for AI systems, including feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data pipelines and evaluation datasets. * Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure used by AI systems, such as data catalogues, business gl e data governance and MLOps data practices, with controls encoded in the context layer and adopted across multiple data domains. * Raised the architectural independence of EAI's senior engineers through standards and coaching. Work Arrangement This role is based in the United States and follows a hybrid working model. You will be expected to collaborate on\-site roughly two days per week. Remote work outside of this arrangement is not available for this role. **Skills** Computer Programming, Data Analysis, Data Architecture Development, Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Ingestion, Data Integration, Data Migrations, Data Modeling, Data Transformation, ETL Development, Performance Tuning, Structured Query Language (SQL) Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees. **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: ### **The Position** **The Opportunity** As a Principal Data Scientist \- Causal AI \& Experimentation (within our Data Science and Machine Learning team), you will serve as a technical leader and key domain authority for advanced experimentation, measurement, and optimization solutions across the CMG organization. In this high\-impact, individual\-contributor role, you will bridge the gap between cutting\-edge causal methodology and high\-stakes business strategy. You will drive the design, development, and industrialization of enterprise\-grade causal AI and statistical models that measure business impact, optimize resource allocation, and guide data\-driven decision\-making. Working alongside other data scientists and engineers, you will help shape the technical strategy for measurement and experimentation initiatives. Provide technical guidance, perform code and design reviews, and mentor team members to foster technical excellence and continuous learning. * Translate complex causal modeling and statistical concepts into clear, compelling narratives and actionable guidance for both technical teams and non\-technical business leaders. * Stay at the forefront of academic and industry advancements in Causal AI, Causal ML, Bayesian modeling, and Generative AI, advocating for responsible AI practices and bringing novel approaches into our measurement ecosystem. **Who You Are** * You have aA Bachelor’s Degree and 8\+ years of work experience, or an equivalent mix of education and work experience, is required. * You have 8\+ years of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or ML engineering with a proven track record of architecting and shipping impactful data science products. * 5\+ years of hands\-on specialization in Causal Inference, Experimental Design, Measurement, and Optimization (e.g., A/B testing, quasi\-experiments, observational causality, Market Mix Modeling, Bayesian modeling, uplift modeling) * Expert\-level knowledge of open\-source frameworks for ML, statistics, and causal inference (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, CausalML, DoWhy, EconML). * Advanced proficiency in Python and/or R, along with strong SQL skills for complex database management and data manipulation * Deep familiarity with open\-source measurement packages (e.g., Robyn, LightweightMMM, Meridian). * Hands\-on experience scaling influence key partners, align business priorities, and explain complex mathematical methodologies to business leaders. * Strong critical thinking abilities with rigorous attention to detail regarding experimental design, bias mitigation, and causal validity. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in Statistics, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field with a focus on AI/ML or Causal Inference with 6\+ years of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or ML engineering 6\+ years with a PhD * Experience working with complex, large\-scale dataset structures in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or highly regulated environments (including longitudinal patient\-level data, syndicated sales, or promotional data). * Familiarity or hands\-on experience integrating Deep Learning or Generative AI techniques with Causal AI frameworks. * A history of contributions to open\-source data science tools or peer\-reviewed publications in causal inference, experimentation, or measurement technology. **Location** * This role is based in South San Francisco and offers a hybrid schedule working 3 day per week on campus * Relocation benefits are **NOT** offered on this posting The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $217,400/yr to The role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams including design engineering, quality assurance, and production to ensure seamless integration of new technologies and continuous process improvements. The Senior Engineer will also analyze manufacturing data to identify bottlenecks and develop strategies to enhance throughput and reduce waste. Ultimately, this position ensures that manufacturing operations meet rigorous standards for safety, quality, and productivity while supporting the company’s strategic growth objectives. **Minimum of new products by designing scalable manufacturing solutions and conducting pilot runs. * Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and provide technical guidance to production teams. * Drive continuous jobs.title: Safety Data Analysis Engineer – AV Operational Safety and Issue Response (GPSSC)
jobs.description: **Job Description** At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE\-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trustworthy automated\-driving products. As the central authority for automated\-driving system safety, the department brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case, including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated\-driving technologies. GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion, and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision. **The Role** The AV Safety Engineering Analytics team is seeking an experienced Safety Data Analysis Engineer to provide engineering support for AV Operational Safety and Issue Response. This is a safety engineering role focused on data\-driven issue response and investigation. You will combine engineering judgment, safety analysis, and strong data skills to investigate potential issues, organize event\-related data, and develop evidence that supports AV Safety Assurance and AV Operational Safety decisions. The role is designed for an engineer who is highly proficient in navigating, integrating, designing, and analyzing large\-scale data. You will support rapid, highly iterative investigations involving specific vehicles, locations, software releases, event sequences, operational conditions, and other issue\-relevant dimensions. The scale of AV operations, including potential issues, actual events, readiness drills, and ongoing software releases, creates a need for rapid, detailed, event\-driven analyses. At the same time, you will help convert repeatable investigation patterns into reusable analytics and issue\-detection methods. **What You'll Do** * Respond collaboratively to AV Safety Strategy and Assurance and AV Operations requests for potential issue\-specific analyses, event\-related data organization, and root\-cause investigations. * Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, and Safety teams to investigate potential AV issues and conduct root\-cause analyses. * Translate investigation needs into clear analysis requirements, data requirements, analytical designs, and execution plans in collaboration with requesting teams. * Establish and support rapid incident\-response and targeted\-analysis capabilities that leverage standing data pipelines as well as unique issue\- and incident\-relevant data sources. * Integrate vehicle telemetry, time\-series signals, event and incident records, readiness\-drill data, software\-release information, location and operational context, and other relevant sources into analysis\-ready datasets. * Distinguish data\-quality, sensor, instrumentation, and pipeline issues from meaningful operational outliers using engineering judgment and data validation methods. * Deliver concise, technically rigorous analysis findings, readouts, and evidence that help partner teams assess potential operations safety issues and determine appropriate next steps. * Identify investigation workflows that can be generalized into reusable metrics, detection methods, pipelines, or analysis tooling without losing the flexibility required for issue investigation. jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you! We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States. We have an exciting opportunity for a **Cloud Operations Engineer** to join our team GeoControl Systems, a teammate company. As a **Cloud Platform Engineer,** you will: * Developing new cloud\-native platform services spanning all three major cloud environments * Developing best practices for cloud\-native application development and promoting them within the organization * Administering NASA cloud networks and managing requests for deployment of COTS and Cloud Native applications into cloud environments * Writing quality code, providing quality and engaged code reviews for peers * Working with Managed Kubernetes offering across all three major cloud providers * Integrating cloud managed AI and data services with other bespoke and open\-source Kubernetes applications * Developing best practices for cloud\-native application development and promoting them within the organization * Identifying opportunities to abstract Prospective Project requirements and develop Enterprise\-grade, multi\-tenant Platform Services * Collaborate with NASA security and compliance teams to ensure teams are adhering to industry best practices and regulatory requirements * Working directly with NASA human spaceflight missions like Orion, Lunar Gateway, Artemis Perform other duties as required * ### **Requirements** *This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.* **Requisition Qualifications:** * Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent certification in a related area and normally possess 10 years of experience in the field or in a related area. * Strong experience with Kubernetes in production * Ability to manage and use GitLab (preferably very proficient) * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipeline tools * Observability Monitoring tools such as Grafana and SuperSet * Proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code utilizing Terraform for infrastructure automation and/or open source alternatives (OpenTofu) * Extensive Linux experience (familiarity with Windows also preferred, but not required) * Expert in at least one programming language (Go and Python is preferred) * Experience with Python, SQL (and R is preferable) Working understanding of Machine Learning Model Lifecycle management (is preferred) * **Requisition Preferences:** * Solution\-oriented mindset, accepts feedback with enthusiasm * Effectively communicates with team members: clear status updates to direct report, regularly establishes unanimous decisions with peers * Self\-motivated and self\-managing, with strong organizational skills * Experience architecting and building cloud\-native applications * Demonstrable success and confidence in owning the full project lifecycle * Good instincts for identifying opportunities for abstraction Balances individual project development tasks at hand with overall platform and company goals * ### **Benefits** GCS health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Typical benefits offered include flexible work schedules and opportunities to work remotely, educational reimbursement, retirement benefits (401K, Roth), health benefits, tax saving options, disability benefits, life and accident insurance, voluntary benefits, paid time off and paid holidays, and parental and pregnancy leave.

jobs.title: Tenure-Track Faculty Position - Open Rank : Computer Systems and Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers. **About Georgia Tech** Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school. **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values** Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do: 1\. Students are our top priority. 2\. We strive for excellence. 3\. We thrive on diversity. 4\. We celebrate collaboration. 5\. We champion innovation. 6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression. 7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community. 8\. We act ethically. 9\. We are responsible stewards. Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact. **Location** ------------ Atlanta, GA **Department Information** -------------------------- **About the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at the Georgia Institute of Technology** The School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at the Georgia Institute of Technology is one of the largest producers of electrical engineers and computer engineers in the United States. Almost 2,600 students are enrolled in the School's graduate and undergraduate programs, and in the last academic year, 801 degrees were awarded. All ECE undergraduate and graduate programs are in the top five of the most recent college rankings by U.S. News \& World Report. In addition to the main campus in Atlanta, Georgia, ECE also has permanent operations at Georgia Tech\-Lorraine in France. Graduate students who spend at least one semester each at two Georgia Tech locations (Atlanta or Lorraine (North America or Europe) can earn the Georgia Tech Global Engineering Immersion Program (GEIP) Certificate when they receive the Georgia Tech M.S. degree. Over 110 ECE faculty members are involved in 11 areas of research and education: bioengineering, computer systems and software, digital signal processing, electrical energy, electromagnetics, electronic design and applications, nanotechnology, optics and photonics, systems and controls, telecommunications, and VLSI systems and digital design: and the School is either home to or a key player in almost 20 research centers and consortia. ECE is key to Georgia Tech's growing reputation as an internationally recognized educational and research and development university. ECE is firmly committed to sustaining excellence in traditional areas of strength and venturing into burgeoning areas of opportunity. **Job Summary** --------------- The School of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position in the general area of Computer Engineering. The School is interested in broad areas of computer\-aided design of modern computing systems, both digital and analog. Areas of interest include EDA for synthesis, verification, physical design, and post\-silicon debug of complex heterogeneous SoCs and SoPs. This includes recent advances in AI/LLM/agent\-based EDA tools. There is also interest in neural architecture search and software\-hardware co\-design of emerging AI workloads such as agentic and embodied AI. Particular topics of interest include self\-aware hardware, runtime adaptation and continua est and experience in translating their research to commercial applications. Applicants should have earned a Ph.D. or equivalent. Candidates will be considered at the ranks of Assistant and Associate Professor. Exceptional candidates may also be considered for appointment as full Professor. Applicants should submit an application cover letter, curriculum vitae, research statement, teaching statement, and the names of three references. Georgia Tech prides itself on its technology resources, collaborations, and high\-quality student body. We encourage applications from women, underrepresented minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance. **To receive full consideration, interested applicants should submit their materials on or before December 31, 2026\.** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- Applicants should have earned a Ph.D. or equivalent. **Required Documents to Attach** -------------------------------- **Interested candidates should submit:** An application letter Curriculum vitae Research statement Teaching statement The names of three references. **Contact Information** ----------------------- **For additional information about this job opening, please contact:** Linda Dillon, at linda.dillon@ece.gatech.edu Lucretia Allen, at lucretia.allen@ece.gatech.edu Shalonda Williams, at shalonda.williams@ece.gatech.edu **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8\.2\.18\.1\.2 and can be found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/\#p8\.2\.18\_personnel\_conduct. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- The Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Institute is committed to maintaining a fair and respectful environment for all. To that end, and in accordance with federal and state law, Board of Regents policy, and Institute policy, Georgia Tech provides equal opportunity to all faculty, staff, students, and all other members of the Georgia Tech community, including applicants for admission and/or employment, contractors, volunteers, and participants in institutional programs, activities, or services. Georgia Tech complies with all applicable laws and regulations governing equal opportunity in the workplace and in educational activities. Equal opportunity and decisions based on merit are fundamental values of the University System of Georgia ("USG") and Georgia Tech. Georgia Tech prohibits discrimination, including discriminatory harassment, on the basis of an individual's race, ethnicity, ancestry, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetics, or veteran status in its programs, activities, employment, and admissions. Further, Georgia Tech prohibits citizenship status, immigration status, and national origin discrimination in hiring, firing, and recruitment, except where such restrictions are required in order to comply with law, regulation, executive order, or Attorney General directive, or where they are required by Federal, State, or local government contract. **Background Check** -------------------- A successful candidate must be able to pass a background check. Please visit: https://usg.policystat.com/policy/19298143/latest

Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: GitHub is changing the way the world builds software, and we want you to help lead this effort. The Traffic Team plays a critical role in GitHub's scalability and resiliency. GitHub’s Traffic team is responsible for every packet into and out of GitHub’s edge and delivers a foundational load balancing platform for all of its services. The team’s objective is to ensure that GitHub continues to operate industry\-leading services at global scale, and to ensure internal engineering teams have the tools and processes necessary to build on top of our platform with as little friction as possible. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Traffic Team, you will work closely with a distributed, diverse, and passionate team of engineers to improve and maintain part of the platform that millions of developers worldwide rely on in their software development cycle. The Traffic Team is highly distributed, and you will thrive in an environment of remote work and asynchronous communication. You're expected to have strong written communication skills and be able to develop working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe. As an engineer at GitHub, you'll always be challenged to solve interesting and novel problems that have a real impact on how the world builds software. Responsibilities: * Lead technical decision making and architecture * Design and implement scalable, reliable and performant solutions for complex problems like rate\-limiting, routing, etc. * Maintain and improve the GitHub Load Balancer, and other systems related to traffic management at GitHub * Write, review, and maintain code primary in Go and Ruby \& Rails * Mentor other engineers in production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python. + OR equivalent experience. * 4\+ years building and supporting large, high traffic applications at scale within platform/infrastructure domains * 4\+ years supporting and building cloud native workloads in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud * 2\+ years experience maintaining a Load Balancer with proven experience in abuse protection mechanisms for DDoS attacks, load shedding, etc. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience with HAProxy, or any other open\-source Load Balancer * 2\+ Years of Golang experience * Experience building or maintaining planetary scale engineering systems * Experience working with a remote, distributed team * Strong written and verbal communication skills Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400\.00 \- USD $372,300\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Advancement Services
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. **About the role** ------------------ Everything GiveCampus is building runs on school data, and today, getting that data connected is the top reason a school's launch stalls. GC Intelligence, our AI that predicts which donors are likely to give and drafts outreach to them, needs a school's full donor history to work. So do Smart Ask Amounts, which suggest how much to ask each donor for, and GC Gift Officer, the tool fundraisers use to manage their donor relationships. All of it depends on data flowing between GiveCampus and the school's CRM, where its advancement office (the fundraising and alumni relations team) keeps every donor, gift, and interaction. Only a fraction of our Partner schools send us their complete data. Closing that gap is one of the biggest growth levers in front of the company. The Advancement Services team owns that flow. It's named for the advancement services staff at each school, the people who manage donor data and the main users of what we build. We connect GiveCampus to the CRMs schools run, mainly Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT and Salesforce\-based systems such as Ascend and Affinaquest. We also own the API that schools and software partners use to send and pull data, the guided data importer that lets schools upload files of donor and gift records, and a new queue\-driven pipeline on AWS designed to move tens of millions of records. We're hiring two Senior Software Engineers to build that pipeline and the bidirectional integrations that run on it. A redelivered message can become a duplicate gift in a school's books, and the CRM on the other end may cap you at about 10 requests per second. You'll design for both. You'll also help set how the team builds with AI agents, from the checks and context files that keep agents on track to the guardrails that keep them away from donor data they shouldn't touch. The team is small and the surface area is large, so you'll own big pieces of it from your first month. The code you ship decides whether a gift made on a giving day (a school's one\-day fundraising push) lands in a school's CRM correctly that same day. You'll work closely with the Advancement Services Product Manager, Partner Success, Partner Operations, and Data Science, plus the CRM vendors and connector partners whose APIs we build against. The team runs one\-week sprints and ships to production multiple times a day. **We're hiring at two levels.** At IC4, you'll own major components of the pipeline and integrations, with design input from the team. At IC5, you'll own the architecture of a system end to end, guide the team's agentic engineering practices, and mentor others through the work. If you're not sure which fits, apply and we'll figure it out together. **Successful outcomes** ----------------------- * A pipeline that holds up at scale. You design and ship AWS\-based pipelines with idempotent consumers. You keep memory and database load bounded, throttling writes, budgeting connections, and keeping pipeline storage off the app database. * Incremental syncs that stay corre riting context files, building skills, or adding checks and evals. You can tell us about a time you didn't trust an agent's output and the check you added afterward. * Infrastructure you can operate. You ship on AWS (or an equivalent cloud) with infrastructure as code, and you've owned the deploy, monitoring, and on\-call side of what you built. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience integrating with fundraising or nonprofit CRMs: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT or its SKY API, Salesforce (including Ascend or Affinaquest), or school systems like Ellucian, Veracross, or Slate. * Experience with Ruby on Rails and RSpec. * You've built a public or partner\-facing API product with OpenAPI documentation. * You've worked in higher education advancement, nonprofit fundraising, or a nearby domain. **What you'll learn here** -------------------------- You don't need to know advancement data on day one. In your first 90 days, you'll learn Raiser's Edge NXT, the Blackbaud SKY API, and the Salesforce products we support. You'll also learn the building blocks of school fundraising data: * Constituents: anyone a school tracks, such as alumni, parents, and donors. * Hard and soft credits: who gave a gift, and who else gets recognized for it, like a spouse or a company that matched it. * Recurring gifts and designations: gifts that repeat on a schedule, and the fund each gift goes to, such as financial aid or athletics. * Opportunities and assignments: large gifts a fundraiser is working toward, and which fundraiser owns each donor relationship. * Events: reunions, galas, and other gatherings, along with who registered and attended. You'll get to know our pipeline codebase and our tools (Metabase for reporting, New Relic, and the Rails console). If you come from another backend framework, you'll pick up Rails along the way. **Our stack** ------------- * Ruby on Rails and React * Postgres and Redis * AWS, including SQS, Aurora, S3, and EKS * REST APIs documented with OpenAPI, plus the Blackbaud SKY API, Salesforce, and other CRM APIs * Sentry and New Relic for observability * AI coding agents across the workflow, with shared context files, skills, and evals **How the team works** ---------------------- * You go deep on the other system's quirks. You'd rather read the SKY API changelog than guess at why a sync broke, and you want to know how a system got the way it is. * You use AI agents by default and verify what they produce. You've built the checks that catch when they're wrong. * You write it down. Design docs, PR descriptions, and incident notes that let a distributed team act without a meeting. * Strong opinions, loosely held. You argue hard for your approach, then commit fully once the team decides. * You care about the people on the other end: the advancement services staff reconciling every record, the fundraisers relying on the data, and the donors behind it all. Keep an eye on your spam and promotions folders in case our emails end up there. **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants.
