jobs.description: ### **About** **GoodData.AI** At GoodData.AI, we're building the future of agentic AI for data intelligence. Our full\-stack data intelligence platform empowers companies to turn raw data into real business impact — from agentic AI apps to embedded analytics that scale securely and seamlessly. With GoodData.AI, organizations don't just analyze data, they monetize it. But what really sets GoodData.AI apart is our mission: to put intelligence wherever decisions are made. That's why we've built a platform that's AI\-native, composable, and built for the way modern enterprises work. ### **About the Role** ### **GoodData is hiring a Sales Engineer in San Francisco to win new deals and grow our US accounts. You’ll be the technical lead on our US deals. That means confidently walking into a room with a CIO, a data engineering lead, and a skeptical architect, quickly understanding your audience, and leading a conversation that moves the deal forward. You're comfortable running customer demos and technical discussions independently, navigating tough questions, and building credibility with stakeholders at every level. You don’t wait for the AE to tell you what’s next. You anticipate technical challenges, develop solutions, and proactively drive the next steps.** This is far beyond a standard demo role. You will act as a strategic technical advisor and advocate, guiding enterprise customers on how GoodData's Agentic Serving Plane—including our semantic layer, agentic AI capabilities, embedded analytics, and flexible APIs—fits seamlessly into modern data architectures. ### **What you'll do** **Own the technical sales cycle** * **Lead technical discovery:** Evaluate customer business goals, data stack, AI roadmap, integration requirements, and security criteria. * **Design tailored solutions:** Formulate solution architecture, data modeling strategies, and AI/agentic workflows into actionable recommendations, interactive demos, and prototypes. * **Deliver technical presentations:** Conduct customized product demos and deep\-dive technical workshops for prospect stakeholders and executive teams. * **Support GTM initiatives:** Collaborate on technical outbound content, customer expansion playbooks, and workshops to drive net new acquisition and cross\-sell momentum. * **Drive Proofs of Concept (PoCs):** Define success criteria, build PoCs, manage check\-ins, and deliver final technical readouts to secure technical wins. * **Partner with Account Executives:** Align on deal strategy, opportunity qualification, mutual action plans, and technical validation. * **Manage technical procurement:** Complete RFPs/RFIs, security questionnaires, and architecture reviews in coordination with cross\-functional teams. **Be GoodData's technical voice in the US** * Present at conferences, meetups, partner events, and webinars; deliver talks and live demos * Represent GoodData at customer dinners, executive briefings, and booth sessions * Work with US partners in the data ecosystem (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, cloud providers) on joint demos and co\-selling. ### **How we work** * **Collaborative Spirit:** Partner with US\-based Account Executives, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success teams while serving as the vital technical bridge to European technical sales, engineering and product leaders. * **Hybrid Work:** This position is based in San Francisco, CA. Connect in\-person with colleagues at our SF office 2\-3 days a week, with client and event travel as deal momentum demands. * **Global Collaboration:** Work closely with our European teams, requiring regular early morning availability starting at 7:00 AM PT, with occasional meetings as early as 6:00 AM PT. Afternoons are generally focused on US customer discovery and strategic meetings. * **Travel:** Up to 20% travel within North America for high\-impact on\-sites, key conferences, and partner events, with occasional trips to Europe. Depending on the progress of the deals, we sometimes visit prospects at later stages of the deal or for in\-person discovery sessions. ### **What you bring** * 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Field CTO, Forward\-Deployed Engineer or similar), ideally selling B2B data, analytics, AI solutions, or developer platforms to US mid\-market and enterprise buyers. * A proactive, owner’s mindset: you anticipate what a deal needs next, whether that’s a prototype, an executive briefing, or a hard conversation about fit, and you drive it forward before anyone asks. * Demonstrated experience independently managing the technical aspects of complex sales opportunities, from discovery and PoC through technical validation and close. * Presence: you’re at ease running a live demo for a room or a C\-level audience, handling hard questions, and steering a meeting that’s going sideways. * Solid grounding in analytics and data: SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic layers, and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Postgres). * Hands\-on building skills: you can prototype with Python, SQL, REST APIs, SDKs, and/or React/TypeScript, using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as part of your daily work. * Practical knowledge of AI and agentic systems: LLMs, agents, MCP, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and guardrails, and the ability to tell what is real from what is hype. * Strong communication skills. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** ==================================== **Location:** San Francisco or remote · Full\-time **About us** ------------ Hum’s mission is to learn how the Earth changes by building a “world model for the entire world”: one that represents the dynamics of Earth processes, forecasts what a place looks like next, and makes that understanding useful. Founded at the University of Waterloo and backed by top investors like HF0, Climactic, Onto Ventures and angels from Firebase and OpenTable, we are a small team working on some of the largest unsolved problems. **The role** ------------ As our Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own the software and infrastructure that trains and serves our models, so our research scientists can stay focused on the models themselves. The rest of our engineering team is building the pipelines that ingest petabytes of earth observation and remote sensing data, and an agent that uses that data and our models to answer customer questions. You'll own everything in between, the path from ingested data into training, the systems that run experiments and large\-scale training, and the inference path that delivers model outputs to the agent. You'll work closely with those engineers to fit all the pieces together, and with our AI research scientists to make the models they dream up trainable, measurable, and servable at scale, from the first small experiment through full training runs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the ML platform.** Build and run the systems for experiment tracking, distributed training at scale, and serving inference, and keep them fast, reliable, and reproducible. * **Collaborate on the interfaces.** Work with our engineers and scientists to define and maintain the boundaries between data and training, data and inference, and inference and the agent. * **Enable multimodal training.** Build the data and model plumbing that lets us train on many sensors, observation types, and text in one model. * **Go from small to large.** Help our scientists prove ideas in fast, cheap experiments, then scale the winners to petabyte\-scale training runs. * **Make evaluation real.** Implement and improve our benchmarks and evaluation frameworks, both internal and user\-facing. * **Watch the meter.** Measure and optimize the cost and wall\-clock time of experiments, training, and inference. * **Support the agent.** Work with the product team on how the agent calls the model and consumes its outputs, and build the integration. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience, including hands\-on machine learning engineering. * Proficiency building distributed, multi\-node training pipelines in PyTorch and Lightning. * Experience with AWS or another cloud platform, particularly the tooling for training and serving medium\-to\-large models. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production\-quality Python and care about reliability, observability, and cost. * Fluent with modern agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and current on how to use them well. **Bonus** --------- * Experience training large diffusion or transformer models, ideally on video or time\-series data. * Experience with multimodal or spatiotemporal data, geospatial data, or geoscience problems. * Experience serving models in production and integrating them with downstream applications or agents. * Startup experience, comfortable with a small, fast\-moving team. **Why us?** ----------- * **Work that matters for the planet.** Our customers in nature conservation, carbon removal, and government use our models to protect ecosystems and respond to a changing climate. We take positive impact seriously, including safety and guardrails, and you'll help us get it right. * **A team worth joining.** Founded at the University of Waterloo by PhDs and engineers who've built and shipped at scale, we're small, technical, and collaborative. You'll work alongside people who care about the problem as much as you do. * **Well backed.** $10M\+ raised from HF0, Inovia Capital, and Propeller Ventures, angels including the cofounders of Firebase and OpenTable, and partners like AWS and the United Nations. * **Compensation and upside.** Competitive salary, meaningful early\-stage equity, health, dental and vision. As one of the first AI hires, your equity stake reflects that.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account** Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more. **About the Role** ------------------ Happen Bank is building a modern enterprise data and AI platform on Databricks. Our Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Analytics teams build the pipelines. This team builds what they build on. As a Principal Data Engineer, you'll own the technical architecture and development of the platform frameworks and infrastructure that make downstream pipelines faster, safer, and more consistent. This includes configuration\-driven ingestion frameworks, secure connectivity to source systems, reusable data protection libraries for anonymization and tokenization, and the infrastructure\-as\-code foundation that brings these capabilities together. This is a framework and platform engineering role, not a pipeline\-delivery role. Success means enabling teams to onboard new data sources, protect sensitive information, and promote work to production through configuration rather than custom code.**What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own ingestion architecture:** Define the technical vision and architecture for a declarative, configuration\-driven ingestion framework that brings data from relational databases and object\-store files into the raw data layer. Establish reusable patterns and contracts for downstream teams while evaluating tradeoffs between ingestion approaches * **Build scalable platform frameworks:** Lead the design and implementation of reusable, versioned libraries that support policy\-driven data protection, including configurable rules, governed access, consistent outputs, secure\-by\-default failure behavior, and audit trails. Maintain backward compatibility across shared capabilities used by multiple teams * **Set infrastructure and deployment standards:** Define infrastructure\-as\-code practices for safe deployment, replacement, rollback, and lifecycle management, including data ownership considerations for managed pipeline objects. Establish compute, cost, and sizing guidance for large initial loads and steady\-state incremental processing at billion\-row scale * **Drive platform reliability and observability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, recovery, and data validation capabilities that ensure reliable operations from source to destination. Identify and address observability gaps in underlying platform tools * **Lead evidence\-based technology decisions:** Conduct structured proofs of concept with measurable success criteria, document architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and engage technology vendors to resolve product gaps and influence future capabilities * **Drive cross\-functional platform delivery:** Translate ambiguous technical challenges into clear requirements, interfaces, dependencies, and phased delivery plans. Partner with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Information Security, DBAs, and source\-system owners to deliver early solutions while building scalable long\-term capabilities and driving framework adoption * **Raise engineering standards:** Mentor senior and staff engineers, lead technical design and code reviews, and establish best practices for testing, documentation, release management, and maintainability across shared platform capabilities **About You** ------------- * 10\+ years of software or data platform engineering experience, including designing and delivering platform\-level frameworks, libraries, or infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams * Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong experience with infrastructure as code, including Terraform and CI/CD pipelines for data platforms * Deep experience building ingestion capabilities across diverse data sources, including relational databases, files, APIs, and custom systems, with expertise in incremental processing, change data capture (CDC), schema evolution, and protecting production source systems from excessive load * Advanced programming skills in Python, SQL, and a JVM language such as Scala or Java, with experience developing Spark UDFs and reusable libraries using strong testing, packaging, and versioning practices * Deep hands\-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader, workflows, compute configuration, and governance capabilities, or equivalent data platform experience * Strong knowledge of security and priva * Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles or equivalent deployment tooling **Work Location** San Francisco The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in\-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in\-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In\-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level. **Time Zone Requirements** Local hours (PT) While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary. **Travel Requirements** As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed. **Compensation** The target base salary range for this position is 197,000\-230,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long\-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings). We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-JH1 Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com. **Notice on AI Tool Use** For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process. jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description: ### **About HappyRobot** HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email \- they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23\) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle\-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. ### **The Role** As the Head of Customer Success, you will own the post\-sale experience for HappyRobot’s largest and most strategic enterprise customers, and you will build the team and systems that scale it. You will set the vision, structure, and operating rhythm for Customer Success, with direct accountability for adoption, retention, net revenue retention, and expansion across our customer base. This is a player\-coach leadership role. In the near term, you will stay close to our top accounts and serve as an executive sponsor in critical customer relationships. Over time, you will hire and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, define the playbooks they run, and partner with Sales, Deployment, Product, and Engineering to make sure every customer sees measurable value from their AI workforce. We are especially interested in leaders with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams. ### **What You Will Do** * Own the Customer Success function and its targets for gross retention, net revenue retention, expansion, and customer health. * Serve as the executive sponsor for our largest enterprise accounts, building relationships with operators, VPs, and C\-level stakeholders. * Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Customer Success Managers, and define clear career paths and performance standards. * Build the Customer Success operating model, including account segmentation, coverage models, health scoring, renewal forecasting, and escalation processes. * Create repeatable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, business reviews, risk management, and expansion that scale across regions and customer types. * Partner with Sales to identify and close expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, and own the renewal motion. * Work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Strategists to ensure smooth handoffs from implementation to ongoing success. * Act as the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot, translating feedback and usage patterns into clear input for Product and Engineering. * Define and report on Customer Success metrics, and present performance, risks, and strategy to the executive team and board. * Select and implement the tools and systems the team needs, such as CRM, health scoring, and customer analytics. ### **What You Bring** * 10 or more years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer\-facing function at a B2B SaaS or technology company, including 3 or more years leading and scaling a team. * **Preferred:** Hands\-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi\-stakeholder accounts. * A proven track record of owning retention, net revenue retention, and expansion targets for enterprise customers. * Experience building a Customer Success function from an early stage, including hiring, process design, and tooling. * Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C\-level stakeholders. * Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and drive decisions from them. * Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers. * A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast\-growing startup. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with AI, automation, or voice products. * Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems. * Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base. * Prior experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup, ideally through a Series A to C stage. ### **Why HappyRobot** Why Join Us * Join a world\-class team of engineers and builders. * Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo. * Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. * Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage. * Competitive salary \+ equity in a high\-growth startup. Our Operating Principles **Extreme Ownership** We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame\-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. **Craftsmanship** Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw\-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching. **We are “majos”** Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. **Urgency with Focus** Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high\-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy. **Talent Density and Meritocracy** Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. **First\-Principles Thinking** Strip a problem to physics\-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy\-paste solutions.

jobs.title: Research and Learning Services Librarian – Engineering, Sciences and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description: **Position Details** -------------------- Position Information **About Hofstra** At Hofstra University, intellectual curiosity is not just aspirational – it is central to how we engage on a daily basis. Hofstra faculty work within a diverse scholarly community committed to student success, intellectual discovery, free inquiry, inclusivity, and collaboration. Enrolling more than 10,000 students, Hofstra offers students an array of undergraduate and graduate academic programs spanning the arts, humanities, sciences, business, engineering, law, health care, communications, and more. Our accomplished faculty collaborate with students to explore interdisciplinary questions and produce innovative research that lays the foundation for future personal and professional success. With a beautiful campus in Hempstead, NY, Hofstra’s location seamlessly merges the tranquility of coastal suburban living with the boundless opportunities of nearby New York City. Hofstra University is dedicated to recruiting and retaining a highly qualified and diverse academic community of students, faculty, staff, and administrators respectful of the contributions and dignity of each of its members. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive community. **Position Title** Research and Learning Services Librarian – Engineering, Sciences and Artificial Intelligence **Position Number** 896255 **Position Category** **School/Division** Library Operations **Department** **Full\-Time or Part\-Time** Full\-Time **Description** The Hofstra University Library invites applications for a tenure\-track appointment as Research and Learning Services Librarian for Engineering, Sciences, and AI, in the Department of Research and Learning Services. This librarian will provide research and instructional support to students and faculty in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences and advance AI initiatives within the library and the broader campus community. The successful candidate will understand issues surrounding AI in academia and develop teaching and learning initiatives and services that address them. This librarian will bring a growth mindset, approaching emerging trends in librarianship and academia with curiosity and imagination. The Research and Learning Services Librarian for Engineering, Sciences, and AI will initiate and cultivate relationships with faculty, centers, programs, and projects across campus to integrate library resources and services into teaching, learning, and research. The successful candidate will demonstrate familiarity with research methodologies, grant\-seeking and proposal writing, and emerging technologies sufficient to expand and strengthen library research support for faculty and students. The University Library supports Hofstra University’s mission of providing quality education in an environment that encourages and nurtures learning through the free and open exchange of ideas. It shares the University’s commitment to academic freedom and the transmission, advancement, and preservation of knowledge. Through collaboration with students, faculty, and administrators, the University Library supports the University’s curricular offerings and meets the community’s research and instructional needs. Responsibilities include: * Engage actively with faculty in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences to integrate information literacy into curricula and provide research support to students. * Establish and cultivate relationships with faculty to support disciplinary research and enrich library services and collections. * Collaborate with the Center for Excellence in Learning, Teaching, and Assessment to support faculty teaching and research. * Develop and deliver workshops, credit\-bearing course modules, tutorials, and online lessons, and integrate AI instruction into curricula to introduce or refine ethical, practical, and critical uses of generative and applied AI in disciplinary contexts. * Develop and implement training for librarians to support the ongoing effective use of AI tools. * Provide reference services, individual research consultations, library instruction, and specialized programs to students, faculty, and staff, both in person and online. * Perform collection development duties in accordance with department policy. * Participate in professional and service activities within the Hofstra University Library, the University, and the broader profession. * Conduct research, publish, and participate in scholarly activities to meet the Hofstra University Library’s criteria for reappointment and tenure. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * An M.L.S. or M.L.I.S. degree from an ALA\-accredited program. * Experience providing public services in academic libraries. * Experience providing library instruction. * Familiarity with information use and research practices in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences. * Familiarity with AI literacy standards and discipline\-specific information literacy standards. * Experience using Springshare applications, such as LibAnswers, LibChat, and LibGuides. **Preferred Quals Summary** * Working knowledge of WorldCat Discovery, OCLC library management systems, and related systems. **Special Instructions** This is a tenure\-track faculty position. It will be filled at either the Instructor, Assistant, or Associate Professor rank, depending on qualifications. An additional graduate degree, scholarship, and university service are required for tenure consideration. Please upload the following with your application for consideration: * Cover letter * Curriculum vitae * Email address and phone number of three professional references All applications received by December 31, 2026, will receive full consideration. Inquiries should be directed to the Chair of the Search Committee Prof. William Caniano at William.Caniano@hofstra.edu . **Deadline** Open until filled **Tenure Track** Yes **Date Posted** 10/26/2026 **EEO Statement** Hofstra University is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to extending equal opportunity in employment to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, physical or mental disability, marital or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. **Salary/Salary Range** $75,000\-$85,000 Additional Information *Hofstra University provides the above salary\* as a good faith estimate of the starting pay range which considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and education. In addition to the salary offered, we offer a collegial and inclusive culture, and a benefits program which includes generous paid time off, paid holidays, tuition remission for employees and eligible dependents, and a retirement plan with University contributions.* * *Salary ranges indicated for positions covered under a Collective Bargaining Agreement are in accordance with the CBA.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI to join our Data Engineering, AI \& ML Platform team. This role will help design and build the enterprise platform capabilities that enable teams to create, deploy, evaluate, observe, and operate production\-grade AI agents and intelligent applications at scale. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, AI platform engineering, Generative AI, agentic systems, data engineering, and MLOps. A major focus of the role will be building reusable platform capabilities for agent development, including reasoning and orchestration workflows, tool integration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, memory/context management, evaluation, observability, and responsible operation of AI agents. Rather than building one\-off AI applications, you will help establish reusable services, SDKs, patterns, and platform components that accelerate AI development across Honeywell. You will collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML engineers, application teams, architects, product teams, and domain experts to take emerging AI capabilities from experimentation to secure, reliable, production\-grade enterprise services. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an engineer who is comfortable solving ambiguous problems, developing platform capabilities, and turning rapidly evolving AI technologies into maintainable production systems. The role is based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid basis. Note: For the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% Monday through Friday. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Agentic AI Platform** * Design and build reusable enterprise platform capabilities for developing, deploying, and operating AI agents and multi\-agent workflows. * Build frameworks and reusable components that allow agents to securely interact with enterprise APIs, data platforms, applications, tools, and knowledge sources. * Develop orchestration patterns using agentic AI frameworks, without coupling the platform to a single framework. * Build services supporting RAG and enterprise knowledge retrieval, including document ingestion, retrieval pipelines, vector/semantic search, grounding, citations, and contextual enrichment. * Develop systematic approaches for agent and LLM evaluation, including task success, response quality, grounding, tool\-use correctness, latency, reliability, and cost. Implement observability and tracing for agent execution so developers can understand agent decisions, model calls, tool calls, failures, performance, and resource consumption. * **AI Platform Engineering** * Design, build, and operate scalable platform services and APIs using Python and FastAPI or comparable production frameworks. * Build reusable APIs, SDKs, libraries, templates, and reference implementations that make it easier for engineering teams to develop and deploy AI applications. * Design cloud\-native AI platform services using technologies such as Azure, Kubernetes, Databricks, Azure * Machine Learning, MLflow, or equivalent platforms. * Develop production capabilities for model and application deployment, configuration, versioning, experimentation, evaluation, and lifecycle management. * Build automated CI/CD and testing pipelines for AI services, agent workflows, prompts/configurations, and supporting platform components. * Convert prototypes and notebook\-based experimentation into modular, testable, maintainable, production\-quality software. Design platform patterns for maintaining data quality, lineage, access control, and traceability across AI workflows. * **Production Engineering, Safety \& Reliability** * Build AI services with production software engineering practices covering testing, security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Implement end\-to\-end observability, tracing, monitoring, and alerting across agent workflows, models, APIs, retrieval systems, and platform services. * Establish mechanisms for handling agent failures, tool failures, model errors, timeouts, retries, and degraded dependencies. * Implement appropriate guardrails, access controls, auditability, and human oversight for enterprise agentic AI workflows. * Optimize AI workloads for latency, throughput, infrastructure utilization, and model/token cost. * Diagnose complex production issues spanning AI models, orchestration, data, APIs, infrastructure, and applications. **YOU MUST HAVE** * 8\+ years of software, data platform, ML platform, or AI engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting production\-grade systems. * Strong Python software engineering expertise, including API/service development, testing, debugging, packaging, design patterns, and modern software development best practices. * Experience building cloud\-native distributed applications and platforms using containers, Kubernetes, public cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and reliability engineering. * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including model serving, lifecycle management, monitoring, operational support, and production deployments. Experience building LLM and agentic AI applications, including RAG/grounding, enterprise data integration and retrieval (structured and unstructured data), orchestration frameworks, and tool/API integration. * **WE VALUE** * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing multi\-agent systems, agent tool ecosystems, planning/reasoning workflows, agent memory, or human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability platforms such as LangSmith, MLflow or equivalent tooling. * Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, Databricks, Kubernetes, or comparable AI/data platforms. * Experience with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, RDF/SPARQL, Neo4j, ontology engineering, or GraphRAG\-style knowledge systems. * Experience building AI systems that integrate with industrial IoT, operational technology, building systems, digital twins, or high\-volume telemetry. * Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, internal frameworks, or reusable engineering capabilities used by multiple development teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * **ABOUT HONEYWELL** Honeywell International Inc. (NYSE: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world’s most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software\-industrial company committed to introducing state\-of\-the\-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad\-based, attractive industrial end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. Learn more here: https://www.honeywell.com/us/en **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL** In addition to a performance\-driven salary, cutting\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer\-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. For more information: https://benefits.honeywell.com/ The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting date: October 26th, 2026 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. Key responsibilities include but are not limited to... * Support continuous improvement of the Information Marketplace as a core enterprise platform * Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications supporting the Information Marketplace platform * Build modern front\-end interfaces using React, TypeScript, and state management frameworks * Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js and related technologies * Translate business and technical requirements into well\-designed, maintainable software solutions * Contribute to the architecture of microservices, APIs, and UI frameworks with a focus on scalability, security, and performance * Integrate with enterprise platforms including metadata services, APIs, and third\-party tools * Troubleshoot and resolve complex jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a **Principal Data Engineer**, you will build and maintain the data pipelines that power AI model training and algorithm development for IDEXX inVue Dx and other AI\-powered diagnostic products. This is a hybrid role based out of our Westbrook, ME location, with a minimum expectation of 2 days a week onsite. The Data \& AI Center of Excellence (AI Enablement \& Model Operations) manages the data foundation behind IDEXX's AI\-powered diagnostics. You'll join the Data Engineering team, working hands on in Databricks, dbt, and Snowflake, and serving as a technical anchor for other engineers on the team. **In this role:** ----------------- \+ You will design, build, and maintain fault\-tolerant production data pipelines in Databricks and dbt Core, following the medallion architecture and SCD2 patterns already in place across the team. \+ You'll own delivery of a piece of the team's roadmap and partner directly with Data Science and MLE colleagues on what they need from the data. \+ Your day\-to\-day will include writing and reviewing code, tests, and documentation to a standard other engineers can build on. \+ You'll troubleshoot pipeline failures and data quality issues, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches problems early. \+ You'll contribute to Snowflake integration work, including federated connections and history tracking for source systems. \+ You'll mentor junior and mid level data engineers on code quality, data modeling, and platform best practices. \+ You'll review pull requests and pair with teammates on tricky problems. \+ You'll help scope and triage incoming Jira tickets, and flag when something needs to be escalated. \+ You'll take part in interviews for future hires on the team. \+ You'll partner with your manager on team standards for testing, deployment, and documentation. **Why this role matters:** -------------------------- The pipelines you build feed the AI models behind IDEXX inVue Dx and other AI\-powered diagnostic products, which help veterinary teams care for pets. This is a senior, hands on role with real ownership: you'll drive significant pieces of the pipeline from start to finish and set the bar for code quality and data modeling across the team. **What you need to succeed:** ----------------------------- \+ You have 7\+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with real production experience. \+ You have strong SQL and Python skills and hands on experience with dbt. \+ You've worked with a modern cloud data platform (Databricks and/or Snowflake strongly preferred). \+ You're comfortable with CI/CD, version control (GitHub), and automated testing for data pipelines. \+ You've mentored or reviewed the work of junior and mid level engineers. \+ You've worked directly with Data Science, MLE, or other technical partners to understand what they need from the data. \+ You use good judgment about when to escalate, when to make the call yourself, and when to ask for help. \+ Preferred: Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated data environment. \+ Preferred: Experience with AI/ML training pipelines, or working closely with data science or MLE teams. \+ Preferred: Familiarity with medallion architecture, SCD2 patterns, or similar data modeling conventions. \+ Preferred: A track record of proposing and driving improvements to engineering practices or tooling, not just following the ones already in place. **What you can expect from us:** -------------------------------- This is a hybrid role based out of our Westbrook, ME location, with a minimum expectation of 2 days a week onsite. \+ Competitive Salary starting at $130,000\+ annual salary \+ Opportunity for annual cash bonus, if applicable \+ Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One \+ 5% matching 401k \+ Pet insurance \+ Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more! **Why IDEXX:** -------------- We're proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve since 1983, our team members help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, ensure safe drinking water for billions, and help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease. We have customers in over 175 countries and a collaborative global workforce. Our culture embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you'll be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement. If meaningful work and a sense of purpose are at the top of your list, you'll find it here. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws. \#LI\-KS1

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: The AI Engineer designs, builds, deploys, and supports practical AI solutions that solve business problems and deliver measurable value. This role partners with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand workflows, identify high\-value opportunities, and translate ambiguous needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions. The position combines business\-facing consulting with hands\-on engineering, with a significant focus on designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting AI solutions. Solutions may range from low\-code agents and automations to custom\-developed Azure applications and integrations. The AI Engineer selects and implements the approach that best fits the business and technical requirements. The AI Engineer uses Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure, APIs, connectors, code, and other approved enterprise technologies, and treats AI solutions as production software by applying established software engineering and SDLC practices throughout their lifecycle. Success requires both strong communication skills and sound engineering judgment. The ideal candidate can work comfortably with non\-technical stakeholders while applying software engineering principles, AI governance, security, source control, testing, documentation, and operational support practices. **ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** include but are not limited to: * Supports and demonstrates IMA's core values * Values and understands the importance of diversity, equity, and inclusion among all IMA associates ### **Business Partnership \& Solution Design** * Partner with the AI Enablement Lead and business stakeholders to understand problems, workflows, users, data dependencies, risks, and success criteria. * Assess technical feasibility and translate business needs into requirements, solution architecture, user stories, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. * Communicate options, constraints, tradeoffs, and recommendations to business and technical audiences. The AI Enablement Lead primarily drives business engagement, prioritization, and adoption; the AI Engineer leads technical design and delivery. ### **AI Architecture \& Engineering** * Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, integrations, and AI\-enabled applications. * Develop solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure services, APIs, connectors, Python and/or C\#, and other approved technologies. * Design integrations with enterprise applications, knowledge sources, and structured or unstructured data. * Develop prompts, agent instructions, grounding strategies, tools, connectors, and reusable components. * Apply RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, agentic patterns, and model orchestration when appropriate. * Own or substantially contribute to architecture decisions, including Copilot Studio versus custom Azure solutions. Consider Azure AI Foundry capabilities when relevant and balance value, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability. ### **SDLC, Operations \& Quality** * Apply SDLC practices across requirements, architecture, development, code review, testing, release management, documentation, support, and retirement. * Use source control, CI/CD, environment separation, configuration management, and repeatable deployment practices. * Implement appropriate unit, integration, functional, regression, security, and user\-acceptance testing. * Build in logging, monitoring, usage analytics, performance measures, and alerts; troubleshoot production issues and perform root\-cause analysis. * Create architecture diagrams, technical specifications, runbooks, support documentation, and user guidance. ### **Governance, Security \& Value** * Implement controls for identity and access, data privacy, human oversight, source grounding, output validation, and auditability. * Evaluate and mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe or inaccurate outputs, bias, data leakage, and inappropriate tool actions. * Assess knowledge and data readiness, and partner with content owners to improve quality, permissions, organization, and lifecycle management. * Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on pilots, rollout, user enablement, adoption, feedback, and measurement of business outcomes. * Monitor solution reliability and usage, prioritize engineering enhancements, and contribute to the AI delivery backlog and roadmap. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS** include but are not limited to: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Three or more years of experience in software engineering, application development, automation, AI solution delivery, or a related technical field * At least one year of hands\-on experience designing and implementing AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, or AI\-enabled applications. * Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Aut RAG, agents, evaluations, and model limitations. * Ability to design secure, scalable, observable, supportable, and cost\-conscious cloud solutions. * Understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, data protection, networking, APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with non\-technical stakeholders. \#LI\-AG1 *The anticipated posting timeline for this opportunity is 10/27/2026\-11/27/2026\.* **Compensation \& Benefits** Being a part of IMA has its benefits. When you become part of the IMA family, you become eligible to take part in our valuable benefits and rewards package designed to benefit you, your family, and your life. jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** At **In Tandem**, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter. As a **Staff\+ Builder**, you're on the frontier of continuously redefining how we deliver software and exercise judgement in a constantly evolving landscape — a true AI\-native builder expanding products and how they get built. Some of the best work here starts with no brief, no team and no playbook. We want someone who sees that as the appeal: who takes an idea from zero to one and cares personally whether it gets traction. This role exists to bring that way of working into In Tandem, wherever the organization needs it most. This is an evergreen role. We will shape the specific team and scope with you as we learn where your strengths meet the most important opportunities across our products and platform. As we move through conversations, we will discuss the concrete problem area, collaborators, and expectations for the opening we are considering together.### **What you will do:** * **Seek out problems worth building for.** Talk with users, learn from support and product data, and pay attention to changes in our markets. Turn those signals into a clear view of what matters, then take initiative inside shared priorities, and bring partners along as you learn. * **Take it from zero to one.** Start where there is no structure. Get a first version in front of real users quickly, find out whether anyone cares, and do the unglamorous work that earns early traction. Own the outcome, not just the code. * **Carry useful work into production.** Shape a focused first version, build it, and learn from real use. Define how you will judge success before you build, then use the evidence to improve, expand, or stop the work. * **Raise the pace and quality of engineering.** Identify places where an AI\-enabled workflow can shorten the path from idea to shipped software. Build the tools, context, checks, and feedback loops that let other engineers use it with confidence. * **Own the hard decisions.** Move work forward when requirements are incomplete, make your reasoning visible, and bring consequential tradeoffs to the right partners. Choose when to prototype, when to invest in durable architecture, and how to verify that a system is correct, safe, and useful. * **Connect the pieces.** Work across product and engineering boundaries. Bring depth in a core platform and enough range across APIs, web, mobile, and infrastructure to help a feature succeed end to end. * **Make others stronger.** Share working examples, explain tradeoffs clearly, invite criticism, and help teams adopt what proves effective. ### **What strong work could look like:** The shape of the work will depend on the team. Examples include:* Recognizing a recurring difficulty in a family workflow, validating it with users and partners, and shipping a focused improvement across client and service boundaries. * Launching something small with no existing team or process, getting it to its first real users, and iterating on their feedback until it was adopted or you chose to stop. * Turning a promising agent prototype into a reliable engineering workflow with evaluation, tests, observability, and clear human review points. * Removing a recurring bottleneck in delivery so teams can make more high\-quality changes with less coordination. * Connecting an emerging user or market need to our product strategy, testing the opportunity with a small build, and using the result to decide whether it deserves more investment. These are examples of the work this role might own, not claims that those projects are planned or assigned. ### **What you bring:** * Staff\-level impact as a hands\-on engineer: you have shaped technical direction, built important systems, and helped other people deliver stronger work. * An owner's mindset. You've started something with little structure, such as a product, feature, internal tool, open\-source project or company. You stayed with it through the early phase until it found users or you learned it wouldn't. * Evidence that you can move from an uncertain problem to a useful result. You know how to test a premise with a prototype and how to recognize when a prototype needs stronger engineering before it can be trusted in production. * Product judgment and curiosity about users and markets. You can explain why a problem mattered, how you chose it with others, and what changed for users or the business because of what you built. * Practical fluency with AI\-assisted development. You have used models or agents to build real software or workflows, and you can explain where they helped, where they failed, and how you checked the result. * Strong judgment about architecture, quality, security, and user experience. You know which decisions need close attention and which can be accelerated. * Depth in at least one engineering area, with the curiosity and fundamentals to work effectively across the stack. * Low ego, high integrity, and a habit of making your reasoning visible so others can learn from and improve it. **What will stand out** Show us a piece of work you helped take from an uncertain opportunity to a useful result. If it started from zero, tell us what you did to get the first users and what you did when nobody was available to help. What user or market signal made the problem worth pursuing? How did you choose the direction with your partners? What did you build yourself, what reached production, and how do you know it made a difference? If AI or agents played a part, tell us what you delegated, how you evaluated the output, and what you changed when the first approach fell short. A strong account of a failed experiment and the judgment it sharpened is welcome. You may have built that work in a product company, a small team, open source, or a path that does not fit a conventional résumé. The evidence matters more than a particular employer name or tool list. **Why Join?** *We’re redefining family technology.* In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods. *Scale meets startup energy.* With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day. *Purpose\-driven. Performance\-focused. People\-first.* Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem\-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters. **How We Support You:*** Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members * 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting * Paid leave for all new parents * Learning \& Development stipend for employees * Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays \+ Winter Break (3 Days) \+ Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) \+ Floating Holiday (1 Day) * Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0\-1 years of employment \+ 20 days for 1\-3 years of employment * Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere! **Come As You Are**! In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.### **About In Tandem** We believe technology can champion deeper connections within families, strengthen bonds, and improve communication. We're building solutions that foster connection, organization, and peace\-of\-mind throughout key stages and milestones of family life.

jobs.description: **Sales Engineer** *Presales, Enterprise and Partner Sales \| Remote* **About Index Engines** ----------------------- At Index Engines, we're all about helping companies bounce back from cyber threats and trust their data again, no matter what hits them. Our flagship solution, CyberSense, delivers 99\.99% accuracy in detecting data corruption, helping organizations recover quickly from ransomware attacks. We partner with awesome industry leaders like Dell Technologies, IBM, Lenovo/Infinidat, and Hitachi Vantara to power AI\-driven cyber recovery across both primary and backup storage. You'll also be our ear in the field, bringing what you learn back to Product. **This is a remote role.** **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner with Account Executives to plan, prepare and jobs.title: Quality Automation Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: As a Quality Automation Engineer at Infotech, you'll help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of the products that state transportation agencies, contractors, and local governments rely on every day. You design test suites that are scalable and maintainable, and you can tell a flaky test from a true product bug at a glance. You understand the business your tests protect. You're also a collaborator. You'll partner with engineers and product managers early, during refinement, to define acceptance criteria and build for testability, and you'll help developers add automated checks earlier in the pull request cycle. You're curious about how AI tools and new techniques can improve how we deliver software, and you're passionate about building quality from the start. ### **What it's like to be an engineer at Infotech** **Our vision** We build software that makes our customers' jobs easier, faster, and less complicated. We do this by learning their challenges, solving problems in thoughtful ways, and always looking for ways to improve. **Our culture** We're a close\-knit group of curious, talented people who care about the work we do and the people we work with. On our team, you'll find that we are: * Curious and open. We ask questions, explore options, and stay open to new ideas. * Creative and lighthearted. We believe work is better with a little fun. * Relaxed and approachable while also being ambitious and technically sharp. * Focused on our customers and driven to solve real problems. * Empowering and supportive. We succeed by helping each other succeed. * Energized and communicative. We value clear, open collaboration and trust. * Always evolving. We love a good technical challenge and use it to grow together. ### **What will you do in this role?** * Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and backend services. * Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing, fast feedback loops, and automated quality gates. * Manage test environments, test data generation, and mock services so tests stay independent of external dependencies. * Speed up test execution through parallelization, containerization, and proactive management of flaky tests. * Create, maintain, and run functional, regression, API, integration, and end\-to\-end test suites. * Analyze build failures, separate framework issues from true product bugs, and track defects through resolution. * Expand coverage to non\-functional requirements, including performance, load, security, and accessibility testing. * Track quality metrics and test coverage to find gaps and build confidence in every release. * Partner with software engineers and product managers during refinement to define acceptance criteria and build for testability. * Champion a shift\-left testing culture by helping developers add automated checks earlier in the pull request cycle. * Take part in sprint planning, review test pull requests, and join release readiness sign\-offs. * Help set engineering\-wide QA standards, automation best practices, and testing guidelines. * Use AI tools and trend analysis to spot new opportunities and contribute ideas that improve our processes, services, and products. ### **The technical chops needed for this role** We know great engineers pick up new tools and approaches quickly, so depth and adaptability matter more than checking every box. That said, we expect proven, hands\-on experience in the areas below. You don't need to cover everything, but you should feel confident operating at a confident level and contributing meaningfully from day one. **Must Have** **Nice to Have** **Transferable** Test automation frameworks for web applications Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, WebDriver Other UI automation frameworks API and REST service testing Postman, REST Assured Other API testing tools A programming or scripting language for test code (Go) JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C\# Comparable languages CI/CD pipeline integration GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps Similar CI/CD tools QA methodology, test design, regression testing, and defect tracking JIRA Testing database\-backed systems SQL and database validation (strong grasp of data structures) Test environments, test data, and service mocking Mocking and stubbing tools, test data management Fast, reliable test execution (parallelization, flaky test management) Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Non\-functional test coverage (performance, load, security, accessibility) Load, performance, and security testing tools; cross\-browser testing Clear test documentation and defect communication Experience testing enterprise SaaS platforms ### **What we offer** * **Comprehensive health benefits** and inclusive wellness support * **Flexible time off** and paid holidays * **Continuing education and leadership development programs** * **An inclusive culture** built on empathy, connection, and trust ### **You must have** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field and one year of relevant experience; or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field and one year of relevant experience. * 3\+ years of experience in software quality assurance or test automation. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. ### **We would like you to have** * Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and containerized environments such as Docker or Kubernetes. * Experience with SQL and database validation. * Experience with load, performance, or security testing tools. * Experience testing enterprise SaaS platforms. * Experience with test data management and mocking or stubbing tools. * An understanding of accessibility and cross\-browser compatibility testing. * Strong soft skills, including collaboration, clear communication, and a team\-first mindset. * Pride in your work. Showcase your skills and let us celebrate your successes! ### **Where you will work** Infotech is a flexible employer. Our people\-first culture allows us to support remote, hybrid, or on\-site work arrangement preferences whenever possible. This position is open to fully remote candidates. Construct your future with us while working fully remote within the US. This position requires up to 10% travel and may occasionally require after\-hours work. ### **Who we are** If you're driving on a highway in North America, there's a good chance Infotech software helped build it. In the U.S., **88% of state transportation agencies use Infotech\-developed software** to manage road construction. From digital bidding to secure document signing, from cost estimation to inspection, we build tools that streamline infrastructure project delivery and ensure transparency, quality, and compliance. We're proud to be a **Certified™ Great Place to Work®** (https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified\-company/7060193\), with a people\-first culture, outstanding employee retention, and flexible work\-life support. Headquartered in Gainesville, Florida, Infotech is a pioneer in civil construction software and a vibrant community of technologists, collaborators, and problem solvers. ### **Additional Information** This is a non\-sponsorship eligible position. **Resume required.** In compliance with pay and benefits transparency requirements, please visit the Total Rewards page (https://www.infotechinc.com/total\-rewards) on our website. jobs.title: Transformer Design Engineer
jobs.description: Description:**Engineer the Power Behind Critical Industries** ------------------------------------------------- At **Intermountain Electronics (IE)**, we design, manufacture, automate, and test custom\-engineered electrical equipment and critical power infrastructure for industries across North America. Our solutions support mission\-critical operations, industrial facilities, OEM applications, oil and gas, mining, and other essential markets. We're seeking a **Transformer Design Engineer** to join our team in Price, Utah. This position offers an opportunity to take transformer projects from initial customer requirements and technical design through manufacturing, testing, and field support. You'll combine electrical engineering expertise with hands\-on problem\-solving, collaborate with customers and production teams, and help deliver reliable, high\-quality transformer solutions. If you enjoy turning complex technical requirements into practical, manufacturable designs and seeing your work come to life, we'd love to hear from you! **Why Join IE?** ---------------- At IE, engineering is about more than drawings and calculations. Our engineers work closely with the people who manufacture, test, and deliver our equipment. You'll be part of a collaborative team that values technical expertise, creative problem\-solving, continuous improvement, and pride in the products we build. Learn more about IE and our products at **ie\-corp.com**. **Benefits \& Employee Perks** ------------------------------ * Competitive salary * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 10 paid holidays * Medical and dental insurance plans * Teladoc access to U.S. board\-certified doctors, available 24/7/365 * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Company\-paid life insurance * Supplemental vision, life, short\-term disability (STD), and long\-term disability (LTD) insurance options * 401(k) with company matching contributions of up to 6% of base salary * Health Savings Account (HSA) with available company matching contributions of up to $2,000, depending on family size * Paid parental leave **Position Overview** --------------------- The Transformer Design Engineer is responsible for developing accurate transformer quotations, electrical designs, and manufacturing documentation while providing technical support throughout the entire project lifecycle. This role serves as a technical resource for customers, application engineers, procurement, fabrication, production, quality assurance, and field service personnel. Responsibilities include evaluating customer requirements, designing transformer components and assemblies, coordinating manufacturing activities, resolving production challenges, supporting transformer testing, and troubleshooting equipment after delivery. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Transformer Engineering, Design \& Customer Support** * Evaluate customer plans, technical specifications, and applicable codes to establish transformer project requirements. * Serve as a technical resource for customers, recommending transformer configurations and identifying opportunities to incorporate IE products into project specifications. * Partner with business development personnel on strategic customer visits and participate in joint customer meetings to support major or critical project opportunities. * Prepare accurate, timely transformer quotations for IE application engineers and customers, applying appropriate pricing markups and entering information into Epicor. * Develop complete electrical designs that meet project requirements, coordinating with customers and internal teams to clarify specifications and secure necessary approvals. * Prepare engineering and manufacturing documentation before production begins. * Design transformer components and parts used in final assemblies, translating handwritten design information into detailed AutoCAD drawings. ### **Manufacturing Coordination \& Production Support** * Coordinate the fabrication of transformer hardware and components with internal fabrication teams and outside vendors. * Develop comprehensive bills of materials (BOMs) and submit them for procurement after review with the IEC General Manager. * Monitor and support transformer manufacturing activities to verify that completed equipment meets required form, fit, function, and customer specifications. * Ensure transformer projects comply with IE quality standards and customer\-defined quality requirements. * Work with the Production Supervisor to confirm manufacturing processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are followed consistently. * Collaborate with the IEC General Manager and Price Manufacturing Manager to develop, document, implement, and improve transformer manufacturing procedures. * Establish standardized work instructions and employee training processes that support established SOPs. * Assist directly with transformer manufacturing when additional production capacity is needed, using hands\-on experi loyees, fellow engineers, customers, supervisors, and management to deliver accurate designs and specifications within established deadlines. * Strong understanding of the overall engineering and manufacturing process, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to anticipate challenges during planning and design reviews. * Ability to communicate technical information clearly to production\-floor employees and other team members. * Strong analytical, research, design, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Effective project management skills, including coordinating resources, communicating progress and changes, and completing work within established schedules and budgets. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including active listening, presenting numerical information, and interpreting technical documentation. * Strong customer service skills and commitment to meeting customer and internal team expectations. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, organize tasks, adapt to changing conditions, and meet strict deadlines. * Demonstrated leadership, sound judgment, initiative, creativity, and willingness to pursue professional development. * Commitment to teamwork, confidentiality, professionalism, ethical conduct, and a respectful, harassment\-free workplace. * Understanding of how engineering decisions affect quality, cost, productivity, revenue, and company resources. * Willingness to share technical knowledge, support organizational goals, complete administrative responsibilities accurately, and contribute to continuous improvement. * Ability to respond constructively to unexpected challenges, accept direction, follow through on commitments, and maintain consistent productivity and quality standards. ### **Certifications \& Licenses** * Must possess a valid driver's license. * Must hold OSHA Forklift Certification or be able to obtain certification within one month of employment. ### **Supervisory Responsibilities** This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. ### **Work Environment** * Work is performed primarily in an office setting with generally quiet to moderate noise levels. * Occasional exposure to moving mechanical equipment and potential electrical shock hazards may occur. * The position may involve occasional exposure to fumes, airborne particles, and toxic or caustic chemicals. * Employees must follow IE safety procedures, promptly report unsafe conditions, and work safely around machinery and moving equipment. ### **Physical Requirements** * Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Frequently stand and walk, with occasional extended periods of standing or working on concrete surfaces. * Regularly use hands and arms for handling, reaching, and performing job\-related activities. * Perform movements including climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling as required. * Regularly communicate through speaking and hearing. * Occasionally sit and perform activities involving taste or smell. * Possess the visual capabilities needed for the position, including close, distance, color, and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. ### **Work Schedule \& Availability** * Must be available to work a standard 40\-hour workweek. * Additional hours may be required based on project demands and business needs. ### **Additional Employment Information** This job description outlines the general duties and responsibilities associated with the position.
