jobs.title: Communications Data Specialist
jobs.description: **Communications Data Specialist** The UAW has taken an all\-new approach to bargaining and striking. During the 2023 negotiations with Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis, our union ran a contract campaign for the first time, initiated strikes against all three companies at the same time, and brought a whole new level of transparency to bargaining. The result was record\-breaking contracts. From our Stand Up Strike to the recently announced new organizing drive across 13 non\-union automakers, the UAW is at the forefront of rebuilding a fighting labor movement. Our union is seeking a Communications Data Specialist to join our powerhouse Communications team in assisting strategic campaigns across the country. The Communications Data Specialist will help build, maintain, and improve the data, communications, and technology infrastructure that powers the UAW's strategic campaigns. The ideal candidate is a technically strong, self\-motivated problem solver who can work across the full technology stack—from user\-facing web tools and dashboards to server\-side applications, databases, APIs, integrations, and automated communications systems. This position also requires exceptional people and customer service skills. The successful candidate will be highly responsive to colleagues and campaign partners, able to translate technical problems into practical solutions, and comfortable working with stakeholders across departments and levels of the organization. The ideal candidate understands that getting things done in a large organization requires both technical expertise and the ability to navigate organizational structures, competing priorities, hierarchy, and bureaucracy while maintaining momentum toward strategic goals. Candidates must be comfortable working in a high\-intensity, high\-velocity environment and be willing to work long and irregular hours, along with travel, including overnight stays. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Strategic Campaign \& Cross\-Department Collaboration** * Work with the Communications Director and staff across departments to leverage data, member lists, communications platforms, and technology in support of strategic campaign objectives. * Translate the needs of communications and campaign staff into practical, user\-friendly technical solutions. * Navigate organizational hierarchy, competing priorities, and bureaucracy with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skills while finding ways to move projects forward. * Identify opportunities to improve technology, data practices, and workflows and proactively implement solutions. **2\. Full\-Stack Web Development \& Technical Systems** * Design, build, maintain, and improve full\-stack web applications and internal tools using TypeScript and related technologies, including frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and databases. * Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive web experiences and data\-driven tools for staff and campaign use. * Assess, troubleshoot, document, and improve websites, web applications, databases, communications platforms, and other technical systems. * Diagnose technical problems independently and communicate clearly about solutions, risks, timelines, and technical needs. **3\. Data, Systems Integration \& Automation** * Analyze large communications datasets to generate strategic insights, improve targeting, and support campaign planning and decision\-making. * Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows, and integrations between Solidarity Tech, CRMs, databases, websites, communications platforms, and other systems. * Maintain a strong working knowledge of Solidarity Tech and its integration with the UAW's broader technology and data ecosystem. * Improve data quality, system interoperability, automation, and the reliability and accessibility of campaign information. **4\. Staff Support, Training \& Customer Service** * Provide highly responsive technical and customer support to Communications staff and other stakeholders, following issues through to resolution and prioritizing urgent campaign needs. * Provide ongoing training and support for Solidarity Tech, communications platforms, data systems, dashboards, and other technology tools. * Develop documentation, training materials, and processes that enable staff to effectively use systems and reduce dependence on individual technical staff. * Build strong relationships with technical and non\-technical users and serve as a trusted, solutions\-oriented resource. **5\. Project Management \& Execution** * Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting campaign deadlines. * Take ownership of technical projects and problems from identification through implementation, testing, training, and ongoing support. * Balance urgent campaign needs with longer\-term technology, data, and infrastructure improvements. * Work independently, proactively identify problems and opportunities, and foll ervice orientation and responsiveness, with the ability to provide ongoing technical support, training, and guidance to staff with varying levels of technical expertise. * **Self\-direction, collaboration \& execution:** Highly self\-motivated, organized, and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders; independently identify problems, research solutions, and follow work through to completion. * **Judgment, adaptability \& organizational navigation:** Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively within a complex organization with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, established hierarchies, and bureaucracy. Must be persistent, solutions\-oriented, adaptable, and able to build relationships while finding practical ways to get things done. Basic understanding of labor unions and strategic communications, eagerness to learn about the sectors represented by the UAW, and commitment to the mission of the UAW. Successful candidates will exhibit discerning judgment, exemplary people skills, adept writing capabilities, and a strong commitment to service. The ideal candidate is both a team player who can collaborate with an enthusiastic staff and a self\-driven individual who can independently identify problems, develop solutions, manage competing priorities, and follow projects through to completion. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, communications, data, and organizing. They will be able to move fluidly between writing code, analyzing data, troubleshooting a communications platform, answering a colleague's urgent technical question, and working with senior stakeholders to determine the best path forward. **Salary and Benefits** This is a full\-time, exempt position, represented by News Guild, with a remote workplace. The UAW offers a salary of $118,566\.76, along with best\-in\-class health, retirement, and paid time off benefits. **How to Apply** To be considered for this position, please apply through Indeed and provide the following: * A current resume reflecting qualifications for this position, including months and years of employment. * A short letter of application (500 words or less) which specifically explains how your experiences and accomplishments have prepared you to work with the UAW's aggressive and bold Communications Department. * An example work product—such as a web application, web asset, dashboard, database, data analysis, API integration, mass communications system, or other technical project—that demonstrates your ability, along with a short written explanation of your role and the technology used. If you have any issues with attaching the required documents to your Indeed application please email them to recruiting@uaw.net. *The UAW is dedicated to promoting a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that our collective strength is amplified when all voices are represented. Women and people of color are strongly encouraged to apply.* **About Us** The International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America (UAW) is a progressive, militant union with one of the largest and most diverse memberships in North America, representing 400,000 active members and 600,000 retirees. Our members are employed in a range of workplaces, from multinational corporations to small manufacturers, from state and local governments to colleges and universities, hospitals and private non\-profit organizations. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $118,566\.76 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years have you been a member of the UAW or any other labor union? * Are you a UAW member? Willingness to travel: * 25% (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Knowledge Engineering, Customer Sucess Data Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit Customer Success is building the knowledge and agentic intelligence foundation that will power how millions of customers get help and how our teams make decisions based on knowledge and data. We’re looking for a hands\-on Principal Knowledge Engineer to be the architect of that data and knowledge foundation. You will define and own the knowledge architecture and governance for the ICS data platform and agentic intelligence layer, including the Intuit Customer Success Knowledge Graph. Your work will power use cases such as internal customer success agent experiences and self\-serve data agents that let teams ask questions in plain language and get trusted answers. This is a rare chance to set the architecture and system for an enterprise\-scale agentic intelligence platform from the ground up. You will guide a team of data scientists, data professionals, and engineers, and you will stay close enough to the code to build, prototype and unblock. **Responsibilities** * **Own the agentic knowledge architecture.** Define the target architecture for how ICS knowledge is modeled, stored, connected and served to agents and people. This covers the Intuit Customer Success Knowledge Graph, ontologies and taxonomies, entity resolution, and how structured data, unstructured content and expert knowledge come together. * **Architect the agentic intelligence layer.** Set the patterns for how agents retrieve, reason over and act on knowledge. This includes GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph, vector and structured queries), context engineering, tool and MCP design, multi\-agent orchestration, and memory. * **Set the semantic layer strategy.** Define how business metrics, entities and definitions are expressed once and reused across dashboards, data agents and AI experiences. The goal is that “what does this number mean” has one answer everywhere. * **Lead data and knowledge governance.** Build the governance strategy for knowledge quality, freshness, lineage, provenance, access control and responsible AI. Make sure agents answer from trusted, compliant and well\-attributed sources. * **Make the key architecture and tooling decisions.** Evaluate and select graph stores, vector stores, semantic layer tools, agent frameworks and evaluation tooling. Make clear build\-versus\-buy calls and document the tradeoffs. * **Build hands\-on.** Prototype reference implementations, write production\-quality code, review designs and pull requests, and step into the hardest technical problems yourself. * **Balance now and next.** Deliver what the business needs this quarter, such as tax\-season readiness and high\-impact self\-serve use cases. Make sure each delivery moves toward the long\-term architecture instead of adding technical debt. * **Define how we measure quality.** Set the evaluation frameworks for knowledge coverage, retrieval quality, answer accuracy, groundedness and agent reliability, and use them to drive prioritization. * **Translate between business and technology.** Work with segment data leaders, business, engineering, and operations to understand their workflows, nuances and decisions. Explain architectural choices in business terms and build alignment across teams. * **Guide and grow the team.** Mentor data scientists, technical data analysts, and engineers. Raise the technical bar through design reviews and standards, and build a strong knowledge engineering practice across ICS. **Qualifications** **Required** * 15\+ years in data and knowledge engineering, or AI and ML engineering, including significant time as a technical lead or architect on large\-scale data or knowledge platforms. * A track record of architecting and shipping large\-scale data and knowledge systems in production, such as enterprise knowledge graphs, semantic platforms, or data platforms that serve many teams and use cases. * Deep expertise in knowledge modeling, including ontology and taxonomy design, entity resolution, graph data modeling and knowledge graph construction. This includes using LLMs for extraction and enrichment. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered and agentic systems, including RAG and GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, agent frameworks (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP), context engineering and agent evaluation. * Deep knowledge of AI infrastructure: vector and graph databases (for example Neo4j, Neptune), embedding and retrieval pipelines, model serving, cloud data platforms (for example Databricks, Snowflake, AWS), and their scale, latency and cost tradeoffs. * Experience defining semantic layer and metrics strategy so that business definitions stay consistent across BI and AI consumers. * Experience designing data and knowledge governance, including lineage, provenance, quality, freshness, access control and responsible AI practices. * Strong programming skills and the ability to write and review production code. * A pragmatic approach to architecture: you can meet short\-term business needs with flexible solutions while steadily building toward a long\-term vision. * Excellent communication and the ability to influence without authority. You understand people, process and business needs, and you can speak the business team’s language as fluently as the engineering team’s. * Experience mentoring and technically guiding teams of data scientists, data professionals and engineers. * BS in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Science or a related field. An MS or PhD is preferred. **Preferred** * Experience with knowledge systems for customer success, customer support or contact\-center environments, such as agent assist, knowledge\-base optimization or self\-service. * Experience building natural\-language\-to\-SQL or self\-serve data agents over enterprise warehouses. * Familiarity with semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL) alongside property graphs (Cypher). * Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tooling (for example Langfuse, MLflow) and evaluation\-driven development. * Experience in regulated domains such as finance or tax, where accuracy, provenance and compliance are critical. * Publications, patents, open\-source contributions or conference talks in knowledge graphs, semantic AI or agentic systems. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $247,500 \- $335,000

jobs.title: Agentic AI Analyst
jobs.description: **About Invoca:** We built the category that made conversations measurable. Now we're building the AI agents orchestrating those engagements. Invoca is the revenue infrastructure connecting marketing, commerce, and contact center teams — turning every buyer conversation into revenue, and attributing it all the way back to the media spend that drove it. Our multimodal AI agents operate at the moment of decision: engaging buyers across the journey with personalized interactions at scale for life's most considered purchases — without losing the empathy, explainability, and trust those decisions demand. Every engagement is transparent and attributable — brands see not just what converted, but why, and what marketing dollar earned it. Come work on the layer where AI agents and real revenue meet. **The Opportunity** As an Agentic AI Analyst at Invoca, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and refining the emerging category of agentic AI applications. Within our Product organization, you'll collaborate closely with a cross\-functional team, including Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Customer Success, to identify, evaluate, and operationalize agentic use cases that directly improve customer outcomes and advance Invoca's strategic AI vision. A core focus of this role is **the integration layer that makes agents useful in the real world:** designing and validating the tools agents call (via MCP and similar protocols), authoring the skills that shape agent behavior, building the evaluation harnesses that measure whether agents actually work, and running simulations that stress\-test agents before customers ever touch them. This is an opportunity to grow your product skillset at the intersection of customer needs, agentic AI system design, and real\-world AI performance. You will contribute to building new features, evaluating agent performance in production, and distilling insights from field engagements and system data to inform product priorities. You should bring strong problem\-solving ability, curiosity around emerging AI capabilities, and confidence working across stakeholders to translate ambiguity into clarity and execution. **What You'll Do** * **Design and Validate Agentic Integrations (MCP Tools):** Define the tools our agents use to read and act on customer data. Author tool specifications (names, descriptions, input/output schemas, error behavior), prototype MCP servers and tool integrations, and validate that agents select and invoke tools correctly across realistic scenarios. Partner with Engineering on tool ergonomics that reduce hallucinated calls and improve task completion. * **Author and Maintain Agent Skills:** Design, write, and maintain reusable skills: structured instructions, workflows, and domain knowledge that govern how agents approach specific jobs. Test skill triggering accuracy, iterate on instructions based on eval results, and manage a versioned library of skills for reuse across products and customers. * **Build and Run Agent Evals:** Design evaluation frameworks for agentic behaviors, including golden datasets, task\-level success criteria, grading rubrics, and LLM\-as\-judge pipelines. Run evals across model, prompt, tool, and skill changes to catch regressions, quantify improvements, and inform release decisions. Report results in a way that both Engineering and GTM can act on. * **Simulate Agent Behavior Before Production:** Build and operate simulation environments (synthetic callers, mock tool backends, adversarial and edge\-case scenarios) to exercise multi\-step agent workflows at scale. Use simulation results to uncover failure modes, calibrate human\-in\-the\-loop handoff points, and establish confidence thresholds before beta and GA. * **Design End\-to\-End Agent Behavior:** Own how an agent reasons through a task from start to finish, including planning logic, state management across steps, escalation and human\-in\-the\-loop decision points, and fallback behavior when tools or data are unavailable. * **Validate Use Cases with Customers and GTM:** Work with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and customers to surface high\-value problems, and mine call transcripts, usage data, and tool\-call traces to identify where agents can deliver measurable outcomes. Translate those findings into scoped, experiment\-ready proposals. * **Monitor Agent Performance in Production:** Track and interpret key metrics, such as task completion rates, tool\-call success rates, fallback frequency, and customer feedback, to assess agent efficacy and prioritize improvements. * **Optimize Retrieval and Model Behavior:** Partner with Engineering and ML teams to tune the components behind agent quality, including retrieval and RAG strategies, context management, and model selection, using eval and production data to guide changes. * **Triage Production Issues and Regressions:** Own the process for capturing, reproducing, and documenting unintended agent behaviors reported from pro  Familiarity with agent\-to\-agent (A2A) protocols or multi\-agent orchestration patterns. * Experience designing for long\-running or stateful agent sessions (context persistence, session resumption, drift over time). **Strong Plus** * Working comfort with Python, JSON/JSON Schema, and reading API documentation, enough to prototype and inspect tool calls and traces. * Prior experience building or managing integrations between SaaS platforms (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, contact center, or data platforms) via APIs, webhooks, or iPaaS tools. * Experience in marketing or advertising technology, such as paid media, call tracking, attribution, marketing analytics, or ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, etc.). Compensation, Benefits \& Perks: At Invoca, we believe great work starts with taking care of our people. That's why we offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support your health, your family, your growth, and your life outside of work. For teammates in the U.S., health benefits begin on your first day of employment. ***Location: This is a remote\-first role. We are currently hiring in the following locations with a preference for talent located in the SF Bay Area:*** ***United States:*** *Greater Los Angeles Area (including Santa Barbara and San Diego) · SF Bay Area · Denver Metro · Austin Metro · Chicago Metro · Greater NYC Area · Seattle Metro* ***Candidates must be based within \~2 hour drive of these areas. Occasional business travel may be required.*** Compensation * Base Salary: $94,000–$134,000\* * Variable Compensation: Bonus and/or commission eligibility, where applicable. * Equity: All employees are invited to share in Invoca's success through our stock option program. *\*Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, skills, and location.* Benefits \& Perks Health \& Wellbeing * Day\-One Health Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on your first day of employment for U.S.\-based teammates. * Mental Wellbeing – Access to mental wellbeing support and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * Wellness Subsidy – Reimbursement that can be applied toward gym memberships, fitness classes, and more. Time Away * Flexible Time Off – We encourage a healthy work\-life balance. Our flexible paid time off policy gives you the flexibility to recharge and take time away when you need it. * Paid Holidays – Invoca provides 20 U.S. paid holidays, including a winter break, giving you time to rest, recharge, and spend time with friends and family. * Paid Family Leave – Up to 12 weeks of 100% paid leave for baby bonding, adoption, and caring for family members.\* * Paid Medical Leave – Up to 12 weeks of 100% paid leave for childbirth and medical needs.\* Growth \& Career * Enterprise\-Grade AI Tools – Access to industry\-leading enterprise AI tools, including leading LLMs and agentic AI workflow solutions to help you maximize productivity and work more effectively. * Professional Development – Annual reimbursement of up to $1,000 per fiscal year to support learning, certifications, conferences, and other professional development opportunities. Financial Benefits * 401(k) – Invoca offers a 401(k) plan through Fidelity with a company match of up to 4%.\* Recognition \& Community * Recognition Programs – We celebrate great work through company\-wide and team recognition programs, including President's Club and quarterly and departmental awards recognizing innovation, execution, and customer impact. * InVacation (Sabbatical) – As a thank\-you to our long\-term team members, we offer a sabbatical after seven years of service. *\*Some benefits may vary for teammates outside the U.S. based on local laws, regulations, and country\-specific offerings.* Pay: $45\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

You will implement agent runtimes, orchestration patterns, memory, tool integration, observability, evaluation, and guardrail capabilities while partnering with architects, data teams, product owners, and Responsible AI stakeholders. Build and deploy enterprise AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Bedrock models, AgentCore runtime services, AgentCore Gateway, agent registry patterns, and agent\-to\-agent communication where appropriate. Implement data ingestion, semantic retrieval, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graph, and memory pipelines that allow agents to consume certified data products, Denodo/USBIE sources, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and governed enterprise content. Develop intent classification, tool routing, workflow orchestration, guardrails, policy checks, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and fail\-safe escalation patterns for agentic applications. Integrate agents with enterprise systems and workflows such as Salesforce/Elevate, Service Platform, CaseView, Genesys, MAC/MPI, USBIE, Denodo, APIs, MCP tools, and event streams. Uphold enterprise standards for application security, IAM/agent identity, data protection, auditability, Responsible AI, ADS/data\-product governance, observability, and production reliability. Recent experience building enterprise GenAI or agentic AI solutions, including agents, agentic RAG, multi\-step orchestration, chat experiences, or signal\-to\-action workflows. Experience implementing AI guardrails, safety controls, intent classification, routing logic, access controls, audit logging, evaluation, and human escalation paths. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, application security, Responsible AI expectations, data governance, scalability, resilience, and production operations. Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical delivery of a defined workstream, and collaborating with architects, product owners, data teams, and platform teams. jobs.description: **Company Description** *No Relocation Assistance Provided.* KIOXIA America, Inc. is the U.S.\-based subsidiary of KIOXIA Corporation, a leading worldwide supplier of flash memory and solid state drives (SSDs). From the invention of flash memory to today’s breakthrough BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory technology, KIOXIA continues to pioneer innovative memory, SSD and software solutions that enrich people's lives and expand society's horizons. The company's innovative BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory technology is shaping the future of storage in high\-density applications, including advanced smartphones, PCs, SSDs, automotive, and data centers. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly skilled and technically driven Principal SSD Debug Engineer to lead complex failure investigations involving enterprise and data center SSDs deployed in hyperscale server environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in server hardware architecture, operating system storage stacks, NVMe/PCIe protocols, and SSD firmware internals. This role requires strong hands\-on debugging capabilities across the complete storage subsystem, from host applications and operating system drivers through PCIe interfaces to SSD controller firmware and NAND media. The candidate must be capable of independently reproducing complex system\-level failures, isolating root causes between host platforms and SSDs, analyzing and modifying embedded firmware, and driving cross\-functional engineering teams toward technically sound and sustainable resolutions. subsystem, and SSDs, to isolate host, platform, and SSD level issues. * Investigate interactions between SSDs and server components, including CPUs, PCIe root complexes, chipsets, BMCs, BIOS, and system firmware. * Investigate storage failures in multiple controller configurations, including resource contention, concurrency, thermal behavior, PLP, heterogeneous driver interactions through virtualization, and platform\-specific interactions. * Analyze Linux and Windows host logs, kernel crash dumps, PCIe protocol traces, BMC event logs, and system telemetry to identify failure mechanisms. * Drive cross\-functional debug with SSD firmware, platform, and customer teams, define reproducible test cases and drive corrective actions to closure. * Collaborate across globally distributed engineering teams, driving technical issue resolution across time zones. * Analyze host and SSD telemetry logs, corelate failures with firmware source code and hardware behavior, and drive root cause to closure. * Work on development of debug firmware in C programming across the SSD firmware stack to accelerate the root cause analysis. * Work on troubleshooting SSD performance issues and reduce tail latencies and improve IOPS and throughput. * Perform required lab work to replicate the reported issues * Create 8D/failure analysis reports and explain to the customer * Write product use\-case technical white papers as needed **Qualifications** **BS degree in computer engineering or equivalent field with minimum 10 years of experience in a technical related field or MS degree in computer engineering or equivalent field with minimum 8 years of experience in a technical related field.** * Strong hands\-on C programming and debugging experience in embedded firmware or low\-level systems software. * Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug complex embedded firmware codebases * Strong knowledge of firmware concurrency, mutexes, semaphores, interrupts, atomic operations, race conditions, and deadlocks. * Experience debugging memory corruption, pointer errors, stack overflows, timing\-sensitive failures, and hardware/software interactions. * Working knowledge of BMC functionality, IPMI/Redfish interfaces, server management logs, BIOS/UEFI, and platform initialization * Proficiency in Linux storage debugging tools such as dmesg, journalctl, nvme\-cli, fio, lspci, perf, and kernel crash analysis tools. * In\-depth understanding of NVMe and PCIe specifications, with proven experience debugging protocol\-level failures. * Ability to interpret specification requirements and validate observed firmware behavior against defined protocol standards. * Solid understanding of SSD architecture, including controller SoCs, NAND flash, FTL, garbage collection, wear leveling, and error handling. * Familiarity with SoC architecture, memory\-mapped registers, register\-level programming, and firmware debugging interfaces such as JTAG. * Strong analytical skills jobs.title: SVP Cloud Infrastructure, IT Operations
jobs.description: The Senior Vice President (SVP), Cloud Infrastructure \& IT Operations is accountable for the technology foundation that keeps LERETA secure, resilient, and available. This executive sets the strategy for, and leads, the migration from LERETA's current data\-center environment to the cloud. The SVP also leads the managers and teams responsible for cloud and hybrid infrastructure, end\-user computing, security operations, and Help Desk services. Working with software engineering, enterprise architecture, information security, data, product, and business leaders, this leader turns technology strategy into measurable results in reliability, security, cost, and service quality. **Key Responsibilities:** **Cloud Migration \& Data Center Exit** * Owns the migration roadmap: waves, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, cutover, rollback, and decommissioning * Partners with application owners and architects to choose the right strategy per workload (rehost, replatform, refactor, retain, replace, or retire), with objective entry and exit criteria * Runs hybrid operations during the transition and retire data\-center infrastructure, licenses, circuits, and support contracts as workloads move * Reports progress, risks, decisions, and financial outcomes to executive leadership **Cloud Platform \& Architecture** * Leads a governed, multi\-account cloud environment with standard identity, networking, security, logging, monitoring, tagging, and policy controls * Guides managed Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake platforms for availability, recovery, performance, security, and cost * Establishes reusable patterns, reference architectures, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD\-integrated platform practices * Partners with architects on cloud\-native application design; serve as the senior escalation point for complex platform issues **Hybrid \& On\-Premises Infrastructure** * Keeps remaining VMware, server, storage, network, DNS, firewall, load\-balancing, backup, and connectivity services stable and secure until migrated or retired * Avoids long\-term investment in infrastructure scheduled for retirement without accepting undue operational or security risk **Endpoint Computing \& End\-User Services** * Owns the endpoint strategy and full lifecycle for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and virtual desktops: provisioning, imaging, configuration, asset management, refresh, and secure disposal * Enforces endpoint security baselines through device management: hardening, encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR) coverage, and patch\-compliance targets * Leads the Help Desk: service levels, escalation paths, first\-contact resolution, knowledge management, and user experience. This remains a core part of the role after the data\-center migration * Uses service data and recurring\-issue trends to drive permanent fixes and automation **Security Operations** * Leads security operations across cloud, on\-premises, and endpoint environments: continuous monitoring, threat detection, and response, including management of SIEM, EDR, and managed\-detection partners * Owns incident response readiness: playbooks, escalation, tabletop exercises, and coordination with the CISO, Legal, and business leaders during security events * Runs risk\-based vulnerability and patch management with defined remediation timelines, plus email security and phishing\-defense programs * Operates the technical controls that support SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits and client security assessments, and supply audit evidence in partnership with the CISO and compliance team * Monitors networks and infrastructure for unusual traffic and activity patterns, manage firewall and perimeter controls, and escalate potential threats to the CISO * Runs risk\-based vulnerability and patch management across cloud, on\-premises, and endpoint environments with defined remediation timelines * Acts as first responder for security events in IT environments (containment, recovery, and root\-cause fixes) under the CISO\-led incident response plan * Operates the technical controls that support SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits and client security assessments, supply audit evidence, and report security\-operations metrics to the CISO **Reliability, Cost \& Vendor Management** * Sets service\-level objectives, observability standards, and disciplined incident, problem, change, and disaster\-recovery management, including regular backup and failover testing * Establishes a FinOps discipline: tagging, showback, forecasting, rightsizing, and commitment planning, with spend tracked against budget * Manages cloud, migration, infrastructure, security, telecom, and managed\-service vendors to clear deliverables and service levels, while retaining internal knowledge to avoid vendor dependency **Leadership** * Builds and leads a multi\-disciplinary organization of managers and engineers across cloud, infrastructure, endpoint, security operations, and support * Sets clear accountabilities and measurable objectives, develop successors, and stay hands\-on enough to challenge designs and mentor staff * Communicates complex technical risks and recommendations clearly to executives and the board This position will perform other duties as assigned based on the needs of the department. Salary range: $230,000 \- $260,000 Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a hands\-on Network Engineering Consultant to support network remediation efforts and build out the dedicated network infrastructure for the bank’s upcoming core conversion to Jack Henry. This consultant will work closely with the bank’s IT team and conversion stakeholders to ensure the network environment is stable, secure, well\-documented, and ready to support the new core platform. The role combines design and configuration work with physical, in\-the\-rack execution. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build, configure, and validate the dedicated network environment supporting the Jack Henry core conversion, in coordination with internal IT and the conversion team. * Execute network remediation work, identifying and resolving configuration gaps, legacy issues, and inconsistencies across routing, switching, and firewall infrastructure. * Configure and support routers and switches, including VLANs, trunking, and routing (static and dynamic protocols such as OSPF/BGP). * Implement and manage firewall rules, policies, and network segmentation to support secure connectivity between bank locations, data center, and vendor environments. * Perform rack\-and\-stack installation of network hardware, along with cabling, patching, and labeling in data center and office network closets. * Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues and support cutover activities, which may include occasional off\-hours work. * Create and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, IP schemas, patching records, and change documentation. * Adhere to the bank’s change management, information security, and compliance standards. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 3–7 years of hands\-on network engineering experience. * Basic networking certification (e.g., week at either the New Canaan or Hamden, CT office. * Strong documentation habits and clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience in a jobs.title: Design & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Welcome to Lava Island** Lava Island is an indoor play oasis where kids fly across trampolines, vanish into towering jungle gyms, dive into foam pits, and race down slides while families share pizza and celebrate birthdays in the party rooms. It is loud, bright, and full of energy. Every trampoline, deck, slide, and play piece is made by hand. **Active Play Solutions (APS)** is the team that makes them. Before any of it gets built, somebody has to design it. That is you. **The Job** You will own original product design for Lava Island's playground and jump deck equipment, built in Autodesk Inventor, from first concept through build\-ready specification. You will also work with the automation that makes APS's production floor smarter and more efficient as manufacturing scales. This is a from\-scratch role. You are not maintaining files somebody else built, you are the one building them, and you will lead APS's move from AutoCAD to Inventor, training the team on the new way of working as you go. **Why APS** * **Real design authority.** Build from concept, not from a spec somebody else already made. * **Two disciplines, one seat.** Product design and automation both live on your desk. * **Build something.** The CAD standards and design library for APS are being built right now. You help set how it runs. * **Own the transition.** Lead the move to Inventor and shape how design works here going forward. * **Denver home base.** On\-site, minimal travel. * Per company benefits program. **What You Will Do** **Design the equipment** * Design playground and jump deck equipment from concept through build\-ready specification in Autodesk Inventor. * Review drawings and models for accuracy, manufacturability, and compliance with our design standards. * Build a library of reusable design templates, standard parts, and design documentation for APS. **Build the automation** * Design and refine warehouse automation and machine programming as production volume scales. * Evaluate and recommend equipment and tooling upgrades that improve manufacturing efficiency. **Lead the transition** * Move APS from AutoCAD to Inventor, building the training materials and coaching the team through it. **Coordinate across teams** * Work with the Design/architecture team in Revit so equipment integrates cleanly with building layouts. * Partner with production floor leadership to refine designs based on real build feedback. **What You Need** * 5\+ years in mechanical or product design, with real, original design work in Autodesk Inventor, not just editing existing files. * Autodesk Certified Professional in Inventor for Mechanical Design (or equivalent) is strongly preferred, and matters more to us than a four\-year degree. Real, demonstrated Inventor experience is what we're looking for. * Strong working knowledge of Inventor iProperties, including their role in drawings, bills of materials, and design documentation. * Experience integrating CAD design with automation, CNC, or robotics systems. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing requirements. * Comfortable teaching others a new tool and new design standards. * Comfortable working on\-site in a production/warehouse environment. * Comfort with email, digital documentation, and design/PDM systems. APS operates in a Microsoft 365 environment. Background in playground, amusement, or structural steel manufacturing is a plus. So is familiarity with Revit, experience building configurable product models, experience with process automation or “smart” manufacturing systems, and having led a CAD platform transition before. **Ready to Build What's Next?** If you want to be the one designing what Lava Island builds next, not just running someone else's files, we want to meet you. Apply today.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **Magic (makers of Loyalist) · New York, NY · In\-office 5 days/week · $150k\-$200k \+ equity** Hi! I’m Niky, a founding engineer. Before joining Magic, I was working at a clinical data AI startup while reading every hospitality book I could find. The half\-formed product in my head turned out to already exist: Magic, which Maggie was building. Exhilarated, I jumped at the opportunity. A year down the line, we’re yet again looking for a foundational piece of our team (…you?) **What we’re building** ----------------------- Loyalist is the operating system that powers how our favorite restaurants remember you. We ingest live data from \~30 third\-party systems during service (reservations, POS, reviews, private events, marketing, e\-commerce). We turn that data into guest profiles and automated actions: a server hands a VIP a comped glass of wine because the system flagged that she’s been posting five\-star reviews over the last year. A marketing manager sends a happy\-birthday offer to 2,000 guests at once, each message referencing the specific dish that guest ordered last time. A sommelier gets a heads\-up that a two\-top walking in tonight are repeat 2018 Barolo drinkers. We’re also actively moving beyond restaurants into the full span of hospitality: hotels, casinos, spas, and more, so that Loyalist becomes a full‑fledged system for hospitality service everywhere. 1,000\+ restaurants run on Loyalist today, from neighborhood favorites to Carbone, Momofuku, Le Bernardin, and Daniel Boulud’s group. Some of the biggest have 5\-10 million guests each and hundreds of millions of visits and orders going back 15 years, and we process more than 10 million guest interactions every year. **What the role looks like** ---------------------------- You’d be a fullstack engineer shipping end\-to\-end features for restaurants. Engineers own the full arc here: talking to the customer, scoping the work, and shipping it. An example feature I shipped recently is Journeys, our system for designing multi\-step guest experiences across multiple venues and integrations. Operators define what should happen across a guest’s lifecycle (welcome, post\-visit, lapsed\-regular, anniversary), and Loyalist orchestrates it across reservations, POS, marketing, and reviews. The biggest strategic direction right now is moving onboarding from engineer\-led to operator\-led. We’ve historically configured each customer’s Loyalist instance by hand (which is how I learned the industry). We want operators to drive most of that themselves. That’s a lot of UI work with real consequences, and much of it is what you’d be working on. **Who’ll thrive here** ---------------------- **You’ll probably do well if:** * **You like the gap between customer problem and development to be small.** This involves an intimate understanding of the customer side of the company. * **You’ve shipped production code for long enough to have opinions about it.** Experience matters more than name, and we prioritize building 0 1\. * **You’re solid across some of our stack.** TypeScript and Python, React, Django, SQL, and solid database design intuition as to when to use what. You probably won’t thrive here if you want direction to come from above. Here it comes from you and the customer, and the failures of last Saturday's dinner service. Also if you’re not curious about restaurants, hospitality, or the physical\-world data layer. **About the team** ------------------ We’re 20 people, roughly half from restaurant and hospitality backgrounds and half from tech. * **Maggie** is our founder. She cold\-staged in Atelier Crenn’s kitchen in high school, did dining room ops at Eleven Madison Park, strategy at Momofuku, co\-founded a restaurant media company at Wharton, and wrote her honors thesis on grit in Michelin\-star restaurants. * **Chris** has been owning our infrastructure end\-to\-end (Kubernetes, ETL, background job orchestration) and has a rare ability to make the trade\-off call quickly. He also plays jazz and classical bass, sometimes in the office before a gig. * **Will** leads our zero\-to\-one work in hotels and members clubs. He’s the person thinking hardest about what the data model looks like when a “guest” means something different than it does in a restaurant. He also goes to DJ sets and DJs for fun. * **Abby** is on accounts and wrote the only academic paper in existence on food pop\-ups * **Dylan**, our founding partnerships lead, flew himself to Chicago on a Saturday to stage at Alinea. He spent the day folding napkins and serving arctic char off a bourbon stave. * **Julie**, our head of growth, has a tradition of visiting Monet’s water lilies at the MoMA every year on her birthday. A restaurant partner noticed, and earlier this year mailed her three Monet prints with a handwritten note. **A few things about how we work:** * Every team member does a *stage* at a customer restaurant: it’s an industry practice where you shadow or work behind the scenes during a service. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infra
jobs.description: **Magic (makers of Loyalist) · New York, NY · In\-office 5 days/week · $170k\-$210k \+ equity** I’m Chris, a founding engineer at Magic. You’d be taking over a lot of the infrastructure work I’ve been holding alone, so I wanted to tell you about it from my perspective. I came to Magic from Hightouch, a martech startup where I worked on data pipelines and syncing for companies across industries. I wanted to go somewhere smaller, more in person, and plugged into a real\-world, NY\-centric industry. At Magic, we’re supporting a legacy hospitality industry just starting to adopt serious tech, and we have customers right outside the office in Soho. Year one got us to 800 restaurants. Year two is about building for 1,000 and beyond and growing to new verticals. You’d be the one architecting that. **What we’re building** ----------------------- Loyalist is the operating system behind how 1,000\+ restaurants remember their guests. We ingest live data from \~30 third\-party systems before, during, and after service (reservations, POS, reviews, private events, email, SMS, e\-commerce, data warehouses) and turn it into action. We track 40 million guest profiles across our customers, hundreds of millions of historical visits and orders, and more than 10 million personalized guest interactions every year. Customers run the gamut, from favorites literally in my neighborhood like Place des Fêtes to Carbone, Momofuku, Le Bernardin, and Daniel Boulud’s group. The largest of them have 5\-10 million guests each and import 15 years of history in one go. (Some of them are precise enough about their data to email us when they notice a specific guest’s 2010 visit didn’t import.) Under the hood, Loyalist is closer to a real\-time data platform than a CRM. Tons of background jobs importing data, syncing guest profiles and tags, and sending email and SMS automations. Those jobs are set\-and\-forget on their side and mission\-critical on ours. That asymmetry shapes our infra work. A few of the problems I find most interesting: **Silent pipeline failures we have to catch before the restaurant does.** If a Toast instance drops on a Wednesday, data stops flowing into Loyalist. The customer won’t notice (they’re running their restaurant). *We* might not notice for a few days either, and by Saturday the revenue report is wrong and we’ve missed three days of customer journeys. We’ve made a lot of progress here but still don’t have enough of the right signal in Datadog. This is one of the first things you’d work on. **Background job orchestration at scale.** We’re running on Celery, which has carried us to 800 restaurants, but it’s probably not the right tool for where we’re going. Migrating to something modern like Temporal is a project a senior engineer would scope and own. **Analytical workloads**. Some customers import 15 years of history and then want to run reports against it. Right now those queries run on the same database that’s syncing live reservations during dinner service! Moving analytical workloads to something purpose\-built is something I want you weighing in on from day one. **What the role looks like** ---------------------------- You’ll own our AWS infrastructure: RDS, background jobs, caching, networking, etc. You’ll also own a lot of the integration layer, like a new POS integration, sometimes talking with partner companies. First 30–60 days, I’d expect you to focus on those three things: getting our observability to actually tell us what’s broken and how badly, scoping the background job orchestrator migration, and scoping the analytical database migration. Ideally we make meaningful progress on these fast. You’ll talk to customers, usually when they’re asking for a new integration or surfacing a specific issue and we need someone who can speak to the infra implications on a call. You’ll also partner closely with Niky and the product side. **Who’ll thrive here** ---------------------- * You have production infrastructure experience with multi\-tenant data at scale * You’ve owned a background job system before. You know how to keep a retry from firing twice and sending an SMS to a guest about their anniversary (twice). * You’re familiar with at least some of our stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Postgres, Python/Django, Docker, Datadog, IaC. * You’re okay being the infra owner on a 5\-engineer team for the foreseeable future. **You probably won’t thrive here if** you want direction to come from above. Here it comes from you and the customer, and the failures of last Saturday's dinner service. Also if you’re not curious about restaurants, hospitality, or the physical\-world data layer. **About the team** ------------------ We’re 20 people, roughly half from restaurant and hospitality backgrounds and half from tech. * **Maggie** is our founder. She cold\-staged in Atelier Crenn’s kitchen in high school, did dining room ops at Eleven Madison Park, strategy at Momofuku, co\-founded a restaurant media company at Wharton, and wrote her honors thesis on grit in Michelin\-star restaurants. * **Niky**, our other founding engineer, ships most of what’s customer\-facing. She built the recurring\-hold feature that Major Food Group’s team now uses to block six months of VIP reservations at Carbone in advance. She’s also the office’s biggest fan of roughly everything: women’s basketball, Olivia Rodrigo, half of our customer restaurants. You bring a topic to the table and I can promise Niky loves that thing. * **Will** leads our zero\-to\-one work in hotels and members clubs. He’s the person thinking hardest about what the data model looks like when a “guest” means something different than it does in a restaurant. He also goes to DJ sets and DJs for fun. * **Abby** is on accounts and wrote the only academic paper in existence (literally) on food pop\-ups * **Dylan**, our founding partnerships lead, flew himself to Chicago on a Saturday to stage at Alinea. He spent the day folding napkins and serving arctic char off a bourbon stave. * **Julie**, our head of growth, has a tradition of visiting Monet’s water lilies at the MoMA every year on her birthday. A restaurant partner noticed, and earlier this year mailed her three Monet prints with a handwritten note. **A few things about how we work:** * Every team member does a *stage* at a customer restaurant: it’s an industry practice where you shadow or work behind the scenes during a service. I did mine at Rezdora. Dylan did his at Alinea. It’s framed as a requirement, but it’s really a perk, and it’ll change how you build. * Lunch is from a different NYC restaurant every day. New hires pick the first week’s rotation. * We’re in\-office five days a week in SoHo, having fun, and going to dinner together. * We use AI aggressively. Claude for most of the coding, AI code reviewers, AI for investigation and planning. Nothing is off\-limits. I know joining a 20\-person company is a big bet. What sold me was the combination of interesting systems work, a team I’d learn from, and an exciting domain with customers nearby. Ten months in, the bet has paid off. I’ve owned more architectural decisions here than I did in three years at my last company. I've gotten to work on real\-time data ingestion at scale, cross\-platform guest normalization, and I’ve gotten to dine at a customer’s restaurant every month. If that sounds like a bet you’d want to make, I’d love to meet. **The offer** ------------- * Salary $170k\-$210k \+ equity * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents (HSA plans available) * Flexible PTO * Daily NYC lunch (see above) * Access to coveted reservations in NYC * Chris Compensation Range: $170K \- $210K

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About MD Integrations** At **MD Integrations**, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful. **MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time. **Overview** MD Integrations (MDI) is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support and enhance our cloud infrastructure. As a growing company, we are focused on scaling, standardizing, securing, and optimizing our AWS environment while expanding our use of Infrastructure as Code and automation. This role will be instrumental in maintaining and improving our cloud infrastructure, increasing automation, supporting production reliability, and helping modernize how infrastructure is deployed and managed. The engineer will work closely with backend developers and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless system functionality and reliable software delivery. The ideal candidate is DevOps\-focused with a strong systems engineering foundation. Strong practical knowledge of AWS, Linux, networking, Infrastructure as Code, security, and automation is essential. This position reports directly to the Sr. Director, Systems Operations and is fully remote. Availability during and after core business hours may be required as business needs dictate. **What You’ll Be Accountable For** * **Infrastructure as Code \& AWS Infrastructure** * Implement, maintain, and optimize AWS infrastructure across services such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, ECR, VPCs, IAM, load balancers, WAF, AWS Firewall, Security Groups, and S3\. * Build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform and help reduce reliance on manually configured cloud resources while improving consistency across environments. * Administer and optimize Linux systems and automate infrastructure, deployment, and configuration tasks using tools such as Terraform, Bash, Python, or JavaScript. * **DevOps \& Software Delivery** * Collaborate with backend engineering and other technical teams to improve deployment workflows and software delivery processes. * Apply significant hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines to help design, troubleshoot, improve, and standardize deployment workflows. * Support containerized applications and infrastructure using technologies such as Docker, ECS/Fargate, and ECR while improving deployment reliability, repeatability, security, and automation. * **Security, Networking \& Reliability** * Maintain secure AWS networking infrastructure including VPCs, routing, VPNs, load balancers, DNS, SSL/TLS, firewalls, and Security Groups. * Implement and monitor AWS security controls including IAM policies, encryption, network security rules, logging, GuardDuty, AWS Config, CloudTrail, and Security Hub. * Support highly available and scalable infrastructure with appropriate redundancy, failover, resiliency, and security practices aligned with ISO 27001, HIPAA, and SOC 2\. * **Monitoring, Incident Response \& Disaster Recovery** * Manage and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions such as CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Better Stack, DataDog, or New Relic. * Support incident response and troubleshooting across production and development AWS environments, proactively identifying recurring reliability or performance issues. * Support backup, disaster recovery, resiliency, and recovery testing using AWS Backup or comparable technologies. * **Operational Improvement \& Projects** * Identify opportunities to improve AWS efficiency, right\-size resources, reduce unnecessary cloud spend, and automate repetitive operational tasks. * Work with Cloudflare and similar technologies supporting CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, traffic routing, and edge security. * Work closely with external MSPs, contractors, and internal teams to coordinate infrastructure modernization projects, track progress, and ensure initiatives meet business and technical needs. **Your Work DNA** * **Automation\-focused** – You look for opportunities to replace repetitive manual work with reliable automation. * **Strong systems thinker** – You understand networking, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and how application systems interact. * **DevOps\-minded** – You work collaboratively with engineering teams to improve infrastructure and software delivery. * **Security\-focused** – You incorporate security into infrastructure design and operational practices. * **Proactive problem solver** – You identify issues early and work toward durable solutions. * **Strong communicator** – You can explain complex technical topics to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Self\-starter** – You take ownership of your work and can function independently with minimal supervision. **Your Background** * Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tooling. * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related role. * Extensive practical AWS experience across networking, security, cloud infrastructure, and production systems. * Experience with managed Terraform platforms such as HCP Terraform, Scalr, Terraform Enterprise, or similar is strongly preferred. * Significant experience designing, supporting, troubleshooting, or improving CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. * Experience with containerized workloads using technologies such as Docker, ECS/Fargate, and ECR. * Strong Linux system administration and scripting experience using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages. * Experience designing, managing, and optimizing highly available and scalable systems. * Strong understanding of cloud networking including VPCs, routing, DNS, SSL/TLS, VPNs, firewalls, and load balancers. * Experience with monitoring, logging, observability, and production incident response. * Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks. * Experience with cloud cost optimization, backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure resiliency. * Experience with Cloudflare or comparable CDN, WAF, edge security, or Zero Trust technologies is preferred. * Experience coordinating projects with MSPs, contractors, and internal engineering teams. **What We Offer*** **Competitive Salary:** We offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. This role is budgeted in the range of $120,000\-$155,000 DOE. * **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** Our benefits package includes 75% subsidized health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match. * **Professional Development Opportunities:** We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on\-the\-job training and development opportunities. * **Flexible Work Arrangements:** We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes. * **Direct Engagement with Customers and Executives:** We are a lean organization and this role will work directly with executives and customers on high\-impact initiatives, balancing strategic alignment with day\-to\-day execution. * **Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment:** We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **Summary of role:** AI Infrastructure Engineer will build and run the GPU and accelerator platform our AI workloads depend on. That covers the clusters and schedulers underneath, training and inference serving on top, and the observability and cost data that tell us how well the fleet is used. The role will write production code every day and own systems end to end, from design through on\-call. **Representative projects** * Stand up a multi\-cloud GPU fleet spanning hyperscalers, neoclouds and on\-prem, orchestrated through custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators so researchers never have to think about where their job lands. * Build a scheduling layer with gang scheduling, bin\-packing and fair\-share quotas that measurably raises accelerator utilization across teams. * Ship a high\-throughput vLLM serving stack with prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload and FP8/FP4 quantization. Back it with a benchmarking and traffic\-replay harness that tracks TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles against per\-config baselines. * Build a self\-healing health\-check and remediation system that rides out fault storms across hardware, network and software without paging a human. * Build an end\-to\-end cost\-attribution pipeline. It ingests utilization, occupancy and billing data into the warehouse, attributes every GPU\-hour to a team and workload, and drives capacity planning. * Build internal tools and dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use every day. **Responsibilities:** * Design, deploy and operate GPU clusters across AWS, GCP, and other hyperscalers/neoclouds/on\-premise data centers, including custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators and the metadata services behind them. * Build scheduling that keeps accelerators busy: gang scheduling for distributed jobs, bin\-packing to reduce fragmentation, and quotas and fair share for multi\-tenant teams. * Run distributed training infrastructure on PyTorch Distributed, Ray, or Megatron, with fast checkpointing and model loading. * Deploy and tune high\-throughput LLM serving with vLLM or similar: tensor and model/expert parallelism, prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload, FP8/FP4 quantization. * Build benchmarking and traffic\-replay tools that measure TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles, and set per\-config performance baselines. * Build health checks across hardware, network and software layers, and automated remediation that handles fault storms without human intervention. * Instrument fleet utilization with DCGM, Prometheus and Grafana. Write recording rules and alerts that teams rely on. * Ingest utilization, occupancy and billing data into a warehouse, attribute spend to teams and workloads, and support capacity planning. * Drive autoscaling, rightsizing and idle\-capacity recovery programs with measurable cost results. * Write clear runbooks and documentation, and explain infrastructure tradeoffs to researchers, finance and leadership. * Build internal tools or dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use daily. **You may be a good fit if you** * Have 5\+ years building and operating production distributed systems or ML infrastructure * Write production\-quality Python plus Go or C\+\+, and are fluent in shell scripting for system administration. * Have deep hands\-on Kubernetes and container experience, plus working knowledge of Slurm or another HPC resource manager. * Have run GPU workloads at scale, including scheduling, orchestration and troubleshooting. * Have hands\-on experience with at least one distributed training or serving stack: PyTorch Distributed, Ray, vLLM or Megatron\-LM. * Have deep experience with at least one major cloud provider. * Know observability tools like DataDog, Prometheus, PromQL and Grafana, and are comfortable on\-call for critical systems. * Own projects end to end and gather your own requirements with little direction. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (or a strong desire to learn deeply)** * LLM inference optimization: KV cache systems, disaggregated serving, quantization, speculative decoding * High\-performance networking: RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, NVLink * GPU profiling with Nsight or similar, and CUDA or Triton kernel work * Accelerators beyond NVIDIA: AMD MI\-series, TPU, Trainium * Capacity planning, billing normalization or cost attribution across providers * Automated fault diagnosis, log mining or AIOps at fleet scale * Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and secure or air\-gapped deployments **Benefits** * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We are seeking an AI Operations Specialist to help business and product teams use AI to take on review and quality work. You will map how work gets done today, build AI\-driven workflows, and test them until the results can be trusted. You will also help product teams decide whether an AI feature is ready to launch. This is a hands\-on role: you help build the workflow, ship it, and stay on to make sure it keeps working. The scope is expected to grow as AI capabilities evolve. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Help prioritize projects by business impact and make the case for the ones worth pursuing. * Partner with process owners to map current workflows, then define where AI can do the work and where people step in on hard cases. * Build AI workflows: write prompts, set up pipelines, maintain agreed quality levels, and monitor for drift after launch. * Build test sets, measure accuracy, and calibrate LLM judges against human reviewers. * Help product teams define launch\-readiness criteria for AI features and provide evidence for go/no\-go decisions. * Turn unclear policy into criteria reviewers can apply consistently, working with product, legal, and policy partners. * Work with subject matter experts to write labeling guidelines and produce human\-verified labels on real data. * Run labeling at scale with vendor agents, and validate their work using agreement metrics and spot checks. * Make solutions reusable and document learnings so future teams reach production faster. * Keep methods current as models, tools, and vendor agents change, and retire what no longer works. * Own assigned workstreams end to end, from setup through quality checks. ### **Qualifications** **Required** * 5\-7 years in operations, program management, analytics, consulting, or applied AI, with accountability for results. * Daily AI user who has built something with AI that delivered measurable impact, such as a workflow, an automation, or an analysis. * Comfortable with metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and sampling. * Experience taking a messy process and making it measurable. * Quality experience in some form, such as review guidelines, QA, or audits. * Clear writer, able to work with business leads, product managers, and engineers. * Self\-directed and comfortable working with limited direction. * A technical background is not required. Prior experience designing evaluations or calibrating LLM judges is not required; training is provided. **Preferred** * Hands\-on SQL, Python, or API experience. * Trust and safety, content moderation, annotation operations, or other human\-in\-the\-loop work at scale. * Experience fine\-tuning models or calibrating LLM judges. * Background in a two\-sided marketplace, travel, or another operations\-heavy business. * Experience setting up intake and prioritization for a new team. ### **Key Details** * Start date: November 23, 2026 * Duration: 12 months * Location: Remote (within the U.S.) * Work schedule: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) * Pay rate range: $65\-$75/hour \+ benefits * Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. * Engagement: W\-2 Contract

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer (Full\-Stack, AI\-Native)** ====================================================== **Marvin** · Denver/Los Angeles \- Hybrid 2\-day in office · Full\-time · $160k\-190k **About Marvin** ---------------- Marvin helps people navigate their mental health and wellbeing. We partner with employers and health plans to give their members one place to understand their coverage, find care, and get support, including an AI coach built into the product. We're a small team shipping a production healthcare application, which means every engineer touches things that matter and owns them end to end. **The role** ------------ We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer who has made AI a core part of how they build software, not a novelty. This is not a machine learning research role. You won't train models or tune GPUs. You will ship product in a modern TypeScript/Next.js stack, and you'll do it with AI woven into both the product and your own workflow. Two things distinguish this role from a standard senior web position: * **You build with AI.** You've moved well past autocomplete. You direct agentic coding tools to do real, multi\-step work, you know exactly where they break, and you own every line they produce. * **You build AI into the product.** You've shipped LLM\-backed features to real users and lived with them in production: prompts, tool calls, evals, tracing, cost, latency, and failure modes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features end to end across our Next.js/React/TypeScript app, Prisma/Postgres backend, and AWS infrastructure. * Extend our AI coach and build new LLM\-powered member experiences: retrieval over benefits data, structured extraction, guided flows, and agentic tool use against our own APIs. * Design evaluation and observability for AI features so we know when they get worse, not just when they crash. * Push our AI\-assisted development practice forward: agent instructions, reusable skills, hooks, MCP integrations, and review practices that keep quality high as velocity climbs. * Handle sensitive health data responsibly. PHI boundaries, redaction, audit trails, and vendor data agreements are part of the design, not an afterthought. * Review code, whether written by a human or an agent, with a critical eye. Mentor teammates and raise the bar on testing and reliability. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **Core engineering** * 5\+ years building production web applications, with deep TypeScript, React, and Node experience. Next.js is a strong plus. * Comfort across the stack: relational data modeling (we use Prisma and Postgres), auth flows, caching, background jobs, and cloud deployment (AWS, Docker, Terraform or similar). * A real testing habit at every layer: unit, component, and end\-to\-end. maintenance to boost equipment availability while helping to lower maintenance expenses. * Engage in operational support or site on\-call duties as the role requires. * Complete additional tasks as jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **About the Role** ================== We're looking for a **VLA Algorithm** **Engineer** working at the intersection of robotics, simulation, and world models to help advance our embodied AI foundation models. You'll build and optimize robotic simulation environments, develop large\-scale synthetic training data pipelines, and improve how models trained in simulation transfer to real\-world robots. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling challenging problems in robotics, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and 3D vision, and wants to help build more capable, robust, and generalizable robotic systems. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Robotics Simulation:** Build and optimize simulation environments for robotic tasks, including manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, and humanoid robotics. * **Embodied AI Foundation Models:** Contribute to the training and optimization of embodied AI foundation models, including pretraining on large\-scale egocentric human video and real\-world robot data. * **Multimodal Learning:** Design approaches for incorporating multimodal inputs, including force and tactile sensing, and develop, train, evaluate, and optimize models that integrate these signals. * **Simulation \& Evaluation Infrastructure:** Improve simulation and evaluation pipelines to reduce the sim\-to\-real gap and enhance model stability, robustness, and generalization across real\-world environments. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * At least 1 year of relevant professional experience or research experience in robotics, simulation, system identification, reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), world models, 3D vision, or a related field. * Experience with robotics simulation, robotic learning, or related algorithm development. * Strong understanding of at least one relevant research area, such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, system identification, world models, or 3D computer vision. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * **Simulation Platform Development:** Hands\-on experience developing or extending simulation platforms, with familiarity with the underlying architecture of tools such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Orbit, MuJoCo, PyBullet, or Genesis. * **Large\-Scale Synthetic Data Generation:** Experience building synthetic datasets for robotics or computer vision, developing scalable data generation pipelines, or using diffusion models for large\-scale synthetic data generation. * **Sim\-to\-Real Transfer:** Demonstrated experience transferring reinforcement learning or imitation learning policies from simulation to physical robotic arms or mobile robots. Familiarity with addressing simulation\-to\-reality differences in dynamics and observations through systematic compensation or adaptation techniques is a plus. **Default Benefits:** ===================== * Health insurance * Vision care * Dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid holidays * PTO (Paid Time Off) * Sick leave
