jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. **About the Team** ================== Our AI Enablement team drives enterprise\-wide adoption of generative AI, spanning platform engineering, governance, and hands\-on delivery of AI\-powered products and internal tooling. The team builds and operates the infrastructure, integrations, and knowledge systems that let engineering and business teams safely adopt large language models at scale. The Lead AI Engineer joins as the senior technical authority on this team, setting the architectural direction that Senior and Associate AI Engineers build against. **Position Summary** ==================== The Lead AI Engineer provides technical leadership and architecture ownership for the company's AI platform and its embedded delivery initiatives, operating one level above the Senior AI Engineer role. This person owns the technical design of agentic and LLM\-powered systems built on large language model APIs, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/connector integration, and evaluation/governance tooling, in a highly regulated healthcare environment. The Lead AI Engineer sets architectural standards across AI\-embedded product delivery, mentors Senior and Associate AI Engineers, and represents AI platform architecture to engineering leadership and Legal/Compliance/Privacy. Success is measured by the reliability, security, and scalability of the AI systems shipped, the rate at which Senior/Associate engineers adopt the architectural standards this role sets, and this role's influence on AI platform decisions across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * AI Architecture Leadership: Define the technical architecture and roadmap for LLM/agentic systems — model routing across cloud AI platforms, connector/integration patterns, RAG pipelines, and prompt/evaluation frameworks. * Solution Design \& Governance: Lead architecture reviews for new AI capabilities and ensure designs meet enterprise security, privacy, and data\-provenance requirements. * Platform Ownership: Drive the technical design of shared AI platform capabilities, including knowledge\-retrieval systems, citation/traceability of AI\-generated outputs, and permission\-aware access to data. * Hands\-On Delivery: Personally architect and build high\-complexity components on priority AI delivery initiatives where a working system, not just a design doc, is the deliverable. * Technical Mentorship: Set coding, architecture, and evaluation standards for Senior and Associate AI Engineers; run design reviews and pair on complex agentic workflows. * LLMOps \& Responsible AI: Establish secure, observable, and cost\-attributed AI operations — usage/spend attribution, abuse monitoring, model evaluation, and rollback strategy — for production LLM systems. * Cross\-Functional Architecture: Partner with engineering managers, product, platform, and Legal/Compliance to align AI architecture decisions with delivery timelines and enterprise standards. * Vendor \& Model Strategy: Evaluate foundation model providers and AI tooling vendors; jobs.title: Director of Quality Assurance
jobs.description: **Job Summary**: The Director of Quality Assurance leads the QA organization through its transformation to an AI\-optimized SDLC, able to support multiple product launches and continuous feature delivery in parallel across a multi\-tenant SaaS platform. This leader defines the overarching quality strategy, champions the integration of AI tools across the entire SDLC, and scales automated, resilient testing frameworks to accelerate delivery while sustaining the reliability and regulatory compliance Medrio's customers depend on. This position reports directly to the SVP of Engineering and works closely with Development, Product, Support, and Compliance throughout the SDLC. The QA organization is geographically dispersed, combining onshore and offshore teams of in\-house engineers and external vendor partners working across multiple time zones. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * **AI\-Driven Quality Strategy:** Lead the strategic integration of generative and predictive AI tools throughout the SDLC, including AI\-assisted test case creation, requirements analysis, and automated risk\-based test coverage. * **Quality Throughput \& Capacity:** Scale quality output in line with an AI\-accelerated development organization, ensuring test capacity keeps pace with development output without compromising quality. Success is measured through cycle time to release, escaped defect rate, automated test coverage, and full regression suite runtime. * **Modern Test Automation Leadership:** Oversee the evolution of automated testing strategies for a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, prioritizing modern frameworks like Playwright alongside AI\-powered self\-healing test infrastructure to minimize script maintenance and maximize suite reliability. This includes tenant isolation and data\-segregation testing, configuration\-driven test matrices across tenant variants, and management of shared\-schema regression risk. * **Organization Oversight:** Direct all activities of the QA organization, ensuring continuous validation, high platform stability, and alignment with modern quality engineering best practices. * **Regulatory \& Compliance Quality:** Ensure QA practices, documentation, and evidence meet the requirements of a regulated healthcare environment (including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GxP/CSV, SOC 2, and GDPR where applicable), and support internal and customer audits as a senior representative of the quality function. * **Validation of AI\-Generated Test Assets:** Own the framework by which AI\-assisted test artifacts are reviewed, approved, and evidenced, ensuring automation generated with AI meets the traceability and audit standards required in a validated environment. * **Security\-Forward Quality:** Partner with Security and DevOps to embed security testing into the delivery pipeline (SAST/DAST, dependency and vulnerability triage, and coordination of penetration testing), and ensure PHI is appropriately handled and de\-identified across test environments and test data. * **Distributed, Offshore \& Vendor Team Leadership:** Lead a distributed QA organization spanning in\-house employees and external vendor teams across time zones, setting consistent standards, throughput expectations, and quality bars across both, and maintain strategic partnerships with QA vendors, tool providers, and staff augmentation partners to ensure tight alignment with internal goals. * **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** Deliver on company strategic roadmaps and improve the cost and efficiency of the quality function as scope grows. * **Release Execution Across a Multi\-Product Portfolio:** Own the quality plan across multiple concurrent product launches and continuous SaaS feature releases, including parallel release trains, phased and feature\-flagged rollouts, and release\-readiness criteria that hold without becoming a gate on delivery. * **Team Leadership \& Talent Development:** Recruit, mentor, and upskill QA leaders and engineers on AI\-driven testing paradigms and modern automation toolchains. * **Defect \& Metric Management:** Monitor open bugs and defects, establish continuous improvement loops, and provide Engineering leadership with clear, data\-driven quality metrics and insight into organizational performance. * **Budget Management:** Manage the QA organization within an agreed\-upon budget and support Engineering leadership in financial planning and resource forecasting. **Customers or Clients:** * Existing and prospective customers of the Medrio Platform * Medrio's Development, Product, Support, and Compliance teams * Sales, Professional Services, and Executive teams **Education and Years of Experience:** * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience * 10\+ years of QA experience * 5\+ years of management experience at a Director level or equivalent senior leadership position * Experience working within a regulated, compliant SDLC in healthcare or life sciences, with HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 exposure * Direct experience building and leading QA for a multi\-tenant SaaS product * Demonstrated experience introducing AI\-assisted testing into an established organization **Working Conditions (include any required travel):** * Position is remote; US\-based preferred * Works across multiple time zones to support a distributed QA organization * Some travel may be required. **Other Skills and Abilities**: * **AI \& Automation Expertise:** Demonstrated experience implementing AI tooling across the SDLC (AI\-assisted test generation and self\-healing test runners), together with Playwright at scale in CI and modern web and API automation, including contract and API testing. Sound judgment about where AI is and is not appropriate in a validated environment. * **Change Leadership:** Proven ability to take an established team through a tooling and process shift without losing delivery throughput or people. * **Full SDLC Mastery:** Comprehensive understanding of the full Software Development Life Cycle and how quality engineering integrates into Agile and DevOps CI/CD pipelines. * **Regulated \& Compliant Delivery:** Demonstrated ownership of quality practices in a regulated healthcare setting, including validation, traceability, and audit evidence. * **Offshore \& Vendor Team Management:** Demonstrated ability to work with and manage offshore teams, both in\-house employees and contractors supplied through external vendors, including selecting, onboarding, and managing QA vendors and external partners. * **Communication \& Collaboration:** Excellent executive communication skills with a proven track record of reporting metrics and strategic progress to C\-level stakeholders. * **Detail\-Oriented \& Methodical:** Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to maintaining defined compliance, documentation, and execution standards. **About Medrio:** At Medrio, we look for smart, capable, and conscientious people to help us expand our product capabilities, grow our business, and better serve our customers. Our employees love working for us because they get to develop, market, and sell a product that advances human health, and they enjoy many perks, including * Great benefits: We offer medical, dental, vision, and life/LTD insurance, and we cover 100% of our employees' health insurance premiums and 50% of dependent premiums. * Wellness: Medrio values our staff's well\-being. To prove it, we promote an atmosphere of work/life balance, including flexible work schedules and locations. * Weekly company\-wide standup. The Medrio team is made up of individuals with a wide array of skills and interests, but all have a passion for providing the best possible user experience for our customers. We value collaboration, ingenuity and creating a culture of excellence! **Salary Range: $185,000 \- $205,000 USD** *To see detailed information on the data we collect during the application process, and how Medrio complies with data privacy laws, visit our* *Careers* *page.*

The Software Engineer I, AI designs, develops, tests and supports AI\-enabled software applications and services as a member of an Agile development team. This position is part of the AI team within Meijer Technology, which builds and operates the company's enterprise AI assistant and the shared services that support AI\-enabled applications across the business. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Menlo** Menlo Research is an Applied R\&D lab building Asimov, an open\-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open\-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **The Role** Asimov is leaving the lab. Teams are buying fleets, commissioning custom builds, and wiring their own agents into a humanoid body. Every one of those deployments needs someone who can make it work on site. That’s you. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Deployment team, you’ll embed with Menlo’s enterprise customers and own their Asimov deployments end to end, from a scoped use case to a robot doing real work in their environment. You’ll write the integration code, configure the platform, debug the robot on the floor, and bring back what you learn so the next deployment goes faster than the last. You’ll partner with our Enterprise Lead on the customer side, and with Brain, Platform, and Hardware on everything behind it. **What You’ll Do** * Own customer deployments end to end, taking each one from a scoped use case to Asimov running reliably in the customer’s environment * Build integrations that connect customer agents, software, and workflows to Asimov through the Menlo Platform’s Python SDK, control plane APIs, and Agent Platform * Package customer agents for deployment and configure their permissions and safety envelopes, including velocity limits, workspace boundaries, and force constraints, for each site * Prototype and validate tasks in Digital Asimov and simulation before they touch hardware, then bring them up on real robots on site * Stand up deployments on Menlo Cloud or in customer on\-prem environments, working through networking, auth, and real\-time connectivity on the ground * Diagnose problems across the full stack, from actuators and firmware to perception, policies, and agent behavior, using telemetry and logs to fix them or hand them off with a clean repro * Be the customer’s technical point of contact: run onboarding, train their engineers, and set honest expectations on what the robot can and can’t do today * Turn field learnings into product by feeding bugs, missing capabilities, and deployment data back to Platform and Brain, and write the playbooks and tooling that make every future deployment faster * Travel to customer sites whenever a deployment needs hands on the robot **What We Look For** * You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or field engineering role, ideally on physical systems like robotics, autonomy, or industrial automation * You write production\-quality Python, live comfortably in Linux, and can read C\+\+ when that’s where the bug lives * You know your way around ROS 2, Docker, and networking, because robots on customer Wi\-Fi are their own adventure * You’ve debugged systems in the field where the problem could be software, hardware, network, or the environment itself, and you found it * You can explain a policy failure to a customer’s operations lead and walk our engineers through a stack trace in the same afternoon * You take ownership: you’d rather unblock the customer tonight and ship the clean fix tomorrow than wait for perfect * You use AI as a real collaborator in your day to day work **Nice to Have** * Experience connecting LLM agents or agent frameworks to physical systems * Hands\-on time with humanoids, legged robots, or manipulators * Familiarity with simulation tools like Isaac Sim or MuJoCo, and the realities of sim\-to\-real * Comfort with embedded and hardware debugging: motor drivers, CAN, sensors, power * Experience with WebRTC or real\-time media infrastructure such as LiveKit * Experience with enterprise on\-prem deployments, security reviews, or IT integration * Time as one of the first customer\-facing engineers at an early\-stage startup **Why Join Menlo** You’ll sit where every Menlo system meets the real world: the agent platform, simulation, policy training, the Asimov hardware, and the data engine. Deployments are where the robot gets tested for real, and what you learn on site directly shapes what we build next. Small team, real robots, open source by default, and customers who are betting on us early. If you want to be the person who makes humanoid labor work outside the lab, come build it with us. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations** We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Sr. Field Applications Engineer

This chip\-scale platform overcomes the performance and scalability limits of traditional switches, enabling smaller, faster, more reliable, and energy\-efficient systems. jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer‒ Data Platforms & Security (Bilingual in Mandarin)
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Menusifu Inc. is a leading restaurant point\-of\-sale solution company based in New York that provides a comprehensive state\-of\-the\-art restaurant management system for dine\-in, take\-out, delivery, and Cafes. As a SaaS provider, Menusifu covers all kinds of functional requirements from upper\-stream supply chain to restaurant internal management operations and even customers. Nowadays, Menusifu has more than 200 employees and 6 offices (headquarter located in Manhattan) all around the world. We, at Menusifu, are keen on providing you with an intelligent yet fine dining experience through our innovative ordering system. We’re born to build smart restaurants. Our team is young and energetic, enterprising, and invincible. Menusifu has a broad\-development platform to let you fully show your talents. Our mission stems from the passion for food, and beyond. If you crave it, then make it better! If you are a foodie with the same attitude, growth goals, and entrepreneurial enthusiasm as Menusifu, please join now! Stay hungry, Stay foolish! We are seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer to take ownership of our backend data processing layer. In this role, you will design and build the services responsible for raw data ingestion, programmatic cleanup, canonical normalization, zero\-trust data protection, and downstream metric aggregation for our internal analytics and basic data warehouse. Operating entirely in an AWS cloud environment, you will build application layers that process high\-volume polyglot data across distributed document\-oriented NoSQL stores and relational databases. Your focus will be on writing resilient code, establishing strict multi\-tenant boundaries, and transforming raw, messy operational feeds into clean, derived data models that power both core product features and business reporting. **What you bring to the table:** * **Ingestion \& Normalization Services:** Build high\-throughput microservices and APIs to ingest, parse, validate, and normalize noisy data streams from varied third\-party systems (POS, inventory, reservation feeds) into consistent, canonical domain formats. * **Derived Data \& Warehouse Pipelines:** Design and build batch and stream\-processing jobs to aggregate operational records into derived analytical datasets, dimensional models, and warehouse\-ready tables (e.g., daily restaurant performance, sales velocity, labor cost metrics). * **Asynchronous Processing:** Architect and maintain event\-driven worker services and message queues on AWS to handle real\-time deduplication, schema validation, and transactional reconciliation. * **Data Privacy \& Application Security:** Engineer security guardrails directly into the software layer, including tenant isolation, field\-level encryption, PII masking, tokenization, audit trails, and automated data retention enforcement. * **Polyglot Persistence Layer:** Develop performant data\-access layers, aggregation logic, and transactional boundaries across distributed document/NoSQL stores, relational engines, and analytical storage layers. * **Resilience \& Quality:** Write extensive unit, integration, and contract tests to guarantee data fidelity. Implement dead\-letter queues, automated retry mechanisms, and observability to track data hygiene and schema drift. **Who will be the best fit:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, deploying, and maintaining production\-grade backend services and distributed systems. * **Primary Stack Proficiency:** Strong production expertise in \[e.g., Go / Node.js \& TypeScript / Python / Java] with an emphasis on microservice design, clean architecture, and concurrency. * **NoSQL Document Store Experience:** Deep experience writing performant data models, complex queries, and aggregation workflows for distributed document\-oriented databases at scale. * **Relational Database Fluency:** Solid software integration experience with relational database systems (schema migrations, transaction management, connection pooling, and optimized query design). * **Data Modeling \& Analytics Exposure:** Hands\-on experience creating derived datasets, rollup aggregations, and basic dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, daily/hourly rollups) for analytics consumption. * **AWS Cloud Native:** Hands\-on experience building on core AWS services (e.g., ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, Kinesis, EventBridge, KMS, S3, Secrets Manager). * **Defensive Coding \& Security:** Practical knowledge of software\-level security patterns, including payload validation, symmetric/asymmetric encryption workflows, role\-based access control (RBAC), and sanitization of sensitive business data. * **Mandarin Chinese communication ability.** **Even Better:** * Prior experience in multi\-tenant B2B SaaS, fintech, or hospitality/retail technology platforms. * Experience with cloud data warehouse or query tools (e.g., AWS Redshift, Athena, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or columnar storage formats like Parquet). * Familiarity with Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines for shipping operational data to analytics targets. * Familiarity with compliance\-oriented software development (SOC 2, PCI\-DSS data boundary requirements). * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK) and CI/CD automation. * AI assisted code development **What we offer:** * Flexible working hours and locations * Excellent Start\-up culture with openness and inclusiveness * Young and energetic team * Great career growth opportunities * Benefits include Health Insurance, Dental\&Vision Insurance, FSA, PTO, etc. * Mentor Program * Competitive Salary package \*\*We are currently work hybrid with about 2\-3 days/week in the office. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H\-1B visa status)? * Have you graduated from your current academic program? (We do not take any interns or part\-time employees at this moment, please kindly note that we will not move on with you if you are not graduated yet. You are welcome to apply in the future!) Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * MongoDB: 3 years (Required) * Node.js: 3 years (Required) * Back\-end development: 3 years (Required) * Web Development Practices and Tools: 3 years (Required) Language: * Mandarin (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10016

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: **One Team. All Heart. All Hustle.** At Merchants Fleet, we believe great outcomes happen when talented people come together with a shared commitment to service, innovation, and continuous improvement. Our Heart \& Hustle culture is built on collaboration, adaptability, integrity, and a passion for solving complex challenges. If you're excited about building scalable data solutions, partnering with business leaders, and creating trusted data products that drive meaningful business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you. **About the Role** As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you'll serve as a critical technical bridge between our Enterprise IT/Data Architecture and Treasury teams. Treasury teams to understand business needs and translate them into scalable data and reporting solutions. * Identify, explore, and integrate data from multiple systems to support financial reporting, source data across platforms. * Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of enterprise data assets and reporting layers. * Document business rules, data definitions, metrics, and logic to promote transparency and shared understanding. * Support internal and external audits through clean reporting datasets and traceable data lineage. * Build automated validation, monitoring, and error\-handling processes to proactively identify and address data quality issues. * Serve as a trusted data partner for finance stakeholders, helping bridge the gap between business requirements and reliability. * You thrive in collaborative environments and build strong partnerships across teams. * You seek continuous improvement and aren't afraid to challenge existing processes. * You balance window functions. * Experience designing data models and semantic layers for business users. * Strong understanding of data architecture, transformation, and integration principles. * Ability to Engineering, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related technical discipline. * Additional business education, such as Finance coursework, MBA, or related experience preferred. * Experience supporting financial reporting, treasury operations, audit processes, or securitization data environments is highly desirable. **Why Merchants?** At Merchants Fleet, you'll have the opportunity to We invest in our people, encourage innovation, and empower employees to challenge the status quo. Here, you'll have the chance to solve complex data challenges, contribute to high\-impact initiatives, and grow your career in an environment where your ideas and expertise make a difference. **Ready to Build the Data That Drives Business Decisions?** If you're passionate about designing scalable data solutions, enabling financial insights, and partnering with business leaders to solve meaningful challenges, we'd love to hear from you. **Before You Apply** * Before applying, please review the following requirements: * This position is based at our headquarters in Hooksett, New Hampshire. No relocation assistance will be provided. * Minimal travel may be required. * Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. * Merchants Fleet is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position. **One Team. All Heart. All Hustle. Visit www.merchantsfleet.com/explore* *Merchants Fleet is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. If you require an accommodation with our hiring process please send an email to careers@merchantsfleet.com or call (603\) 836\-6483\.* *To provide all candidates with the highest level of our attention, Merchants Fleet does not accept uninvited solicitations or resumes from third parties. All workplace policies, required notices and guidelines (including EEO posters, CCPA notice for California residents) are available online.*

jobs.description: Overview: Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026! **Position Summary:** As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership and direction for multiple agile teams or projects to implement prioritized software product roadmaps. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it. Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life. We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals. Learn more about us here: https://www.mercuryinsurance.com/about/careers \#LI\-ZK1 Perks and Benefits: ***We offer many great benefits, including:**** Competitive compensation * Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States for most positions * Paid time off (vacation time, sick time, 9 paid Company holidays, volunteer hours) * Incentive bonus programs (potential for holiday bonus, referral bonus, and performance\-based bonus) * Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance * 401 (k) retirement savings plan with company match * Engaging work environment * Promotional opportunities * Education assistance * Professional and personal development opportunities * Company recognition program * Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Mercury is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities who need assistance with the application and/or employment consideration process. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large\-scale AI systems, working side\-by\-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands\-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply. ### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI Responsibilities:** * Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements. * Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs. * Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real\-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products. * Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team. * Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross\-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers. * Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments. ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions * Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience architecting and deploying large\-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise\-ready production * Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise\-grade reliability * Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products) * Experience in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare) or navigating enterprise compliance requirements (SOC2, data residency, privacy frameworks) * Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs * Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands\-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment. Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com. $183,997/year to $257,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.title: Silicon Packaging Engineer
jobs.description: Meta is looking for an experienced Silicon Packaging Engineer for its Ecosystem and Technical Operation team. The ideal candidate will be able to prioritize competing workstreams across a cross\-functional engineering environment based on impact, deadlines, and stakeholder needs. They will have experience with hardware development and integration of machine learning clusters, both server and fabric. They will be very familiar with AI/HPC hardware development, and will be data\-driven and focused on the impact they can create as part of a engineering team.The Meta Infrastructure team designs, builds, brings\-up, tests and integrates hardware systems that power Meta’s platforms, deployed in data centers worldwide, from silicon to sheet metal. Designs are published through the Open Compute Project Foundation. This is an opportunity to join our team and help us build some of the world’s most open and efficient machine learning platforms.We are building a competency in packaging design and technology to support the development of custom silicons for Infrastructure hardware as well as to develop packaging solutions that are optimal for our AI/ML products and system level performance. ### **Silicon jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: ### **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive\-in, drive\-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn't coming; it's here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it. ### **Who you are** Metropolis is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Applied AI to lead internal product strategy and drive an AI\-first operational transformation across the company. In this role, you will be dedicated entirely to internal\-focused AI initiatives, partnering directly with business leaders across Finance, Operations, Go\-To\-Market, and beyond to identify high\-leverage bottlenecks and eliminate process friction. You are a deeply analytical, product\-driven leader who operates comfortably at the intersection of complex operational workflows and modern AI architecture. You bring the same product rigor as our core product team (clear PRDs, disciplined roadmapping, and structured discovery) while flexing to a scrappier, sometimes vendor\-heavy motion when the work calls for moving fast on AI\-first initiatives. Working side\-by\-side with AI Engineers and vendors, you will turn operational challenges into scalable agentic workflows, internal applications, and automation systems that deliver measurable business impact. ### **What you'll do** * Prioritize the internal Applied AI product roadmap, translating ambiguous business challenges into prioritized engineering specifications and AI\-first solutions * Partner deeply with business leaders across Finance, Operations, and GTM to map existing workflows, identify automation leverage points, and drive internal technology adoption * Collaborate closely with AI Engineers to design, scope, and deploy internal applications, prompt pipelines, RAG implementations, and agentic workflows * Define clear requirements, PRDs, and quantifiable success metrics for every transformation, tracking outcomes such as time savings, error reduction, and cost impact * Lead agile product development cycles, gathering direct feedback from internal users to continuously iterate on deployed AI tools and improve output quality * Oversee change management efforts to ensure new internal tools and systems are seamlessly adopted across business units for sustained impact * Monitor production reliability, internal tool adoption, and the overall business value delivered by deployed systems * Roll up your sleeves to prototype solutions directly, rather than only writing specs for others to build ### **What we're looking for** * 6\+ years of product management or technical product leadership experience, with at least 2 years focused on shipping AI\-powered applications, LLM implementations, or process automation systems * Proven track record of driving internal process transformations, operational optimizations, or building software tools for internal business stakeholders * Practical understanding of modern AI capabilities, including LLMs, prompt systems, agentic patterns (tool calling, multi\-step reasoning), and RAG architectures * Hands\-on fluency building with AI tools yourself — prompt engineering, AI coding agents, and rapid prototyping — not just directing engineers on what to build * Working familiarity with modern data architectures, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure, including SQL, Snowflake, and AWS * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts to non\-technical business leaders * Strong instincts for change management and user empathy to ensure non\-technical teams successfully transition to AI\-first workflows * Entrepreneurial drive and a strong bias toward shipping fast, testing iteratively, and solving open\-ended problems in a fast\-paced environment ### **While not required, these are a plus:** * Previous experience managing third\-party vendor selection, evaluation, and integration for enterprise AI or software solutions * Experience scaling internal productivity tools or AI agents within high\-growth technology companies * Computer Science, Data Science, or related technical background * Direct familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and governance frameworks around enterprise AI usage * Background operating in hyper\-growth startups or environments managing rapid organizational change **4 Days in Office:** Metropolis values in\-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office\-first model, which requires employees to be on\-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection *When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world\-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $180,000\.00 USD to $205,000\.00 USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis's total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans and more.* *\#LI\-AR1 \#LI\-Onsite* *Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate's application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting.* *As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.* *Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs — without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.* *We are committed to providing a welcoming, accessible hiring experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please reach out to us at* *recruiting@metropolis.io**.*

jobs.title: Senior Application & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success. We’ve been employee\-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you. At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you. **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Application \& AI Security Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for improving the security of KSM’s internally developed applications, APIs, AI\-enabled solutions, and supporting integrations. This role partners directly with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen application designs, and implement and validate practical fixes. The engineer integrates security into application and AI development workflows, with particular attention to authentication, authorization, sensitive client data, and risks associated with large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and connected tools. Application and API security remain the primary focus of this position. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Assess internally developed applications and APIs for vulnerabilities involving authentication, authorization, access control, and sensitive data exposure. * Perform hands\-on application security testing, source code reviews, and architecture assessments; prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact. * Partner with developers to design and implement fixes, then independently validate that identified vulnerabilities are resolved. * Evaluate legacy applications, integrations, and application\-to\-application communications for security weaknesses. * Improve API protections, including service authentication, object\-level authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, and abuse prevention. * Integrate practical security requirements and testing into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines. * Implement and maintain appropriate SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning capabilities. * Establish secure coding guidance and reusable patterns for traditional and AI\-assisted development; review significant changes before production release. * Review application and AI architectures across AWS, Azure, and development environments, including client\-data isolation and access to sensitive information. * Work with Security and Development to strengthen application, API, and AI integration logging, monitoring, and detection of unauthorized activity. * Assess AI\-enabled applications, LLM integrations, and agent workflows for prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, insecure tool execution, and excessive permissions. * Review how AI systems access, process, and transmit client information; evaluate controls for AWS Bedrock and other approved AI services. * Develop practical security testing for AI features, including adversarial tests of LLM integrations and agent tool calls. * Support investigations involving application or AI integration compromise and drive corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Track application security findings through remediation and communicate material risks, priorities, and progress to leadership. * **Qualifications \& Experience** ================================ **Required** ------------ * 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, application security engineering, or closely related technical roles. * Strong knowledge of web application and API security, including authentication, authorization, session management, and access control. * Demonstrated experience identifying, remediating, and validating vulnerabilities in production applications. * Ability to read, understand, and review application source code and collaborate directly with software developers. * Practical experience with application security assessments, manual testing, and code reviews. * Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. * Understanding of LLM application architectures, AI agent permissions, prompt injection, and the security implications of AI tool integrations. * Experience securing REST APIs, service\-to\-service authentication, and application credentials. * Experience incorporating security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software development workflows. * Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical risks and remediation to developers and business stakeholders. **Preferred** ============= * Professional software development experience in languages and frameworks used by KSM’s development teams. * Experience securing applications and APIs hosted in AWS or Azure. * Experience with SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning tools. * Experience with application penetration testing, threat modeling, or secure architecture reviews. * Experience protecting sensitive financial, personal, or confidential client information in multi\-tenant applications. * Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and modern identity integration patterns. * Experience improving application/API logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities, including AI integrations. * Hands\-on experience securing production AI applications or integrations, including AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms. * Experience with AI security testing, adversarial evaluation, or assessing prompt injection and agent tool access. Relevant credentials such as OSWE, CSSLP, or GWAPT, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. * *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.* *KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee\-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.*

jobs.title: Network Engineer – Healthcare Imaging Infrastructure Modern Medical Solutions, LLC · [Remote (US) /
jobs.description: **About us** Modern Medical Solutions (MMS) is a healthcare IT managed services and consulting firm that specializes in radiology. jobs.title: Senior Azure Artificial Intelligence Security Architect - Remote
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY: Defines and maintains Molina’s security architecture framework for artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, evolving it as capabilities, deployment approaches, and threats change. Creates reusable security patterns, implementation guidance, and technical requirements for secure AI adoption across enterprise platforms and business use cases. Serves as the AI/ML security subject matter expert, including for Microsoft Azure and Databricks workloads, and partners with technology teams to implement and validate controls. ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES: **Designs Secure AI/ML Architectures:** Develops and promotes secure, resilient, and scalable architecture patterns for AI/ML solutions built on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, and other platforms. **AI Model Security:** Defines lifecycle security requirements, architecture patterns, and evaluation processes to protect the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of AI models, associated data, and dependencies. Guides teams in assessing model risks, implementing safeguards, and validating security before deployment and during operational use. Updates requirements as model technologies, deployment approaches, and threats evolve. **AI/ML Threat Modeling:** Conducts comprehensive threat modeling and risk assessments specifically for AI/ML systems, identifying vulnerabilities related to model inversion, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. **Agentic AI Security:** Leads threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture for autonomous AI agents, addressing prompt injection, tool abuse, and uncontrolled agentic behavior. Defines requirements and patterns that constrain agent actions, protect data and connected resources, and establish oversight and accountability. Validates control effectiveness as agent capabilities and operating models evolve. **AI Tools and Integration Security:** Defines trust boundaries, access controls, data protection, and oversight for interactions between AI systems and enterprise resources. Establishes supporting security requirements and reusable architecture patterns for AI tools, services, and integrations, including Model Context Protocol (MCP). Partners with implementation teams to validate controls protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of contextual data and connected systems, and updates guidance as integration technologies evolve. **MLSecOps Integration:** Collaborates with our MLOps and Data Science teams to embed automated security controls ("shift\-left") into the entire machine learning development lifecycle, from data ingestion to model deployment. **Architectural Guidance:** Maintains AI reference architectures and publishes security guidance, standards, and patterns addressing AI technology, development, security, privacy, and observability. Updates these architectural resources to guide secure AI implementation across the enterprise. **Strategic Advisory \& Business Alignment:** Consults on AI capabilities across business and technology platforms, ensuring alignment between AI architecture frameworks and the organization’s strategic goals. Offers actionable recommendations on solution design, risk mitigation, and cross\-domain impacts. **Partner \& Collaborate:** Partners with solution architects, technology leaders, business, governance, cyber security, compliance, and privacy teams to identify AI risks, documents design decisions, and provides enterprise patterns to resolve issues. **AI Platform and Service Security:** Evaluates enterprise AI platforms, products, and services against enterprise security requirements, assessing security capabilities, integration risks, and control gaps. Defines safeguards, acceptance criteria, security requirements, and deployment guidance. Partners with technology and governance teams to enable secure adoption and reassesses requirements as platform capabilities and business uses change. **Threat Research and Security Observability:** Tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities targeting AI systems and develops proactive defensive strategies. Designs security capabilities that support AI governance and observability, using threat research to inform their evolution. **Job Qualifications** **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * At least 5 years of experience in a senior cybersecurity role (e.g., Security Architect, Cloud Security Engineer), or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. * Proven, hands\-on experience securing AI/ML workloads and data pipelines within Microsoft Azure and Databricks platforms. * Demonstrated experience translating AI threat models into reusable security architecture patterns, implementation guidance, and testable technical requirements. Ability to validate practical controls through prototypes or security testing and guide engineering teams in adopting them across multiple AI implementation types. * Deep understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle and MLOps practices, with the ability to identify where security controls and validation belong from data ingestion through model deployment. * Strong understanding of network, application, and data security controls in a cloud\-native environment. * Demonstrated knowledge of security challenges, threat landscapes, and mitigation approaches for AI/ML systems, including generative and agentic AI. Ability to assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion, adversarial attacks, tool abuse, and uncontrolled agent behavior. * Proficiency in Python for security testing, control\-validation prototypes, and automation, with familiarity with data science and AI libraries. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Displays intellectual curiosity, integrity, and is motivated by achieving long\-term business outcomes. Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead cross\-functional teams. * **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Practical experience applying agentic AI security architecture, implementation requirements, and control validation approaches to autonomous systems. Demonstrated ability to assess autonomous\-behavior risks and apply mitigations for common attack vectors. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and securing the infrastructure that supports it. * Familiarity with applying MLSecOps principles through security\-testing and automation tools in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. * Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or Azure Security Engineer Associate/Expert. * Experience translating governance, compliance, security, and privacy management requirements into security architecture. * Familiarity with requirements under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act, and ability to partner with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to define AI data\-handling controls, document design decisions, and produce validation evidence. * Experience supporting agile teams by providing guidance on design, opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt. * Experience designing generative AI solutions and applying machine learning operations practices to AI models, applications, and supporting platforms. Ability to assess the architecture and security implications of unfamiliar AI technologies and apply transferable security principles as implementation approaches evolve. Ability to balance the long\-term (big picture) and short\-term implications of individual decisions. * To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board. Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** Monetary is the financial platform powering treasury and capital markets across the public sector. State and local governments, public universities, health systems, and the bankers and advisors who serve them run trillions of dollars in debt, cash, and investments on Monetary. We've built the most sophisticated treasury platform in public finance — sitting at the intersection of treasury management and a $4 trillion fixed income market that's been waiting for modern infrastructure. **ABOUT THIS ROLE** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can exist in a fullstack environment. You will need to balance working on projects with your team and working across teams to implement improvements platform wide. Engineers at Monetary work on products in multiple stages of maturity: we are enhancing some products that have been in use for years, we are launching new products, and we have some products that are in a more greenfield state. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to thrive within our Majestic Monolith of Ruby on Rails and React. You'll strike a balance between driving impactful team initiatives and collaborating across the organization to enhance our entire platform. At Monetary, our engineers touch the full lifecycle of product maturity—from refining established systems to architecting brand\-new, greenfield solutions. As a senior member of the team, you will act as a bridge between various practice areas, providing mentorship to colleagues while leading efforts in system design, solution shaping, and decomposing complex epics into actionable tasks. **HOW WE WORK** * Our application is a Majestic Monolith built with Ruby on Rails, React, and PostgreSQL. Our app is hosted in AWS, and we use GitLab for our CI/CD pipelines and deployments. We use feature flags to allow us to continually integrate our code. * Our front\-end is built with React, TypeScript, and MUI React. We have an in\-house library of accessible components documented in StoryBook. These components are being used in new development, and we are in the process of updating existing pages to use them. * Our back\-end is a Ruby on Rails JSON API that communicates with a React SPA (single page application). * All of our engineers work on the front\-end, back\-end and database. We have some engineers who are much more experienced in one, but we can all do some work in any part of the stack. * We have a small dedicated infrastructure team, but our teams deploy and monitor their own code. * Engineers collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and industry specialists to understand problems and design solutions. Engineers manage breaking down work into tickets and planning and managing projects. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Participate in all stages of the SDLC: solution shaping, system design, ticket writing/breakdown, write full\-stack code, review code, perform deployments, participate in monitoring, and gather data for reporting. * Own the quality of your work. Write tests and work with your team to ensure everything works before merging and releasing. * Work cross\-functionally on your team to ensure work is scoped to deliver quickly and deliver the right functionality. * Work collaboratively with other cross functional product\-focused teams. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 5\+ years of related professional experience * Experience with Rails or similar (Django, Laravel, Phoenix, Gin etc.) * Experience with React or similar (Angular, Vue, Svelte, etc.) * Some familiarity with front\-end and back\-end web development * Experience Leading Projects that have multiple engineers * Ability to communicate complicated technical concepts well with teammates in all functions, including non\-technical roles **WHY MONETARY** Monetary is a fast\-growing company where we dream big, move fast, make an impact, and bring joy to everything we do. Our core values drive our success as an organization, and we are looking for talented teammates who share our passion for challenging the status quo, innovating in all we do, and wanting to make a difference. When it comes to benefits and perks, we are committed to supporting our employees' well\-being to make their lives better, both in and out of the office. We offer: * Location: Charlotte NC (Hybrid \- Flexible) * Annual salary range is $135,000\-150,000 based on experience * Up to 10% annual bonus * Equity (stock options) for all employees * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with 4% employer match * Flexible work schedules and generous leave policies * Professional development opportunities * Stipend for remote workers to set up their ideal work space * Annual Company Onsite **Interview Process** * 30 min \- Introduction Call * 60 min \- Interview with Engineering Manager. Behavioral \+ Technical (Video call) + Our technical assessment covers development using Rails, React, and SQL. * 2 hr \- Onsite Interview with members from the Product, Design, and Engineering teams + This will be multiple panel interviews each containing 1\-2 team members. + The engineering portion will include programming. **OUR "GOAT" VALUES** **GROW Continuously** * We believe in continuous improvement, never accepting the status quo as good enough, and iterating to move quickly without compromising on quality. * We are energized by the fast\-paced rate of change that growth demands and see new challenges as opportunities for resilience and personal development. * We are driven by curiosity to think creatively, innovate, and experiment, and we humbly incorporate lessons learned from success and failure along the journey. **OWN Your Outcomes** * We hold ourselves accountable for exceptional effort, execution, reliability, professionalism, and results that add tremendous value for customers. * We are all individual contributors, responsible for delivering value to our customers, team, and company with every action we take. * As managers, we lead by example in both what we do and how we do it, and stay personally familiar with the work as we coach our teams. * We follow through on our decisions and commitments with action. **ABOVE \& Beyond** * We create moments of magic, surprising and delighting our customers at every touchpoint. * We run towards problems and enthusiastically jump in to help colleagues however we can be valuable. * We take pride in proactively doing the extra little things that set us apart, even when no one is watching. **TEAM Over Ego** * There is no task needed at Monetary that is beneath any of us. * We work hard to be the teammate others want on their team. * We have the courage to have hard conversations and the grace to receive honest feedback in pursuit of excellence. Monetary is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and prohibit discrimination and unlawful harassment in the workplace. All applicants will receive consideration for employment based upon their qualifications without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, marital status, genetic information, political affiliation, National Guard or veteran status, disability, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law. We welcome and encourage applicants with disabilities to contact our team for assistance during the application and hiring process. We are committed to expanding accessibility and making reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law.
