jobs.title: Assistant Engineer
jobs.description: **DEFINITION:** Under general direction, performs highly technical or specialized functions to ensure compliance with environmental protection programs in solid waste management, landfill operations, ReGen Monterey’s approved Operations Plans, building codes, and standards of practice; coordinates, performs professional engineering work in connection with air, landfill gas, ground water, stormwater and wastewater sampling, waste acceptance program, monitoring and reporting compliance requirements; interacts with other departments, regulatory agencies and the public; perform other duties related to ensuring that ReGen Operations are in compliance with permits and regulatory requirements; and monitors environmental control systems performance. **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:** This is the first working level engineer position in the professional engineering series. Incumbents are under the direct supervision of the Associate Engineer or Senior Engineer and perform first level professional engineering field and office work. Candidate shall possess an Engineer\-In\-Training (EIT) certificate; shall pursue and obtain a California Professional Engineer (PE) license within 5 years; or may possess a recently obtained PE license. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *The following duties are typical of this classification and are intended only to describe the various types of work that may be performed, the level of technical complexity of the assignment(s) and are not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties. The omission of a specific duty statement does not exclude it from the position if the work is consistent with the concept of the classification or is similar or closely related to another duty statement to address business needs and changing business practices.* **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Provides technical support including engineering for the design, permitting, operation, and maintenance of the building facilities and landfill’s environmental control systems (e.g., storm water, leachate, underdrain water, groundwater, landfill gas, etc.) under supervision of Associate Engineer or Senior Engineer. * Assists with the implementation of ReGen Monterey’s environmental protection programs and other related programs and projects in coordination with the Senior Engineer. * Coordinates sampling, monitoring, and reporting programs related to various ReGen operations, such as landfill operations (air quality, landfill gas, groundwater, stormwater, leachate, and soils), and ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, regulations and permits either directly or through the management of consultants and service contracts. * Prepares various written correspondence, reports, materials. * Assists in the investigation of site information and conditions associated with maintenance or capital improvement projects; or of complaints associated with regulatory compliance issues. * Assists with maintenance of environmental compliance records and project files. * Supervises inspection of industrial waste users for compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory standards. * Monitors and interprets conditions during storms and other hazardous situations and recommends appropriate actions. * Conducts field tests and trains staff on proper sampling and inspection techniques. * Performs inspections and documents field collected data and observations. * Performs various monitoring and sampling activities to ensure compliance with regulations. * Reviews, analyzes, and interprets test results and coordinates with Senior Engineer and other ReGen Monterey staff to contribute to the development of recommendations for infrastructure improvements or correction of problems. * Assists with review of draft environmental or project reports for internal and external audiences as required either directly or through the management of consultants and service contracts. Maintains EP data tracking systems and provides ReGen related reporting information and statistics. * Assists and supports team to administer customer special waste disposal approvals in accordance with ReGen Monterey’s approved Waste Acceptance Program. * Adhere to an assigned work schedule and meet ReGen attendance standards. * All ReGen positions require the employee to provide good customer service to both internal and external customers, maintain positive and effective working relationships with other ReGen employees, and have regular and reliable attendance and timeliness. Must always show cooperation and respect to fellow employees and supervisors. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Knowledge of and Ability to:** * Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office, CAD, general computer acumen and ability to learn and utilize other job\-related technical software. * Civil engineering principles and practices as applied to the field of solid waste management, including the planning, development, design, maintenance, construction, and operation of solid waste management, landfill, and related public works facilities. * Permitting requirements and processes for solid waste and landfill operations * Working knowledge of chemical and physical characteristics of organic and inorganic waste. * Working knowledge of principles of chemistry, engineering, biology, geology, hydrology and water, air, and soil quality management. * Working knowledge of research methodology and standard statistical procedures. * Applicable County, State, and Federal laws, codes, and ordinances related to the design, construction, and operation of solid waste management and landfill facilities. * Sound customer service practices and procedures. Working knowledge of Quality Assurance and Quality Control principles and practices. * Safety laws, programs, and requirements related to ReGen operations. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). **TRAINING, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor’s degree in civil or environmental engineering or related field. * 1\-2 years of civil engineering, environmental protection, and compliance related experience. **REQUIRED LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:** * Possession of a valid and current California Driver's License. * Possession of Engineer in Training (EIT) certificate. **PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:** The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employees to successfully perform the essential functions of this class. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands** While performing the duties of this class, employees are regularly required to sit; talk or hear, in person, in meetings and by telephone; use hands to finger, handle, feel or operate standard office equipment including keyboard; and reach with hands and arms. Employees are frequently required to walk and stand on uneven ground. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Lifting boxes such as recruitment files, applications or other forms weighing up to 25lbs. **Mental Demands** While performing the duties of this class, employees are regularly required to use written and oral communication skills; read and interpret data, information and documents; analyze and solve policy and operational issues; observe and interpret people and situations; use math and mathematical reasoning; learn and apply new information or skills; perform detailed work on multiple, concurrent tasks with constant interruptions; work under deadlines and interact with all levels of ReGen management and personnel, and the public. **Work Environment** Normally, work is performed in both indoor and outdoor environments; occasionally will be exposed to varying temperatures; regular exposure to exposure to dirt, dust, fumes, noise, garbage, foul odors; potential exposure to hazardous materials and chemicals, moderate exposure to, and often works around, fast\-moving vehicles and equipment; constant contact with staff and the public. **Special Demands** Must be able to actively participate in public meetings including giving presentations in person and on camera before staff, the Board of Directors, and members of the public.

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering & Compliance
jobs.description: **DEFINITION:** Under general direction from the General Manager, plans, directs, organizes, integrates, manages and provides oversight of services of the Engineering \& Compliance functions of the District; serves as the District Engineer and Compliance Officer; provides oversight and project management of capital improvement projects, contractor and contract services; directs and manages the development of short and long\-term goals and objectives consistent with the Strategic Plan and annual business plan and ensures their effective execution; provides direction and supervision of Engineering staff; ensures all assigned operations and functions serve the needs of the District, while complying with applicable laws and regulations; provides highly responsible and complex administrative support to the General Manager; and performs related duties as assigned. **Distinguishing Characteristics:** This position is responsible for managing and integrating a wide variety of functions, programs and staff engaged in managing the broad, comprehensive engineering and compliance services and activities for the District. Within assigned areas of accountability, the incumbent operates with substantial latitude and discretion to achieve effective and efficient utilization of resources in serving the District’s mission. Positions at this class level serve as a member of the District’s senior leadership team and provide advice and counsel to the General Manager regarding strategic policy and problem\-solving issues relating to the assigned Departments and the District overall. A person appointed to the Director of Engineering \& Compliance/District Engineer classification is an “at\-will” employee. The incumbent in this position provides direct supervision of the Senior Engineer and has oversight of the two (2\) District departments of Engineering \& Compliance. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *The following duties are typical of this classification and are intended only to describe the various types of work that may be performed, the level of technical complexity of the assignment(s) and are not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties. The omission of a specific duty statement does not exclude it from the position if the work is consistent with the concept of the classification or is similar or closely related to another duty statement to address business needs and changing business practices.* **Minimum Qualifications AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: * Performs a variety of professional engineering tasks in the planning, design development and construction of District Facilities and evaluates the effectiveness of District programs, procedures and services relating to maintenance and operations including: planning, design, landfill and site development and maintenance, construction and building renovation needs, operations of landfill gas monitoring and collection systems, leachate collection/extraction/treatment systems and groundwater monitoring wells, and traffic flow and control. * Oversees and is responsible for planning and execution of all engineering \& compliance, and safety programs. * Plans, organizes and implements the District’s capital improvement projects; develops revenue forecasts and monitors expenditures; reviews and evaluates work methods and procedures to ensure budget adoption prior to July 1 of each year. * Oversees and is responsible for permitting of all District services and functions; administers regulatory compliance programs, including environmental and construction permit requirements. * Performs and reviews engineering calculations, prepares cost estimates and manages budgets for contract construction projects. * Assist in preparation of long\-term capital overlay plan for capital equipment, machinery and facilities as part of the annual budget preparation process. * Plans and evaluates performance of assigned staff; establishes performance requirements and personal development targets; regularly monitors performance and provides coaching for performance improvement and development; collaborate with HR Manager to takes disciplinary action, up to and including termination, to address performance deficiencies, in accordance with the District's personnel rules, policies and labor contract provisions where applicable. * Prepares Requests for Proposal (RFPs) for equipment and services as directed; represents the District in negotiations with vendors and service contractors. * Provides oversight and lead direction of all capital improvement projects. * Prepares and presents project status reports to the Board of Directors, management staff, other District staff, outside agencies and the public. * Oversees proper compliance with specifications on the use and development of disposal site and proper compliance with permits issued for various site operations and/or operation’s support facilities or equipment. * Provides advice and consultation on long range operations planning and facility development. * Perf training, and employee evaluation. * Research and evaluation methodologies. * Project Management. * Sound customer service practices and procedures. * Safety laws, programs, and requirements related to District operations. * California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). **Skills:** * Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project, Access. * Modern office procedures, methods, and equipment including filing and recordkeeping. * Proper use of the English language, including grammar, spelling, and punctuation. * Familiarity of function and analytical design of common civil engineering software. * Familiarity with basic finance and accounting principles and practices. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** Any combination of training and experience which would likely provide the required knowledge and abilities is qualifying. A typical way to obtain the required knowledge and abilities would be: Ten to fifteen (10\-15\) years of varied and responsible professional engineering work experience in the development, design, maintenance, operation, and construction of public works and/or solid waste management and landfill and processing facilities, including some experience in working with compliance and regulatory agencies in addition to possessing a bachelor’s degree in engineering. jobs.title: Senior/Lead Forward Deployed AI Engineer/Architect-Copilot/Azure
jobs.description: **Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer** **AI Foundry \| NewRocket** **Location:** Remote with travel (\~70%) **Role Overview** NewRocket is seeking a highly skilled **Senior** **Forward Deployed AI Engineer** **and Architect** to join the AI Foundry team and work directly with customers to deploy, operationalize, and scale AI\-powered workflow solutions. This role blends full\-stack engineering, enterprise integration, generative AI implementation, and client\-facing solution delivery. Forward Deployed AI Engineers partner closely with business consultants, product teams, AI/ML engineers, and customer stakeholders to translate real\-world business problems into secure, reliable, deployable AI\-driven solutions. As an Anthropic partner/vendor, NewRocket is expanding its capability to design and deliver enterprise solutions using Claude and other leading AI technologies. In this role, you will apply modern LLM engineering practices—including prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, structured outputs, agentic workflows, model evaluation, and responsible AI controls—to deliver measurable customer value. You will help customers implement agentic AI workflows, intelligent automations, and AI\-powered integrations within ServiceNow and broader enterprise ecosystems. You will also contribute directly to the evolution of NewRocket's AI platforms, accelerators, and intellectual property, including the **NewRocket Intelligence Platform**, **Value Realization Dashboard**, **Data Intelligence Platform**, and reusable **Agent Packs**. This role requires strong engineering skills, curiosity about emerging AI technologies, sound judgment regarding responsible AI deployment, and the ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving customer environments. **Key Responsibilities** **Client Delivery \& AI Solution Implementation** * Deploy, configure, and operationalize agentic AI workflows, AI assistants, and AI\-powered automations within client ServiceNow environments and enterprise technology ecosystems. * Translate customer business requirements, operational processes, and desired outcomes into technical architectures, implementation plans, and production\-ready AI solutions. * Implement and integrate NewRocket Agent Packs, AI accelerators, and workflow solutions into enterprise environments. * Work directly with customer teams to tailor AI solutions to their operating models, business processes, data sources, security requirements, and user needs. * Support workshops, discovery sessions, technical working sessions, demonstrations, pilots, and production rollouts. * Clearly communicate AI capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, solution behavior, and adoption considerations to technical and business stakeholders. **Anthropic and Generative AI Engineering** * Build enterprise AI applications and workflows using Claude, the Anthropic API, and other LLM platforms as appropriate for the client use case. * Apply effective prompt and context\-engineering techniques, including clear instructions, examples, role and task definition, structured inputs, response constraints, and long\-context management. * Design and implement AI workflows using structured outputs, tool use/function calling, API integrations, multi\-step orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop review patterns. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions that ground AI responses in authorized enterprise data and knowledge sources. * Implement practical techniques to improve reliability and user trust, including citation or source\-grounding patterns, validation, confidence thresholds, output schemas, fallback handling, and escalation workflows. * Stay current on Anthropic platform capabilities, Claude model releases, implementation guidance, responsible AI principles, and enterprise deployment best practices. * Complete relevant Anthropic training, partner enablement, and technical education programs as available, and incorporate those practices into NewRocket solution delivery. **Solution Engineering \& Prototyping** * Build demos, prototypes, and proof\-of\-concept implementations that validate AI\-driven workflows and customer use cases. * Rapidly iterate with customers and internal teams to refine AI\-powered solutions based on feedback, performance results, and operational needs. * Support the design and implementation of AI orchestration, LLM integrations, agentic decision models, and workflow automation patterns. * Evaluate when an agentic approach is appropriate versus deterministic automation, traditional workflow logic, search, analytics, or human review. * Develop reusable implementation patterns, solution templates, prompt libraries, integrations, and deployment assets that accelerate future client delivery. **Full\-Stack Engineering \& Integration** * Develop secure integrations between ServiceNow, enterprise systems, APIs, data platforms, and AI services. * Build supporting components such as scripts, mic ower BI * Proficiency in **JavaScript/TypeScript**, **Python**, or similar programming and scripting languages. * Familiarity with modern LLM application concepts, including prompt engineering, context windows, token usage, embeddings, vector search, RAG, tool use/function calling, structured outputs, and model evaluation. * Understanding of responsible AI concepts, including hallucination mitigation, sensitive\-data handling, identity and access controls, human oversight, AI safety, and secure AI deployment. * Experience operating in customer\-facing engineering, consulting, technical implementation, solutions architecture, or professional\-services roles. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. * Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, travel to clients as needed, and deliver high\-quality solutions in fast\-moving customer environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (**MCP**) concepts and experience building or integrating secure tools and data connections for AI applications. **ServiceNow Experience — Strong Plus** * Experience with ServiceNow development, configuration, workflow automation, or enterprise platform implementation. * Familiarity with ServiceNow scripting, APIs, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Virtual Agent, Now Assist, AI Agents, and platform development patterns. * Understanding of ServiceNow data models and enterprise workflow concepts, including: * + CMDB + ITSM, CSM, HRSD, or employee workflows + Workflow and task tables + Knowledge management + Enterprise integrations and data exchange patterns **AI, Data \& Platform Experience** * Experience building AI prototypes, RAG systems, semantic search capabilities, AI assistants, or agent\-based workflows. * Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into enterprise applications and business processes. * Experience with vector databases, embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, retrieval strategies, and knowledge\-grounding patterns. * Familiarity with LLM orchestration and application frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable tools. * Experience with AI observability, tracing, evaluation frameworks, prompt/version management, monitoring, and cost optimization. * Experience contributing to internal platforms, reusable accelerators, developer tooling, or product capabilities. * Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, SQL, Git, infrastructure\-as\-code, and secure cloud deployment practices. **Why This Role Matters** Forward Deployed AI Engineers are the bridge between real\-world enterprise problems and NewRocket's AI platforms. By working directly with customers, they deliver immediate operational value while shaping the evolution of NewRocket's AI products, accelerators, and platform capabilities. This role is critical to scaling the **NewRocket Intelligence Platform** and the broader **AI Foundry strategy**. As NewRocket expands its partnership with Anthropic, this engineer will help establish practical, secure, and responsible patterns for deploying Claude\-powered AI solutions that improve enterprise workflows, accelerate decision\-making, and create measurable business outcomes. **We Take Care of Our People** NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Participate in and lead architectural discussions, contributing to technical design documents and implementation proposals. + Full\-Stack Excellence: Maintain and improve the stability, readability, and scalability of the codebase, ensuring best practices across backend services and frontend architecture using React and Next.js. + Optimize Performance \& Reliability: Drive performance improvements and optimize Core Web Vitals (such as INP metrics) across our pages. Lead operational excellence by ensuring services meet SLAs, influencing incident response, and continuously reducing incident volume and MTTR. + Leverage Cutting\-Edge Tooling: Utilize AI coding assistants and LLMs proficiently to accelerate development velocity, generate boilerplate, and troubleshoot complex debugging scenarios, while exercising critical judgment to verify outputs for security and accuracy.What You’ll Bring: + Software development experience, including internships, academic projects, or relevant professional experience. including time in large\-scale, distributed systems + F ull\-stack proficiency : Experience in frontend web development with a strong focus on Typescript, React js and Apollo GraphQL combined with deep proficiency in backend languages like Node js and GraphQL. + AI Tooling Mastery: Proven proficiency using modern AI\-assisted SDLC environments and agents (e.g., Claude/Cursor/GitHub Copilot, \- based engineering agents) and drive AI adoption at scale + Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise: Experience designing and operating cloud\-native services on AWS (EKS, containers like Docker, managed databases) with modern CI/CD orchestration (e.g., CircleCI, ArgoCD, Kubernetes). + Systems Design: Strong grounding in system design, data modeling, API design, responsive design principles, and CSS technologies like PandaCSS/CSS3\. + Observability \& Data\-Driven Mindset: Comfort working with observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces like NewRelic and Splunk) and using data to debug, optimize, and harden production systems. + Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering/related field or equivalent professional experience.How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. Our employees work three days in our Austin headquarters where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com® is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits include: + Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage. + 13 Paid Holidays and Flexible Time Off. + Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match. + Family forming benefits and Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program. + Tuition Reimbursement and 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions. + 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off. + Free snacks and refreshments in each office location.Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or disability status. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Apply Now

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **ENGINEERING MANAGER** *Nexxt Spine LLC, Noblesville, IN* Nexxt Spine LLC, is a leader in the medical device industry, dedicated to designing, manufacturing, and distributing an expanding portfolio of innovative spinal implants and instruments. We are committed to a culture of innovation, excellence, and employee engagement while delivering solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen surgeon and distributor partnerships. **JOB DESCRIPTION** The Engineering Manager makes sure every spinal implant and instrument project has a clear definition at the start and a confirmed finish at the end. The role turns surgeon concepts into defined scope, owns the plan from concept through 510(k) clearance and production release, and holds the engineering team accountable for closing each phase. The role supervises the full engineering ladder, from Engineer I through Lead Engineer. It sets the standard for how projects are scoped, tracked, and closed, while the engineers own the technical design work. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Project Clarity** * Translate surgeon concept meetings into a written project charter with scope, intended use, deliverables, and success criteria before design work begins. * Approve design inputs with the Senior Engineers so every requirement is measurable, testable, and traceable to user needs. * Build an integrated project plan for each implant and instrument system, covering CAD design, prototyping (3D printing, SLA, machining), testing, patents, 510(k), and production transfer. * Define phase gates and the entry and exit criteria for each, including concept review, design freeze, verification and validation, regulatory submission, and launch. * Assign clear owners and due dates to every deliverable, and confirm each engineer understands the expected output and standard of completion. * Manage scope changes through a documented change process that records impact on schedule, cost, testing, and regulatory pathway. * Publish a single source of truth for project status that surgeons, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and sales can rely on. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Project Completion** * Track progress weekly against the baseline plan, identify slips early, and drive recovery actions to closure. * Run phase gate reviews and confirm exit criteria are met before a project advances; do not allow open items to carry forward undocumented. * Coordinate FDA testing with internal labs and external test houses so mechanical testing to ASTM standards finishes on schedule for 510(k) submission. * Partner with regulatory to plan submission dates, track FDA questions, and close responses within agreed timelines. * Confirm DHF completeness at each gate and at project close, so design records are audit\-ready under FDA, GMP, and ISO 13485\. * Manage handoff to manufacturing, including design transfer, supplier readiness, and first production builds. * Maintain a risk and issue log for each project and escalate blockers that the team cannot resolve. * Close every project formally with a completion review, lessons learned, and archived records. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Supervise the Lead Engineer, Senior Engineer II, Senior Engineer I, Engineer II, and Engineer I positions, including hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews. * Set individual goals tied to project milestones, and hold regular one\-on\-ones to review progress and remove obstacles. * Balance workload across concurrent projects and match assignments to each level's scope and independence. * Hold engineers accountable for on\-time, complete deliverables while giving clear, specific feedback on quality. * Support career growth along the Engineer I to Lead Engineer ladder, including promotion readiness and development plans. * Work with the Lead Engineer to ensure technical design reviews, mentoring, and design standards are applied consistently. * Model clear communication with surgeons and cross\-functional partners, and coach engineers to do the same. **QUALIFICATIONS**Required: * Experience taking implants or instruments from concept through 510(k) clearance and production release. * Prior supervisory or project leadership experience over engineers at multiple levels. * Working knowledge of FDA design controls, GMP, ISO 13485, and DHF requirements. * Proficiency with project planning tools and methods, including schedules, phase gates, and risk logs. * Hands\-on understanding of SolidWorks, additive manufacturing, and mechanical testing to ASTM standards, enough to judge technical progress and risk. * Clear written and verbal communication at all levels, from surgeons to executive leadership. * Critical thinking and creative problem solving when weighing schedule, cost, and technical trade\-offs. Preferred: * PMP or equivalent project management certification. * Spinal implant or orthopedic device experience. * Experience with patent processes. * Background in traditional manufacturing or laboratory research. **EDUCATION** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering

jobs.title: Outbound AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nimble:** ----------------- Nimble is the real\-time web search platform built for enterprise accuracy, completeness, and trust. We run Web Search Agents that actively navigate live websites using real browsers and reasoning, turning the public web into governed, decision\-grade data for AI systems and high\-stakes business use. Unlike index\-based “AI search” tools or brittle legacy scraping, Nimble makes the live web queryable on demand, delivering structured outputs that teams can verify and rely on. Our platform powers use cases where correctness matters: financial due diligence, real\-time pricing and promotions, market intelligence, and AI systems that depend on fresh, complete data. Trusted by leading enterprises like Home Depot, Uber, and Coca\-Cola and backed by top\-tier investors, Nimble sits at the intersection of AI, automation, and real\-time web intelligence. As demand accelerates across AI, LLMs, and data\-driven decisioning, we’re scaling quickly and looking for high\-energy, driven teammates who thrive in fast\-moving environments and want to help define a new category. **Why join Nimble?** * Work on a deeply technical platform powering real\-time AI and enterprise decisions * Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence * Build alongside a sharp, mission\-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership **About the Role:** ------------------- As an Outbound AI Engineer at Nimble, you’ll support a focused Enterprise pod and help that pod create pipeline and ARR. You’ll own the work traditionally associated with top\-of\-funnel, but your role will not stop at booking meetings. You’ll use AI agents, automation, account research, GTM assets, and follow\-up support to help the pod open doors, progress opportunities, and generate revenue. The goal is simple: help the pod create more pipeline and ARR from the accounts we care about. **You do not need to be a software engineer.** **You do need to be resourceful, AI\-native, and comfortable using modern AI tools to replace manual BDR work with better research, stronger personalization, faster execution, and more useful sales support.** Being good at prompting is helpful, but it is not enough. We’re looking for someone who understands how to connect AI into actual GTM workflows and can think in terms of agents, workflows, tools, and repeatable systems. **What Makes This Role Different** Most BDR roles are built around activity volume. This role is built around pod outcomes. You’ll be expected to open doors and book meetings, but also to help the pod create better account strategies, better messaging, better assets, better follow\-up, and better ways to engage the accounts we care about. You are not just passing meetings to AEs and moving on. You are part of the Enterprise pod and share the goal of creating pipeline and ARR from the accounts assigned to that pod. The role combines the accountability of outbound with the leverage of AI, agents, automation, and GTM tooling. **What You’ll be Doing:** ------------------------- * Support a pod of 2–3 Enterprise AEs * Research accounts, stakeholders, buying committees, market signals, and relevant business initiatives * Build AI\-executed outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels * Book qualified meetings with target accounts * Use AI agents, workflows, and automation to improve account research, personalization, messaging, sequencing, and follow\-up * Build repeatable account research workflows for assigned accounts and segments * Build lightweight tools, workflows, dashboards, and automations that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Create account\-specific or segment\-specific GTM assets that help AEs open and progress conversations * Support post\-meeting follow\-up, stakeholder mapping, and multi\-threading * Partner closely with AEs to help move opportunities from first meeting to pipeline and ARR * Stay focused on assigned accounts and strategic GTM priorities rather than chasing easy meetings outside the target list **How We Expect AI to Be Used** This role is not about occasionally using ChatGPT or Claude to write outbound emails. We’re looking for someone who can use AI agents, workflows, automation, and agentic loops to make outbound faster, sharper, and more scalable across a focused set of target accounts. You should be comfortable using AI as a research, workflow, automation, and GTM execution layer. That means using LLMs where useful, but also connecting them to tools, data sources, workflows, and repeatable processes that help the pod operate more effectively. **Examples of how you might use AI in this role:** * Build repeatable account research agents for assigned accounts and segments * Create agentic workflows that gather, summarize, and structure public web signals across accounts * Build account briefs that summarize company priorities, business model, public web presence, competitive landscape, and relevant business initiatives * Identify relevant stakeholders and buying committees across target accounts * Turn account research into relevant outbound angles by persona, account, and use case * Build repeatable messaging frameworks for different segments, buyer types, and use cases * Create personalized outreach based on account\-specific signals, not generic AI\-written copy * Use AI agents to analyze websites, documentation, product pages, job postings, news, company updates, customer stories, technical content, and other public web signals * Build lightweight workflows, automations, dashboards, and internal tools that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Connect AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems through Skills, APIs, automations, or similar approaches * Use agentic loops to monitor accounts, surface changes, identify triggers, and suggest next actions * Use AI to create GTM assets that help AEs open conversations and move opportunities forward * Improve follow\-up after meetings by summarizing context, identifying next stakeholders, creating tailored follow\-up assets, and helping the AE multi\-thread the account * Continuously test and improve outbound messaging, targeting, and account strategy based on what is converting **Success in this role means contributing to:** * Pipeline created by the pod * ARR generated by the pod * High\-quality account engagement * Opening doors in strategic target accounts * Supporting AEs with research, assets, tools, and follow\-up * Stronger pipeline creation and deal progression You will not be measured by activity volume, emails sent, or meetings booked for the sake of meetings. **What You Should Have for the Role:** -------------------------------------- **We’re looking for someone who can combine outbound execution with AI\-native thinking.** **You should be comfortable doing the hard parts of outbound, but also curious enough to build better ways of doing the work.** You are: * Commercially minded and revenue\-oriented * Comfortable with outbound prospecting, including email, LinkedIn, and phone * Strong at account research and business writing * Able to understand business problems and turn them into relevant outreach * Able to use AI as a workflow and research engine, not just as a copywriting tool * Comfortable connecting AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems * Familiar with Skills, APIs, automations, no\-code / low\-code tools, or similar ways to extend AI beyond a chat interface * Able to build repeatable processes with AI, automation, spreadsheets, enrichment tools, and lightweight dashboards * Able to turn public web data and account signals into specific outbound angles * Aware that good AI\-assisted outbound still requires judgment, business context, and strong sales instincts * Disciplined about working assigned target accounts and GTM priorities * Strong at follow\-up, organization, and CRM hygiene * Able to work closely with AEs and support opportunities after the first meeting * Excited by a role that blends outbound, AI, GTM strategy, and sales execution **Helpful Background** You may be a fit if you have experience in one or more of the following: * BDR / SDR / outbound sales * Enterprise sales development * AI\-assisted prospecting or GTM automation * Sales tools, workflow automation, or no\-code / low\-code systems * Account\-based outbound or strategic account prospecting * Working with assigned target accounts or named account lists * Selling or prospecting into technical, product, data, operations, strategy, or revenue buyers * Building workflows, internal tools, automations, or agent\-based research processes On\-Target Earnings (OTE): 75,000$ \- 90,000$

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** As a **Senior DevOps Engineer** on NinjaOne's DevOps Engineering team, you will build and run the release and deployment pipelines that move code from commit to production quickly, safely, and predictably at scale. The role centers on CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform, and we are looking for hands\-on experience across multiple clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) with Kubernetes as our deployment runtime. You will treat every environment, from ephemeral test stacks to production, as version\-controlled, reviewable, and reproducible code. If you think in modules, state files, and plan/apply workflows rather than console changes and one\-off scripts, this role is built for you. You will help build a cloud\-agnostic Terraform foundation that engineering teams can adopt as we grow toward a multi\-cloud model. You will work closely with Development, QA, Security, and Corporate IT to keep our release process and infrastructure secure, resilient, and fast. We are a fast\-paced, rapidly growing company, and this role suits someone who enjoys owning the "last mile" of software delivery: turning builds into safe, automated, repeatable production deployments. **Location** \- We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states \- **CA**, **CO**, **CT**, **FL**, **GA**, **\*IL**, **KS**, **MA**,**MD, ME**,**NJ**, **NC**, **NY**,**OH,** **OR**, **TN**, **TX**, **VA**, and **WA**. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.* *Onsite interviews may be required for this role.* We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on **Java**, **Kotlin**, **C\+\+**, **Golang** and **Postgres**; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in **AWS**. Knowing large\-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client\-server architecture will help you. **What You’ll be Doing*** **Build and improve CI/CD pipelines:** Develop and maintain our CI/CD framework, with particular depth on the CD side: artifact promotion, environment promotion, deployment gating, and automated rollback, with Terraform runs, plan reviews, and policy checks built into the pipeline. * **Implement deployment strategies:** Build progressive delivery patterns (blue/green, canary, rolling) with automated health checks, gating, and rollback, all defined as code. * **Automate release management:** Build tooling for release orchestration across services and regions, including scheduling, change tracking, and feature\-flag\-driven rollout. * **Write and maintain Terraform:** Design reusable, well\-versioned modules and manage remote state, workspaces, and environment strategy so teams can safely self\-serve infrastructure changes through code review. * **Support our cloud\-agnostic IaC foundation:** Build secure, compliant infrastructure in AWS today, and help shape provider\-agnostic module patterns and standards that extend cleanly to Azure and GCP, with Kubernetes as the common runtime. * **Add governance and guardrails:** Integrate policy\-as\-code, security and compliance scanning, and cost checks (e.g., Sentinel, OPA, Checkov, Infracost) into the Terraform pipeline so changes are safe, auditable, and cost\-aware by default. * **Enable other teams:** Partner with engineering teams to migrate existing infrastructure to Terraform, and build documentation and golden\-path templates so teams outside DevOps can author and own their own IaC. * **Monitor and support delivery:** Watch deployment pipelines, release health, and Terraform plan/apply activity. Act as a technical escalation point for production support during and after business hours, including incident response, rollback, and remediation. * Other duties as needed. **About You*** 7\+ years in a cloud\-based DevOps environment, with deep, current AWS expertise and a strong emphasis on release engineering, deployment automation, and IaC. * Hands\-on, production experience with Azure and/or GCP in addition to AWS. Experience operating on two or more clouds is preferred. We want someone who has deployed and run infrastructure on more than one cloud, not someone who has only reasoned about portability. * 4\+ years of production Terraform: module authoring, remote state management (e.g., S3/DynamoDB backends), workspaces, provider version management, and safe plan/apply workflows integrated into CI/CD. * Experience with **Kubernetes** (or ECS) container orchestration and deployment tooling such as Helm and Kustomize, including provisioning clusters and node groups via Terraform. * Experience with **Terraform** in a multi\-team environment, including state design, module registries, versioning policy, and access control. Familiarity with provider\-agnostic module patterns is a plus. * Deep experience designing and operating continuous delivery pipelines (not just CI), including progressive rollout (blue/green, canary, rolling) and automated rollback. We prefer candidates who have owned the CD/release side, including infrastructure provisioning. **CircleCI** experience is a plus. * Familiarity with Terraform ecosystem tooling such as Terragrunt, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Atlantis, Sentinel/OPA, or Checkov is a plus. * A track record of reducing deployment lead time, change failure rate, and time to recover through automation and codified infrastructure. * Experience helping other teams adopt IaC through documentation, golden\-path templates, and migrations. * Strong cloud operations skills, with a focus on the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of cloud\-native applications and their Terraform\-managed infrastructure. * Comfortable with agile tools (Jira, Confluence) and version control (Git, BitBucket) for both application code and IaC. * 5\+ years working with \*nix operating systems (Linux, MacOS, BSD variants, IBM AIX). * 4\+ years of scripting in languages such as Shell, Go, Python, PERL, or Tcl/Tk, used to build deployment tooling, automation, and Terraform wrappers. * 4\+ years of production monitoring, alerting, and deployment observability, including managing change and configuration and detecting drift against Terraform\-managed state. **About Us** NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140\+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. **What You’ll Love** We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. We honor your flexibility needs with full\-time work that is hybrid remote. We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan. We prioritize your work\-life balance with our unlimited PTO. We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement. **Additional Information** This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship. * Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self\-relocate. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job\-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey, or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

jobs.title: Embedded OS Field Engineer
jobs.description: **About the job** Nordic Semiconductor is looking for an **Embedded OS (Android AOSP, Linux) Field Engineer** to be the technical face of **Memfault**, the device\-observability platform recently acquired by Nordic, for customers building on Android/AOSP and embedded Linux. This is a customer\-facing engineering role. The primary mission is to guide prospects and customers through technical evaluation and get Memfault integrated into their development and production flows. That means running architecture reviews, driving proofs\-of\-concept to a successful outcome, and unblocking their engineers hands\-on along the way. It suits someone who is comfortable in *either* Android/AOSP *or* embedded Linux and genuinely excited to grow into the other. This person also has the opportunity to contribute directly to Memfault's Android and Linux SDKs as they gain deep, unique insights into customers' use\-cases and painpoints. For additional context, this role is similar in nature to other industry roles such as Field Application Engineer (FAE), Forward Deployed Engineer, or Solution Architect / Engineer (SA / SE). **Key responsibilities** * Lead technical discovery of customers' existing architectures, and drive evaluations and POCs to success against agreed criteria * Own the hands\-on integration of Memfault into customers' Android/AOSP and embedded Linux software, and into their development and product workflows * Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers' platform and firmware engineers to bring up coredumps, metrics, OTA, and logging, and to troubleshoot and unblock them * Deliver technical pitches, demos, and workshops, and answer the hard architecture questions, partnering closely with sales and customer success through the deal lifecycle * Close the loop with the product and SDK teams on gaps, bugs, and rough edges found in the field, and build reference examples, documentation, and tests where they help customers succeed **Qualification and skills** * Up to 5 years in embedded software, with deep, production experience in **either** Android/AOSP **or** embedded Linux, plus the appetite to ramp up on the other * Strong C/C\+\+ on embedded targets (Rust and/or Kotlin a plus); jobs.title: IT Support Specialist I
jobs.description: At Northbridge University, we are looking for a **IT Support Specialist**! **Summary:** Northbridge University operates a geographically diverse, virtual Service Desk using Support Teams comprised of Support Analysts and Specialists. We’re Series C, venture\-backed by SignalFire, Rakuten Ventures, Y Combinator, HubSpot, and BAM Elevate. We offer remote work as the default option in the United States in California, Colorado, Florida, Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah and Washington. jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description: **About the Foundation** ------------------------ The OpenClaw Foundation is the steward of the world's largest open source AI agent project. Its mission is grounded in a foundational conviction: that AI must be open, safe, and ultimately owned by the individuals and communities who use it. The Foundation operates across three core mandates: * Advancing research into the human\-agent relationship while continuously evolving the OpenClaw platform; * Maintaining and hardening the codebase to ensure security, reliability, and long\-term sustainability; * Establishing interoperability standards for the emerging agent era, defining how agents configure, communicate, establish trust, transact, and represent user identity across ecosystems. Modeled after the governance structures that shaped the open web and modern computing infrastructure, the Foundation serves as a neutral, multi\-stakeholder convening body — the equivalent of W3C or the Linux Foundation for the agentic AI era. Major laboratories and infrastructure providers collaborate under its umbrella on shared, vendor\-neutral infrastructure, with no single organization controlling the roadmap or direction. The OpenClaw Foundation believes that individuals should have full sovereignty over their AI: their data, their interactions, and the behavior and personality of their agents. Open source is not incidental to this mission but central to it — code must remain free to use, modify, and build upon. The future of agentic AI will be defined by a broad, developer\-driven community, not prescribed by any single commercial interest. **The Role** ------------ The OpenClaw Foundation is seeking a Head of Design to define the design vision, systems, and experiences that shape how people interact with AI agents. This is a foundational, highly hands\-on role for a design leader with exceptional taste and a track record of building and shipping best\-in\-class products from zero to one. You'll establish a cohesive design language across the OpenClaw ecosystem, develop scalable design systems, and invent new interaction paradigms for how people collaborate with, delegate to, and maintain control over AI agents. You'll operate at the intersection of product strategy, interaction design, visual design, and engineering — moving from long\-term vision to rapid prototyping and production\-ready execution. You'll set the bar for design quality across consumer experiences, developer tools, and agent interfaces, while creating systems that enable a broader open source ecosystem to build cohesive products. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define design vision: Establish a distinctive design philosophy and product direction for OpenClaw, setting a high bar for craft, usability, and visual quality. * Build zero\-to\-one products: Lead products from concept through prototyping, implementation, and launch, translating emerging AI capabilities into intuitive, best\-in\-class experiences. * Own the design system: Build and evolve shared components, design tokens, interaction patterns, and visual standards that scale across products and platforms. * Invent agent interactions: Design new paradigms for delegation, memory, permissions, identity, trust, and human\-agent collaboration. * Stay hands\-on: Personally drive product design, visual exploration, prototyping, and implementation details, partnering directly with engineers to bring ideas to life. * Shape product strategy: Work with Foundation leadership, researchers, and engineers to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and translate ambitious ideas into shipped products. * Scale design across the ecosystem: Establish principles and reusable tools that help contributors and third\-party developers build consistent, high\-quality experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * A proven track record of building and shipping exceptional zero\-to\-one products, with clear ownership from early concept through launch. * Exceptional design taste, visual craft, and a strong point of view on the future of software and human\-computer interaction. * Deep expertise in design systems, including building scalable component libraries, interaction patterns, and visual languages from the ground up. * The ability to combine strategic vision with hands\-on execution, moving fluidly between product direction, rapid prototyping, and pixel\-level detail. * Strong interaction design and systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex technical capabilities into intuitive user experiences. * Technical fluency and a history of close collaboration with engineering teams to ship polished, production\-ready products. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments and influencing direction without relying on large teams or heavy processes. * A compelling portfolio demonstrating product impact, design excellence, and end\-to\-end ownership. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience designing AI\-native products, autonomous agents, assistants, or emerging interaction models. * Experience building developer tools, technical platforms, or infrastructure products. * Contributions to open source projects or experience designing for distributed communities. * Familiarity with agent identity, permissions, privacy, security, or interoperability. * Experience with front\-end development or code\-based prototyping. Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Platforms That Healthcare Depends On Behind every dependable healthcare application is infrastructure that has to work. Oracle Health’s Core Platform Operations (CPO) team supports the core platforms that help run Millennium, spanning Linux infrastructure, Application Tier, WebSphere, Distributed File Systems, Business Objects, and Citrix. Our mission is to keep these platforms reliable, secure, and ready for the healthcare organizations that depend on them, while making them easier to maintain and improve. Our work connects Linux engineering with the behavior of the services running above it. You might trace a performance issue through a server and its middleware dependencies, improve a health check, or turn a repeated maintenance task into reusable automation. Across the team, we use rolling maintenance and canary environments to introduce changes with care. Current initiatives also include developing maintenance orchestration to reduce manual effort and human error. You’ll collaborate with application, networking, security, and infrastructure partners, learn how the pieces fit together, and help turn difficult operational problems into better engineering. Your Role As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll manage, maintain, and enhance physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments. You’ll bring deep technical judgment to system configuration, performance tuning, security patching, capacity planning, and complex troubleshooting, while helping shape the standards and tools the team uses every day. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You’ll guide engineering decisions, mentor colleagues, and turn operational findings into lasting improvements. You’ll also participate in on\-call support and serve as an escalation resource for the services within your scope. Why This Work Is Worth Doing If you enjoy following a problem from an application symptom down to the Linux processes, network connections, or resource constraints behind it, there is plenty to explore here. You’ll have opportunities to build useful tools, influence how infrastructure is operated, and see your improvements make daily work better for other engineers. Bring your curiosity, share what you learn, and help us solve the next problem more effectively than the last. What You Will Do * Engineer and operate Linux infrastructure. Configure, update, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments, with a focus on availability, performance, stability, and security. * Guide reliable design. Evaluate infrastructure configurations and service dependencies, identify failure points, and recommend practical improvements to reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Understand and improve performance. Analyze CPU, memory, storage, filesystem, process, and network behavior. Forecast resource needs, investigate bottlenecks, and tune systems using measured results. * Strengthen monitoring. Improve metrics, logging, health checks, and actionable alerts. Use service trends and service\-level objectives to identify degradation and prioritize engineering work. * Resolve complex incidents. Apply a methodical approach to diagnosis across operating systems, applications, networking, storage, and related dependencies. Coordinate with partner teams to restore service and communicate findings clearly. * Prevent recurring failures. Perform root cause analysis and post\-incident reviews. Translate findings into corrective actions, better diagnostics, runbooks, and engineering improvements. * Maintain secure systems. Apply security patches and updates, remediate vulnerabilities, strengthen configurations and access controls, and maintain compliance with applicable security standards and policies. * Make production changes safely. Plan maintenance, assess dependencies and risk, prepare rollback procedures, and validate system and application behavior after changes. * Automate repeatable work. Develop, test, document, and maintain Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable automation for configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and recovery. Use version control and peer review to keep changes traceable and maintainable. * Support application delivery. Partner with developers, network engineers, security teams, and other IT staff on deployments, environment readiness, connectivity, and server\-related requirements. * Improve resilience and recovery. Help validate backup, restore, and recovery procedures for assigned systems, and address gaps that could delay service restoration. * Build team capability. Maintain architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and change records. Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and communicate technical risks and recommendations to stakeholders. * Contribute to dependable support coverage. Participate in on\-call rotations and planned maintenance, provide escalation support for assigned services, and improve the documentation and tooling that make support more effective. jobs.title: Healthcare Field Engineer - Florida
jobs.description: PACS Group, Inc. is a holding company investing in post\-acute healthcare facilities, professionals, and ancillary services. Founded in 2013, PACS Group is one of the largest post\-acute platforms in the United States. Its independent subsidiaries operate 325 post\-acute care facilities with 47,000 employees across 17 states serving over 31,000 patients daily. PACS business support division, PACS Services, provides technology and administrative support services — accounting, finance, human resources, compliance, payroll, AR/AP, legal, risk management, information technology, corporate communication, and other business advice and support — to their healthcare facilities, reducing administrative burdens so their leadership and care teams can focus on the care, well\-being, and quality of life of their patients and residents. PACS is one of Utah's Best Companies to work for. It has also been recognized as one of Utah's Fastest Growing Companies for multiple years. **Job Summary/General Purpose** ------------------------------- The Healthcare Field Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and enhancing technology infrastructure and healthcare information systems across skilled nursing and senior living facilities. This role partners closely with facility and clinical teams to ensure reliable technology operations, secure access to healthcare information, and effective end\-user support. The position plays a critical role in maintaining regulatory compliance, optimizing system performance, and delivering technology solutions that improve operational efficiency and patient care outcomes. While this position is home\-based, team members spend the majority of their time supporting facilities in person, with approximately 80% travel throughout their assigned state. All required business travel is company\-paid. **Key Responsibilities/Essential Duties** ----------------------------------------- * Support and improve enterprise technology infrastructure, healthcare information systems, and end\-user computing environments across multiple skilled nursing and senior living facilities. * Implement, maintain, and optimize electronic health record (EHR) systems and other clinical applications while ensuring seamless integration within the enterprise environment. * Collaborate with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and deliver technology solutions that enhance user experience and productivity. * Maintain secure, compliant technology environments by implementing security controls, conducting risk assessments, and supporting adherence to healthcare regulatory requirements, including HIPAA and SOC standards. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, networking, telecommunications, and cloud\-related issues while providing exceptional technical support to end users. * Travel to facilities to perform onsite support, infrastructure assessments, modernization initiatives, and technology deployments. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required Experience** * Minimum of five (5\) years of field\-based IT support or infrastructure experience. * Hands\-on experience with: Cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. Active Directory and file share administration. Desktop and end\-user support. Windows client operating systems, including Windows 11, Microsoft Office, and SharePoint deployment and troubleshooting. Apple iOS and macOS deployment and troubleshooting. ChromeOS deployment and troubleshooting. PSA and/or RMM tools. Printer hardware and software support. Telecommunications technologies, including POTS, VoIP, fax, eFax, and ATA devices. Network configuration, administration, and troubleshooting. ### **Essential Physical Requirements** * Ability to sit, stand, walk, speak, drive, and operate a computer for extended periods. * Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. * Ability to bend, stoop, climb stairs, and work in confined spaces when installing or troubleshooting technology equipment. * Ability to install, connect, and test networking equipment and cabling. * Ability to travel by vehicle and airplane as needed. **Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.** ### **Travel Requirements** * Up to 80% travel to facilities within the assigned state. * Occasional travel to facilities in other states. * Participation in regular on\-call support rotations is required. ### **Preferred Experience** * Healthcare IT experience. * Experience supporting technology environments within skilled nursing, post\-acute care, senior living, or healthcare organizations. ### **Required or Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently resolve moderately complex technical issues. * Understanding of healthcare technology security, compliance, and data protection requirements. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in diverse facility environments. ### **Preferred Certifications** * Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP) and/or Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA). * CompTIA A\+. * CompTIA Network\+. * CompTIA Security\+. * CompTIA Cloud\+. * Microsoft Cloud and Azure certifications. * ITIL 4 Foundation certification. * Other relevant industry certifications. **Work Location** ----------------- This position is based remotely from the employee's home address within Florida. Team members are expected to spend approximately 80% of their time working onsite at skilled nursing and senior living facilities throughout their designated territory. Frequent in\-state travel is required, including visits to facilities located several hours from the employee's home location. All approved business travel expenses are paid or reimbursed by the company. Tampa/St. Petersburg, Florida area preferred. **Pay** ------- The base salary for this position is **$80,000 \- $90,000 annually** based on experience and location. **Join PACS: Elevate Healthcare with Us!** PACS is elevating healthcare by revolutionizing our approach to leadership and quality care. Guided by our core values of **love, excellence, trust, accountability, mutual respect, and commitment**, we strive to foster a culture of compassionate care within our teams and the communities we serve. As we grow rapidly, exciting opportunities await you to engage in impactful projects and contribute valuable insights to stakeholders nationwide. If you're ready to make a difference and embrace our mission of creating real change, we invite you to join us at PACS. Together, let’s shape the future of healthcare! **Join Our Team and Thrive!** At PACS, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. That’s why we offer an exceptional benefits package designed to enhance your well\-being and support your lifestyle. **Our Comprehensive Benefits Include** * Health Coverage: Enjoy medical, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy. * PTO and Vacation: Benefit from generous paid time off and holidays to relax and recharge. * Financial Wellness: Take advantage of Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to manage your healthcare expenses effectively. * Retirement Planning: Secure your future with our 401(k) plan, complete with company contributions to help you build your retirement savings. * Support When You Need It: Our Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) provides confidential support for personal and professional challenges. Join us at **PACS** and take advantage of a workplace that truly values you! We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, and any other protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
