jobs.title: Expert Grid Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: Requisition ID \# 175242 **Job Category:** Engineering / Science **Job Level:** Individual Contributor **Business Unit:** Strategy \& Growth **Work Type:** Hybrid **Job Location:** Oakland Department Overview At PG\&E we’re reimagining the future of energy—and we need passionate, purpose\-driven professionals to help us get there. As part of Grid Research Innovation \& Development (GRID) team, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming California’s electric system to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving energy landscape. In 2022, PG\&E launched its True North Strategy (TNS) , a bold 10\-year vision to advance our breakthrough commitments to people, climate, and prosperity. Innovation on our high voltage electric transmission system is a critical component of reaching our TNS vision, with the sharp rise of interconnection requests from large\-load customers, especially data centers , creating significant opportunities to reduce rates through beneficial load growth. The GRID department is focused on bringing technologies and solutions that support the implementation of TNS from conception to reality. The Innovation Framework \& Execution (IF\&E) team plays a critical role within GRID by enhancing PG\&E’s capacity to assess, test, and deploy novel solutions and technologies. The team is comprised of experienced innovation practitioners that are directly embedded into some of our highest priority R\&D initiatives, including transmission innovation, to drive successful outcomes and accelerate new technologies’ paths to scaling. Position Summary We’re seeking a curious, tenacious professional to support cross\-departmental innovation efforts on PG\&E’s electric transmission grid. This role is ideal for someone who has built a strong foundation in electric power systems and has developed a product\-oriented mind\- and skill set. In this position you’ll have a unique opportunity to influence how California's transmission grid evolves to support electrification, data center growth, and emerging energy technologies. Successful solutions developed in this role may influence future transmission planning and operational practices within PG\&E and across the utility industry. The successful candidate will begin their assignment with a six\-month rotation in Transmission Planning to deepen their understanding of PG\&E's planning processes, tools, and interconnection challenges before transitioning into the Grid Innovation role to apply those insights to transmission innovation initiatives. This is a highly collaborative role that requires empathy, technical fluency, and a systems\-thinking approach. You’ll be a connector breaking complex challenges into actionable solutions, bridging transmission planning with real\-time operations, and technical ingenuity with customer needs. This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location is in Oakland, CA. The team has an expectation of working from Oakland office up to several days per month. Also, the role will require up to 20% travel throughout PG\&E’s service territory. PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs. **Bay Area Minimum:** $140,000\.00 **Bay Area Midpoint:** $189,000\.00 **Bay Area Maximum:** $238,000\.00 Reporting Relationship This position will have a matrixed reporting structure. You will primarily report to the Manager of Innovation Framework \& Execution, with additional reporting responsibilities to leaders within Transmission Planning and Large Load Development teams. You will collaborate closely with Transmission Operations and Local Customer Engagement teams. Job Responsibilities Lead innovation for transmission grid transformation Drive the assessment and development of new technologies and processes to expand grid capacity and flexibility Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, and vendors to evaluate and iterate on innovative new solutions Benchmark industry best\-practices for large\-load interconnections, especially data centers Keep the customer experience at the center of every solution Develop business plans that articulate the expected benefits and costs of innovative solutions, with a close eye on rate and systems impacts Translate technical findings into compelling executive summaries that inform enterprise decision\-making Pilot, learn, and scale novel transmission solutions Stand up cross\-functional teams and project governance to pilot novel technology pilots with real impacts on large\-load customers Translate complex discussions with inherent uncertainty into tactical checklists of clear next steps, following PG\&E’s Lean Operating System Facilitate cross\-functional evaluations of pilot outcomes and develop recommendations for scaling successful solutions Evaluate solution feasibility, operational readiness, and scalability, and develop implementation roadmaps from concept through deployment Support broader transmission innovation initiatives Flexibly jump in to support emerging relevant priorities across GRID Act as transmission innovation subject matter expert during PG\&E\-hosted events such as Pitch Fest Qualifications **Minimum:** Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or equivalent experience Experience with grid modeling software (e.g. CYMDIST, PSLF, TARA, Aspen, or similar tools) 7 years of electric utility related experience **Desired:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering 8\+ years of electric utility, transmission planning, transmission operations, or related power systems experience Previous experience in power flow, short circuit, and transient studies Previous experience with writing code using Python and EPCL Familiarity with NERC TPL\-001\-05, MOD\-26, and MOD\-32 standards Experience with grid digital twins, AI/ML applications, and advanced analytics Experience evaluating DERMS, EMS, ADMS, or grid flexibility management platforms Experience supporting large\-load, hyperscale, or data center interconnections Experience evaluating emerging technologies, startups, or conducting technical due diligence Technology innovation, R\&D, or pilot deployment experience Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering or related field preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Ability to lead and influence cross\-functional technical teams and project stakeholders Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, actionable insights for audiences at all levels. Ability to adapt to change and quickly pivot, with a strong bias for action and results Ability to be creative, versatile, efficient, and productive in the face of ambiguity and change Ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives that impact multiple business functions Ability to rigorously define and enforce prioritization of feature development, defeating scope creep and delivering the most impactful iterative results

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30\+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time. Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote\-from\-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose\-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world. **Location** This position will be remote based in the United States. **Reporting** This position will report to the Senior Manager, Data Engineering. **Summary of Role** You will own the technical design of the data platform that powers Palmetto's products, partners, and AI agents. Our data spans the whole customer journey: sales, lending, installation, interconnection, and years of system production. You will turn it into one governed, trustworthy view of the business, with each metric defined once so every dashboard, notebook, and agent returns the same answer. You will also build the secure, authorized, auditable path that lets people and systems use that data directly. This is a high\-leverage individual\-contributor role. You'll set technical direction, write foundational code, and work closely with core platform and product teams. AI agents are first\-class consumers of our platform, and we build with them every day. **Strategic \& Tactical** * **Model the business.** Build and own data products that deliver trustworthy data, from bronze to gold, for analysts, engineers, product teams, partners, and AI tools. * **Make data agent\-ready.** Shape the semantic context, documentation, and interfaces that let agents answer from governed definitions, with answers that trace back to source. * **Build governance in.** Treat classification, masking, access policy, and change control as code, and prepare the platform for SOC 2 and related compliance audits. * **Build and run pipelines.** Operate ingestion and orchestration as code, with CI/CD, observability, alerting, and SLAs. * **Communicate.** Partner with finance, operations, product and engineering to understand how their data requirements are evolving. * **Build the access path.** Design and operate the secure, authorized, low\-latency interface through which products, partners, and agents consume data. * **Raise the bar.** Review code, mentor teammates, and give engineering teams templates and CI checks to ship trusted data. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years in data engineering, including time at a Staff or lead level owning a platform used by multiple teams. * Deep experience in SQL and Python. * Strong database fundamentals in a modern analytical warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery): schema design, query plans, distributed computing. * Deep experience with dbt or an adjacent transformation framework (e.g., SQLMesh, Dataform). * Experience with ETL orchestration (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow). * Infrastructure as code and container orchestration on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Demonstrated agentic engineering beyond prompting: you run coding agents in loops checked by specs and tests, and stay curious about new tools. * Design docs that settled cross\-team architecture questions, and clear written and verbal communication with non\-technical partners. * Working knowledge of API design, authentication and authorization (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, RBAC), and PII handling. * Knowledge of reporting tools such as Looker and Hex is a plus *Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.* **Equal Employment Opportunity** Palmetto embraces diversity and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for four years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full privacy policy. For more about our Privacy Policy, visit: https://palmetto.com/privacy\-policy

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.description: Paystand is the world's leading blockchain\-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software\-driven, zero\-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on\-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises. Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20\+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full\-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non\-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology. **What We Do** We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time\-to\-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost. **Why We Do It** The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain. **How We Do It** We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on\-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later. **Join Us** We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. **We stand on change. Come stand with us.** **Role at a Glance** -------------------- We're looking for a high\-performing Account Executive who thrives in complex B2B sales environments and knows how to win in fintech. In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle — from building and qualifying pipeline through outbound prospecting to closing strategic deals ranging from $15K to $500K\+ in ARR. You'll work with finance leaders and operators to modernize their payments infrastructure and drive measurable business impact. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in B2B SaaS sales, experience selling payments or financial technology solutions, and a disciplined, data\-driven approach to managing pipeline and forecasting. But here's what separates a great AE at Paystand from a great AE anywhere else: we're an AI\-first company. We're not looking for someone who manages their pipeline — we're looking for someone who engineers their pipeline. The best candidates will bring a builder's instinct to every part of the sales process, using AI to find leverage where others see manual work. **Roles \& Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Build and own a high\-quality pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, targeted account research, and relationship\-driven outreach — leveraging AI tools to identify signals, prioritize accounts, and scale activity intelligently. * Lead consultative discovery conversations with finance and operations leaders to uncover business pain points and position payments as a growth lever. * Deliver tailored presentations, demos, and proposals that clearly articulate ROI and operational impact — using AI to personalize and sharpen messaging at scale. * Partner cross\-functionally with SDRs, Product, and Customer Success to drive deals from first touch through implementation, ensuring alignment and velocity throughout the sales cycle. * Navigate complex negotiations with confidence, structuring agreements that create long\-term value for both the customer and the company. * Maintain disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting in CRM — using data and AI\-assisted insights to drive prioritization, identify risk, and improve close rates. * Stay ahead of fintech and payments trends to confidently differentiate our solution in a competitive market. * Consistently meet and exceed revenue targets while contributing to a culture of accountability, innovation, and high performance. **Requirements \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------- * 5\-7 years of experience in B2B sales, ideally within SaaS, fintech, or payments — with a consistent track record of hitting or exceeding quota. * Experience selling into or alongside ERP ecosystems or similar cloud\-based platforms is required. * Strong understanding of payments technology, merchant services, or financial infrastructure. * A consultative, strategic sales approach — you know how to guide conversations beyond features and toward measurable business outcomes. * Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex solutions into compelling value for finance and operations leaders. * Highly self\-driven and competitive, with the ability to t  field preferred, but not required. **AI \& Leverage — What Sets You Apart** ---------------------------------------- We're an AI\-first company, and we expect our AEs to bring that mindset to how they sell. We're not evaluating whether you can do this job — we're evaluating whether you can help reinvent how this job gets done. Standout candidates will be able to speak to: * How they use AI to research target accounts, surface buying signals, and prioritize outreach — at scale, not one by one. * Workflows or systems they've built (or would build) to automate repetitive parts of the sales process, freeing time for high\-value conversations. * How they use AI to personalize proposals, demos, or follow\-up communications without sacrificing quality. * Their approach to using data and AI\-assisted insights to improve forecasting accuracy and pipeline health. * Specific tools they've experimented with — whether Clay, ChatGPT, Gong, or others — and what they learned. *Five years ago, a great AE outworked the competition. Today, a great AE builds systems that outwork the competition. We're looking for the latter.* **Bonus Areas of Expertise** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered sales tools such as Clay, Apollo, Gong, Chorus, or custom LLM workflows. * Experience building or contributing to sales playbooks, sequences, or automation that scaled team output. * Familiarity with accounts receivable automation, B2B payment rails, or cash flow management solutions. * Prior experience in a high\-growth startup where processes were built, not inherited. **Why Paystand** ---------------- Paystand is modernizing B2B payments for the enterprise — and we're doing it with a team that thinks differently. Here, you won't just close deals; you'll shape how an entire market moves money. If you're competitive, consultative, energized by meaningful wins, and ready to bring an AI\-first approach to how you sell — we'd love to talk. **Benefits \& Perks** * Compensation ranging from $180,000 to $200,000 OTE, depending on experience. * Enjoy generous PTO and sick leave, because we believe in balance. * 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching. * We've got your health covered with comprehensive health dental and vision insurance plans. * Fuel your days with free snacks and paid lunches in the office. * Unlock stock options and own a piece of our success! * Work with the best tools and equipment, setting you up to thrive. * And the best part? Endless growth opportunities await you as we rapidly expand! If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand. We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team. More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply. We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem\-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity. Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you. Most of our roles are onsite. Positions that are eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements will be clearly indicated in the job posting. For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.\#LI\-Onsite

Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Proven track record of independently leading projects from concept to execution, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, as needed. (Required) * Master of Arts or Science Computer science or a related field with a focus on machine learning or data science (Preferred) * 1\+ years healthcare analytics (Preferred) We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives. Live Your Life's Work We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description: You may know Penske for our big yellow trucks. But did you know we’re an industry\-leading technology innovation company? At Penske we have a 50\-year history of leading the transportation and supply\-chain industry, delivering world\-class and award\-winning technology solutions. And, it starts with our associates. No matter what your skills or technology stack, our IT team is for you. You’ll work and grow alongside great people and on really cool projects. We inspire our IT experts to push the boundaries, create possibilities, be innovative, and, most of all, to have fun. Ultimately, you’ll help develop and ensure our technology solutions keep our company and our customers moving forward. Do you have what IT takes? **Summary** The Salesforce Developer is responsible for designing, developing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting Salesforce platform solutions that meet business and technical requirements. This role partners with business stakeholders, Salesforce administrators, internal IT teams, offshore development teams, Salesforce Support, and third\-party AppExchange partners to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce capabilities. **What You Will Be Doing** As a Salesforce Developer, you will be part of a team that develops our next\-generation applications while enhancing and supporting our existing Salesforce ecosystem. You will take a leading technical role — working closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and architects to translate complex requirements into scalable technical designs, implement solutions, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. You will also guide junior developers, influence platform standards, and drive optimization efforts across the Salesforce environment. **Responsibilities** * Act as the primary point of contact and lead support resource for multiple Salesforce modules/processes, resolving business user issues in a timely manner. * Translate complex business requirements into technical designs; develop and implement related components and modules on the Salesforce platform. * Lead requirements and solution design workshops with business stakeholders, providing analysis and solution design expertise aligned with current and future business needs. * Design, build, and deploy high\-performance technical solutions on the Salesforce Lightning Platform, adhering to Salesforce best practices and standards. * Develop custom applications using both declarative tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow) and programmatic development (Apex, Visual Force Pages, Triggers, Lightning/LWC Components). * Architect and support integrations between Salesforce and third\-party platforms and backend web services (REST/SOAP). * Organize, manage, and guide offshore Salesforce development teams in alignment with established standards, processes, and procedures. * Serve as a technical escalation point for a business team, advising on technical feasibility and implementation strategies. * Communicate project status and issues clearly to team members and stakeholders; collaborate with cross\-functional and project teams. * Ensure solutions are sustainable and maintainable across implementation and ongoing use. * Troubleshoot and resolve bugs and open issues to ensure on\-time delivery and smooth hand\-offs. * Participate in and help guide agile development processes, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent years of software development experience. * 5\+ years of overall technology experience, including 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with the Salesforce.com Platform (Apex, Visual Force, SOQL, Unit Testing). * Strong working knowledge of Workflows, Reports, Process Builder, Flow, and Triggers. * Strong working knowledge of web services (REST \& SOAP, JSON \& XML, etc.). * Proven experience with Lightning Components and Lightning Web Component (LWC) development. * 1–2 years of project management experience preferred * Experience directly interacting with business SMEs for requirements gathering, solution design, development, and deployment. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior and offshore developers. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodology. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment. * Salesforce certification (e.g., Platform Developer I or II) required * Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job. * Willingness to travel as necessary, work the required schedule, work at the specific location required, complete Penske employment application, submit to a background investigation (to include past employment, education, and criminal history) and drug screening are required. **EEO Statement** Penske is an Equal Opportunity Employer. **Physical Requirements:** * The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * The associate must regularly lift and /or move up to 25lbs/12kg. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision, Distance vision, Peripheral vision, Depth perception and Ability to adjust focus. * While performing the duties of this Job, the associate is regularly required to stand; walk; sit and talk or hear. The associate is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. **About Penske Truck Leasing/Transportation Solutions** Penske Truck Leasing/Transportation Solutions is a premier global transportation provider that delivers essential and innovative transportation, logistics and technology services to help companies and people move forward. With headquarters in Reading, PA, Penske and its associates are driven by a dedication to excellence and a commitment to customer success. Visit Go Penske to learn more. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Perplexity serves hundreds of millions of queries a month. Every answer, every Perplexity Computer task, and every enterprise deployment runs on production infrastructure owned by the Cloud Infrastructure team: a fleet of Kubernetes clusters across a multi\-account AWS estate, private networks that reach hyperscalers and the neoclouds serving our models, and the storage underneath our user data and agentic workloads. We're looking for SREs who treat reliability as a software problem. You'll own compute, networking, and storage at scale and keep production stable while everything built on top of it is changing fast. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own production at scale.** Run the compute, networking, and storage foundation behind Perplexity's consumer, Computer, API, and enterprise products, and own its availability, latency, and cost. * **Run our Kubernetes fleet.** Operate and upgrade the EKS clusters that host web services, search, datastores, and secure sandboxes. Tune scheduling, autoscaling, node lifecycle, DNS, and service networking so clusters stay healthy under bursty, fast\-growing load. * **Engineer the network.** Design and operate VPC architectures, Transit Gateway and PrivateLink connectivity, load balancing, DNS, and egress across accounts, regions, and cloud providers. * **Keep data durable and fast.** Own the storage layer (EBS, S3, DynamoDB, and the managed databases and caches our services depend on), including performance, durability, backups, and restores that have actually been tested. * **Manage everything as code.** Run infrastructure through Terraform and CI/CD. Build reusable modules and guardrails, and make every change reviewable, repeatable, and safe to roll back. * **Prepare for failures.** Define SLOs, build alerts that someone can act on, design for zone and regional failure, and run game days and disaster\-recovery exercises that prove recovery works. * **Lead incident response.** Be on the critical path when things break. Drive incidents to resolution, write blameless postmortems, and land the fixes so the same failure never pages anyone twice. * **Scale ahead of demand.** Own capacity planning, quotas, reservations, and cost efficiency so product launches and traffic spikes never wait on infrastructure. * **Automate away the toil.** Build tooling, increasingly agent\-driven, that turns provisioning, upgrades, and remediation into self\-serve, hands\-off workflows for every engineering team. **Qualifications** ------------------ We expect you to have real depth in most of these: * Deep AWS expertise. You know VPC, IAM, EC2, EKS, ELB, Route 53, S3, EBS, etc. well past the console, including their limits, failure modes, and the bill that comes with them. * Production Kubernetes at scale: cluster upgrades, CNI, CoreDNS, autoscalers like Karpenter, and debugging a misbehaving node at 3 a.m. Writing Helm charts alone doesn't count. * Terraform mastery. You've designed module structures, managed state across many accounts, and run large refactors and imports without taking production down. * Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, routing). * You write real code in Python, Go, or Rust for automation, tooling, and controllers, and you'd rather automate a runbook than follow it. * Fluency with observability tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana, and the judgment to turn metrics, logs, and traces into SLOs and alerts that matter. * A track record of leading production incidents and turning root\-cause analysis into durable fixes. * You own problems end\-to\-end and do well when the path forward isn't laid out for you. **Additional experience we value** ---------------------------------- * Multi\-region active\-active or failover architectures, and disaster\-recovery programs with real recovery targets. * Proxies, service meshes, and kernel\-level networking: Envoy, Istio, Cilium, or eBPF. * GitOps and progressive delivery: Argo CD, Flux, or similar. * Enterprise and compliance environments: single\-tenant or BYOC deployments, KMS/BYOK, SOC 2 or similar controls. * Running stateful systems in production: Postgres, Redis, or search engines like Vespa or Elasticsearch. * Multi\-cloud or neocloud operations (GCP, CoreWeave, or similar). * FinOps: cost attribution, Savings Plans and reservations, and making infrastructure cheaper without making it fragile.

jobs.title: Project Manager and Support Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: At PetVet Care Centers, our mission is to improve the lives of animals and people — providing exceptional and compassionate care at every stage — for all the moments that matter. **Because life is better with pets.** We deliver the **Ultimate Care Experience — every pet, every client, every time.** That starts with a Culture of Care that supports our team members as much as the pets and clients we serve. With more than **400 locally led hospitals** and over **11,000 team members nationwide**, we offer: * Local autonomy with national support * Career mobility and development opportunities * A collaborative, inclusive environment where your wellbeing comes first **You care for pets. We care for you.** **Position Overview** **The Project Manager \& Support Engineer** is a hands\-on technology professional responsible for managing and delivering assigned IT projects, providing advanced technical support, and improving operational processes across PetVet Care Centers. The role independently leads technology initiatives while partnering with the ITS Project Deployment team, internal stakeholders, vendors, and third\-party service providers. The position also provides experienced support for internal ITS requests, assists with technology purchasing, and serves as an escalation resource for complex technical issues. As PetVet develops its internal service desk capabilities, this role will help establish repeatable workflows and documentation, transition routine support activities to the service desk, and remain focused on project delivery, advanced support, escalations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities** Project Delivery \& Technology Initiatives: * Manage and independently execute assigned ITS projects from planning through implementation and post\-deployment follow\-up. * Develop and maintain project plans, action items, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communications. * Coordinate technical resources, business stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and third\-party service providers. * Partner with ITS Project Deployment Specialists on larger initiatives while independently owning smaller or specialized projects. * Support technology migrations, application transitions, system implementations, infrastructure refreshes, acquisitions, and other enterprise technology initiatives. * Provide hands\-on technical assistance during deployments, migrations, and cutovers when required. * Validate completed implementations and ensure outstanding issues are documented, assigned, and Technical Support \& Escalation: * Provide advanced technical support for complex hardware, software, Microsoft 365, network, access, application, and end\-user technology issues. * Take ownership of escalated technical issues and coordinate resolution across internal ITS teams, the managed service provider, and other vendors. * Investigate recurring issues, contribute to root\-cause analysis, and recommend long\-term corrective actions. * Support executives, corporate users, and hospital teams as needed and serve as a technical resource to other ITS team members. * Participate in troubleshooting and technical validation during project deployments and production issues. Purchasing \& Operational Support: * Own or assist with assigned IT purchasing requests, including validation of technical requirements and selection of appropriate equipment or solutions. * Coordinate with internal stakeholders, vendors, and purchasing resources throughout the procurement process. * Track outstanding requests, communicate status, and escalate exceptions or delays as appropriate. * Help establish standardized purchasing, intake, approval, and fulfillment processes that can transition to the internal service desk. Service Desk \& Process Development: * Document ITS support, purchasing, escalation, and fulfillment processes and contribute to knowledge articles, standards, and playbooks. * Participate in implementation and continued development of PetVet's IT service management platform and service workflows. * Help identify services and responsibilities that should transition to the future internal service desk. * Provide advanced escalation support, technical guidance, and knowledge transfer as the service desk matures. * Identify opportunities to improve service quality, consistency, efficiency, and the end\-user experience. **Qualifications (Required)** * Significant professional experience supporting enterprise IT environments, preferably across multiple sites or locations. * Demonstrated experience independently delivering technology projects, migrations, deployments, or implementations. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across end\-user computing, software, networking, identity/access, and related technologies. * Experience providing advanced or escalated technical support. * Strong understanding of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID. * Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, wireless networking, and VPN technologies. * Experience working with third\-party vendors, managed service providers, telecom providers, or technical contractors. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate technical information to non\-technical users. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, requests, and priorities simultaneously. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams. **Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)** * 7\+ years of progressive IT support, infrastructure, field services, deployment, or project experience. * Experience supporting distributed or multi\-site organizations. * Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, or related Microsoft technologies. * Experience with VoIP/telecommunications projects, ITSM platforms, technology procurement, or vendor management. * Experience developing technical documentation, implementation playbooks, or knowledge\-base content. * IT certifications such as CompTIA, Microsoft, networking, or related certifications are a plus. * Formal project\-management experience or certification is a plus but not required. **What We Offer** We care deeply about supporting our team members — professionally and personally. Benefits include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Paid Parental Leave (birth, adoption, foster) * 401(k) with discretionary contribution * Team Member Pet Discounts * Emotional wellbeing support — including Calm app access and 24/7 EAP * CE stipends and career development resources * Grant Circle — a relief fund for team members facing personal hardship * Local hospital culture backed by national resources At PetVet Care Centers, we're committed to a **Culture of Care** — for pets, for the people who love them, and for the team members who make it all possible. With **more than 400 hospitals across the U.S.** and a team of over **11,000 dedicated professionals**, including **1700\+ veterinarians**, we offer a unique blend of local leadership and national support that helps our hospitals thrive. Our model is built on **partnership, collaboration, and local medical autonomy**, empowering each hospital to deliver high\-quality care while benefiting from shared resources and a strong professional community. Whether you're providing care in a hospital or supporting operations behind the scenes, PetVet is a place where you can grow your career, stay connected to your purpose, and make a meaningful impact. **You care for pets. We care for you.** PetVet is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, religion, citizenship, national origin/ancestry, physical/mental disabilities, military status or any other basis prohibited by law. EOE, M/F/D/V PetVet respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. Please see our privacy notice for additional information about our data practices.

your drive. * **Exciting Challenges:** Every day brings new opportunities to excel. * **Flexible Work:** Fully remote opportunity (from approved locations within the U.S.) with a company that cares. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and, where appropriate, CloudFormation across multi\-account AWS environments. * Build reusable Terraform modules and automation that teams can apply consistently across environments. * Apply AWS architecture, networking, IAM, security, resilience, and provisioning best practices. * Build, improve, and automate CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, CodeBuild, ArgoCD, or similar tools. * Shift security, testing, policy validation, and compliance checks earlier in the delivery lifecycle. * Develop jobs.title: Research Scientist II – Deepfake Detection & Authentication (Video & Audio)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### **What you'll do** As a Research Scientist II on our core Research team, you will independently drive research initiatives, deliver reproducible experimental results, and help translate machine learning models into real\-world product solutions across deepfake video, deepfake audio, and voice/identity authentication. In this role, you will: * Conduct research to develop new functionalities and improve existing technologies for synthetic media detection, multimodal deepfake identification (audio and video), and real\-time identity authentication. * Design, implement, and evaluate deep learning algorithms related to audio\-visual deepfake detection, speech synthesis detection, facial manipulation analysis, and biometric authentication. * Design, develop, and maintain internal research packages and pipelines to train, evaluate, and benchmark ML models, ensuring computational efficiency and absolute reproducibility. * Partner closely with research engineers and engineering teams to transition complex research prototypes into efficient, scalable, production\-ready systems across cloud and edge platforms. * Support targeted investigations by analyzing model behavior, edge cases, attack vectors, and detection gaps, turning insights into measurable improvements in model robustness. * Participate in regular code and research reviews, cross\-functional project syncs, and contribute to patents and peer\-reviewed papers for top\-tier computer vision, speech, audio, and machine learning conferences. ### **Who you are** * You remain focused, persistent, and scientifically rigorous through multiple experimental iterations, navigating ambiguity in complex multimodal datasets, evolving attack techniques, and shifting methodologies. * You seamlessly bridge the gap between research and engineering teams, explaining complex AI/ML and biometric concepts with clarity to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * You take individual ownership of assigned research projects and workstreams, making sound technical decisions grounded in empirical data, mathematical theory, and rigorous experimental validation. * You follow through on your commitments, communicate research progress transparently, and maintain the highest standard of technical integrity, documentation, and model reproducibility. * You design, train, and evaluate machine learning models with a strong awareness of bias, drift, and operational deployment constraints, applying sound judgment to balance experimentation speed with model quality and robustness. ### **Your skill\-set** *Must\-Haves:* * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent industry research experience). * 3\+ years of professional or post\-graduate research experience in Deep Learning, with a dedicated focus on at least one core area: computer vision (facial analysis, video processing), speech/audio processing (speaker recognition, speech synthesis detection), or voice biometrics and identity authentication. * Hands\-on research experience in audio\-visual deepfake detection, synthetic media identification, or multimodal biometric verification. * Strong programming proficiency in Python with a proven ability to build, maintain, and structure reproducible research tooling, experimentation frameworks, or evaluation workflows. * Hands\-on mastery of modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras. * A proven track record of successful, timely project delivery and the ability to translate research findings into practical improvements, supported by peer\-reviewed publications or patent contributions. *Nice\-to\-Haves:* * Fun ents. * Bridge research and production: Partner closely with Research Scientists, Research Engineers, and Product leaders to see your algorithms transition from experimental code into live enterprise deployments. * Strengthen your scientific and engineering rigor: Sharpen your ability to formulate hypotheses, design reproducible evaluation pipelines, and push the state of the art in synthetic media defense. * Drive measurable impact: Your work directly strengthens Pindrop's defense stack against deepfake threats, fortifying trust across voice and video communications for major global enterprises. * Grow as an independent researcher: Take full ownership of meaningful research roadmaps while collaborating with a world\-class team that balances technical excellence with sustainable culture and continuous learning. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * Remote\-first environment \- giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.
