jobs.title: Sr. Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Network Engineer** As a Senior Network Engineer, you will design, build, secure, and support the enterprise network services that connect corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, distribution locations, data centers, cloud platforms, and third\-party environments. You will bring hands\-on expertise across LAN, WAN, wireless, firewalls, secure remote access, internet connectivity, cloud networking, and network monitoring. Working across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, and business teams, you will help deliver reliable, resilient, and secure connectivity. Your work will reduce recurring issues, strengthen network visibility, and support modernization, cloud adoption, site integrations, and technology refresh initiatives. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, internet, VPN, and cloud connectivity. * Support routers, switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, SD\-WAN, secure web access, private application access, and Zero Trust Network Access technologies. * Maintain network availability, performance, capacity, and resiliency across corporate, manufacturing, warehouse, data center, cloud, and third\-party environments. * Resolve complex routing, switching, latency, DNS, DHCP, wireless, firewall, and application communication issues; provide escalation support during incidents and outages. * Implement network security controls with cybersecurity partners, including segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote connectivity, vulnerability remediation, and audit support. * Develop scalable network designs, reference architectures, configuration standards, and technical recommendations based on security, supportability, performance, and cost. * Partner with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and manufacturing/OT teams on hybrid connectivity, site integrations, acquisitions, expansions, and technology refreshes. * Use monitoring, analytics, telemetry, configuration management, and automation to improve reliability, consistency, reporting, deployment speed, and lifecycle management. * Maintain network diagrams, inventories, configurations, IP addressing, circuits, operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation. * Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, hardware vendors, and project teams from planning and testing through transition to operations. **Why You’ll Love This Role** * Own high\-impact network solutions that connect a diverse enterprise spanning offices, plants, distribution sites, data centers, and cloud environments. * Help shape secure, modern connectivity through cloud networking, SD\-WAN, Zero Trust, segmentation, automation, and observability. * Work across technical and business teams where your expertise can improve reliability, simplify operations, and influence enterprise standards. * Balance hands\-on engineering and troubleshooting with architecture, modernization, and continuous improvement work. **Location Requirements:** * Hybrid (2\-3 days/week) at our Corporate Headquarters in Lakeville, MN. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of enterprise network engineering or network administration experience. * Strong knowledge of network segmentation, routing and switching, wireless networking, and network security concepts. * Experience supporting enterprise switches, routers, wireless networks, and firewalls. * Experience troubleshooting complex network, security, and application connectivity issues. * Understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, network resiliency, and capacity planning. * Strong technical documentation and communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Cisco networking technologies, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Zscaler, SD\-WAN, Zero Trust networking, and Microsoft Azure networking. * Experience with network monitoring and performance\-management platforms, firewall policy management, or IT/OT segmentation in manufacturing environments. * Experience automating network tasks with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure\-as\-code, or configuration\-management tools. * Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent. **Success in This Role** * Approaches complex problems with strong analysis, structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, and a security\-first mindset. * Takes ownership, manages competing priorities, and follows through on incidents, projects, documentation, and continuous\-improvement opportunities. * Builds effective partnerships across infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, manufacturing/OT, vendors, and business teams. * Communicates technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and adapts as networking technologies evolve. **Ready to Make an Impact?** Bring your network engineering expertise to complex, business\-critical environments where secure, reliable connectivity matters every day. Apply to help strengthen the platforms, standards, and partnerships that keep Post Consumer Brands connected and moving forward.

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview of the Role** As one of the first engineers on PowerPlan’s Applied AI team, you’ll build the data foundation behind the AI solutions our own teams use every week, across finance, sales, professional services, and product. Most of the work is finding, cleaning, and defining the data each build needs, then picking the simplest structure that will hold it, and pairing with the team’s AI engineer to put larger solutions into the business’s hands. PowerPlan builds the financial software behind the companies that keep the lights on, and nine in ten U.S. investor\-owned utilities use our platform. The Applied AI team sits inside Strategic Initiatives, works closely with the executive leadership team, and brings that same standard of getting the numbers right to how the company itself runs. The standards you help set early will shape how every build after yours gets done. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** Success will be measured by whether the AI solutions you build data for are in weekly use and run by the business, and by whether new builds start from trusted, shared data instead of fresh exports. * Learn how the company runs through its data in your first 30 days, deliver an owner\-checked first catalog of critical data by the end of your first quarter, and keep it current enough by month 12 that business and technology leaders plan AI work from it. * Help set the team’s standards for data, connections, and code review from your first 30 days, including how AI tools connect to business systems: read\-only by default, no more complex than the job requires, and reviewed by IT and security. * Pair with the team’s AI engineer on a first build in your first quarter, lead the data on the first larger build into pilot by six months, and by month 12 deliver the data behind at least two larger AI solutions in weekly use and run by the business. * Agree on the first shared data sets in your first quarter, publish the first one by six months, and have at least two shared, governed data sets in use by more than one team or AI solution by month 12\. * Within your first 12 months, retire hand\-built recurring reports by defining the numbers once, so an AI tool can draft the commentary, answer questions, and flag what needs a person’s attention. **You’re Our Person If…** * You have two to four years of professional experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or in a similar role where writing code to clean and model data was central to the job, or a master’s degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience. * You’ve turned messy, real data from a business system, a spreadsheet, or a set of documents into something people or an AI tool used, and you can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it. * Before you build on a number, you trace it through the systems and processes that produce it and find out from the people who own it what it means, and you can tell us about a time a business owner’s explanation changed what you built. * Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode are your default way of working, and you know how to plan the work, direct the tool, and check what it produces. The team builds with Claude Code, and we provide the tools. * You write working Python and SQL and can read and change code someone else wrote. * You’ve pulled data from an API end to end, including authentication, secrets, paging, and errors. * You work in Git by habit, treat data access and documentation as part of the build, and write notes a business owner can follow. * You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, information systems, or a closely related quantitative field; a business analytics or other quantitative business degree also qualifies if it included substantial programming coursework. * You can work from Atlanta in the office at least three days a week and are authorized to work in the United States (this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future). **Even Better If…** * You’ve built an MCP server, an agent skill, or a connector someone else used. * You have experience with a modern data platform, retrieval over documents (RAG), or data quality checks. * You’ve worked with CRM, finance, or project data, ideally in or alongside finance, professional services, sales operations, or support. * You’ve applied continuous improvement methods, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or value stream mapping. * You hold a master’s degree in a related field, such as computer science, information systems, data science, or business analytics. Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Will you need Visa Sponsorship now or in the future? Location: * Atlanta, GA 30339 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30339

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better\-aligned superintelligences. Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives. We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us. Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. **About the Role** ================== An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments. As an **MTS on our ML Platform team**, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open\-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is an engineering role where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly. You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post\-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it. * Build and maintain Karotte, our open\-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working. * Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM\-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader. * Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure. * Partner with environment builders and post\-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback. **What We are Looking For** =========================== * Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of building and operating production infrastructure or developer platforms that other engineers depend on. * Proficiency in Python, including writing libraries and APIs that other people build on. * Hands\-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or similar). * A working understanding of how to run untrusted code safely: isolation, resource limits, and what happens when a process fills the disk or refuses to exit. * Extensive hands\-on use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and an intuition for where models cut corners. * You've owned something tedious end to end, such as a migration, a release process, or a delivery pipeline, and automated away as much of it as you could. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building RL environments, eval harnesses, or agent benchmarks (Terminal\-Bench, SWE\-bench, or similar). * Familiarity with RL post\-training and inference stacks (verl, Ray, SkyPilot, vLLM, SGLang, or similar). **You may be a good fit if one of the following applies** --------------------------------------------------------- * You've built sandbox or code\-execution infrastructure (microVMs such as Firecracker, gVisor, or similar) at an infrastructure startup or frontier lab. * You've been an early platform or infrastructure engineer at a startup and built the internal platform the rest of engineering relied on. * You've worked as a forward deployed or integrations engineer, getting your company's software running inside customers' own environments. * You've built developer tooling or internal platforms used by ML researchers, even outside a formal ML role. * You've maintained an open\-source developer framework with real external users. **What We Offer:** ================== * Competitive cash and equity compensation (\>90th percentile) * Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment * Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers * Health, vision, dental, benefits * 401K match * Lunch provided everyday onsite * Weekly snack orders * Visa sponsorship \& relocation support available **We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.** Compensation Range: $180K \- $350K

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job title:** Senior Product Security Engineer **Reports to:** Manager, Application Security **Department:** Central Services **Location:** Remote **Grade:** 19 **About Priority:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** The Product Security Engineer plays a key role in embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle by partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Compliance teams. This role is responsible for identifying and mitigating security risks, influencing secure architecture decisions, and helping engineers build secure products by design. The position requires deep technical expertise in application and product security, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex security concepts into practical guidance. You will contribute to securing Priority’s commerce platform while helping scale security practices, tooling, and frameworks across the organization. **Responsibilities:*** Own security design reviews and threat modeling for high\-risk product areas including payment processing, identity and access, fraud systems, and AI. * Serve as a technical security authority for staff and principal engineers, providing guidance on secure architecture patterns, cryptography, and API security. * Lead and execute application security assessments, red team exercises, and adversarial simulations against production and pre\-production environments. * Define and drive adoption of security standards, secure coding guidelines, and SAST/DAST/SCA tooling across engineering teams. * Partner with the Engineering and DevOps teams to mature the security posture of CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and container environments. * Translate complex security risks into clear, prioritized recommendations for engineering leadership and product managers. * Contribute to the team's regulatory compliance posture across PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and other applicable regulatory guidance. **What Success Looks Like:*** Engineering teams treat you as a trusted security partner, not a gatekeeper, and they pull you into design conversations early because it makes their work better, not because they have to. * Threat models and security design reviews are completed at the right stage of the SDLC, reducing the volume of critical findings that reach production. * The security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) is adopted, tuned, and producing signal rather than noise with engineers acting on findings rather than ignoring them. * High\-risk product areas (AI, payments, identity, fraud) have documented security architectures and known risk posture at all times. * Regulatory audits and customer security assessments in your domain produce no surprises, because controls are built in and well\-evidenced. * Security debt in your areas of ownership is tracked, prioritized, and visibly decreasing over time. **Candidate Requirements:**### **Required** * 5 years of experience in application security, product security, or a closely related technical role (e.g., DevOps or Application Development). * Experience in application security, product security, or a closely related technical role. * Deep expertise in at least two of the following security domains: web application security, API security, mobile security (iOS/Android), or cloud security (AWS preferred). * Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.), demonstrating the ability to read, write, and reason about production code. * Experience with modern software development and application security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, etc.). * Hands\-on experience with threat modeling methodologies applied to complex distributed systems. * Familiarity with security frameworks and standards relevant to fintech such as PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, FFIEC, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001\. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences. ### **Preferred** * Experience securing fintech, payments, or regulated financial products. * Experience supporting cloud\-native architectures and modern CI/CD environments. * Experience participating in red team exercises, penetration testing, or adversarial simulations. * Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, GIAC, or similar credentials. * Experience working closely with engineering organizations in highly regulated environments. **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results\-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie. Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:** **Compensation range:** $115K\-$145K We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well\-being, growth, and success \- both inside and outside of work. **Financial Wellness** * Bonus programs * 401(k) match * Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) * HSA and FSA options * Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs **Health \& Well\-being** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health * Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot * Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga) **Time Off** * 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one **Growth \& Development** * Education expense reimbursement * Leadership development programs * Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support We believe great performance starts with feeling supported \- and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind. **Traditional Physical Requirements:*** Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching. * Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds. * Requires eye\-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction). Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Company Overview** At Procure Analytics, we are passionate about driving continuous value for our 800\+ members, and we are passionate about doing so with cutting\-edge technology. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, Procure Analytics is the leading tech\-enabled global purchasing organization for MRO and Packaging, leveraging $1B\+ in buying power to achieve up\-front and ongoing savings for member companies. The Company was founded to address the complex challenges of a frequently ignored indirect spend category – Maintenance, Repair and Operations Supplies (MRO) and packaging. The nature of MRO supplies (millions of SKUs, thousands of individual transactions, hundreds of potential suppliers, and the relatively small cost for individual products) make MRO an under\-managed category within most organizations. MRO comprises 1\-3% of most companies’ total purchases. In the last decade, Procure Analytics has grown from 2 employees and $5 million in total managed spend to over 100 employees and more than a billion dollars in spend, while maintaining its high\-touch service model and member\-focus. Procure Analytics has continued to evolve, adding new categories and geographies in response to members’ needs. Procure Analytics is the fastest growing company in its sector. Procure Analytics’ team serves as an extension of their member organizations, leading change management, driving adoption, and increasing compliance at member locations, while providing analytical tools, savings reporting, and buyer training to drive continuous value growth for mid\-size to Fortune 500 companies. These services, resources and data analytics are provided at no cost to members. Procure Analytics has a very collaborative, humble, and values\-driven culture that upholds these guiding principles: * Act with integrity and in compliance * Drive value creation * Be disciplined entrepreneurs * Be innovative * Treat others with dignity and respect **Strong Private Equity Ownership** In December 2021, Genstar Capital invested in Procure Analytics, along with a large rollover from Bregal Sagemount and the management team. Genstar Capital is a leading private equity firm that has been actively investing in high quality companies for over 30 years. Based in San Francisco, Genstar has developed a strong market reputation of working in partnership with management teams and its network of strategic advisors to build industry\-leading businesses while generating outsized returns. Genstar’s vision is to help build lasting, impactful companies that will continue to succeed well beyond their ownership. Genstar currently has approximately $33 billion of assets under management and targets investments focused on targeted segments of the software, industrials, healthcare, and financial services industries. In 2020, Genstar was ranked 2nd worldwide in aggregate private equity fund performance (out of 529 PE firms) and ranked 3rd in 2019 (out of 497 PE firms) by HEC\-Dow Jones. For more information, please visit www.gencap.com. The Company had previously been backed successfully by Bregal Sagemount, who rolled a significant equity stake into the new investment to continue with the company as a minority investor. **The Opportunity** As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the internal and member\-facing software that powers our analytics, reporting, and procurement tools. You will write production code daily, work closely with senior engineers on system design, and use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate your work. AI tools speed up our work, but they do not replace engineering judgment. You will make sure that what you ship is correct, secure, tested, and maintainable, and you will help raise the quality bar for the whole team. Responsibilities include: * Design, develop, and maintain production applications, services, and features that support our members and internal teams. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted tools to accelerate development, and review, test, and validate all generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability before it is merged or deployed. * Contribute to system designs and technical plans and document design decisions clearly. * Build and maintain unit and integration tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes. * Integrate with cloud platforms and enterprise systems, including authentication, identity providers, and secure API access. * Apply security best practices in everyday development, including input validation, authentication and authorization checks, secrets management, and review of AI\-generated code for security weaknesses. * Apply secure development practices across the software lifecycle: follow secure coding standards, manage secrets and access credentials properly, scan dependencies for vulnerabilities, and remediate findings promptly. * Diagnose and resolve complex production issues and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence. * Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into well\-scoped, well\-engineered solutions. * Participate in code reviews, and support the team’s engineering standards for quality, testing, and documentation. **Location** Atlanta, GA (Hybrid Schedule \- We work onsite Monday through Thursday, and work from home on Fridays\_ **The Person** We are looking for a hands\-on software engineer who writes, reviews, and ships code daily, and who ensures our AI\-assisted development output is accurate, secure, and production\-ready. With the breadth of technologies we use, the successful candidate will manage multiple priorities, make sound tradeoffs, and communicate those tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical colleagues. Time allocation for this role is approximately 60% building and maintaining software, 20% reviewing, testing, and validating code (including AI\-generated code and security validation), 10% architecture and technical planning, and 10% documentation and cross\-team collaboration. Requirements: **Successful candidates should have:** * Five or more years of professional software engineering experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong proficiency in full\-stack development, including modern front\-end development (such as React with TypeScript) and a back\-end language and its ecosystem (such as Python, C\#, or Java). * Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and database design (SQL and/or NoSQL). * Software architecture skills, or experience contributing to the design and build of large\-scale enterprise applications, including service boundaries, data models, and integration patterns. * Strong security awareness in code jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is an AI\-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by: * **Empowering biopharma** to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact * **Enabling strategic positioning** of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking * **Equipping investors** with data\-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions Backed by GV (Google Ventures), SignalFire, McKesson, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R\&D by empowering decision\-makers with real\-time, data\-driven insights. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're seeking a hands\-on Senior DevOps Engineer to build and own the infrastructure, deployment, and reliability foundation of our platform as we scale. This is a rare opportunity to join a high\-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you'll ensure our pharma and biopharma customers can depend on a secure, highly available platform to run their most sensitive due diligence and valuation workflows. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top\-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Infrastructure as Code:** Design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) using infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) to keep environments reproducible, auditable, and scalable. * **CI/CD Pipelines:** Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support fast, reliable, and safe deployments across the platform's frontend, backend, and ML orchestration services. * **Observability \& Monitoring:** Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting (Grafana) to give the team real\-time visibility into system health and quickly surface issues before they impact customers. * **Reliability \& Incident Response:** Drive reliability engineering practices. Uptime targets, SLOs/SLAs, incident response processes, on\-call rotations, and driving accountability for PIRs. Our clients demand high availability for time\-sensitive deal and scientific data. * **Security \& Compliance:** Implement and enforce best practices for secure infrastructure, including network security, secrets management, access controls, and data protection. * **Cost \& Performance Optimization:** Monitor and optimize cloud spend and system performance, balancing cost efficiency with the reliability and scalability the platform requires. You should know an AWS bill like the back of your hand and be able to offer suggestions on how best to optimize it. * **Database \& Data Infrastructure Support:** Partner with engineering to manage and scale data infrastructure (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Pipelines), including backups, disaster recovery, and performance tuning. * **Developer Experience:** Build tooling and self\-service workflows that make it easy for engineers to deploy, test, and debug their services, reducing friction across the development lifecycle. * **Collaboration \& Product Thinking:** Work cross\-functionally with software and ML engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scaling and reliability needs into concrete infrastructure investments. **Who You Are** --------------- **Core Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating production infrastructure in the cloud (AWS), including networking, compute, storage, and IAM. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Hands\-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) to manage infrastructure in a repeatable, version\-controlled way. * **CI/CD \& Automation:** Expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automating build, test, and deployment workflows. We are a github shop. * **Observability:** Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting systems, and using them to drive down MTTR/MTTD. Automated DORA metric tracking too. * **Database \& Data Flow:** Comfort working with both relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB), including backup, replication, and performance considerations. * **Security \& Compliance Awareness:** Familiarity with best practices for secure infrastructure, secrets management, and compliance (especially valuable in healthcare, life sciences, or enterprise environments). * **Scripting \& Automation:** Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for building automation and internal tooling. * **Collaboration \& Product Mindset:** Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with software engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to deliver a reliable, scalable platform. **Soft Skills** * Strong problem\-solving skills and an analytical mindset. * Passion for continuous learning, rapid prototyping, and iterating based on system and user needs. * Autonomous, self\-starter attitude with a strong sense of ownership. * Excellent communication skills. You should feel comfortable presenting on security architecture to a client’s security team. * Collaborative team player with a desire to build things that truly matter. **Bonus** * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma sectors is nice, but not required. More important is a willingness to dive into the field and a curiosity to learn about life sciences and the drug development process, and how deal making revolves around it. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact:** Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader * **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity * **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ We have a strong preference for a candidate to be hybrid, 2 days per week (Tuesday/Thursday) in one of our U.S. hubs: Boston, New York City, or San Francisco. jobs.title: AI Inference Framework Engineer
jobs.description: Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real\-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co\-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co\-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21\. **The Opportunity** =================== Quadric's GPNPU runs both neural networks and C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. model compute pipelines including prefill, decode, batching, multi\-sequence and multi\-modal * Support important framework serving features including KV\-cache management, paged attention, continuous batching, speculative decoding Optimize framework performance and accuracy for GPNPU backend * Reduce host\-device dispatch overhead, implement graph capture/replay, integrate efficient kernels, minimize latency * Support quantization formats such as GGUF (Q4/Q8\), GPTQ/AWQ, int8/fp16 * Validate accuracy against reference backends (perplexity, task benchmarks) and drive improvements **What measurable tokens/s or latency gains on a frontier model * Ship one serving feature (e.g. paged KV cache) in a production release **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 3\+ years building or extending ML frameworks or inference runtimes * BS/MS in CS/CE or related fields * Strong C/C\+\+ and Python * Solid understanding of framework internals: tensor memory management, graph scheduling, operator dispatch * Solid understanding of AI compute performance analysis and optimization * Fluent with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), and We are the pioneers of Entropy Quantum Computing (EQC), utilizing open quantum systems to solve NP\-hard optimization problems. The Company’s portfolio offers unique capabilities in high\-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and remote sensing. **Position Description:** We are seeking a Senior Cloud API Developer to maintain and develop our cloud APIs which allow users to interact with our photonic quantum hardware. jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer
jobs.description: **About Raindrop** ================== Raindrop is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest\-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2\.0 (Self\-Healing Agents), the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions. **Why It Matters** ================== AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing. The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions. That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns. With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more. In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used. As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company \- from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents. **Our Investors** ================= We've raised $50M total, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari). **About the role:** We’re looking for a founding Research Engineer to study how AI agents behave in production. You’ll join an early team, set the research agenda, and publish what we learn. **Your Focus:** * **Agent behavior**: Discover how agents fail and respond to different conditions in the real world, and what that means for monitoring and safety. * **Simulations**: Advance how we simulate agents and the situations they face before they reach users. * **Detection**: Develop new methods for finding issues no one has defined yet. * **Open questions**: High\-upside bets on questions about agents we haven’t thought to ask yet. **Your responsibilities:** * Set Raindrop’s research agenda and run the experiments behind it. * Design evaluations and metrics for problems where the ground truth is unclear. * Publish findings as papers, blog posts, and talks. * Prototype new methods, and bring the ones that work into the product when it makes sense. * Help define what research looks like at Raindrop as the team and product grows. **Ideal Candidate:** * You make complex ideas clear through strong written and communication skills. * Care about sharing your research through publications, open\-source work, or public write\-ups. * Deep expertise in an area such as interpretability, evals, AI safety, anomaly detection, or representation learning. * Good judgment about which experiments are worth running and when a result is real. * You ship experiments and build prototypes * Use and build AI agents and tools

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer: Ransomware Collections
jobs.description: With 1,000\+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company! We are seeking a **Senior Engineer** to help advance the next generation of our ransomware collection capabilities. This role will be responsible for improving the depth, reliability, and differentiation of our existing ransomware collections while expanding beyond traditional threat\-actor sites into the broader ecosystem of infrastructure, identities, communities, and relationships surrounding ransomware activity. The ideal candidate combines strong collection engineering experience with an understanding of how technical collection decisions translate into higher\-confidence intelligence for analysts and customers. This engineer will work closely with our ransomware analyst and broader collections organization to ensure that our automated access strategy evolves alongside changes in the ransomware ecosystem. A central objective of this role is to build collection capabilities that consistently provide intelligence beyond what is readily available through open\-source ransomware monitoring. **What You'll Do:** * Own and improve engineering capabilities supporting ransomware collection, with an emphasis on reliability, coverage, timeliness, and intelligence value. * Expand ransomware collection beyond leak sites and other conventional sources into user\-focused approaches that provide greater visibility into relevant actors and communities. * Partner closely with ransomware analysts to translate intelligence requirements and emerging investigative questions into scalable technical collection capabilities. * Develop and continuously refine automated access strategies for ransomware\-related sources, particularly where authentication, anti\-automation controls, infrastructure changes, or other access challenges make collection difficult. * Build infrastructure that enables the team to discover, access, monitor, and preserve difficult\-to\-collect ransomware intelligence at scale. * Improve the resilience and maintainability of existing ransomware collection systems while reducing manual intervention and operational overhead. * Establish engineering patterns that allow new ransomware sources and collection methodologies to move efficiently and reliably from experimentation into production. * Collaborate across engineering, collections, and analysis teams to ensure collected data is structured and delivered in ways that maximize downstream intelligence value. * Contribute technical leadership and mentorship within the collections organization, helping establish engineering standards and long\-term architectural direction. **Technology \& Engineering Environment:** Our collection systems operate across cloud infrastructure, distributed collection services, browser automation, and specialized network environments. *Candidates do not need experience with every technology* but should be comfortable learning and operating across the type of stack that includes: * **Languages:** Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript * **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform * **Data \& Storage:** S3, PostgreSQL, Redis and distributed caching/storage systems * **Collection \& Automation:** HTTP\-based collectors, browser automation, headless browsers, Playwright/Selenium\-style tooling, authenticated session management * **Network \& Access:** TOR, proxies, SOCKS, VPNs, distributed egress and specialized collection infrastructure * **Messaging \& Processing:** Queue\- and event\-driven processing architectures * **Engineering:** GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability and production monitoring * **Security \& Intelligence:** Dark\-web and restricted\-source collection, ransomware infrastructure, identity and entity resolution, and adversarial web environments Experience building reliable systems against unstable or intentionally difficult\-to\-automate sources is particularly valuable. **What Success Looks Like:** Success in this role means that our ransomware collection capability becomes increasingly difficult to replicate through open\-source monitoring alone. Analysts should have earlier access to relevant information, greater context surrounding threat\-actor claims, and stronger evidence for understanding relationships between actors, infrastructure, identities, and ransomware operations. The engineer in this role should also materially improve our ability to adapt as ransomware actors change platforms, access controls, infrastructure, and operating practices. They will turn what would otherwise be recurring collection problems into durable engineering capabilities. *The base salary range for this full\-time position is $129,000 \- $193,500\. This position may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401K. Your recruiter can share more about the specific details of the compensation and benefit package during the hiring process.* **Why should you join Recorded Future?** Recorded Future employees (or "Futurists"), represent over 40 nationalities and embody our core values of having high standards, practicing inclusion, and acting ethically. jobs.description: Please note: ONLY engineers currently living in Texas will be considered We are building a new billing platform from the ground up and need the senior engineer who owns its core: the engine that moves claims and payments through their lifecycles, the background job system that runs every automated step, and the integrations with payers, clearinghouses and banks. Backend engineering on a money system, TypeScript on PostgreSQL on Azure, working directly with the CTO on a team that stays at two to four engineers. The type of engineer we are seeking: A backend engineer who has shipped a transactional system (payments, claims, orders, ledgers, anything where a row posting twice is a real problem) in a typed language, and who has been the one who found out when it broke. Experience you must have: * Seven or more years of backend engineering in production, in a typed language: TypeScript or Node.js, C\#, Java, Go or Kotlin. TypeScript is what we use. A strong C\# or Java engineer who has not written much TypeScript is fine; a Python\-only engineer is not. * A relational database as their primary store for years. PostgreSQL preferred; SQL Server, DB2, Oracle or MySQL fine. They should be able to talk about transactions, locking and a deadlock they debugged. * Built and ran something with background workers, queues and retries. The tool does not matter (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus, Hangfire, Quartz, Sidekiq, Celery, a database table). The years running it do. * Can explain idempotency and "what happens if the process dies between these two writes" from a system they built. * Integration work against outside vendors: REST or SOAP APIs, SFTP file drops, fixed\-width or EDI files, vendors who change their output without warning. * Owned production. They found out their job broke before the business did and changed the design so it could not repeat. A formal on\-call rotation is evidence, not the requirement. Questions you will be asked: * "Tell me about a system you built where the same job must never run twice at the same time. How did you stop it?" * "Tell me about a production failure you owned where nothing errored and the data was just wrong or missing. What did you change afterward?" * "What is the most TypeScript you have written?" The pitch to candidates * Greenfield core of a real money system, with an architecture already written down and a CTO who will hand it over rather than hover. * Small team, no service fleet, no twelve microservices, one database to search when something goes wrong. * Every automated step earns trust on evidence (shadow, propose, auto). The engineer who builds that gets to decide how far it goes. * Decisions are written. They will read the ones that exist and write the next ones. * Texas based, remote within the state. No relocation. * Billing is unglamorous and sticky. The agencies are the customer, the money is real, and the problems are concrete. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Office of the President
jobs.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. **About the Role** ------------------ This is a rare opportunity to partner directly with Replit’s President, Michele Catasta. As Replit leads in making useful intelligence accessible to all, you will serve as the company President's primary operational and strategic force multiplier across these critical organizations. Your mandate is to own the most complex cross\-functional challenges, unblock technical and operational bottlenecks, and ensure that the core product, engineering, and organizational engines operate with speed, coherence, and precision. This is a **high\-leverage individual contributor (IC) role**, not a traditional management track or team\-building post. You will scale your personal leverage through AI workflows, agentic automation, and rigorous analytical judgment, influence, not headcount. You are the operator Michele turns to when an issue spans multiple disciplines such as technical architecture, product execution, support feedback loops, or organizational design and demands a single, decisive owner. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Act as Trusted Advisor \& Operational Stand\-in:** Serve as a direct thought partner and proxy for Michele. Elevate core operational insights, synthesize briefings for high\-stakes technical and organizational decisions, and step in as a representative when needed. * **Proactively Clear Cross\-Functional Friction:** Anticipate blind spots and resolve organizational bottlenecks before they escalate. Bridge natural seams between Engineering, Product, Support, AI teams to ensure high\-cadence execution. * **Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Complex Initiatives:** Spearhead high\-priority projects that lack a neat functional home such as evolving product unit economics, developer tooling infrastructure shifts, pricing models, or technical re\-architectures. * **Scale Impact via AI \& Automation:** Actively build and deploy AI agents, automation pipelines, and modern operational workflows to multiply your personal bandwidth across status synthesis, metrics tracking, scenario modeling, and operational monitoring. **What This Role Is Not** ------------------------- * **Not a Routine Data / BI Role:** You will not be building routine dashboards, running routine SQL queries, or handling standard quarterly analytics. Those belong to Data, RevOps, and Strategic Finance. * **Not Bureaucracy or Process for Process’s Sake:** We prioritize momentum, rapid iteration, and decisiveness over heavy governance frameworks or dense slide decks. **What We Look For** -------------------- * **7\+ Years in High\-Growth Tech:** Proven track record in strategy, operations, product operations, or technical chief of staff roles, with extensive time spent working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Engineering and Product leadership. * **Cross\-Domain Credibility:** Strong technical fluency to earn the respect of Staff/Principal Engineers and AI researchers, paired with the operational empathy to partner effectively with Support and People teams. * **Exceptional Execution in Ambiguity:** The ability to take ill\-defined, sprawling problems, define clean problem boundaries, and drive them to resolution without formal line authority. * **Strong Quantitative \& Analytical Toolkit:** Deep comfort evaluating unit economics, interrogating technical systems data, building scenario models, and separating actionable signal from noise. * **Executive\-Ready Communication:** Direct, concise communicator who can deliver unambiguous trade\-offs and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and brevity. * **Hands\-on AI \& Agent Automation:** Active, practical experience leveraging LLM workflows, coding agents, and automation frameworks to amplify daily productivity and analytical depth. * **Presence \& Proximity:** Continual availability is essential. Ability to work in\-person (at least) three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) in Foster City, CA, collaborating closely on\-site with leadership. * **Scale Experience:** Experience navigating rapid organizational scaling while maintaining high cultural and engineering standards. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * **Deep Developer Tooling Background:** Prior experience in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, AI coding assistants, or developer\-focused software ecosystems. **How We’ll Know It’s Working** ------------------------------- * **Decision Velocity Across Functions Increases:** Product, engineering, and support initiatives move from scoping to execution faster, with clear alignment and measurable business impact. * **Net\-Negative Friction:** Teams actively seek your partnership because your involvement removes ambiguity, sharpens priorities, and unblocks progress rather than introducing overhead. * **Integrated Health Sightlines:** Replit's President has continuous, high\-signal visibility into the operating health, technical execution, and organizational sentiment across all reporting groups. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits Include:** Competitive Salary \& Equity 401(k) Program with a 4% match (*US Only*) Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance Short Term and Long Term Disability Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave Flexible Time Off (FTO) \+ Holidays Commuter Benefits (*In\-Office \& US Only*) Monthly Wellness Stipend Autonomous Work Environment In Office Set\-Up Reimbursement (*In\-Office Only*) Quarterly Team Gatherings In Office Amenities (*In\-Office Only*) **Want to learn more about what we are up to?** * Self\-driving Company * Replit Agent at Scale * AI Adoption * Build Open\-Source Apps **Interviewing \+ Culture at Replit** * Operating Principles * Reasons not to work at Replit To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non\-traditional backgrounds. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior/ Staff Product Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: **Senior/ Staff Product Engineer (Full Stack)** =============================================== Location: New York, NY (on\-site, 4 days a week) Compensation: $225,000–$325,000 base salary \+ meaningful equity Employment: Full\-time Department: Engineering Note: We are hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact. **About Revin** --------------- Revin builds AI\-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email. Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line. Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior\-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del\-Air, a $300M\+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del\-Air book 11,000\+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments. We’re still early, with substantial room to shape the product, the team, and the business. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people and receive meaningful equity ownership in the company you’re helping build. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a strong engineer who combines technical ability with product judgment, curiosity about customers, and an eye for good user experience. You’ll partner closely with our product manager to decide what we build and how we build it. One PM oversees our entire product, so engineers have substantial responsibility for shaping solutions, challenging assumptions, and influencing the roadmap. We work from clear product briefs and give engineers the independence to make decisions and carry them through. You’ll own customer\-facing product work from the initial problem through launch and iteration. Success means customers adopt what you build, it makes their work better, and you can demonstrate that through usage and outcomes. We use AI programming tools heavily. You should be excited about how much a capable generalist can accomplish with these tools and bring the judgment to deliver high\-quality results. **What you’ll build** --------------------- * **A unified messaging workspace.** A single place where customer service teams see voice, SMS, and email communication and handle agent escalations. * **Embedded booking experiences.** Interfaces that let customers schedule appointments directly on a service provider’s website. * **Agent management tools.** Experiences that help operators maintain and improve how their AI agents work. * **Reporting and analytics.** Products that help customers understand interaction outcomes, assess quality, and identify opportunities to improve. * **Revin’s API and MCP interfaces.** Developer interfaces that enable other software and AI agents to work with our platform. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Own products and features end to end.** Understand the customer problem, shape the solution, build across the interface, APIs, and data layer, and improve it after launch. * **Help shape our roadmap.** Bring ideas and informed opinions. Work with product to weigh customer value against technical complexity, timelines, cost, and reliability. * **Build thoughtful customer experiences.** Create intuitive, polished interfaces in TypeScript and React, including the details that make complex workflows feel simple. * **Measure adoption and impact.** Define success metrics, build the instrumentation to track them, and use data and customer feedback to decide what to improve next. * **Keep work moving.** Ship in short iteration cycles, surface blockers early, and advance other priorities while dependencies are resolved. * **Raise the quality of our execution.** Communicate tradeoffs clearly, use AI tools effectively, and take responsibility for testing, debugging, and the reliability of what you ship. * **At Staff level**, you’ll also help set direction across product areas and raise the effectiveness of the broader engineering team while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **Substantial experience building products for external customers.** You can walk us through products you owned, the decisions you made, what you learned from users, and how the product improved. * **Fluency in TypeScript and React.** You can follow a feature across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems. * **Strong product judgment.** You understand the business problem behind a request, question assumptions, and make sensible decisions when the answer isn’t fully specified. You bring opinions and adapt them as you learn. * **Good instincts for user experience.** You care about how a product feels and work closely with product and design to make it better. * **Experience measuring what happens after launch.** You’ve used instrumentation, adoption metrics, or experimentation to understand whether your work delivered value. * **Independence and clear communication.** You take initiative, make progress through ambiguity, and keep collaborators informed about decisions, risks, and changing expectations. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and the opportunity to make substantial improvements quickly. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building products at a strong startup. * Experience with Python or PostgreSQL. * Experience shipping AI\-powered products or production agents. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary** * **Meaningful early equity.** A real ownership stake and the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Revin matches 100% of the first 3% you contribute, then 50% of the next 2%. Contribute 5% to receive the full match * Unlimited PTO * Commuter benefits * Free lunches and dinners in the office * $100/month gym membership stipend * Tech equipment of your choice * Four days together in Flatiron, one remote day, and flexibility when things come up Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Irvine, California **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technology and InnovationArchitecture, Systems, and Controls **Compensation** ---------------- * $218\.2K – $300\.1K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location. **About Us** ============ Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Role Summary** ================ The Vehicle System Architecture team owns the vehicle\-level mechatronic architecture at Rivian VW Group Technologies. We translate product intent from Brand Product Definition, Program, Cost Engineering, Manufacturing, Strategy and Reliability into parts and function distribution across the vehicle — from product concept through manufacturing. You are accountable for the architecture of a platform program to sequences on the manufacturing line. You lead the actual architecture — where functions live, which controllers exist, what the vehicle can do without. You build the models and processes that let those decisions be made with data and are reused across programs. **Responsibilities** ==================== **1\. Own the Vehicle Architecture** * Lead the vehicle\-level architecture for a platform program: controllers and placement, functional allocation across ECUs, LV/HV distribution concept, sensor and actuator distribution, packaging, temperature/environmental and NVH constraints — from concept through production release. * Lead architecture trade studies with quantified outcomes: cost, mass, range, power, temperature, NVH, complexity, reliability and manufacturability. Derive the cost functions —Trade studies ship with its model, parameters and sensitivity. * Cost\-down by subtraction before optimization: use the model to prove which controllers, harness runs, sensors and requirements the vehicle can do without, and remove them before tuning what's left. * Translate ambiguous partner asks into architecture decisions and hold them at program gates; own the architecture decision record and its rationale. * Align architecture to technology roadmaps — evaluating when to adopt new tech, and what it costs the platform. * Close the loop with the physical vehicle: define the correlation and characterization tests that validate the models, and own each model's error budget. **2\. Build the Models and Tooling Behind the Decisions** * Curate and decide first: define the design space — what is fixed, what is free, which attributes matter — select the candidate architectures, weigh the trades and make the call. Then build the AI\-assisted pipelines that widen the search: proposing controller allocations, harness topologies and function distributions. * Build and own the meta\-models that connect the architecture: feature function controller physical interface software interface, with parameters flowing end to end. * Author first\-principles and stack\-up models (Python, Julia/Modelica, C\+\+; SysML v2 where it earns its keep) at the fidelity the decision demands. Collaborate with domain systems engineers on correlated models for lock. * Drive reliability by design: top\-down from vehicle attributes and bottom\-up from component data. * Lead the vehicle\-level STPA as a design process — surfacing hazards and architecture\-level control gaps early and feeding them back into the model — rather than as a gate. As the team matures, that process becomes the basis for quality enforcement. **3\. Technical Leadership and Department\-Wide Impact** * Negotiate the architecture with VW Group, Rivian brand teams and partner functions and anticipate the next platform's constraints. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Electrical System Architecture, Software System Architecture and the sub\-system domain systems leads. * Set the method: codify how the team does trade studies, meta\-modelling and WCCA beyond electrical; author the playbooks and templates; mentor engineers; review their models and decisions. * Publish the models and requirements as a sourc an and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (**https://rivianvw.tech/\#careers**). **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** -------------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment\-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Creator Services Communication
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEarly CareerID: 47042 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. As a **Software Engineer** in our Creator Services Communication Pod, you will build the next generation communications plane to power the millions of experiences on the Roblox Platform. To give some examples of what we do, we run the mission\-critical Cross\-server Messaging Service, which is crucial for Roblox game developers to implement leaderboards, cross\-server announcements, live operations and more. We own the developer APIs for HTTP calls to external systems and player teleports within and between game servers. We are also launching Compute Functions, which provide developers with a new surface to execute game logic for more robust features such as custom matchmaking, limited inventory drops, or any background task processing. To tie features like these together, we are building a general Game Server Management product to unify developers' observability and control of their servers. At its core, this team is focused on solving complex back end distributed systems and networking problems at scale. However, our scope extends to full stack projects spanning all the way from the infrastructure layer, through engine development, data pipelines, microservices, telemetry, game servers, web development, UI, and UX design. This team collaborates on multiple cross\-company efforts and our projects are of extremely high importance to Roblox. If you enjoy working on modern distributed systems, products for developers, C\# and C\+\+ software, and networking challenges alongside highly\-experienced and passionate engineers, you will be right at home on our growing Creator Services team. **You Have** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong ownership working in complex technical systems. * Knowledge: You are comfortable working with systems level programming languages (C\+\+, C\#, Objective C, Rust, or similar programming language). * Curiosity: You are eager to work across a wide range of systems and understand the Roblox ecosystem end to end * Long\-term Mindset: You are considerate of how your work impacts the team/users over time, not just getting the green checkmark on a deliverable **You Will** * You will develop new products and features that help creators make complex experiences including live game operations at many\-million\-player scale. * You will support core systems at massive scale including how players move between game servers, how game servers communicate with each other, and how experiences interact with on and off platform services. * You will work across the technology stack such as the C\+\+ game engine, Kafka streams, Flink jobs, Elasticsearch/Redis/Clickhouse databases, C\# backend services, and React UIs. * You will take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles. Please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H\-1B sponsorship at this time. You may redact age, date of birth, and dates of attendance/graduation from your resume if you prefer. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
