jobs.title: Software Engineer, Deployed
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. **About the team** ================== The **Agent Deployment** team is a customer\-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise\-grade features and products. Deployment Success Managers own each customer's long\-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go\-live. **Role Overview** ================= Deployed Software Engineers are customer\-facing software engineers: shipping features, building new capabilities, and expanding our product surface area inside some of the world’s most complex enterprises. You’ll work directly with customers to turn messy, high\-stakes workflows into reliable AI\-driven systems, shipping production code that influences both revenue and product direction. This role isn’t about building demos or prototypes; it’s about shipping enterprise\-grade features and products for our customers. If you're energized by building something that didn't exist before, with a direct line between your work and company growth, this is the role for you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Ship core product:** architect and ship production\-grade systems that become part of Serval's core product, born from the real needs of our most complex customers. * **Build platform services:** design backend services, APIs, and integrations that extend Serval's AI agent platform across customers, with a focus on reliability, security, and long\-term maintainability. * **Turn workflows into product:** work directly with customers to turn messy, high\-stakes workflows into generalized, reusable product capabilities. * **Own the deployment lifecycle:** own key deployments from architecture through scaling and continuous improvement. **Example Recent Projects** =========================== * Productionize Serval's voice agent from alpha into a viable channel for enterprise users to reach the Serval AI agent, first at a Fortune 500 financial services company. * Upgrade our worker environment to communicate with on\-premise Active Directory and Microsoft platforms over LDAP and PowerShell, and ship self\-serve deployment so customers can stand up a Serval worker themselves. * Extend our workflow system to ingest knowledge from any source, making a customer's own systems searchable by the agent, a capability that won us the deal. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * Software engineering experience, ideally in a product\-focused or customer\-facing role * Strong coding and system design skills, with experience shipping production systems and building external integrations * High ownership in fast\-moving environments with limited structure, and a track record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped, measurable impact. * A clear communicator with both technical and business stakeholders. **Nice to Have** ================ * Startup experience as a founder or early engineer. * Background working with enterprise customers or supporting complex technical sales cycles. * Experience building or deploying AI/LLM\-powered features or agent\-based systems. * Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company. * **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company. * **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun. Compensation Range: $200K \- $325K

Join SLS to fast\-track your career, maximize your industry impact, and partner with iconic brands to build the digital infrastructure of tomorrow! Responsibilities: * Lead end\-to\-end DCOS commissioning, including FAT, SAT, PFT, FPT and IST, ensuring systems meet performance and handover requirements. * Develop and manage commissioning plans, test scripts, checklists and technical documentation throughout all project phases. * Validate DCOS hardware, network configurations, IP addressing, VLANs, redundancy, stress testing, alarms and data logging. * Execute DCOS\-to\-DCIM integration and onboarding, validating data points, alarm alignment, system hierarchies and interoperability. * Interpret single\-line drawings and verify system\-level calculations, including resiliency scripts, utility power, PUE, BCM and battery monitoring systems. * Apply advanced technical expertise across DDC, PLC, DCS, SCADA and BMS platforms to diagnose and troubleshoot complex controls systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve controls\-related issues across electrical, mechanical, HVAC and fire protection systems. * Develop and maintain standardised controls programming modules, sequences of operation, graphics and reporting tools. * Utilise data collection and monitoring platforms, including Kepware, Matrikon, TopView and OSIsoft PI, to support system diagnostics and performance analytics. * Oversee commissioning compliance, software factory acceptance testing, technical validation and final system handover, ensuring operational readiness and adherence to global standards. * Coordinate project activities across construction managers, general contractors, system integrators, design teams and equipment suppliers; maintain commissioning logs, track progress, report program metrics and oversee Software Factory Acceptance Testing and vendor accountability. Qualifications: * Extensive experience in data center commissioning, controls engineering, or building automation systems within mission\-critical environments. * Strong technical knowledge of DDC, PLC, DCS, SCADA and BMS architectures, including system integration and troubleshooting. * Proven experience delivering commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, PFT, FPT and IST, with a strong understanding of testing and validation procedures. * Experience integrating DCOS and DCIM platforms, including network configuration, data point validation, alarm configuration and system interoperability. * Proficiency with controls monitoring and data collection platforms such as Kepware, Matrikon, TopView, OSIsoft PI or equivalent systems. jobs.title: Sr. Performance & Insights Engineer
jobs.description: The Performance \& Insights Engineer sits within SM Energy's Enterprise Performance \& Insights team, reporting into the Chief Operating Officer organization, and works at the intersection of petroleum engineering, data engineering, and executive decision support. This role translates complex subsurface, operational, and financial data into high\-impact analyses, models, and executive\-ready deliverables that inform Investor Relations (IR) and Board of Directors (BOD) communications and advance critical strategic initiatives. Combining a working command of operational and asset engineering fundamentals with full\-stack data wrangling and coding capability and modern AI\-assisted workflows, the engineer independently frames ambiguous business problems, builds scalable end\-to\-end analytical solutions, and communicates insights persuasively to senior leadership. Operates under limited review while handling assignments of broad scope and complex difficulty; may mentor less experienced analysts and engineers and supervise their technical work. **Essential Roles and Responsibilities** * Translate complex operational, development, and financial business problems into end\-to\-end analytical solutions — from data acquisition and pipeline through model, visualization, and executive\-ready deliverable. * Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, queries, and analytics data views across production, reservoir, financial, and capital\-planning domains using SQL and Python; design and test scripts, stored procedures, functions, and views. * Deliver executive and Board\-ready artifacts through an agentic, AI\-assisted workflow — directing tools such as Claude to build self\-contained HTML dashboards, branded decks, and models from a spec, then refining them while retaining judgment over accuracy and design. * Understanding of production and reservoir engineering fundamentals — decline curve analysis (DCA), rate/pressure transient analysis (RTA/PTA), volumetrics, EURs, artificial lift, and production optimization — to QA/QC data and pressure\-test analytical results for physical reasonableness. * Develop capital\-efficiency, production\-performance, operational KPIs, and economic metrics and models that support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic decision\-making across operating regions. * Design and produce executive\-facing reporting — BOD slides, IR materials, and interactive dashboards — built to SM Energy brand standards. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., large language model assistants such as Claude) to accelerate code development, data QA/QC, documentation, and analysis, applying sound engineering judgment to validate and stress\-test AI\-assisted output. * Develop correlations between geological, completion, operational, and financial variables and well\- and asset\-level performance. * Perform ad\-hoc analyses; troubleshoot data\-quality issues across the business; proactively identify potential issues and recommend solutions. * Serve as a liaison across Operations, Finance, IR, Reservoir/Asset teams, and IT/Data — bridging deeply technical work and business audiences. * Monitor production, capital, and financial data for discrepancies and opportunities; recommend operational and process improvements. * Contribute to data governance, code documentation, change\-release process, and best practices; educate others in support of a data\- and AI\-first culture. * Manage and engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously; independently prioritize tasks and eliminate roadblocks to meet target deadlines. * Conduct business with the highest ethical standards; demonstrate decision\-making that ensures the safety of all people associated with SM facilities. * Other duties as assigned. **Role\-Specific Technical Knowledge \& Skills** **Petroleum Engineering.** Working command of production operations, artificial\-lift applications, and fundamental reservoir engineering disciplines — decline curve analysis, rate/pressure transient analysis, volumetrics, recoveries, EURs, and recovery factors. Understanding of unconventional resource plays across multiple basins/operating regions and familiarity with reserves, economics, AFE, and capital\-planning workflows. Ability to identify limitations and ranges of certainty in a data set and to relate reservoir, completion, and operational characteristics to well performance. **Data Engineering \& Analytics.** Advanced ability to wrangle, pre\-process, and feature\-engineer data and to connect data from disparate sources to surface insights, data\-quality issues, and variable correlations. Sound applied\-statistics foundation; competence with machine\-learning concepts and frameworks a plus. End\-to\-end pipeline design that is cost\-effective and scalable; strong code documentation and change\-management discipline. **AI\-Augmented Delivery.** Ability to integrate AI tools into daily delivery to compress cycle time while retaining engineering ownership of correctness — treating AI output as a draft to be verified, not a final answer. Understands data\-security and data\-privacy implications of AI\-assisted and cloud\-based workflows and accounts for them appropriately. **Computer/Software Applications** * **Programming \& Analytics:** Advanced SQL and Python (pandas, numpy, and related data ecosystem); R or comparable a plus. * **Data Platforms \& Architecture:** Data virtualization via Denodo; Snowflake and/or Databricks; Palantir Foundry; relational database design; ETL/ELT (dbt, SSIS); cloud environments (Azure, AWS). * **Visualization \& Reporting:** Governed enterprise BI (Power BI, Spotfire, or Tableau) for refreshing dashboards, plus bespoke interactive tools built as self\-contained HTML dashboards (D3, Plotly, Recharts) that run anywhere without a license or server. Advanced PowerPoint and Excel for executive and Board deliverables, produced to SM Energy brand standards. * **Development Tools:** Git/GitHub, modern IDEs (VS Code, PyCharm), notebooks (Jupyter), and fast dependency/environment management (uv, Poetry, conda). Comfortable in the agentic developer loop — coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot working inside the IDE/terminal, not used only as a side chat. * **Agentic Delivery:** Fluent in AI\-assisted artifact creation — directing agentic tools (e.g., Claude) to build branded HTML dashboards, PowerPoint decks, and Excel models end to end from a specification, then refining them iteratively. Applies SM's visual standards programmatically ("brand\-as\-code") so output is board\-ready by default, and exercises judgment over layout, data integrity, and narrative clarity rather than accepting first\-pass output. * **AI\-Augmented Development:** Fluent in an AI\-native analytics workflow — uses LLM assistants (e.g., Claude) and agentic tools to accelerate development, QA/QC, refactoring, and documentation, always validating output against engineering judgment. Can leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents securely to enterprise data and tools (e.g., querying Denodo or Snowflake, drafting Office deliverables) and platform\-native AI such as Snowflake Cortex and Power BI Copilot, keeping data security and governance front of mind. * **Petroleum Engineering Software:** Aries, Wellview, and Spotfire; exposure to RTA/PTA and production\-analysis tools; reservoir simulation and frac models a plus. **Education** * Bachelor's degree required in Petroleum, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering; Data Science; Computer Science; Statistics; or a related quantitative field. * A dual foundation in engineering and computing/data is strongly preferred. * Advanced degree a plus. **Typical Experience** * Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience. * Experience should span both petroleum engineering (production/operations, and/or reservoir) and hands\-on data/analytics development. * Demonstrated delivery of executive\- or Board\-facing analytical work is strongly preferred. SM Energy offers competitive compensation and benefits programs which include, but are not limited to, variable pay, health care coverage, retirement plan, protection coverage, time off and leave programs, training and development opportunities and a range of allowances connected to specific work situations. Details are available at Careers :: SM Energy Company (SM) (sm\-energy.com). Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

senior engineers with application upgrades and vendor releases, including pre\-upgrade checks, testing, and post\-change validation. * Perform routine maintenance on web and application servers, including IIS, Apache, Nginx, and Tomcat, as well as TLS certificate renewals and basic configuration changes. * Support the Integrations team, which builds and supports integrations between systems, by checking server connectivity, service accounts, and file transfer endpoints when integration issues are reported. *Patching \& Lifecycle Management* * Perform scheduled operating system and application component patching according to established maintenance windows and change management procedures. * Verify patch compliance and report systems that do not meet required configuration baselines. * Maintain accurate server inventories and lifecycle records. *Database Administration* * Perform routine database administration tasks, primarily involving Microsoft SQL Server. * Monitor backup jobs, conduct test restores, and apply database permission changes based on approved requests. * Escalate database performance, integrity, or other complex issues to senior engineers or This role has direct ownership of the company’s growing control systems, motor systems, motor controllers, and embedded communications electronics, which are critical to product performance, differentiation, and scalability. **Position Overview** The Director of Engineering has full accountability for engineering performance, including: * Product development and R\&D * New Product Introduction (NPI) Execution * Systems engineering rigor and requirements ownership * Configuration management and technical data * Manufacturing readiness and sustaining engineering * Engineering portfolio prioritization, resourcing, and budget ownership This role partners closely with Manufacturing, Procurement, SIOP, Logistics \& Warehousing, Business Systems, Quality, Finance, and Commercial teams to translate product concepts into manufacturable, scalable, and profitable designs. **Key Responsibilities** **Engineering Leadership \& Organization** ========================================== * Provide strategic and day\-to\-day leadership across Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Firmware, and Systems Engineering disciplines. * Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing multidisciplinary engineering team supporting high\-mix, high\-custom consumer products. * Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation requirements, Specifications (FRSs), and system\-level specifications. * Translate customer, market, regulatory, and operational needs into clear, testable requirements. * Ensure end\-to\-end requirements traceability from concept through production release. * Apply systems engineering rigor in a commercially appropriate, right\-sized manner. **New Product Introduction (NPI) \& Design Governance** ======================================================= * Own and continuously evolve a right\-sized, stage\-gate NPI process from concept through full\-rate production. * Lead formal design and readiness reviews including PDR, CDR, TRR, and MRR. * Define gate deliverables, exit criteria, and cross\-functional sign\-off requirements. * Apply Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs) to manage technical risk and roadmap decisions. * Ensure predictable, on\-time, and on\-budget delivery of engineering programs. **Electrical, Controls, Motors \& Embedded Systems** ==================================================== * Own the end\-to\-end development of motor systems, motor controllers, and embedded electronics supporting screen and shade products. * Lead architecture, design, validation, and lifecycle ownership of: + Motors (performance, acoustics, reliability, thermal behavior) + Motor controllers and drive electronics + Communications and control boards * Personally engage in electrical architecture development, schematic design oversight, and system\-level validation. * Define and evolve electrical and controls architectures in SI products supporting RF, PoE, Zigbee, Josh.AI, and other smart\-home or commercial control protocols. * Ensure designs meet performance, safety, compliance, manufacturability, reliabili = * Identify and design portfolio prioritization. * Build business cases for platform investments, tooling, automation, and roadmap tradeoffs. * Ensure engineering decisions reflect total lifecycle cost, margin, and warranty exposure. **Tooling, Fixtures \& Manufacturing Aids** =========================================== * Lead the design, development, validation, and lifecycle ownership of jigs, fixtures, special manufacturing floor. * Ensure all tooling and fixtures are properly documented, released, revision\-controlled, and supported throughout the production lifecycle. * Support continuous improvement jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: SEE Headquarters \- Charlotte Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e\-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high\-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5\.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com. ***What will you do as a Senior AI Engineer at Sealed Air?*** ------------------------------------------------------------- Sealed Air is seeking a hands\-on **Senior AI Engineer** to design, develop, deploy, and support AI\-enabled applications for supply chain and manufacturing operations. The role combines software engineering and solution architecture with predictive machine learning, industrial IoT, MES integration, and generative AI to improve equipment reliability, work center performance, product quality, and operational productivity. The engineer will partner with supply chain leaders, plant operations, maintenance, OT, data engineering, and IT teams to turn business problems into secure, reliable production solutions and measurable outcomes. ***Why do we need you?*** ------------------------- * **Manufacturing AI and predictive analytics.** Develop and operationalize ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, equipment failure risk, cycle time and throughput forecasting, quality prediction, and work center bottleneck analysis. Define baselines and measure operational impact with plant stakeholders. * **Industrial data and MES integration.** Integrate machine and sensor telemetry, historian data, MES events, maintenance records, and ERP data. Connect equipment signals with production orders, assets, work centers, downtime reasons, and quality results to create meaningful analytical features. * **Model engineering and lifecycle.** Build reproducible data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and retraining pipelines. Address time\-series alignment, missing data, data leakage, class imbalance, and changing operating conditions; monitor model drift, false alarms, and prediction quality. * **LLM and RAG applications.** Build applications using LLMs, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) for manufacturing knowledge, troubleshooting, and operational assistance. Evaluate retrieval quality, grounded responses, access controls, latency, and cost. * **AI automation.** Develop AI\-assisted workflows that turn predictions and retrieved knowledge into alerts, recommendations, maintenance requests, and approved business actions. Apply human review, auditability, and appropriate OT controls to actions affecting plant operations. * **Full stack engineering and Azure operations.** Design and build APIs, backend services, databases, and web interfaces. Deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in Azure App Service, including identity, secrets, networking dependencies, availability, and application performance. * **DevOps and production ownership**. Use Azure DevOps for source control, work tracking, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD across development, test, and production. Maintain deployment approvals, rollback procedures, monitoring, incident diagnostics, and support documentation. * **Technical leadership and collaboration.** Translate business needs into technical designs and delivery plans; conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and establish reusable patterns. Use approved AI coding tools and validate generated code for security, correctness, and maintainability. ***What do you need to succeed?*** ---------------------------------- Candidates must demonstrate hands\-on capability across all areas below. Experience limited to AI tool usage, proofs of concept, or managerial oversight does not meet the requirements. * **Engineering background.** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; 10\+ years of overall IT experience, including 7\+ years of hands\-on software development. Demonstrated solution design and architecture experience. * **Supply chain and manufacturing domain.** Strong understanding of production planning and execution, work centers, asset maintenance, quality, inventory, and material flow. Ability to translate downtime, throughput, yield, scrap, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) into practical AI use cases and success measures. * **Industrial Io t Fabric, and production MLOps or LLMOps practices. (Preferred) * Experience integrating SAP or other ERP platforms with MES, historians, maintenance systems, and event\-driven services; familiarity with industrial edge deployments. (Preferred) * **Predictive AI and ML engineering**. Hands\-on experience building and deploying predictive models using machinery, work center, or manufacturing process data. Strong Python, SQL, feature engineering, time\-series analysis, model validation, and ML framework skills; ability to integrate model outputs into operational workflows. * **LLMs and RAG.** Demonstrated experience developing AI applications using LLMs and RAG, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, API integration, and evaluation. Understand hallucination risks, prompt injection, data privacy, and permission\-aware retrieval. * **Azure application management.** Hands\-on experience deploying and operating web applications in Azure App Service. Understand Microsoft Entra app registrations, service principals, managed identities, authentication and authorization, Key Vault, and Azure role\-based access control. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Purple AI
jobs.description: ### **Our Purpose** At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. ### **About Us** SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. ### **What Are We Looking For?** We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. We're looking for an AI\-native product manager to join SentinelOne's Purple AI team and lead the vision and execution for next\-generation agentic security features. Purple AI is how modern SOC teams detect earlier, respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers—and SentinelOne is embedding it platform\-wide to automate security operations while keeping human analysts fully in control and accountable. You'll own the roadmap for new agentic capabilities and drive the evolution of our conversational experience, continually redefining what modern AI in cybersecurity looks like. This is a high\-visibility, strategic role with direct exposure to executive leadership and close collaboration across engineering, sales, marketing, and pricing strategy. ### **What Will You Do?** Primary responsibilities include**:** * Define and champion the strategy and vision for Purple AI—the industry's first GenAI security analyst—along with new AI features driving SentinelOne's next phase of growth * Own the full product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and iteration, to deliver measurable customer and business impact * Synthesize quantitative and qualitative inputs—product metrics, user research, and market analysis—to shape the roadmap and build customer\-centric solutions * Make robust decisions amid incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous information, managing risk and rallying cross\-functional teams around a shared path forward * Refine online and offline evaluation metrics to track with customer\-perceived quality and value, and drive our data\-sourcing strategy to continuously improve model and pipeline performance * Partner with marketing, sales, and documentation to craft a compelling product narrative that drives adoption of our AI products ### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?** Ideal candidates will have: * 10\+ years in enterprise product management; cybersecurity product experience preferred * 6\+ years building AI/ML products * 4\+ years launching 0\-to\-1 enterprise software products * Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, data science, or related field (or equivalent experience) * Strong technical grasp of AI/ML technologies, including generative and agentic AI, natural language processing (NLP), and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) * Exceptional skill navigating ambiguity, framing trade\-offs, and making decisions that balance technical complexity, user experience, and business value * Ownership mentality: proven accountability, persistence, and a results\-driven mindset * Clear, efficient, and persuasive communication—written and verbal—across audiences from engineers to executives * Hands\-on experience using AI tools to accelerate the full PM workflow, improving both the speed and quality of decision\-making *Note: This position requires up to 15% travel to customer and SentinelOne locations worldwide.* ### **Why** **SentinelOne?** AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: **Equity \& Rewards** * Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) **Time Off \& Wellbeing** * Flexible time off * Paid company holidays and paid sick time * Gender\-neutral parental leave * Grandparent leave **Insurance \& Financial Security** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Life and disability insurance * Health and dependent care FSA * Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * ARAG pre\-paid legal * Nationwide pet insurance * Cancer Care program * Global business travel medical insurance **Work Perks \& Flexibility** * Home office allowance * Mobile phone reimbursement **Wellness \& Lifestyle** * Wellness coach * Wellness/gym reimbursement * Fertility coverage * Adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. SentinelOne participates in the E\-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

jobs.title: AI Engineer- Remote
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform, including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, and health information management, Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. AskMD by Sharecare, the company’s **free AI health app**, helps people describe a symptom, ask a health question, and get evidence\-based guidance and a clear next step. AskMD is available in the U.S. on the **App Store**, **Google Play**, and the **web**. To learn more, visit sharecare.com. **Job Summary:** As the AI Engineer, you will play a critical role across vision, strategy, operations, and execution for defining and driving the transformation of Sharecare into the era of agentic engineering. We are looking for engineers who can take a big problem domain we hand to them, disappear into it, and they come back with it working, documented, and theirs. We don’t need to check their work or meddle, because checking isn’t unnecessary. The people who have struggled here waited for scoped tickets to tell them what to do, but that’s what we have agents for. What "a fit" looks like, concretely: * Demonstrate you can ship daily at high volume with a fleet of AI agents. In the interview we'll ask to see your actual setup and what you let it do unsupervised. "I use Copilot sometimes" is not this. * You've owned architecture across multiple companies or many codebases: staff\-plus IC, chief\-architect, or platform\-consulting background. You've seen a dozen ways teams ship and you have opinions with scars behind them. * When handed an ambiguous, ugly, load\-bearing problem, your instinct is to take it whole: read everything, decide, build, write the doc, tell us what you decided. Not to schedule a meeting about scope. * Prior experience working in healthcare and/or clinical research, on health data products including electronic health records, claims, wearables, etc. and/or remote patient monitoring technologies is a plus * You communicate proactively in writing. For example: a Sunday text that says "took care of it, here's the PR and what I changed." * 6\+ years and multiple systems owned end to end What you will own: * The Factory spine. Develop and improve our existing factory to maximize and align in the era of agentic engineering. Increase our throughput by 50% while maintaining a lean team. Your job is to evolve our factory platform: Merge gates, migration safety, canary and rollback on a system where a bad deploy can touch patient care. * The application work spine. The layer that lets AI agents and humans act on patient care with auditability and fail\-closed checks. You’ll own the guardrails that ensure agents can safely provide broader components of care. * The data and metrics. Warehouse, analytics platform, and the pipelines that tell us what happened. * Architecture syncs with me. You'll have the standing I give someone who has seen more systems than I have: disagree with me, make the call in your domain, unpack it for the team when asked. **Essential Job Functions:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions to support business needs. * Build and optimize machine learning models, predictive analytics solutions, recommendation systems, and intelligent automation tools. * Develop and implement generative AI applications utilizing large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and conversational AI technologies. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business challenges into AI\-driven solutions. * Integrate AI and machine learning models into enterprise applications, workflows, and business processes. * Develop and maintain data pipelines that support model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms to identify opportunities for innovation and business improvement. * Monitor model performance and implement processes for model retraining, optimization, and lifecycle management. * Ensure AI solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards. * Conduct testing, validation, and performance assessments of machine learning models and AI applications. * Collaborate with cloud engineering and infrastructure teams to deploy and scale AI solutions in cloud environments. * Develop technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures for AI systems. * Support AI governance initiatives, including model transparency, explainability, fairness, and responsible AI practices. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to AI models, integrations, and production environments. * Participate in code reviews, solution design sessions, and architectural planning activities. * Provide technical leadership and guidance on AI best practices and implementation strategies. * Stay current with advancements in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and related technologies. Support strategic innovation initiatives and contribute to the organization's AI roadmap. * **Qualifications** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field required. **Experience:** * Minimum of at least 4 years of experience software engineering or systems architecture. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting machine learning models and AI\-driven applications. * Experience developing solutions using large language models (LLMs), generative AI platforms, and natural language processing tools preferred. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working with model deployment, MLOps, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Familiarity with model governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Knowledge of cloud\-native AI services, distributed computing, and scalable architecture principles. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business\-focused solutions and recommendations. * Strong collaboration and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business functions. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Knowledge of data privacy, cybersecurity, compliance, and responsible AI practices. * High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability. Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E\-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce\-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4\.com. Shift4 is looking for a Data Engineer to join the Shift4 data team and build the SQL and Python based jobs that turn raw payments data in Snowflake into reconciled, reliable datasets and reports. We currently have a library of containerized Python scripts that run SQL against Snowflake on a schedule. You will extend and improve this platform, making it more reliable, scalable and maintainable as we continue to evolve it. This is a hands\-on build role: you write the queries, wrap them in clean, testable Python, package them to run in containers, and make sure they produce correct numbers every time. Pipeline infrastructure (ingestion into Snowflake) is owned by the Data Platform team; you own what happens once the data is there, while embracing the Shift4 way. **Responsibilities** * Design, write, and maintain Python jobs that execute SQL over Snowflake to produce transaction, settlement, fee, and reconciliation datasets for internal and merchant\-facing consumers * Write performant, readable SQL: window functions, CTEs, incremental logic, and semi\-structured (JSON/VARIANT) handling on large transaction tables * Package jobs as Docker containers and run them on the existing scheduler; make every job idempotent, rerunnable, parameterized, and observable (logging, alerting on failure or bad output) * Implement data\-quality checks and reconciliation controls to ensure data is accurate and totals consistently align across sources and reporting periods. * Keep an eye on Snowflake cost: warehouse sizing, clustering, query profiling, and avoiding wasteful scans * Work with finance, operations, and product stakeholders to translate payments questions into correct, maintainable queries * Apply security controls appropriate for a payments environment: secrets handling, least\-privilege access, PII masking, audit trails * Document the job library and contribute to code review, testing, and CI practices for the team * Proactively explore and apply AI tools to improve efficiency across the development lifecycle (query authoring, testing, documentation) **Qualifications** * **1 \- 3 years experience** in data engineering, analytics engineering, or backend roles building SQL\-heavy data workloads in production * Strong SQL: window functions, CTEs, aggregation and joins over large tables, query tuning and reading execution plans * Hands\-on Snowflake experience: warehouses and credit/cost awareness, stages and COPY INTO, streams and tasks, time travel, VARIANT/semi\-structured data; Snowpark or the Snowflake Python connector * Solid Python for data work: pandas or Polars, parameterized SQL, configuration and secrets management, structured logging, error handling, unit tests * Docker fundamentals: building images, running scheduled batch jobs in containers, debugging container failures * Git and basic CI/CD habits; comfortable with code review and writing testable, rerunnable jobs * Attention to numerical correctness: you notice when totals do not tie out and you dig until you know why **Nice to have** * Payments domain knowledge: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, chargebacks, interchange and scheme fees, merchant and acquirer data models, reconciliation * Orchestration and transformation tooling: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt * AWS from the developer side: S3, IAM, Secrets Manager, ECS/Fargate scheduled tasks * Data\-quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda) and pipeline monitoring/alerting * Experience in a PCI or otherwise regulated environment * Exposure to BI tools consuming the outputs (Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, Looker) *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.*

jobs.title: Full-Time Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Backend engineers at Sign\-Speak manage our technology infrastructure, from our cutting\-edge AI communication systems to our machine learning pipelines and data collection platforms. Our infrastructure moves fast and changes rapidly, with strong requirements for reliability, throughput, and end\-to\-end latency. We are looking for a Backend Engineer with experience in networking, transport protocols, and real\-time communication systems. This engineer will help us expand our backend engineering capacity while bringing valuable expertise in networking and media transport technologies, such as WebRTC. Our ideal candidate has a strong understanding of standard backend software engineering, software architecture, networking fundamentals (particularly OSI Layers 3 and 4\), and experience working with real\-time media transport systems. Familiarity with network security and defensive security practices is a plus. We don't particularly care which technical stack you're most familiar with, as long as you have experience with a standard technology stack and a strong foundation in software engineering. However, it's important to be ready for intensive onboarding. We aim to get new engineers up and running as quickly as reasonably possible. **Compensation** Base Salary: 100,000\-140,000 annually **Additional Benefits** Health insurance, stock options, and professional development support. **Company Description** Sign\-Speak is a fast\-growing startup on a mission to improve communication between the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities and the hearing world. Our innovative language software recognizes sign language and translates it into spoken language, and vice versa, using machine learning. We're proud to have raised institutional funding and received funding from the National Science Foundation (NSF), and we're positioned for continued growth. At Sign\-Speak, we're a fun and compassionate team, but we're also extremely hardworking. We're looking for individuals who are as dedicated to our mission as we are and who are willing to put in the effort to help us achieve our goals. If you're a highly skilled and motivated software engineer who's passionate about using technology to make the world a more accessible place, we encourage you to apply. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology, collaborate with a diverse and talented group of individuals, and make a real difference in people's lives. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment that values innovation, creativity, and teamwork. If you're ready to join a team that's making a real impact in the world, we want you to be a part of Sign\-Speak. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain our backend systems and core infrastructure. * Design, implement, and optimize real\-time communication systems, including media transport and networking components. * Develop and improve systems utilizing transport protocols such as TCP, UDP, and WebRTC. * Analyze end\-to\-end latency, network performance, and communication bottlenecks across our real\-time AI applications. * Improve the reliability, throughput, and efficiency of our networking infrastructure. * Expand existing backend systems to support new product requirements and increased usage. * Collaborate with engineers to troubleshoot networking, connectivity, and media transport issues. * Identify and address potential security vulnerabilities within our backend and networking systems. * Write and execute technical design documents. * Participate in on\-call rotations and assist with troubleshooting production incidents. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience developing and maintaining backend applications or distributed systems. * Experience with transport protocols such as TCP and UDP. * Familiarity with real\-time communication technologies, including WebRTC or similar protocols. * Understanding of concurrent systems and asynchronous communication. * Familiarity with system architecture, databases, and backend infrastructure. * Experience troubleshooting performance, latency, and connectivity issues. * Understanding of network security principles. * Willingness to learn and work in a fast\-paced startup environment. **Preferred Areas of Technical Experience** * Real\-time media transport (e.g. RTMP, QUIC), including audio/video streaming. * WebRTC, RTP, RTCP, ICE, STUN, or TURN. * Network performance jobs.title: Data Products - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About the Company** ===================== Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production. Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI\-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale. We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post\-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A\*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition. **About the Role** ================== As a Data Products \- Member of Technical Staff, you will build the systems that bring real human signal into Simile. Our simulations are only as good as the data behind them. The Data Products team owns how that data is collected, structured, secured, and made useful. That includes our in\-house AI interview platform, which runs real\-time, adaptive conversations with people at scale, as well as the infrastructure that lets the world's most security\-conscious organizations trust Simile with their data. We are looking for engineers who can bridge cutting\-edge AI and production\-grade enterprise data systems. You will design and scale products that handle sensitive, messy, real\-world data with rigor. Every system you build should be secure, auditable, and reliable by construction, while staying simple for the people who use it. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Own data products from initial architecture through backend services, APIs, and user\-facing workflows. Make the core design calls on storage, orchestration, and data modeling, including when to build and when to buy. * **Data Collection \& Processing:** Build and scale pipelines that gather data from diverse sources, normalize it into consistent formats, and make it available to our product and research teams at scale. * **Secure Data Handling:** Build systems that support the secure handling and processing of sensitive data. Implement PII redaction, tenant isolation, encryption at rest, and appropriate access controls so customers and participants can trust how their data is treated. * **Data Integration \& Reliability:** Design flexible paths to bring in structured and unstructured data from many sources and formats. Handle schema changes, partial failures, and edge cases without breaking downstream consumers. * **Customer \& Research Collaboration:** Partner closely with our researchers, product teams, and enterprise customers to turn ambiguous requirements into durable data capabilities. * **Pragmatic Shipping:** Balance long\-term architectural rigor with the need to ship incrementally and learn from real\-world usage. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must Haves** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of professional engineering experience (excluding internships) at tech and product\-driven companies, including ownership of production systems that customers depend on. * **Backend \& Data Proficiency:** Strong command of Python and/or TypeScript, plus solid SQL and data modeling fundamentals. Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * **Data Systems Experience:** Hands\-on experience building data pipelines or integrations, including batch and/or streaming processing, workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal), and schema evolution. * **Security Mindset:** Practical experience with authentication and authorization, encryption, secrets management, multi\-tenancy, and handling sensitive data in enterprise or regulated environments. * **Product Thinking:** A track record of balancing technical excellence with a pragmatic approach to shipping, always keeping the customer's problem at the center of the solution. * **Adaptability:** Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-growing environment by navigating loosely defined tasks and managing competing priorities effectively. ### **Nice to Haves** * **Data at Scale:** Experience working with terabyte or petabyte\-scale datasets and distributed data processing, using technologies such as ClickHouse, Flink, or BigQuery. * **Real\-Time Voice \& Media:** Experience with WebRTC, streaming speech\-to\-text and text\-to\-speech, or LLM\-powered conversational products. * **Enterprise Data Integrations:** Experience building customer\-facing connectors, data\-sharing workflows, APIs/SDKs, or developer platforms for enterprise customers. * **Compliance \& Privacy:** Experience working with sensitive customer data, including practical approaches to protecting, de\-identifying, and sharing it responsibly. Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, enterprise security reviews, or privacy\-enhancing techniques such as differential privacy. * **Human Behavior Interest:** Curiosity about social science, survey research, or how people think and make decisions. **Our Process** =============== We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations. **Reapplication Policy:** To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simile observes a **90\-day waiting period** before reconsidering candidates for the same role. **Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** ======================================== **Equal Opportunity:** Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically. **Accommodations:** If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

jobs.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer

We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. **Why are we hiring?** Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced ML Infrastructure/MLOps Engineer to join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will drive the development and deployment of machine learning models, optimize ML workflows, and help ensure our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and secure. If you have a passion for automation, cloud technology, and delivering high\-impact solutions, we'd love to hear from you. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the architecture, deployment, and optimization of scalable ML model serving systems for real\-time and batch use cases. * Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to operationalize ML models. * Develop CI/CD pipelines for ML models enabling rapid, safe, and consistent model releases. * Design, implement, and own comprehensive production monitoring for ML models/systems. * Manage cloud infrastructure, primarily in AWS or other major public clouds, to support ML workloads. * Drive best practices in model versioning, observability, reproducibility, and deployment reliability * Serve in an on\-call rotation as a first responder for software owned by your team. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or a related field, with at least 3 years focused on MLOps or ML infrastructure. * Deep hands\-on experience with AWS or similar public clouds, including compute, networking, container orchestration, and observability stacks. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Formation). * Proficiency in programming languages like Python, and familiarity with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Solid understanding of ML lifecycle management, including experiment tracking, versioning, and monitoring. * Strong communication skills for partnering with cross\-functional technical and non\-technical teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Ray for inference, or pipeline orchestration * Hands\-on experience with deploying large language models (LLMs) to production. * Experience with frameworks such as vLLM is a plus. * Experience with distributed systems and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop). * Experience with event\-driven or streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis). * Knowledge of cloud security, IAM, and compliance best practices for ML workloads. * LLM application development, including prompt engineering and evaluation. **What Values You'll Share** * Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them. * Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. * No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. * One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. The target annual base pay range for this role is $152,900 \- $203,800 This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here. We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. *We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact* *careers@simplisafe.com**.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: SingleStore is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to operate at the intersection of solution architecture, technical delivery, and customer partnership. This role combines elements of a solutions architect, technical account manager, and solution engineer, with a strong emphasis on execution. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Job Summary** **Job Description** Senior AI Engineer (Contract) – Applied GenAI / Full Stack High\-Level Summary / Team Need I’m looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform Team to help build secure, scalable, and reusable enterprise AI capabilities. This team enables safe, fast AI adoption across the enterprise by delivering governed platform capabilities, reusable patterns, and enterprise AI solutions such as RAG\-based search, chat assistants, and agent/chatbot services aligned to enterprise business domains. This is a high\-output, highly collaborative, hands\-on engineering role focused on building and shipping production\-ready AI solutions — not a research role and not a purely architectural role. This role should skew toward backend/platform engineering, and the engineer needs to be able to operate across the full solution lifecycle — including infrastructure as code, APIs/services, cloud deployment, data storage, and production\-ready delivery. Our team builds reusable AI platform components and domain\-aligned AI solutions while working within guardrails related to privacy, security, compliance, observability, and engineering standards. We are not building frontend/UI applications on this team today; this role is centered on backend services, platform capabilities, and cloud\-native delivery. **Required** * 6–8 years of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on development experience in modern application engineering. * Strong experience with Node.js / TypeScript; this is the non\-negotiable primary language requirement for the role. * Strong experience building backend/platform\-oriented full\-stack solutions, including APIs, services, databases, cloud deployment, and operational support. * Strong AWS experience is required. * Candidates should have hands\-on experience with services such as API Gateway, Lambda, Bedrock, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, CloudWatch, CDK, and Fargate. Bedrock is required. * Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) is required, ideally with strong hands\-on use of AWS CDK. CDK is explicitly required for this role. * At least 1 year of hands\-on experience building Generative AI solutions, ideally in RAG/search\-based AI, chatbot/copilot experiences, or enterprise knowledge assistants. RAG/chatbot experience is sufficient for this hire * Practical understanding of prompt engineering and how prompt design impacts grounding, reliability, usability, and output quality. * Working knowledge of retrieval and generation concepts such as embeddings, chunking, semantic retrieval, vector search, top\-k, top\-p, and related controls that influence response behavior and quality. * Basic hands\-on familiarity with guardrails / safety controls / output validation, including awareness of risks like hallucinations, prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and content\-safety concerns. * Experience building and shipping enterprise\-grade APIs/services that connect AI capabilities into real business workflows. * Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, debugging, source control, and CI/CD.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** =================== Smurfit WestRock is seeking a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to identify, develop, and deploy emerging technologies that create measurable operational value across our manufacturing network. Working at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, software, data, and artificial intelligence, the FDE partners directly with operations, maintenance, engineering, and technology teams to solve real\-world industrial challenges. Unlike traditional engineering or software development roles, the FDE owns the full innovation lifecycle: problem discovery, solution design, deployment, performance measurement, continuous improvement, and enterprise scaling. The ideal candidate is a technically versatile problem solver who is equally comfortable on a manufacturing floor, writing code, and collaborating with operators to improve plant performance. **How you will impact Smurfit Westrock** ======================================== **Industrial Problem Discovery** -------------------------------- * Partner with plant personnel to identify operational, reliability, safety, quality, and productivity challenges. * Spend time in manufacturing environments to understand processes, equipment, workflows, and constraints. * Translate operational opportunities into scalable technical solutions and evaluate them based on business impact and implementation feasibility. **Solution Development** ------------------------ * Design and develop solutions using technologies such as artificial intelligence and generative AI, computer vision, Industrial IoT, robotics and autonomous systems, edge computing, advanced sensors and instrumentation, digital twins, industrial analytics, advanced process control, and cloud and data platforms. * Rapidly prototype and validate concepts. * Develop software applications, integrations, dashboards, and automation solutions. **Technology Deployment** ------------------------- * Deploy solutions in production manufacturing environments and integrate them with PLCs, DCS, SCADA platforms, historians, industrial networks, and enterprise data systems. * Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, controls, and network layers. * Ensure reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, and user adoption. **Continuous Improvement and Scaling** -------------------------------------- * Measure and communicate business results, then refine deployed solutions based on operational feedback. * Develop standards and best practices that enable enterprise\-wide deployment. * Support replication of successful solutions across multiple facilities. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** ----------------------------------- * Work closely with operations, maintenance, process and control engineering, OT/IT, data science, technology vendors, and business leadership. * Communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **What you will need to succeed** ================================= * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, robotics, automation, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent industrial, military, skilled\-trades, or demonstrated technical experience may be considered. * Experience applying technology solutions in industrial or manufacturing environments. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to work independently in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments. * Willingness to travel to manufacturing facilities as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ Experience in several of the following areas: * **Industrial Technology:** Process control, automation systems, PLC programming, DCS, SCADA/HMI platforms, industrial networking, OT architecture, and industrial cybersecurity. * **Software and Data:** Python, C\#, JavaScript, SQL, API development and integration, data engineering, cloud platforms, and application development. * **Emerging Technology:** Artificial intelligence and machine learning, generative AI, computer vision, robotics, edge computing, digital twins, and advanced analytics. * **Operational Excellence:** Manufacturing optimization, reliability improvement, asset performance management, continuous improvement, and Lean manufacturing. **Desired Characteristics** =========================== The successful candidate will: * Demonstrate strong curiosity about emerging technologies and passion for solving challenging industrial problems. * Enjoy building, testing, and deploying solutions. * Bring a hands\-on mindset and willingness to work directly with equipment and systems. * Learn new technologies quickly and independently. * Communicate effectively across organizational levels. * Take ownership from concept through deployment and drive work to completion. * Balance innovation with operational reliability and safety. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Success in this role is measured by the ability to: * Identify high\-value opportunities within manufacturing operations. * Rapidly develop and deploy practical technology solutions. * Improve safety, reliability, quality, productivity, and cost performance. * Drive measurable business outcomes through innovation. * Scale successful technologies across multiple facilities. * Become a trusted technical advisor to manufacturing operations. **Why Join the Emerging Technology Team?** ========================================== This team is focused on transforming manufacturing through the application of advanced technologies. We move quickly, test ideas in real\-world conditions, and deliver solutions that create measurable operational impact. **Find the problem. Build the solution. Deploy it. Measure it. Improve it. Scale it.** We're looking for engineers, builders, innovators, and problem\-solvers who want to shape the future of manufacturing technology.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Spam and Abuse
jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for the Spam \& Abuse team at Snap! Spam \& Abuse protects the integrity of every Snapchat account. We keep spam, bot, and automated accounts off the platform, from the device and registration through everything those accounts do afterwards. We keep the rightful owner in control of their account by detecting and stopping account takeover and securing login, recovery, and sessions. We track how adversaries operate off\-platform and turn that into live defenses. And we run the shared detection and enforcement platform that makes real\-time decisions on accounts and publishes account risk that teams across Snap act on. Alongside this, our Secure Mobile Client team builds the client and backend mechanisms behind sensitive flows like registration, login, and recovery, as well as on\-device safety surfaces such as in\-app reporting and end\-to\-end encryption. As the team's technical lead, you'll work across all of these areas. You'll set the technical vision and architecture for how we detect, decide, and enforce, make the hard calls on where to invest, and raise the bar for how the whole team builds and operates its systems. What you'll do: * Set the technical vision and multi\-year architecture for Spam \& Abuse, spanning spam and bot detection, account takeover defense, the detection and enforcement platform, and secure mobile client flows * Lead the design of the team's most complex, cross\-cutting systems, and review the designs of others to keep the architecture coherent across areas * Drive technical strategy with engineering managers and product, and turn it into roadmaps that teams can execute against * Mentor and grow engineers across the team, from new hires to senior engineers, and build a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and operational rigor * Partner with engineering, product, data science, operations, policy, and legal teams across Snap to integrate account risk and enforcement into their surfaces * Raise the reliability, latency, and quality bar of systems in the critical path for registration, login, and messaging, and lead technical response to major spam, abuse, and security incidents * Stay ahead of how adversaries adapt, and make sure our defenses are designed to hold up when they do Utilize AI tools to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production readiness * Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: * Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating large\-scale, low\-latency distributed backend systems * Strong understanding of spam, fraud, fake account, account takeover, or other adversarial abuse problems, and how to defend against them * Proven ability to set technical direction across multiple teams or areas and get alignment from engineers, managers, and partners * Skilled at solving open, ambiguous problems and making sound tradeoffs between speed, precision, and impact on legitimate users * Strong mentorship skills and a track record of making the engineers around you better * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences * Proficiency in languages such as Go, Java, or Python, and comfort working with big data tools such as BigQuery * Deep respect for user privacy and security Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks * Minimum Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science or equivalent practical experience * 9\+ years of software development experience; or Master’s degree with 8\+ years of experience; or PhD with 5\+ years of experience * Experience as a technical lead, domain expert or owner of complex technical initiatives Experience building systems that detect or mitigate spam, abuse, fraud, account takeover, or other malicious behavior * Preferred Qualifications: * Experience leading trust, integrity, anti\-abuse, or account security engineering at a large consumer platform * Experience with real\-time risk scoring and enforcement systems, and working with machine learning teams to put models into production * Experience with authentication, identity, session security, or mobile client security * Experience with security\-sensitive client and backend systems such as device attestation or end\-to\-end encryption * Track record of setting multi\-year technical strategy and delivering it through others "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week. Develops Tableau Reports. 2\. Develop strategies for data acquisitions, data quality and data discrepancy. 4\. Assist in migration and integration of data and processes from legacy systems to new applications and new technologies. 5\. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Solid State Operations is seeking a Software Engineer to help design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions that support government agencies and public\-sector services. The ideal candidate will have experience developing reliable applications, integrating software systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and working collaboratively with engineering and product teams. In this role, you will contribute to cloud\-based platforms and enterprise software used to modernize government operations. You will help build maintainable software, improve system performance, and deliver dependable solutions that meet technical and business requirements. Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and platform features. * Write clean, secure, and maintainable code using appropriate programming languages and frameworks. * Develop and integrate APIs, databases, and external software services. * Troubleshoot application defects and resolve performance and reliability issues. * Participate in code reviews, software testing, and release processes. * Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and technical stakeholders. * Support cloud\-based application deployments and system integrations. * Maintain technical documentation and development standards. * Identify opportunities to improve application quality, scalability, and security. * Contribute to ongoing improvements to enterprise and government software platforms. Required Skills * Experience in software development or software engineering. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, C\#, Python, or JavaScript. * Understanding of object\-oriented programming and software design principles. * Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, and API development. * Knowledge of software testing, debugging, and version control. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
