jobs.title: AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: As an AI Engineering Manager at Solstice, you will play a pivotal role in driving AI initiatives across various business functions using multiple technology platforms. You will translate cutting\-edge AI \& Automation research into practical enterprise solutions while collaborating with technical and business teams to maximize AI's transformative impact on operational efficiency and strategic outcomes. **About Solstice Advanced Materials** Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high\-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next\-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™, and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, Solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit Advanced Materials . Key Responsibilities * Lead and manage a team of AI engineers to deliver highquality, innovative AI solutions * Design, develop, and implement cuttingedge AI algorithms and models to address business challenges * Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and processes * Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members, ensuring best practices in AI development * Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI to drive continuous improvement As an AI Engineering Manager at Solstice, you will play a pivotal role in driving AI initiatives across various business functions using multiple technology platforms. You will translate cutting\-edge AI \& Automation research into practical enterprise solutions while collaborating with technical and business teams to maximize AI's transformative impact on operational efficiency and strategic outcomes. You will report to our Director IT, AI, Analytics \& Automation who oversees our enterprise data strategy, delivery and platform operations. This position is ideal for a strategic thinker \& doer who can bring automation, process optimization and Agentic AI together driving digital transformation to new frontiers by moving from insights to action with AI/ Gen AI advances. You will work out of the Morris Plains, NJ location. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Technical Expertise \& Delivery: Serve as a versatile hands\-on subject matter expert across AI/ Gen AI technologies with a comprehensive understanding of both technical processes and business operations to delivery enterprise grade solutions. Implement the MLOps/LLMOps, Cloud DevSecOps practice \& package AI solutions for production. Service Delivery Leadership: * Lead the design, build, and implement enterprise AI Systems that meet complex business requirements while ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with enterprise objectives. Oversee Gen AI, Classical and Automation initiatives across Enterprise functions such as Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial, Customer Experience, Legal, HR and others. * Own Speed to Delivery: * Accelerate Applied AI Initiatives by creating a rapid iteration loop from idea to execution in line with responsible AI principles. * Guide and technically steer Corporate AI Risk Council balancing risk, compliance and speed for Gen AI adoption. Drive evaluation \& observability first mindset bringing Gen AI reliability to the center stage. Strategize around creating a robust data flywheel ensuring a roadmap for continuous learning systems. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: * Partner across business, technology, architecture, and security teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver secure, scalable AI solutions. * Develop practical standards and guidance for responsible, classification\-aware AI and Gen AI adoption. Raise the AI Bar: * Translate and align key research \& engineering advancements in AI into actionable strategy for Solstice Advanced Materials, pushing the envelope with state of art, robust \& reliable enterprise ready AI solutions. **YOU MUST HAVE** * Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in AI solution delivery, with a demonstrated impact across multiple functional domains. * Strong understanding of core AI concepts, including both foundational principles and hands\-on practical applications with demonstrated experience of productionizing enterprise grade solutions. * Proficiency in multiple AI/ML \& Automation tools such as Azure AI / Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, Cognitive services \& Bot frameworks, Microsoft Power Platform, Workato, OutSystems, Automation Anywhere or similar, with a strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in automation. * Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, SFDC, HCM and other similar enterprise applications to create seamless AI \& automation solutions. * Proven track record in developing, architecting end\-to\-end AI \& Automation solutions that integrate multiple systems and deliver measurable business value. **WE VALUE** * Python experience for AI/ML workflows strongly preferred. * Experience building agent\-based systems with tool use, reasoning workflows, and API orchestration. * Experience developing AI applications with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, and orchestration frameworks. * Solid understanding of AI security practices including RBAC/ABAC, audit logging, and prompt\-level safeguards. * Experience optimizing vector databases and semantic search technologies for large datasets. * Experience with compound AI architectures, retrieval pipelines, and Azure/Databricks DevOps or MLOps practices. * Experience integrating AI solutions into enterprise channels such as Teams, Web Chat, or Direct Line. * Ability to quickly understand new functional domains, technical environments, business processes, and requirements, and translate them into effective automation solutions. * Exceptional analytical thinking and creative problem\-solving skills in complex technical and business contexts. * Ability to translate AI technical concepts for audiences at various levels. * Ownership and Pride in your work and willingness to work in a diverse, cross\-functional environment. Attention to detail. * Proven ability to partner with diverse stakeholders, identify automation improvements, and understand data needs across discrete and continuous manufacturing processes. * Experience of working closely with managed services providers to ensure effective support and management of automation processes. * Prior publication record in top tier journals or conferences such as NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, MICA or similar. **COMPENSATION** The annual base salary range for this position is $201\-063\-251,622\. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Solstice considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR SOLSTICE ADVANCED MATERIALS** In addition to a competitive salary, leading\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Solstice Advanced Materials employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer\-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Solstice Advanced Materials is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI Native
jobs.description: Join the **Sony Engagement Platform Services (SEPS)** Team, where innovation meets collaboration in the dynamic world of digital engagement. At SEPS, we are building the next\-generation platform that powers how fans connect with the content—and the creators—they love. Our mission is to unlock meaningful, data\-driven engagement across Sony’s entertainment ecosystem, from games and anime to music, film, and live experiences—empowering both internal teams and external partners to build at scale. Our mission is to create a world\-class engagement platform that not only enhances existing revenue streams but also drives new opportunities through a robust ecosystem of partners and creators. By decoupling application development from platform services, we empower our teams to deliver exceptional solutions with agility and efficiency. If you are passionate about shaping the future of digital engagement and want to be part of a vibrant community that values creativity and collaboration, we invite you to explore the exciting opportunities within our team. Together, we will shape the future of fan experiences and define the foundation for what’s possible in the realm of engagement. To learn more visit: www.sony.com/en/SonyInfo/technology/stories/entries/sep\_introduction/ **POSITION SUMMARY** SEPS is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI\-Native Staff Software Engineer to support the development of the applications that power the Sony Engagement Platform. In this role, you will design and build secure, scalable, and high\-performing solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences across Sony's global ecosystem. As a Staff Engineer, you will contribute to both front\-end and back\-end systems, playing a hands\-on role in architecture, implementation, and technical leadership. You will operate as part of an AI\-native tiny team, directing and governing AI agents across the full delivery lifecycle. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to build robust, maintainable applications. This is a dynamic opportunity for individuals who thrive in a fast\-paced, innovation\-driven environment and are passionate about solving complex challenges with clean, thoughtful code. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Architect, design and develop RESTful API Endpoints, ensuring high performance, scalability and maintainability. * Collaborate closely with front\-end engineers to build dynamic, responsive, and user\-centric web applications that deliver seamless user experiences. * Define robust data models and database schemas, and manage relational or NoSQL databases with a strong emphasis on data integrity and performance optimization. * Direct and govern AI coding agents across the delivery lifecycle, setting context, reviewing agent\-generated output, and enforcing SEPS delivery standards at every gate. * Design and maintain agent workflows using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and the AI\- native development framework, ensuring structured, auditable, and high\-quality delivery. * Configure and maintain prompt engineering patterns, structured output schemas, with rules and guardrails to align agent behavior with SEPS platform standards. * Trace, debug, and triage agent tool calls, prompt failures, and unexpected outputs, maintaining visibility into AI\-assisted delivery at every stage. * Create and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for application architecture, design, configuration, and ongoing maintenance. * Provide accurate task estimations and delivery timelines, contributing to effective sprint planning and execution. * Participate in the on\-call rotation, responding promptly to production issues and ensuring system stability and uptime. * Mentor and support junior engineers, fostering a culture of AI\-native ways of working, learning, and continuous improvement. Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above * **QUALIFICATIONS FOR POSITION** **Your qualifications and experience should include:** * 8\+ years professional experience working with medium/large complex code bases * Experience in Full Stack development * Experience with one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Go, or Python * Experience in REST API design and implementation * Highly Proficient in HTML, CSS, the JavaScript ecosystem and familiarity with popular frameworks like React, Angular, Ember, Jest, Babel, and TypeScript * Knowledgeable in UI/UX design principles * Demonstrated proficiency with AI\-native coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) as a primary delivery vehicle, not a productivity add\-on * Working knowledge of prompt engineering, context management, and structured output patterns * Familiarity with agent development concepts, tool use, function calling, approvals, and workflow chaining * Awareness of secure AI coding practices including prompt injection, sandbox basics, and ac * We are committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for you to thrive as part of Sony’s purpose to “fill the world with emotion through the power of creativity and technology.” **Benefits:** SCA offers benefits\-eligible employees (generally regular employees scheduled to work 20 or more hours a week) a comprehensive benefits program that offers coverage and support for employees and their family’s physical, emotional, and financial well\-being. **What we offer you:** * Comprehensive medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage with coverage for spouses/domestic partners and child dependents, including access to a Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Employee assistance plan and comprehensive behavioral health benefits * Fertility benefits, including, surrogacy, and adoption assistance programs * Basic and supplemental life insurance for employees as well as supplemental life insurance coverage for their spouses/domestic partners and children * Voluntary benefits such as group legal, identity theft protection, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance * Short\-term \& long\-term disability plans * Up to 12 weeks of paid parental and caregiver leave * 401(k) Plan with pre\-tax, Roth, and after\-tax options and company match with immediate vesting Education assistance and student loan programs * **Other Programs:** * Flexible Work Arrangements including hybrid work schedules * Time off to include vacation, paid holidays, sick leave, Summer Fridays (early release), and a winter break between Christmas and New Year’s Day (based on business needs) * Referral bonuses (subject to eligibility) * Matching gift program * A wide variety of employee business resource groups (EBRGs) * Special discounts on Sony products, offered exclusively to Sony employees Employee stock purchase plan (Sony covers commissions and fees for your Sony stock purchases made through after\-tax payroll deductions) * *T* *he anticipated annual base salary for this role is $220,000–$240,000 for the Los Angeles, CA office location and $200,000–$220,000 for San Diego, CA. jobs.title: Contract Software Development Engineer in Test - Subscription Platform
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. At PlayStation, we are passionate about delivering high\-quality experiences to millions of players worldwide. We are looking for an experienced, hands\-on Software Development Engineer in Test II (SDET II) to help build reliable, scalable Subscription and Streaming experiences. This opportunity is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, developing automation solutions, and improving quality across applications, services, and connected platforms. **Role Overview** ----------------- As an SDET , you will collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Quality Engineering teams to deliver subscription experiences across PlayStation platforms. You will take ownership of testing and automation for assigned features, contribute to technical solutions, and help improve how quality is built into the development process. Your work will span subscription and commerce services, backend APIs, mobile applications, gaming consoles, streaming services, and connected device experiences. You will have opportunities to expand your technical expertise while working with experienced engineers across multiple teams. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, develop, and improve automated testing solutions for subscription services, applications, and connected platforms. * Take ownership of quality engineering activities for assigned features, from test planning through automation and release validation. * Collaborate with engineering teams early in development to identify quality risks, improve testability, and determine effective testing approaches. * Develop reusable automation tools and framework capabilities that improve test coverage, reliability, and engineering efficiency. * Validate end\-to\-end customer journeys involving authentication, commerce, entitlements, subscription lifecycle management, retention, and streaming experiences. * Build automated tests for APIs, backend services, distributed systems, web applications, and native mobile platforms. * Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and contribute to improving test execution reliability and feedback. * Investigate complex failures, analyze root causes, and work with engineering teams to resolve issues. * Contribute to quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting that provide visibility into automation coverage and release readiness. * Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, reduce technical debt, and strengthen overall product quality. * Collaborate with globally distributed engineering and QE teams on integration testing and release qualification. * Explore emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted testing, to improve test development and engineering workflows. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in Software Development Engineering in Test, Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, or Test Automation. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Swift. * Experience developing automated tests and working with test automation frameworks. * Experience testing APIs, backend services, web applications, or native mobile applications. * Understanding of software testing methodologies, test design, and automation strategies. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern software development practices. * Experience investigating technical issues, debugging failures, and collaborating with engineering teams on solutions. * Ability to manage assigned work independently, communicate technical findings, and collaborate across teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with subscription platforms, commerce systems, payment processing, or entitlement services. * Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, or cloud\-based applications. * Experience with automation technologies such as XCUITest, Appium, Selenium, or API testing frameworks. * Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar development tools. * Experience testing streaming services, media playback, gaming consoles, or connected devices. * Experience with React Native or other cross\-platform application frameworks. * Experience developing end\-to\-end automation across client applications and backend services. * Familiarity with observability, telemetry, and quality reporting. * Exposure to AI\-assisted testing and automation tools. * Understanding of accessibility and localization testing practices. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- You enjoy understanding how systems work and finding practical ways to improve their quality. You are comfortable working across different technologies, investigating complex issues, and translating requirements into effective testing solutions. You bring hands\-on engineering experience, take ownership of your work, and collaborate with others to solve problems. You are interested in continuing to develop your technical expertise while contributing to reliable, high\-quality PlayStation experiences. Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Power Systems
jobs.description: **About Sparkfund** ------------------- Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large\-load customers to deploy front\-of\-the\-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on\-time, on\-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost. With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer\-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund, visit sparkfund.com. **Senior Engineer, Power Systems** ================================== **Remote – United States** **About the Role** ------------------ Sparkfund is looking for a Senior Engineer, Power Systems with deep experience in electric utility distribution systems, power systems analysis, and distributed energy resource (DER) interconnection to help advance the deployment of distributed energy infrastructure across multiple utility markets. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who wants to work beyond the boundaries of a traditional utility environment. Rather than focusing on a single utility territory, you'll collaborate with utility partners, technology providers, and internal teams to solve complex engineering challenges and develop scalable approaches to grid integration. As part of our Systems Engineering team, you'll serve as a technical expert supporting Sparkfund's Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) platform. You'll lead engineering work on assigned programs, from grid needs assessments and distribution system analysis through interconnection, protection coordination, and integration with utility operational systems. This role combines hands\-on engineering expertise with direct utility engagement. You'll work closely with utility planning, protection, and operations teams to address technical requirements, move interconnection reviews toward approval, and ensure that distributed energy assets can be safely and effectively integrated into the grid. You'll also partner across Sparkfund with Commercialization, Program Management, and Project Delivery to support technical feasibility, program design, and successful deployment. This is a senior individual contributor position reporting to the Director, Power Systems Engineering. The role requires a high degree of technical independence, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to navigate complex utility requirements while developing repeatable solutions that can be applied across markets. **How We Work at Sparkfund** ---------------------------- Our values shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for our customers and each other. They are also part of how we evaluate success at Sparkfund. ### **Excellence** We hold ourselves to high standards and continuously look for ways to improve. In this role, Excellence means applying sound engineering judgment, maintaining technical accuracy, and delivering high\-quality engineering work that meets utility requirements and industry standards. It also means continuously improving our technical approaches, solving complex problems, and developing scalable solutions that support reliable grid integration. ### **Stewardship** We take ownership, follow through on our commitments, and make thoughtful decisions with the long term in mind. For this role, Stewardship means taking accountability for engineering decisions, recognizing the operational and financial impacts of technical recommendations, and balancing safety, reliability, cost, and deployment requirements. It also means building trust with utility partners and making decisions that support long\-term grid performance and responsible use of resources. ### **Positivity** We approach challenges constructively, assume positive intent, support one another, and bring solutions. For this role, Positivity means approaching complex engineering and utility challenges with a collaborative, solutions\-oriented mindset. It means communicating technical concerns clearly and respectfully, working through differences in engineering approaches, and helping internal teams and utility partners find practical paths forward. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Lead Utility Engineering \& Interconnection** * Serve as a primary day\-to\-day engineering contact for utility distribution planning, protection, and interconnection teams on assigned programs. * Lead technical discussions with utility partners to resolve engineering questions and advance interconnection reviews toward approval. * Prepare and present engineering  enges, and build credibility through your expertise and practical approach. ### **Independent Technical Ownership** You can take responsibility for complex engineering workstreams, establish priorities, evaluate technical risks, and move work forward without requiring extensive oversight. You know when to make a recommendation, when to collaborate, and when to escalate an issue. ### **Engineering Scalability** You look beyond the immediate project and identify opportunities to develop repeatable processes, engineering standards, and technical solutions. You understand the importance of building approaches that can work across different utilities, markets, and deployment environments. ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** You work effectively with engineering, commercial, program management, and project delivery teams. You understand how technical decisions affect schedules, budgets, customer commitments, and operational outcomes. ### **Problem\-Solving Under Complexity** You can navigate varying utility requirements, evolving technical standards, and complex engineering challenges. You balance technical rigor with practical implementation and can develop solutions when the path forward isn't immediately clear. **Compensation** ---------------- The approved salary range for this position is **$145,000–$180,000**, based on experience, qualifications, and location. Where applicable, this position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Any such compensation is separate from base salary and is not guaranteed. Eligibility, amounts, and payment are subject to applicable plan terms, company performance, individual performance, and other business considerations. **Benefits** ------------ Sparkfund offers a competitive benefits package that includes: * Employer\-subsidized medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance * 401(k) plan with a 2% employer match * Flexible vacation policy * Paid federal holidays * Flexible Fridays (half\-day Fridays every week) * 12 weeks of gender\-neutral paid caregiver leave * One\-time work\-from\-home stipend for eligible remote roles * Monthly phone and internet allowance **Work Environment** -------------------- Sparkfund is a remote\-first company with emerging hub offices in Denver, Minneapolis, and Washington, DC. This position is remote within the United States, with occasional travel of approximately 15% for utility partner meetings, project site visits, company gatherings, industry conferences, and business development activities. The role is primarily performed in a remote office environment, with periodic visits to utility and project sites. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Sparkfund is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Sparkfund also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, in all phases of the hiring process and throughout employment. If you need an accommodation, please let us know. **Disclaimer** -------------- This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties, responsibilities, and requirements may change at any time based on business needs. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply — even if you do not meet every listed qualification — as skills and competencies can develop in different ways.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **The Team** ------------ The Data team builds and runs the systems that make Stability AI's data usable, both to operate the business and to train our models. We're a small, collaborative team that works closely with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research. We focus on outcomes rather than hours, and you'll have deep technical access and the freedom to build. **Our stack:** AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, EMR, Step Functions, EventBridge), Iceberg, dbt, Postgres, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, QuickSight, Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, Customer.io, PostHog, OpenTelemetry and SLURM — or similar. We care about the judgement more than the logo. **The Work** ------------ You'll own our company data platform end to end: the AWS data lake, the transformation layer, the integrations between our business systems, and the Kubernetes\-based infrastructure they run on. The data that runs the business (billing, usage telemetry, identity, CRM, ERP, cloud cost) lives in a dozen systems that were never wired together. You'll be the engineer who connects them and keeps them reliable. You'll also be the data engineer for our research teams across audio, video, image and 3D, building the pipelines that turn raw media into training\-ready datasets. This is a hands\-on role with real ownership, not a data\-prep or analyst seat. * **Own** the company data platform end to end: the S3/Athena/Glue lake, the dbt project and its daily build, ingestion from Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, OpenTelemetry and product events, and the Postgres serving layer for dashboards and AI agents * **Build and operate** integrations between billing, CRM, ERP, identity and telemetry systems so revenue, usage, cost and customer identity reconcile automatically instead of through spreadsheets and tickets * **Design and maintain** the warehouse layer: dimensional models, data contracts with product engineering for event schemas, quality tests, lineage and a catalog * **Enforce** PII tiering (open vs. restricted schemas) through access grants, working with Security and Legal * **Process** data at scale: billions of telemetry rows, terabyte log streams, Iceberg tables, partitioning and cost control * **Own** orchestration and infrastructure: orchestration on EKS, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and join the business\-hours on\-call rotation for the daily pipelines * **Deliver** operational reporting for Finance and leadership: revenue by business line, credits and prepaid liability, and cloud cost by department * **Support** the research teams across every modality: source, license\-check, ingest and version large training datasets for audio, video, image and 3D * **Build** the generation, filtering, deduplication and captioning pipelines that turn raw or synthetic media into training\-ready shards, and run them at scale on our SLURM cluster and cloud object storage * **Keep** lineage, quality metrics and dataset documentation current so any researcher can reproduce a training set * **Lead** design reviews, mentor teammates and write the runbooks that remove single\-person dependencies * **Partner** with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research on company\-wide data initiatives **What You Bring** ------------------ We're looking for an engineer who pairs strong software engineering habits with warehouse. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering habits with warehouse modelling depth, and the judgement to say what a number means and what it does not. ### **Experience** * 6\+ years building and running production data platforms, including ownership of the architecture * Experience integrating SaaS business systems (Stripe, HubSpot, an ERP, an identity provider) into a warehouse * Production experience preparing large multimodal training datasets and running batch workloads on HPC or cloud schedulers (SLURM, Kubernetes or similar) * Comfort working independently in a small team with real ownership ### **Skills \& Expertise** * Expert SQL and Python, with strong software engineering habits: tests, code review and CI * Warehouse and lake experience with real modelling: Iceberg or Delta on S3, Athena/Trino, Snowflake or BigQuery, and dbt * An orchestrator in production (dbt, Airflow or Argo) and distributed processing (Spark or equivalent) * AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm and Terraform — you can debug a failing Glue job and a broken Helm release ### **Additional Strengths** * Prior 0\-to\-1 platform ownership at a startup * Experience working with research teams on generative models, or hands\-on exposure to audio, video, image or 3D data * FinOps and cloud cost reporting * Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar compliance requirements for data access **Benefits \& Compensation** ---------------------------- * Health coverage for you and your family. Choose from PPO and HMO plans, including select plans where Stability AI covers 100% of premiums for you and your eligible dependents. * HSA and FSA accounts to set aside pre\-tax dollars for healthcare and other eligible expenses. * Company\-paid life insurance, with the option to add voluntary coverage for yourself, your spouse, and your children. * Short\- and long\-term disability coverage, to protect part of your income if illness or injury keeps you from working. * 401(k) with company match of up to 4%. * Paid parental leave to support you as your family grows. * Flexible paid time off, plus paid company holidays. * The equipment you need to do your best work, provided by Stability AI. At Stability AI, we aim to pay fairly and competitively, and we believe you should know what a role pays before you invest time in getting to know us. **The annual base salary range for this role is $175,500 \- $230,000 USD.** It reflects our good\-faith expectation for the role as posted and applies to candidates hired within the United States. Where you fall within that range depends on the depth and relevance of your experience, your skills, and how you perform in our interview process. Because great candidates don't always map neatly to a single level, we may also consider someone for a level above or below the one posted. If we do, the range will be adjusted to match, and we'll talk it through with you openly. Base salary is also just one part of your total compensation. Eligible employees take part in our equity program and receive the benefits described above. We'd rather talk about all of this early than leave you guessing, so your recruiter is happy to walk you through the range, how offers come together, and anything else that matters to you, at any point in the process.

jobs.description: 1\.0 FTE Full time Day \- 08 Hour R2656602 Hybrid 108480039 TDS Data Science Innovation Technology \& Digital Solutions PALO ALTO, 1830 Embarcadero, California If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered. Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.** **A Brief Overview** The Product Engineer – AI/ML bridges technical strategy, hands\-on software development, and applied AI delivery. Operating in a forward\-deployed capacity, this role works directly with operational and clinical stakeholders to uncover root challenges, prototype solutions, and build high\-value AI capabilities. Unlike traditional product or project management roles focused solely on static specifications, the Product Engineer – AI/ML maintains end\-to\-end execution ownership—writing production\-capable code, configuring AI model workflows (such as RAG and foundation APIs), and driving initial 0 1 implementation. Working alongside Data Scientists and Core Platform Engineering this role ensures AI solutions deliver measurable impact. **Locations** Stanford Health Care **What you will do** * Partner directly with operational and clinical teams to probe and identify root\-cause challenges rather than passively receiving feature requests. * Design, build, and iterate on working prototypes using programming languages such as Python, modern APIs, LLM orchestration frameworks, and retrieval systems. * Evaluate operational bottlenecks to determine whether simple automation, rule\-based logic, or generative AI models represent the best technical approach. * Balance technical tradeoffs across model accuracy, execution latency, maintainability, and operational inference costs. * Integrate prototypes with health system data stores, enterprise APIs, and operational workflow tools. * Collaborate with Data Science teammates to pass solutions through formal evaluation harnesses prior to enterprise deployment. * Participate in constructing test suites to measure and mitigate model hallucinations, errors of omission, and factual inaccuracies. * Ensure alignment with healthcare data privacy policies, HIPAA regulations, and institutional AI governance standards. * Partner with Data and Software Engineers to transition validated prototypes to enterprise\-grade platforms. **Education Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). Master’s degree preferred. * **Experience Qualifications** * 3–5\+ years of progressive experience in data science, software engineering, applied AI engineering, or technical product development. Experience working in healthcare, health tech, or complex regulated enterprise environments. * **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem\-solving, and analytical skills. * Knowledge and understanding of healthcare informatics related technologies and standards. Proven ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. * **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience working with REST APIs, web services, and modern development workflows. * Hands\-on experience with foundation model APIs, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks. * Familiarity with enterprise data structures, cloud data platforms, and data privacy governance. Strong ability to analyze operational workflows, probe for root causes, and translate business needs into technical solutions. * **Physical Demands and Work Conditions** **Blood Borne Pathogens** * Category II \- Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks **These principles apply to ALL employees:** **SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient \& Family Experience** *Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C\-I\-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient\-experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.* *You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:* * Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care * Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health * Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination **Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination in****all of****its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.** Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $81\.59 \- $108\.12 per hour The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Enterprise Application Development
jobs.description: We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join our Enterprise Application Development team and help build the software that runs our retail convenience store business. Our team designs, develops, maintains, and supports applications in\-house, giving engineers the chance to work directly with the business and see the impact of what they build. We work across a broad range of applications, systems, and business processes, so there's always something new to learn. This is a mid\-level role for someone with professional experience and technical confidence who can contribute independently, bring fresh perspective to the team, and keep growing their technical and business knowledge. What You'll Do: * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise applications. * Analyze complex technical and business problems and develop effective solutions. * Work with business analysts, stakeholders, and technical team members to understand requirements and business processes. * Contribute to technical designs and application architecture. * Develop and support RESTful APIs, backend services, and system integrations. * Participate in peer code reviews and collaborative development practices. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions. * Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and security. * Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve applications and business processes. * Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute ideas that improve how we build and support software. What Sets You Apart: * A self\-starter who takes ownership and moves work forward without constant direction. * Naturally curious about how systems, technology, and the business behind them work. * An engaged contributor who brings ideas, asks questions, and looks for better ways to solve problems. * Comfortable working through unfamiliar problems and picking up new technologies. * Able to respectfully challenge existing approaches and contribute to technical decisions. * A strong communicator who works effectively with both technical and non\-technical people. * Takes pride in building quality software and improving the systems and processes around it. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience. * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Strong understanding of software development fundamentals and strongly typed programming languages such as C\#, Java, Kotlin, or similar. * Proficiency with SQL and relational databases. * Professional experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency working with Linux\-based containers and containerized applications. * Solid understanding of container orchestration concepts. * Experience with source control, code reviews, testing, debugging, and modern software development practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: * C\# / .NET * Spring Boot * Kotlin * SQL Server * PostgreSQL * Docker * Linux / Ubuntu * Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines * CI/CD practices * Microservices architecture * Automated testing * AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar Our Technology Our development environment includes: .NET \| Spring Boot \| Kotlin \| SQL Server \| PostgreSQL \| RESTful APIs \| Docker \| Azure DevOps \| Azure Pipelines \| Git \| Linux/Ubuntu You won't need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to learn. Our containerized environment is continuing to evolve, with container orchestration part of our longer\-term technology roadmap. Benefits: * Starting Pay: $85,000 \- $100,000/year salary. * 100% company paid retirement\- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * Health, Vision \& Dental benefit package. * YMCA discount program. * Monday \- Friday (in office). As you grow into the role, you'll take on rotating after\-hours on\-call support. Why Join Us? You'll work on software that matters to the business, alongside a team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. You'll work across a diverse technology landscape, learn how a complex retail organization operates, and help shape the future of our applications. If you're curious, engaged, and want to build more than just software, we'd like to meet you. To help provide our employees with a safe work environment, we are a drug free workplace.

jobs.title: Materials Physics Scientist
jobs.description: #### **Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.** **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- **Materials Physics Scientist:** * We are seeking a highly motivated Research Scientist to drive various types of physical chemical problems in continuous fiber\-reinforced polymer composites and prepreg technologies. * This role will drive experimental research aimed at developing fundamental structure\-process\-property relationships related to salient performance relative to composite applications. * This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of polymer science, composite mechanics, microstructural characterization, and materials engineering to solve technically challenging problems with direct relevance to advanced composite material development. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and execute research projects/programs focused on continuous fiber\-reinforced polymer composites, prepregs, and their constituent materials. * Characterize composite and prepreg microstructures and establish quantitative relationships between microstructural features, processing history, and resulting material performance. * Investigate parameters such as fiber distribution and alignment, resin\-rich regions, porosity/voids, fiber–matrix interfaces, local heterogeneity, and other microstructural features relevant to composite performance. * Utilize micromechanical testing methods, including laboratory micromechanical test frames, to investigate deformation, damage initiation, damage evolution, and failure mechanisms in unidirectional plies, prepregs, and representative composite architectures. * Apply microscopy, image analysis, mechanical testing, and complementary characterization techniques to understand composite structure–property relationships. * Develop mechanistic understanding of failure modes and connect observations across length scales, from constituent and microstructural behavior to bulk composite performance. * Investigate the chemistry, morphology, and physical state of thermoset and/or thermoplastic resin systems used in advanced composites, including changes occurring during processing and cure. * Evaluate relationships among resin formulation, cure history, phase behavior and morphology, network development, and resulting mechanical performance. * Where appropriate, apply analytical, statistical, computational, or micromechanical modeling approaches to interpret experimental results and develop predictive structure–property relationships. * Develop test methods and experimental approaches needed to address new materials questions where established methods are insufficient. * Work collaboratively with polymer scientists, materials scientists, engineers, modeling specialists, and manufacturing/process development teams. * Translate fundamental scientific findings into actionable guidance for material formulation, prepreg design, processing, and product development. * Document experimental methods, data, analyses, and conclusions with a high standard of scientific rigor and reproducibility and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Experience and Skills** ------------------------- **Required Qualifications:** * Ph.D. in Materials Science and Engineering, Polymer Science/Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related discipline. * Research experience with continuous fiber\-reinforced polymer composites, preferably including carbon fiber composites and prepreg materials. * Strong experimental background in composite materials characterization, mechanical testing, micromechanics, or structure–property relationships. * Demonstrated understanding of the mechanics and failure behavior of fiber\-reinforced composites, including damage and failure mechanisms in unidirectional composite systems. * Working knowledge of polymer matrix systems used in advanced composites, such as epoxy, thermoset, and/or high\-performance thermoplastic matrices. * Experience analyzing experimental data and developing scientifically defensible conclusions from complex materials datasets. * Demonstrated ability to independently formulate hypotheses, design experiments, troubleshoot experimental methods, and drive research programs from technical question through conclusion. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary R\&D teams. **Preferred Qualifications;** * Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable: * In\-silico/modeling skills set highly desired; finite element analysis, analytical micromechanics, multiscale modeling, or other computational approaches used to interpret composite behavior. * Python, MATLAB, statistical analysis software, image\-analysis tools, or other computational tools for experimental data analysis and visualization. * Microstructural characterization of composite prepregs and cured composites using optical microscopy, SEM, X\-ray CT, or related techniques. * Quantitative image analysis and statistical characterization of composite microstructures. * Thermoset cure chemistry and cure kinetics. * Polymer phase behavior, phase separation, morphology development, or structure evolution during cure and processing. * Toughened resin systems and an understanding of relationships among resin morphology, interfaces, and composite damage tolerance. **What We Offer** ----------------- **Competitive salary and benefits package:** * The U.S. base salary range reasonably expected to be paid for this position is $98,720\-$140,000 per year. Since actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted base salary range. Total compensation for this role also includes bonus and/or other incentives. * 16, or more, weeks of maternity/paternity and co\-parenting leave, according to local regulations * Training platform for all employees * Free language courses (24 languages available) * Free well\-being sessions (physical and psychological) * 401\-K Match About us * Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity. * At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. * Syensqo is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. \#LI\-Senior * \#LI\-Onsite * \#LI\-JM2

We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. Target is one of the world's most recognized brands and one of America's leading retailers. But behind the brand our guests love, is a culture of continual innovation and right now, we are up to big things! Target's security team is a place where innovation happens daily. Interested in a culture that combines ongoing learning, engineering excellence, and stellar outcomes? We are too – that's why we work here. Join our team to improve Target's security and move the business forward. As a Lead Engineer on the Cloud Security team, you'll be the senior software developer building and owning the services that turn Target's cloud security signal into action. Cloud Security at Target is one team with two engineering disciplines — platform engineers who deploy, tune, and operate the cloud security controls (CSPM/CNAPP, IaC scanning, admission control, SSPM, workload protection), and software engineers who build the services that aggregate, attribute, enrich, and distribute the findings those controls produce, plus the broader backend that the team's capabilities depend on. You will lead the software engineering side of that partnership. Beyond deep technical expertise, you have a strong bias for action and a builder's mindset. The team's software sits between the controls that produce findings and the product and platform engineers who have to act on them, and you are comfortable operating in that realm – translating security requirements into reliable, well\-tested backend services; owning the day\-to\-day operation and continuous improvement of the findings pipeline and adjacent services; coordinating APIs, data contracts, and developer\-experience tradeoffs with the platform engineers on your team and with the consumers of your services; and partnering with peers so cloud security findings flow into the enterprise remediation lifecycle. You have the engineering credibility to set technical direction for other software engineers on the team and the communication and partnership skills to make the services land well across Target. and partnership skills to make the controls land well across Target. **Expect to:** * Serve as the senior software engineering lead and hands\-on owner of the Cloud Security team's software portfolio — setting the technical direction, standards, and roadmap that other software engineers execute against. * Lead the design, development, and operation of the finding pipeline: services that ingest cloud security signal from CSPM/CNAPP, IaC scanning, admission control, SSPM, and workload protection; deduplicate and normalize it; enrich it with ownership attribution, severity, and business context; and route it to Target's enterprise remediation and governance workflows with SLAs so product and platform teams can act. Monitor feed completeness, freshness, and failures, and use remediation feedback to improve signal quality. * Design and build scalable backend services in Kotlin, Java, and Spring Boot — event\-driven where it fits, request/response where it doesn't — with clean APIs, clear data contracts, and the observability needed to run them well in production. * Own the ownership\-attribution problem end\-to\-end: the data model, the sources of truth, the reconciliation logic, and the feedback loops that keep attribution accurate as Target's cloud footprint evolves. * Own the noise\-reduction problem end\-to\-end on the software side: deduplication, correlation across sources, suppression logic, and enrichment — so every finding that reaches an engineer is worth their time. * Build the integrations and data contracts that connect the team's services into Target's enterprise ecosystem: SIEM/SOAR, remediation and governance workflows, ticketing, source control, CI/CD, and internal developer platforms. Partner with Network, Identity, Data Protection, SecOps, Vulnerability Management, ITDP, governance, and product/platform teams on tele : deduplication, correlation, suppression discipline, ownership attribution, and SLA\-based remediation * Track record of running production services with clear SLOs, on\-call coverage, change management, and continuous\-improvement loops * Experience driving multi\-quarter roadmaps end\-to\-end — from problem framing through rollout, adoption, and steady\-state operation — and delivering predictably against them * Comfortable making and defending pragmatic build\-vs\-buy decisions, and knowing when to invest in custom engineering vs. lean on an existing capability * Strong experience with relational databases, cloud\-based data warehouses, schema design, data migrations, and data lifecycle considerations for security services; experience with event\-streaming technologies such as Kafka or Pub/Sub. * Hands\-on experience with public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure experience also valued) and with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at enterprise scale * Strong understanding of automated testing — unit, integration, contract, regression, and end\-to\-end — and a demonstrated commitment to shipping code with tests, not around them * Strong understanding of observability practices and tools for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and service\-level objectives * Hands\-on experience integrating backend services with developer workflows (CI/CD, source control, ticketing) in a way that scales with a large engineering organization * Strong understanding of secure software development practices and modern cloud\-native architectures * Solid understanding of AI/ML and the emerging engineering considerations associated with it, including the responsible use of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tools such as Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex * Strong cross\-functional partner: comfortable working closely with a variety of security and product engineering teams to align requirements, rollout plans, and operational ownership * Effective at representing your work, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership, and equally effective explaining the same content to staff engineers in detail * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong presentation abilities * Demonstrated jobs.title: Engineer IV - Electrical
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** The Engineer IV – Electrical (Sustainability) provides specialized electrical engineering expertise and technical support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy\-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD). optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging assessments of existing electrical infrastructure, equipment, and associated building systems to evaluate current conditions, system performance, capacity, deficiencies, and opportunities for upgrades or improvements. * Develop existing conditions assessment reports documenting findings, technical deficiencies, infrastructure limitations, recommended upgrades or improvements, technical submittals, requests for information (RFIs), requests for clarification, and change order proposals; provide technical recommendations to Project Managers and appropriate decision\-makers. * engineering analyses and prepare technical reports supporting District design guidelines and applicable project requirements. * Support field visits, design and construction meetings, commissioning, facility design and/or construction projects, preferably within California community colleges or other public educational institutions. * Experience supporting large public works capital improvement programs. * Experience with electrical infrastructure assessments, load studies, utility coordination, and electrical service capacity evaluations. * Experience with Photovoltaic (PV) systems, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), microgrids, and electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. * Experience with building electrification, central plant electrical infrastructure, and integration with Building Management Systems (BMS) and building automation controls. * Experience reviewing electrical engineering designs, technical specifications, and construction documents. * Familiarity with Division of the State Architect (DSA) design, approval, and construction processes. * Experience utilizing Bluebeam Revu and Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and processes. * Experience and/or certification in Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) or Collaborative for High Performance Schools (CHPS) projects.
