jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Enterprise Modernization & AI Delivery
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. Our mission: Modernize global enterprises safely, automatically, and at unprecedented speed. We move fast, own outcomes end\-to\-end, and build at the frontier of applied AI for large\-scale transformation. **Role Summary** We are seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) with deep expertise in delivery and value stream management to lead our most strategic customer implementations. In this role, you are not just a project scheduler. You are the delivery leader who directs cross\-functional pods across multiple parallel workstreams, making sure Tessera’s multi\-agent AI solutions are integrated predictably, safely, and successfully into complex enterprise environments, and that every phase of the engagement delivers measurable value. You will be the bridge between Tessera and enterprise client’s delivery team spanning core business systems, ERP, CRM, finance, HR, and operational platforms. The role calls for strong technical fluency across enterprise architectures, business processes, integrations, and transformation programs. You will work closely with customer Solution Architects, technical teams, system owners, and business stakeholders, translating operational and technical requirements into actionable plans for Tessera’s delivery pods. You will use your understanding of enterprise modernization to guide issue resolution, support architecture discussions, and keep every workstream aligned on what is required, technically feasible, and most valuable to the customer. The ideal candidate has spent years leading delivery within System Integrator environments or large enterprises and wants to apply AI to accelerate modernization at scale. **Key Responsibilities** *Cross\-Functional Delivery Pod Leadership* * Lead cross\-functional delivery pods of Forward\-Deployed Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI engineering teams, setting priorities, removing blockers, and holding the team accountable to outcomes * Own end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-agent AI modernization programs from discovery through deployment and operational handoff * Build pod structures, cadences, and operating rhythms that scale across multiple concurrent customer engagements * Anticipate technical friction points related to data structures, legacy customizations, integrations, and workflow orchestration before they affect the pod’s velocity *Multi\-Workstream Orchestration* * Run multiple parallel workstreams across data, integration, AI agent configuration, testing, and business process alignment, managing dependencies and sequencing between them * Coordinate across Tessera teams, customer stakeholders, and third\-party vendors to maintain delivery momentum across every workstream * Develop integrated program plans that give leadership a single view of progress, risk, and value across all workstreams * Support modernization efforts spanning core business systems, CRM, finance, HRIS, and operational platforms *Delivery \& Value Stream Management* * Map customer value streams end to end, identifying where Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities remove manual effort, shorten cycle times, and reduce cost * Define and track delivery and value metrics such as time\-to\-value, throughput, cycle time, and business outcomes achieved, and report them to executive stakeholders * Prioritize work by business value, so the highest\-impact capabilities reach customers first * Continuously improve delivery flow by identifying bottlenecks, handoff delays, and waste across the program *Technical Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment* * Act as the primary technical interpreter between customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and Tessera’s AI and product organizations * Lead discovery workshops to map system landscapes, business processes, data flows, and integration points to Tessera’s agentic AI capabilities * Translate technical trade\-offs, delivery plans, and value outcomes for both executive stakeholders and delivery teams * Facilitate alignment across enterprise architecture, IT operations, security, and business functions *Execution in Complex Enterprise Landscapes* * Drive Agile delivery within enterprise change management frameworks and modernization methodologies * Anticipate risks related to legacy system remediation, data harmonization, integration dependencies, and business continuity * Develop mitigation plans grounded in operational and technical realities *Enterprise\-Grade Governance \& Deployment* * Ensure all delivery activities meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, auditability, and operational governance * Oversee technical prerequisites for integrations across enterprise platforms and cloud environments * Partner with customer security and infrastructure teams to ensure successful deployments and operational readiness *Customer Engagement \& Escalation Management* * Serve as the primary delivery contact during onboarding and implementation * Manage technical escalations from customer IT and business teams, coordinating responses across pods, engineering, and product * Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers through clear communication, accountability, and consistent delivery *Startup Mindset \& Extreme Ownership* * Operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment with evolving priorities and ambiguous challenges * Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex enterprise transformation programs * Travel to customer sites for workshops, solution design sessions, and implementation oversight as needed **Required Qualifications** * 4–6\+ years of experience leading technical delivery for large enterprise modernization or transformation programs * Proven track record leading cross\-functional delivery teams or pods through complex, technically demanding implementations * Demonstrated experience running multiple concurrent workstreams with significant dependencies * Experience mapping and managing value streams, and tying delivery work to measurable business outcomes * Comfort defining, tracking, and reporting delivery and value metrics to executive audiences * Strong understanding of enterprise business systems, integrations, data flows, and modernization challenges * Experience with one or more enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or similar * Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts, APIs, middleware, and cross\-platform integrations * Ability to explain technical concepts, system constraints, integration challenges, and data models to both engineering teams and business stakeholders * Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills * Strong command of Agile methodologies and experience orchestrating complex programs with multiple dependencies **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience at a top\-tier consulting or system integration firm (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, IBM, Capgemini), or leading large enterprise modernization programs internally * Experience delivering AI/ML\-enabled programs, or strong interest in LLMs, automation, and multi\-agent AI orchestration * Familiarity integrating ERP and other core systems with adjacent platforms including CRM, HRIS, finance, analytics, middleware, and cloud infrastructure * PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, value stream management, enterprise platform certifications, or related certifications are a plus **Behavioral \& Problem\-Solving Expectations** * Balance technical systems understanding with program structure and executive communication * Lead pods with clarity, accountability, and a bias toward outcomes over activity * Operate with extreme ownership and thrive in ambiguity * Simplify complexity and drive alignment across technical and business teams * Keep a strong customer\-first, value\-first mindset throughout complex transformation programs Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early\-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end\-to\-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI\-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote in Latin America. **About the Role** ------------------ As our Technical Recruiter, you'll specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment and own hiring from intake to offer. That includes our hardest searches, Senior and Principal AI Engineers, plus our regular full\-stack, front\-end and back\-end roles. You'll know the AI engineering market well enough to tell a mid\-level from a senior, from a principal before they reach our interview team. You'll also use AI tools to source and run searches better than a manual process can. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities** * Specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment: own full\-cycle hiring for AI and ML Engineers (Senior and Principal) and for full\-stack, front\-end and back\-end engineers. That covers intake, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, debriefs and offers. * Design and execute recruitment strategies: build a search plan for each role, covering target profiles, channels, messaging and timelines. Adjust it when the market says otherwise. * Find principal\-level AI talent: build pipelines for Senior and Principal AI Engineers beyond LinkedIn. Look in GitHub, open\-source projects, research papers, technical communities and referrals. * Level candidates accurately: screen against senior\-vs\-principal so the interview team only meets candidates at the right level. * Use AI tools to improve search: use AI tools and LLM assistants for market mapping, search strings, candidate research and outreach. * Turn recruiting data into insights: track time\-to\-fill, pass\-through rates, sources and decline reasons in Greenhouse. Use them to show where searches stall and what to change. * Optimize hiring processes: tighten intake, scorecards, scheduling and candidate communication. Document playbooks and interview plans so searches run the same way every time. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 5\+ years of technical recruiting, with full\-cycle ownership of engineering searches. * Recent experience hiring AI or ML engineers at Senior level or above, and you can explain how a Principal differs from a Senior. * Enough technical fluency to discuss LLM applications, RAG, evaluation, fine\-tuning and MLOps with engineers, and to probe their claims. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI tools in your recruiting work, with examples of what changed because of them. * A track record of sourcing passive senior candidates through channels other than LinkedIn. * Fluent written and spoken English. You'll work with engineers and leaders across many countries. * A data\-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to make decisions and explain them to hiring managers. Comfortable with Greenhouse or a similar ATS. * Experience designing recruitment strategies and improving hiring processes, not only running them, in a small team where processes are still being built. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience recruiting for consulting firms or agencies with client\-driven hiring * Experience hiring across multiple LATAM countries and the US * Spanish or Portuguese * Experience with Juicebox AI or similar AI sourcing tools **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is: * **AI\-fluent.** You already use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently. * **A builder.** You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection. * **A clear communicator.** You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge\-sharing, and hands\-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. **This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.** As a team member, you can expect: * To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed * Payments made in USD * 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years * Wellness \+ Remote Stipend * AI Voucher **About Able** -------------- Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio\-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. **Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!**

jobs.description: **Who We Are**: Thermo Systems is a global, full\-service control systems integration partner, delivering world\-class automation solutions in the District Energy, Life Sciences, and Mission Critical markets. Our diverse leadership and dedicated engineering team are committed to excellence and consistent growth. Our unique company culture, known as "The Thermo Way," strengthens our team by fostering an environment where all members perform their best. Our commitment to being unified, dynamic, and delivering excellence is evident in how we build trusting relationships through connection and camaraderie, ability to adapt, and focus on integrity and success. These values guide our daily operations and interactions, setting the standard for our team's behavior. As we continue to grow and evolve, "The Thermo Way" supports our goals of becoming a world\-class organization, ensuring employee success, customer success, and financial strength. **Job Summary:** Works on a variety of control system projects. Capable of leading several project related tasks and/or large, strategic projects simultaneously. Provides engineering support on projects led by others. Assumes ultimate responsibility for the assigned projects/tasks. Takes direction and seeks guidance from the assigned project leads, the supervisors, and company leadership. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor of Science; Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or other pertinent curriculum combined with relevant technical experience. * Typically, 10\+ years total experience. * Proven Track Record: 3\+ years as Control Systems Project Engineer II or equivalent. **Duties and Responsibilities:** **Technical Responsibilities:** * Lead, train, and mentor co\-workers during start\-up and commissioning of systems. * Expert in reading and interpreting piping \& instrumentation diagrams and wiring diagrams. Able to provide feedback regarding field conditions versus drawings. * Expert with Human\-Machine Interface (HMI) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) applications. * Assists in maintaining the company’s Quality Management System (QMS). * Firm understanding of migration paths and upgrading of legacy control systems. * Able to independently design complex control systems. * Provide instrumentation specifications for complex control systems. * Value engineer specifications to provide the most cost\-effective solutions. * Leads detailed design of complex Information Technology (IT) systems, network infrastructure, and computer system designs, as it relates to control system integration. * Highly competent in the design of complex HMI systems. * Able to author complex design documents. **Customer Service:** * Communicate in an effective, positive, and proactive manner with customers. * Follow customer specific site standards and procedures. * Always conduct business in professional manner. * Provide excellent customer care and support. * Be patient, attentive, and responsive to customers in solving their problems. * Always follow up and honor commitments with customers. * Expert in understanding and servicing customer needs and provides recommendations to enhance those needs. **Project Responsibilities:** * Complete assigned tasks accurately, on schedule, and under budget. * Lead individual project related tasks and/or large projects in their entirety. * Assume the ultimate responsibility for the successful completion of projects or tasks on schedule and under budget. * Take on the role of the customer’s main contact on those projects that the employee is assigned to lead. * Identify changes in scope to overall projects and/or tasks. * Provide support on other projects or tasks that are scheduled to be led by others. * Manage and delegate assigned tasks accurately, on schedule, and under budget. * Understands and anticipates customer needs. * Accurately estimates the duration and difficulty of tasks. * Ensures the team adheres to a realistic schedule and budget. * Seeks opportunities for new work with customers and contractors. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * Where applicable, directs and oversees junior or subordinate staff members regarding construction, operations, and/or maintenance tasks and assignments at a project site. **Required Skills and Abilities:** * Networks across the company to accomplish objectives. * Executes work in the most efficient manner. * Evaluates and adapts to the strengths and shortcomings of others. * Willing to take on undesirable responsibilities to help the team. * Committed to further developing technical and leadership skills. * Actively participates in company trainings and trade shows to showcase company expertise **Travel required:** * Overnight travel may be required up to 50% **On Call:** * On call rotation participation may be required based on location and client needs. **Work Authorization/Other Requirements:** * Proof of eligibility to work in the country where the position is located is required. * Maintain a valid drivers license. * Fit for Duty at all times jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Driven Systems
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Thimble was an early pioneer in insurtech. We built a digital\-first way for small businesses to buy coverage by the job, month or year, and have since delivered more than 200,000 policies across the United States. We started direct\-to\-consumer as an MGA, but today, we’re focused on growing through brokers and distribution partners, bringing the same simple, fast experience to the agents who serve small businesses. Thimble is still evolving and is at the front of AI\-native distribution with MCP technology paired with API distribution. In 2023, Thimble was acquired by Arch Insurance, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. (Nasdaq: ACGL), an S\&P 500 company providing insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance worldwide. That gives us something rare: the speed, ownership and culture of a startup, with the balance sheet, stability and long\-term commitment of one of the industry’s strongest insurers. For more information, visit thimble.com. ### **Our Values** Our unique culture is built around our six core values: **Think Wild, Act Tame** Be relentlessly creative. Question everything. Get to know the rules so well, you can use them in new ways. Be the industry’s compliant radicals. **Green Means GO** Act. Move forward. Learn. You can only make a decision based on the best information you have – so make it. **Own Every Detail** Be ruthlessly precise. Disciplined. Sweat the small stuff. **Simplify,** **Simplify, Simplify** Get to the point. Make it crystal clear. Cut everything else. It’s our job to make insurance easy – however hard that is for us. **Every Moment Counts** Show up early and ready. Deliver on time or before. Make the most of your time, so others can make the most of theirs. **Stay Human** Treat every person, and their ideas, with respect. Cherish diversity.### **About the Role** Thimble is investing in the next generation of its platform, and this engineer helps lead that work. Our backend is built on Node.js microservices and event\-driven architecture on AWS, and we are evolving it toward durable, explicitly orchestrated workflows, with AI\-native tooling at the center of how we build. This is a hands\-on role: you’ll write, review, and ship production code every day, with AI agents as your primary build partner. You’ll also shape technical strategy and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You’ll work in Node.js and TypeScript every day, so you need to be productive in them from the start. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the durable workflows and services that will replace our current event\-driven flows, defining service boundaries, state ownership, idempotency, and retry semantics * Use of agentic coding tools on hard problems: setting up context, breaking down problems, and verifying output * Write and ship production code in Node.js and TypeScript every day, using agentic coding tools (Claude Code and similar) as your primary way of working * Define the reference patterns (service templates, shared libraries, code generators) that every rebuilt service follows * Plan and execute the migration in increments that keep production running, with tested rollbacks * Build and maintain the tooling around our AI workflow: MCP servers, evaluation scripts, and automated checks that hold AI\-generated code to the same bar as hand\-written code * Instrument services with metrics, alerts, dashboards, and tracing, and own production incidents end to end * Make targeted changes in our React and Angular applications when backend work requires them * Partner with product, growth, and other engineers, and contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions ### **What We’re Looking For** * Strong backend engineering with production experience in Node.js and TypeScript * Hands\-on experience building and operating distributed or event\-driven systems, and a working understanding of how they fail * Experience using AI tools to drive a large code migration at scale (framework upgrade, service rewrite, language port) * Curiosity about agent harnesses, MCP, and A2A protocols; production deployment of agents is not required * Experience contributing to a migration or re\-platform on a live system * Comfort reading unfamiliar code and data models and spotting problems in them * Enough frontend literacy to trace a problem from the UI down to the service layer * Clear written communication and comfort working in a remote, async\-friendly environment ### **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on experience with a durable execution or workflow orchestration engine, in any language * You’ve built or contributed to an MCP server, an agent harness, an evaluation suite, or a multi\-agent system, whether as a side project, open source, or an internal tool * Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or another regulated industry in a similar environment to our tech stack **Thimbler Benefits \& Perks!** * Fully remote company * Thimble Fridays! (out of office at 12:00pm local time) * Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage * 401(k) auto enrollment and matching (100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 3%) * PTO: 20 days vacation \+ 12 company\-wide holidays \+ 8 floating days \+ 1 VTO (Volunteer Time Off) \+ unlimited sick time * Parental Leave: 100% paid 12 weeks \+ 2 weeks gradual return * Computer choice of Mac or PC * Work from home setup reimbursement * Monthly co\-working space and/or child care reimbursement * Monthly ClassPass credit * Quarterly wellness reimbursement * Other health \& wellness perks including: One Medical, Teladoc, Talkspace, Kindbody, and Health Advocate * Virtual events, happy hours, trivia, and fun! In addition to managing external/internal applicants and referrals, it is your job to skillfully identify, source, engage and sell these passive candidates on the opportunities within Thomson Reuters. **Key Responsibilities** In this role as a **Contract Technical Recruiter** , you will: * Manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition process, from receipt of approved requisition to the accepted offer * Create and execute recruiting strategies that are creditable and show clarity with stakeholders to drive results * Create effective sourcing strategies designed to attract top and passive talent with an emphasis of diverse pipelines * Build tailored assessment and interview processes for hiring needs to learn about the candidate’s skills and capabilities * Be accountable for meeting established performance targets and providing a high\-quality candidate experience throughout the recruiting cycle * Utilize Workday (applicant tracking system) to post positions, manage candidates, develop reports, and maintain all recruitment data Implement best practices to attract and recruit diverse talent including use of technology, social media, community outreach, military, educational, professional organizations, referral networks and outplacement agencies * **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of demonstrated recruitment experience, combination of corporate and agency experience preferred. Experience sourcing and recruiting AI talent is preferred (ML Engineers, Data and Applied Scientists with NLP and LLM) * Proven experience in creative sourcing strategies to identify passive candidates using out\-of\-the\-box methodologies and the ability to build pipelines through those efforts * A prior record of accomplishment of recruiting and scaling high\-performing organizations; prior experience working in global information, professional services, or technology company is desirable * A demonstrated ability to assess and evaluate candidates; Training in behavioral or competency\-based interviewing is a plus Experience negotiating total rewards beyond salary that includes bonus, LTI/RSUs, and sign on * **Preferred Qualifications** * Successful and efficient use of Workday ATS to manage a workload of up to 20 open jobs at a time while being mindful of time to fill and candidate experience goals * Experience with Claude AI, ChatGPT, or other AI tools Sourcing tools such as JuiceBox and/or SeekOut * \#LI\-KW This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization. **What’s in it For You?** * **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance. * **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future. * **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. * **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. * **Making a Real\-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, aid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? jobs.title: Lead AI Experience Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Thomson Reuters™, we’re transforming Service Management from a reactive, process\-bound group into an AI\-native, intelligence\-driven organization. Operational data flows into intelligence, intelligence into orchestration, and orchestration into execution, in a closed loop with AI embedded in detection, decision, and action. Our AI Operations and Automation (AIOps) function is the intelligence layer of that model. Intelligence only matters if people can see it, question it, and act on it. As more of our operations run through AI agents, the layer where people and agents meet the data decides whether any of it gets trusted. You’ll build that layer. **Key Responsibilities** This role sits where three disciplines meet: dynamic data visualization, applied AI, and UI/UX. You’ll define how our AI agents exchange information with one another and hand it to the engineers who depend on it. You’ll design and build interactive visualizations that make dense operational telemetry immediately readable, showing what’s happening, why, what the system has already done about it, and what still needs a person. And you’ll own the experience end to end, from first prototype to the tools our teams run on every day. This is an internal role and an exciting one that never existed before. Your users are our own people: the Global Command Center, site reliability and platform engineers, service managers, and the leaders who need to read the health of our systems at a glance. Their trust in what they see is the product. We don’t have a template for this role, and that’s the point. You’ll help define what it becomes. You’ll join Service Management and Transformation, part of the CIO segment of our Technology organization, and work alongside AIOps, the team building the models and automation behind the interfaces you design. We keep a clear separation between building and running, so you’ll have room to build. The role is hybrid, based in our Dallas, TX office. * Build dynamic data visualization. Design and engineer interactive, real\-time views of operational data, including topology and dependency graphs, event and alert streams, incident timelines, and predictive signal. Think D3, WebGL, and modern front end, not drag\-and\-drop BI. * Define the agent\-to\-agent interface. Establish the interfaces and data contracts that let AI agents pass structured, verifiable information to one another, and hand it to engineers in a form they can inspect and challenge. * Make automated action visible. Our L0 tier is where AI and automation resolve issues ahead of human responders. Show what it did, why, and how confident it was, so engineers supervise machine decisions rather than simply receive them. * Design the experience. Lead the UI/UX and information architecture: research how responders work under pressure, decide what they need to see and when, shape the interaction model, and make a complex system feel simple to someone working an incident at 3 am. * Prototype and ship. Turn ambiguous problems into working software quickly, then harden the strongest ideas into tools our teams depend on. * Set technical direction. As a lead, you’ll set the standard for the experience layer, make the architectural calls, and mentor engineers and designers. A builder first, a coach alongside. * Partner closely. Work day to day with AIOps, Service Data and Insights, Configuration and Topology, Workflow Engineering, and the Global Command Center. In your first year, you might: * Replace an operational report our teams read line by line with an interactive view that answers the question in seconds. * Publish the first version of our agent\-to\-agent data contract, and prove it with two agents working together in production. * Ship the interface that lets engineers see, and trust, every L0 resolution they’re accountable for. * Establish the shared patterns the rest of the organization builds on: components, guidelines, and working prototypes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience. 8\+ years designing and building software, including data\-rich, user\-facing products, hands\-on applied AI or agentic work, and time setting technical direction for others. A degree in computer science, human\-computer interaction, design, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * A hybrid background. Deep experience in two of these three and fluency in the third: front\-end and data\-visualization engineering, applied AI, and UI/UX design. * Information architecture and user\-centric design. You structure dense information so people find what matters without hunting for it, and you ground design decisions in research with real users, including interviews, task analysis, and usability testing. * Dynamic visualization in production. You’ve shipped interactive data visualization in JavaScript or TypeScript, with React and tools such as D3\.js, WebGL, or Canvas, and you care how it feels as much as whether it renders. * Applied AI fluency. Hands\-on wi two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. jobs.description: Technology Software Engineer \- AI Governance \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** Seattle **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A39691A Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. TikTok's Privacy and Security (PNS) Data Retention team makes sure that data across the platform is kept only as long as it is needed, and is then deleted reliably and verifiably. The data covers online services, offline warehouses, logs, backups, and ML training datasets. Global privacy rules keep getting stricter, and the data estate keeps growing to exabyte scale. The team owns the policies, platforms, and technical controls that turn retention commitments into guarantees we can enforce and audit. As a Backend Engineer \- Data Retention, you will design and build scalable, reliable, high\-performance systems that manage the lifecycle of data at TikTok scale. That includes finding and classifying data, applying retention policies, running deletion, and proving that deletion happened. You will turn fast\-changing privacy and regulatory requirements into concrete platform capabilities. You will work closely with storage infrastructure, data platform, ML platform, product, privacy, legal, and security teams to ship solutions across thousands of services and storage systems. Responsibilities: \- Design and build large\-scale data lifecycle management systems that enforce retention policies across heterogeneous storage: RDBMS, KV stores, caches, message queues, data warehouses (Hive/HDFS), object storage, logs, and backups. \- Build and run high\-throughput deletion pipelines, such as TTL enforcement, user account deletion propagation, and partition and snapshot expiry. They must be correct, idempotent, and observable, and must not hurt the stability or performance of production systems. \- Build data discovery and inventory capabilities, including metadata collection, data lineage, and classification of personal and sensitive data. These keep retention policies accurately mapped to real storage assets. \- Build verification, auditing, and reporting systems that prove deletion is complete and on time. Provide evidence for internal audits and regulator inquiries. \- Support exception workflows such as legal holds, retention extensions, and policy approvals, with fine\-grained access control and full audit trails. \- Work with ML platform teams to extend retention and deletion controls to training datasets, feature stores, and derived artifacts such as embeddings and model checkpoints. \- Work with privacy, legal, and compliance teams so that systems meet applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global and regional privacy laws) and TikTok's own data commitments. \- Help shape the technical roadmap for the data retention platform, and find and evaluate new techniques and tools that improve coverage, efficiency, and reliability at scale. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. \- Strong background in large\-scale distributed systems, databases, messaging and streaming systems (such as Kafka or Flink), and caching. \- Solid understanding of storage internals and data lifecycle concepts, such as TTL, compaction, partitioning, snapshots and backups, and consistency models. \- Experience building high\-throughput batch or streaming data pipelines with strong correctness guarant age systems. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $207480 \- $368220 annually. ​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: ​ 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ ​ Diversity \& Inclusion ​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. ​ TikTok Accommodation TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. jobs.description: **Job Description** **Role: Cloud Security Engineer / AI Security Engineer** **Location: Los Angeles, CA** (Remote – 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings) **Duration: 3\+ Months (Extension Possible)** **Experience:** 15\+ Years **Primary Skills:** IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies **Role Overview:** Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15\+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS. The role focuses on authentication, reusable IAM policy templates, Cedar\-based authorization, and secure access to tools, APIs, and enterprise resources. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. IAM Policy Templates \& Access Management** * Design, develop, and maintain reusable AWS IAM policy templates for AI agents and AgentCore infrastructure. * Implement role\-based access control (RBAC) and least\-privilege security principles. * Define IAM roles, trust policies, permission boundaries, and resource\-based policies. * Configure IAM execution roles for AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Gateway. * Develop standardized IAM templates for accessing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Bedrock, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch. * Automate IAM policy deployment and configuration using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK. * Conduct IAM access reviews, permission audits, and policy validation. * Troubleshoot access\-denied issues, role\-assumption failures, and authorization misconfigurations. **2\. Cedar Policies at AgentCore Gateway** * Design, author, test, and deploy Cedar authorization policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy. * Implement fine\-grained authorization for AI agents accessing tools through AgentCore Gateway. * Define policies specifying which identities can invoke particular tools, APIs, and operations. * Configure policy engines and associate them with AgentCore Gateways. * Implement attribute\-based access control (ABAC) using identity attributes, roles, scopes, and contextual conditions. * Develop policies that restrict sensitive tool operations based on business roles, permissions, and security requirements. * Validate Cedar policies against gateway schemas and test permitted and denied access scenarios. * Enforce default\-deny authorization and prevent unauthorized tool execution. * Monitor and troubleshoot authorization decisions and policy evaluation failures. **3\. Security Governance \& Compliance** * Implement security controls for enterprise AI agents and Generative AI applications. * Develop security standards for agent identities, API integrations, and access management. * Support audit logging, access traceability, and security monitoring using AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch. * Identify and mitigate risks including excessive privileges, credential exposure, unauthorized tool access, and privilege escalation. * Conduct security reviews of agent architecture and integrations. * Collaborate with AI engineering and DevOps teams to ensure secure production deployments. **4\. Security Automation \& DevSecOps** * Automate security policy deployment through GitHub Actions and infrastructure\-as\-code pipelines. * Integrate IAM and Cedar policy validation into CI/CD workflows. * Implement automated security checks and policy compliance testing. * Maintain version\-controlled security configurations across development, testing, and production environments. * Support security incident investigation, access troubleshooting, and remediation. **Required Technical Skills** * **AWS Security:** IAM, IAM roles, policies, STS, AWS Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch. * **Authorization:** Cedar policy language, RBAC, ABAC, fine\-grained access control. * **Authentication:** OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, AWS IAM authentication. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. * **Automation:** Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD security integration. * **Cloud Security:** Least\-privilege access, identity federation, credential management, and secure API integrations. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description: ### **About this role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability\-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest\-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero\-model and LoRA\-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self\-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin\-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands\-on production\-reliability experience on large\-scale distributed or GPU\-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD\-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on\-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** * Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. * Triage and extend automated self\-healing: when the node\-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero\-model or LoRA\-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. * Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first\-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. * Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. * Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. * Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest\-priority issues. * Lead reliability cross\-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade\-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** * Experience operating a provisioning or host\-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. * Deep experience owning production reliability for large\-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML\-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi\-node training or disaggregated\-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. * Familiarity with the operational realities of multi\-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter\-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. * A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node\-level health/remediation systems. * Comfort with event\-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit\-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. * A software\-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $160,000 \- $280,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Our Story** ------------- TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2\-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here. **The Opportunity** We're looking for a Staff\-level Software Engineer who is as comfortable designing production systems as they are applying AI to real business problems. This is a hybrid role, not a pure AI research or ML engineering position. You'll build the internal tools and platforms that power our operations teams, and be the technical expert on where AI creates real value and where it doesn't. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams and systems, not just the ones you build yourself. When the business needs to explore an AI opportunity, weigh technology options, or understand where we stand on AI, you'll investigate, recommend, and deliver. You'll navigate ambiguity and make well\-reasoned build\-versus\-buy decisions, then drive the recommended solution through implementation. You'll also think about the data each product generates, so what we build feeds our analytics and helps leadership decide where to invest. You bring strong engineering judgment, a bias toward pragmatic solutions, and the ability to turn open\-ended questions into decisions and working software. You'll be a trusted technical advisor to leadership, and your impact will be measured by what the whole team ships, not just what you build yourself. **What You Will Own** **Architecture \& Delivery** * **Build and own.** Architect and build internal tools and platforms for operations teams, owning them from design through deployment and ongoing operation, including reliability and incident follow\-through. * **Set direction.** Define service boundaries, integration patterns, and data flow across teams, and write the technical strategy and RFCs that make the direction clear. * **Simplify.** Reduce operational toil by retiring or consolidating systems, managing tech debt and migrations, and weighing long\-term maintenance cost in every build\-versus\-buy decision. * **Integrate and protect.** Build reliable integrations with legacy and third\-party SaaS systems, with security, access control, and audit trails designed in for sensitive data. **Applied AI** * **Apply AI with judgment.** Identify where AI belongs in a solution and where it doesn't, and design it as a well\-engineered part of the system (retrieval, agents, LLM\-powered features, workflow automation). * **Prove it, then ship it.** Run time\-boxed proofs of concept that answer "is this worth doing?" with evidence, then advance successful proofs of concept into production\-ready solutions, with evaluation, observability, reliability, and security. * **Guide AI investment.** Assess our AI maturity, define a practical roadmap, and track AI cost and ROI so investment decisions rest on data. **Data** * **Build products that produce good data.** Design data models and instrumentation so every product generates clean, usable data for analytics and strategic planning. **Technical Leadership** * **Lead across competing priorities.** Align teams with differing priorities on shared platforms, standards, and tradeoffs. Build consensus through influence and evidence, and drive decisions when consensus cannot be reached. * **Improve engineering quality and delivery practices.** Write high\-quality code and lead through code reviews, design reviews, and engineering standards, using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to raise the whole team's delivery speed. * **Mentor and advise.** Mentor engineers and serve as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders and leadership, explaining tradeoffs clearly and driving decisions to closure. **What You Bring** **Required:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable, maintainable production systems. * Demonstrated Staff or Principal\-level scope: you have led architecture or a major technical initiative across multiple teams with competing priorities, and aligned them on shared platforms or standards. * Hands\-on experience building applications with LLMs and generative AI in production, not just experiments. Demonstrate experience operating AI systems at scale, addressing production challenges, and measuring outcomes. * Working experience rolling out agentic systems into production, including evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring. * Strong backend and systems design skills, including APIs, data modeling, cloud infrastructure, and integration with legacy and third\-party SaaS systems. * Reliability engineering experience, including SLOs, idempotency, retries, partial esigning data models and instrumentation that support analytics. * Working knowledge of modern AI application patterns: RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt, harness, and context engineering, tool use and agents, and evaluation methods. * Ability to weigh build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs and balance technical options against cost, complexity, and business value, including choosing simpler solutions or stopping projects when the evidence doesn't support them. * Strong communication skills, including explaining AI concepts and tradeoffs to non\-technical audiences and driving decisions to closure. **Preferred (Nice to Have):** * Experience with vector databases and search technologies, whether managed services or extensions to existing databases. * Experience with a modern data stack (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt) and building the data pipelines that feed analytics. * Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams. * Familiarity with ML fundamentals, fine\-tuning, or model evaluation frameworks. * Experience with AI cost management, such as token usage, model selection, and caching. * Background in a regulated or document\-heavy industry such as legal or financial services. **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)** We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset. * **Embrace Change:** Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?" * **Committed:** You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting. * **No\-Ego Energy:** Positive, professional, and solutions\-oriented. Drama stays at the door. * **Ownership:** You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours. * **Fast \& Hungry:** You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact. **What We Offer** * Base Salary: $160,000 \- $200,000, commensurate with experience * Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor. * Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law. Compensation is determined by the location where the work is performed and is subject to applicable local law. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Platform Integration
jobs.description: **Job Description:** ==================== **Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure** At Toppan Merrill, we’re building Quinn, a cloud\-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports. We’re applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter most. You’ll join a small, highly visible team, work directly with senior engineering leadership, and engage with some of the world’s largest law firms. In this role, you’ll be the founding engineer for how outside AI tools such as Harvey and ChatGPT Enterprise securely connect to Quinn. That means production\-ready OAuth 2\.1 with token exchange, deny\-by\-default authorization, and a complete audit trail, built on the emerging Model Context Protocol standard and held to the security bar of the most demanding enterprise clients there are. The first thing Quinn will pilot with clients is this integration. A working prototype already exists; turning it into a service a law firm’s security team will approve is the core of this role. You’ll build it and own it after launch. **What you will do** * Productionize the integration service (an MCP server) that outside AI tools connect to, over the Streamable HTTP transport * Implement sign\-in with OAuth 2\.1 using our identity provider (Okta), including token exchange so the service calls Quinn on behalf of the attorney and never passes an outside tool’s token through * Enforce what each outside tool may do: which actions its permissions allow, and which documents are on each client firm’s approved list, denying everything else by default * Keep an immutable, exportable audit trail of every action an outside tool takes, including reads, that client firms can review * Design controls for AI\-specific risks, including tool misuse driven by content in documents and abnormal bulk access to documents * Test with at least two external AI tools, and support client firms’ security reviews * Build an internal command\-line tool for our operations teams on the same service **How you’ll work** You’ll own the integration service end to end and partner closely with our Identity and Security teams on the authorization design and client security reviews. You’ll also work with a backend engineer building the matching controls inside the Quinn platform, and with the IT and innovation teams at our design partner law firms. **First 90 days** * Stand up the service with production sign\-in in a test environment * Implement the approved\-document list and the audit log * Connect a first external AI tool end to end **Required** * 6\+ years of backend or platform engineering * Deep, hands\-on OAuth 2\.0 or 2\.1 and OIDC experience: authorization servers, scopes, audience, PKCE, token exchange * Experience building services that external customers or partners integrate with, including security reviews * Security\-first engineering habits: deny by default, least privilege, audit logging * Strong in TypeScript (Node.js) or Python, and comfortable working in the other; our services use both * Experience integrating with customers’ identity providers (OIDC or SAML federation, multi\-tenant SSO) **Preferred** * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or AI tool and agent integrations * Okta administration or custom authorization servers * Experience integrating with enterprise legal software (document management systems, Harvey, or similar) **Success at 12 months** * Pilot running with design partner firms, having passed Toppan Merrill’s security review and each firm’s own * Service passed an external penetration test with no open critical or high findings * At least two different AI platforms connected Learn more at https://www.toppanmerrill.com/careers/. About Toppan Merrill *We understand that your skills deserve recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive pay scale ranging from* $135K–$175K ***annually,*** *based on experience and expertise. We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.* *Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:* * *Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision and, Life insurance for employees and dependents* * *Employer Contribution to* 401(k) * *Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays* * *Paid parental leave* * *Paid community* *involvement/volunteer* *days* * *Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming* Toppan Merrill is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified individuals, including qualified women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and veterans, are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- General**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** Aegon’s Core AI Team is scaling rapidly to meet growing demand for AI\-driven transformation across our global business. Building on recent successes – including the launch of a vendor\-agnostic enterprise LLM gateway (AWS Launchpad), we are now investing in next\-generation Gen AI and Agentic AI capabilities. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: ### **About Treeswift:** In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead. We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments. Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms. To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital. We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia. Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us. **About the role** ML sits at the heart of Treeswift’s product translating complex sensor data into meaningful insights that drive critical decision\-making for our customers. As our business grows the importance of this work only grows with it. You will join at a critical inflection point and will lead the charge on the following priorities (amongst others): * **Technical Leadership.** You will be responsible for continuing to improve the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. As the breadth of models and datasets grows you will thoughtfully introduce feedback loops and ML Ops that accelerate model improvement. You have excellent judgement on what problems require fast experimentation/validation, and where we should be focused on sustainable scalable improvement over a longer period of time. * **Edge model development.** Working closely with our robotics and embedded teams, you will support growing exploration of model deployment on devices for real\-time use cases. * **Lead and grow our team (as needed)**. We have an incredibly talented ML team distributed across our NYC, Philly and SF offices. You will lead the current team, identify gaps and grow the team as needed. * **Collaborate closely** with our Software, Robotics, Hardware and Product teams to deliver on Treeswift’s vision and business objectives. You will report to our Head of Software Engineering. This is a full\-time, hybrid role based out of our Lower Manhattan, NYC office (2\-3 days per week in person, currently pinned to Tuesdays and Wednesdays). ### **About Machine Learning At Treeswift** Machine Learning at Treeswift is the layer that translates sensor data into meaning for our end\-users. At a high\-level we develop three categories of model that power downstream business decisions. * **Classifying** a point cloud \- distinguishing ground from vegetation from structures etc. * **Identifying** individual objects within 3D space — poles, equipment, wires, trees, etc. * **Describing** characteristics of individual objects. This includes everything from tree species and health, detailed wire types, pole information (height, attachments, etc.) etc. Together this information informs critical decision\-making for our customers such as: * What vegetation is a risk to utility infrastructure and how severe is that risk? What action is recommended as a result (trim, removal, etc…)? * Is ongoing asset construction deviating from the expected design and if so how? If so, is this an approved deviation or a quality issue that needs to be addressed before a downstream customer or financial impact? ### **Required skills and experience** * Early\-stage or fast\-moving environments where scope and ownership evolve quickly. * Strong familiarity with models built on images, video, lidar, pointclouds, speech, or geospatial data sources. * Building and using cloud\-based training and inference pipelines (including orchestration, deployment, and the operational realities of running models at scale). * Willingness to drive architecture and approach across both, bring innovative ideas and rapid execution to new and existing models, and be accountable for the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. * Leading development of our training and inference pipelines. You will lead how we build and evolve these pipelines as well as move us towards on\-device inference for time\-sensitive use cases. * 3\+ years experience in leadership: setting clear direction for a team, driving architecture and design decisions, reviewing others' work, and mentoring individual engineers. * Experience creating, curating, and cleaning training datasets, and building the evaluation and feedback loops that drive model improvement. * Strong programming skills and expertise in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and TensorFlow. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You have the ability to keep a team distributed across three offices (NY, Philly, SF) well\-aligned. You will be a strong partner to the product team on how to balance technical trade\-offs and product objectives. ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience developing models for and deploying models to run on edge\-devices. * Experience with deep learning training frameworks such as MLflow, Lightning, Weights and Biases, or similar. * Experience with semantic mapping, image processing techniques and/or computer vision fundamentals. * Experience with Apache Airflow (especially 3\.x) and/or Astronomer. * Experience with one or more of: Sensor Fusion, SLAM, Visual Odometry. * 8\+ years of professional experience **Benefits** * Competitive salary and equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents * Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents * Flexible, unlimited paid time off * 401(k) retirement savings plan * Free OneMedical membership * Commuter benefits * Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues. The estimated salary range for this position is $225,000 \- $265,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City. Treeswift is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
