jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: This is a grant funded, 18 month, Limited Appointment position. Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union. This position is considered flexible, 2 days on\-site, and must be available for lab on\-site meetings that may happen once per week or bi\-weekly, based on needs of the department. The Machine Learning and Data engineer role will lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of data pipelines and infrastructure to support the deployment and continuous monitoring of Machine Learning (ML) and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools within UCSF’s APeX Enabled Research (AER) team. Most projects will be in partnership with other UCSF technical teams and involve highly customized research solutions. Communication skills and inventive technical solutioning are crucial. The AER team provides a large array of services to the UCSF Research community, including project consultation, grant support, budget estimations, and project implementation and support. Project examples include: * Development of EHR\-based interventions via clinical trials embedded within healthcare delivery systems to generate scientific evidence while delivering healthcare. + Enabling UCSF researchers with algorithms, digital tools and / or clinical interventions with strong evidence of feasibility and acceptability. + Develop technical approaches and budgets in order to implement these tools within the electronic medical record. + Supporting the development of scalable, low cost infrastructure to enable ongoing research. This role primarily involves managing and optimizing the data and monitoring pipelines of the Health IT Platform for Advanced Computing (HIPAC), a cloud infrastructure that supports the development and deployment of AI/ML tools, including large language models (LLMs) in the EHR. Specifically, the ML/data engineer will work on implementing new data integrations, enhancing HIPAC’s ETL functionalities, productionizing AI/ML tools developed by UCSF data scientists/researchers, and designing and implementing metrics to continuously monitor AI/ML tools deployed at UCSF Health. Competitive applicants for this position are software, machine learning, or data engineers with 6\+ years of experience in implementing and maintaining AI/ML pipelines. Proficiency in MLOps, Python, SQL, and CI/CD is required. This role also requires a deep understanding of Epic data models (Clarity and Caboodle). Successful candidates either have or are able to obtain Epic Clinical/Clarity data model certification shortly after onboarding. **Department Overview** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Department of Information Technology Academic Research Systems (ARS) group is chartered to provide data services and infrastructure that support the UCSF Research Community’s computing and analytic requirements through centralized informatics services in the areas of Data, Tools, Secure Compute Environments, and Consulting Services. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * 6 years of experience in positions of increasing responsibility designing, implementing, and maintaining complex AI/ML applications. * Experience with data analysis and machine learning tools such as Jupyter, Pandas, scikit\-learn, Numpy/Scipy, PyTorch, etc. * Demonstrated advanced knowledge of full software development lifecycle * Advanced experience with Python; ability to write clean, efficient, and production\-level Python code * Advanced experience with SQL (e.g., SQLServer, PostgreSQL) * Demonstrated experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models and pipelines * Advanced experience in database systems, data warehousing solutions, and understanding of ETL pipelines * Advanced experience in designing, building, or maintaining data infrastructure for efficient ML model training and inference. * Demonstrated experience working with MLOps, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline toolsets * Experience in developing complex, automated testing * Experience with cloud\-based architecture in platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure * Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non\-technical personnel at various levels in the organization * Self\-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines * Demonstrated broad problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to interface with management on a regular basis * Excellent project leadership and management skills. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * Experience with large language models and other generative AI technologies, especially supporting the deployment of GenAI\-based tools in a production environment * Familiar with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) * Experience with Epic data structures * Epic Clarity Certification * Cloud Development certifications **About UCSF** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells. **Pride Values** UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values . In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here . Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide. **Equal Employment Opportunity** The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law. **Salary Information** The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy. Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement. To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation\-and\-benefits/index.html

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Fully onsite in Austin TX AI Engineer — Agentic Systems Mid\-Level Individual Contributor \| 3–5 Years Experience Role **Summary** We are hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate agentic AI systems — LLM\-powered agents that reason over enterprise data, call tools, and execute multi\-step workflows end to end. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the center of how we automate complex technical and operational work. You will take ambiguous problems, decompose them into agent workflows, and ship production services that engineering teams depend on daily. This is an ideal role for an engineer with a strong Python and ML foundation who has already shipped LLM or RAG applications and now wants to go deeper into orchestration, tool\-calling, and autonomous multi\-agent architectures. You will work within an established platform and architecture, with senior engineers available for design review — but you will own your components from prototype through production. **Key Responsibilities** Agent Design \& Orchestration Build and ship LLM\-powered agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi\-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent orchestration libraries. Implement multi\-agent workflows — planner, executor, reviewer, and specialist roles — including state handling, hand\-off logic, retries, and graceful failure paths. Design and expose tools to agents via function\-calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, wrapping internal APIs, databases, and enterprise systems as safe, well\-scoped agent capabilities. Retrieval \& Knowledge Systems Build and operationalize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines**:** chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, re\-ranking, and context assembly. Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources — SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, REST APIs, Excel, and SQL warehouses — into retrieval and agent context layers. Continuously improve answer grounding and reduce hallucination through better retrieval, prompt design, and context management. Engineering \& Deployment Develop production Python services and APIs for agent and model inference using FastAPI, containerized with Docker and deployed through standard CI/CD pipelines. Instrument agents with tracing, token and cost accounting, latency monitoring, and structured logging so that behavior is observable and debuggable in production. Apply MLOps and LLMOps practices including version control for prompts and configs, automated regression testing, and safe rollout of model or prompt changes. Evaluation \& Quality Build evaluation harnesses for agent workflows — golden datasets, task\-level success metrics, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression suites that gate releases. Measure and tune for accuracy, latency, and cost, and make explicit trade\-offs between them based on the use case. Collaboration Partner with domain experts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to turn manual workflows into reliable automated agents. Deliver results through interfaces users actually adopt — Streamlit apps, chat interfaces, dashboards, and embedded integrations. Write clear design notes and runbooks, and participate actively in code and design reviews. **Required Qualifications** 3–5 years of professional software, ML, or data engineering experience, including at least 1 year building LLM\-based or GenAI applications. Strong Python engineering skills — not just notebooks. Production code, testing, packaging, async patterns, and API development with FastAPI or similar. Hands\-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent) in a shipped application. Demonstrated experience building RAG systems**:** embeddings, vector stores (e.g., FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma), and retrieval quality tuning. Practical command of prompt engineering, structured output, function/tool calling, and context\-window management. Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent), and comfort writing queries against enterprise schemas. Experience containerizing and deploying services with Docker and shipping through CI/CD on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Solid grounding in ML fundamentals and familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace Transformers. Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to escalate when a problem is under\-specified rather than guessing. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or comparable agent tool\-integration layers. Production experience with multi\-agent or agentic workflow systems, including human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and approval gates. Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases, or MLflow. Experience with workflow orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect — or analytics engineering with DBT. Exposure to model fine\-tuning or parameter\-efficient adaptation (LoRA/PEFT) and knowing when it is — and is not — the right answer. Background in a technical engineering domain (semiconductor, hardware validation, manufacturing, or similar) where agents operate over specialized data. Experience with AI governance, responsible\-AI review, or enterprise security requirements for LLM deployments. Building AI Tools and flows for Server Validation Must Have**:** Optimizing Token utilization Python Scripting Database \- Azure VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: **Role Overview** This role focuses on improving solar asset performance using data, analytics, and real\-world operational insights across a large solar portfolio. The position is responsible for analyzing energy production, identifying performance issues, calculating energy losses, and supporting operational teams in improving the efficiency and reliability of solar assets. **Responsibilities** * Extract, validate, and analyze data from Data Acquisition System (DAS) providers to support performance reporting and operational assessments of solar energy assets. * Perform production analytics, identify performance trends, and investigate deviations from expected energy generation across a large solar portfolio. * Set up and configure DAS software and coordinate programming activities with Energy Optimization Managers (EOMs), Energy Optimization Technicians (EOTs), and DAS providers. * Conduct performance testing, including capacity tests, for newly onboarded solar projects. * Provide monitoring, troubleshooting, and diagnostic support to operations teams to resolve performance\-related issues. * Identify operational inefficiencies, investigate equipment issues, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders. * Calculate and analyze energy losses resulting from equipment outages, underperformance, and system downtime. * Support project onboarding by validating system data, reviewing monitoring configurations, and ensuring accurate performance tracking. * Prepare performance reports and provide relevant data to the Customer Service Team for customer reporting. * Support data analytics, periodic system assessments, and performance improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and reliability of solar assets. **Qualifications and Desired Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. jobs.title: SDK Developer
jobs.description: **About VectorWave** VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio\-frequency waveforms pre\-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog. We are a venture\-backed MIT spinout translating award\-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti\-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi\-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications! **The role** The SDK developer role focuses on building the interface for users to control, program, and operate the APU. You will work closely with the APU development engineers to integrate the functionalities into software packages that ship with the APU. Your work here will create SDKs that seamlessly connect the user to the programmable APU AI signal processing \& inferencing. **Location:** This is an in\-person, full\-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences. **What you'll do** * Design \& deliver SDKs for VectorWave’s partners and APU developers * Integrate automated controls, calibrations, etc. as necessary into the software interface for the APU * Distill which physical parameters are user\-controllable, visible, or automated within the SDK * Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter\-system compatibility * Help build a new developer community around APU edge AI inferencing * Provide SDK support for early partners and developers to ensure successful APU integration **What you bring** * Experience creating SDKs for electronic or radio systems * Experience in system lifecycle management (i.e. updates, feature integration) * Experience creating detailed system and user guide documentation * Expertise in UX and UI for controlling complex systems * Expertise in bug testing and/or software robustness * Familiarity with the basics of deep neural networks **Nice to have** * Explicit SDK design for SDRs, RFSoCs, or other similar systems * UX and UI for manipulating deep neural networks * Software security and application shielding * Remote/web cyber security * Familiarity with PyTorch **How we work** * **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details. * **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them. * **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non\-technical helps us solve problems together. * **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve. * **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust. * **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie. **Compensation and benefits** Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus: **The basics** * Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits. * Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included. * Vision: Guardian. * Unlimited PTO. **Family matters** * We offer 95% dependent premium coverage. * Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning. * Coming soon: Twenty\-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non\-birthing, adoptive, and foster. **For life beyond work** * 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar. * Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit. **Equal opportunity** VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. You will ship React and Next.js features across our dispensary and brand sites, and you will be the single owner of the analytics implementation, from the dataLayer in our components through Google Tag Manager into GA4 and BigQuery. Technical SEO and our integration with Sweed, the e\-commerce and POS platform behind our menus and checkout, are yours too. You will make sure every tracking code and pixel is installed correctly, captures the data points we target, and sends accurate data to the systems and platforms we rely on, such as Google. Marketing, merchandising and leadership make revenue decisions from that data. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Storefront features.** React and Next.js pages and components, built in TypeScript, tested, and accessible to WCAG 2\.2 AA. * **Measurement.** The tracking plan and every link in the chain: dataLayer events, GTM containers, GA4 properties and the BigQuery export. Maintain data quality across the chain, reconcile GA4 against e\-commerce revenue, and build automated checks so releases protect tracking. * **Checkout and pixels.** Tracking across our embedded checkout, including attribution and consent, and governance of marketing pixels and tags. * **E\-commerce integration.** Our Sweed integration: menu and product data, store routing and edge cases, including ongoing API integration work. * **Technical SEO.** Structured data, sitemaps, canonicals and crawlability across a large catalog of store, menu and product pages. * **Growth support.** Support the Growth team's A/B tests and conversion analysis by implementing test variants and the tracking that measures them. * **New site launches.** Launch new sites from our shared codebase, each with its own analytics and content setup. * **Contractors.** Direct and review the work of external contractors assigned to frontend and analytics work. **How we work** --------------- We run two\-week sprints and ship weekly. Stories carry testable acceptance criteria, and done means tests pass, accessibility is verified, analytics events fire and the change is checked on staging. Pull requests stay small and get reviewed the same day. Blockers are raised the day you hit them, and every retro item becomes a ticket with an owner. AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of how we work every day. We want someone who already works this way, gives those tools good context, and checks their output against acceptance criteria and real production data rather than trusting a green build. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production React applications, including Next.js and TypeScript. * 2\+ years implementing analytics in code: GTM, GA4 and dataLayer design. * Working SQL, ideally against GA4's BigQuery export. * Experience integrating third\-party commerce APIs. * Accessible front\-end work to WCAG standards, with automated tests as part of done. * Scrum team experience, daily use of AI coding tools, and clear writing that a marketer or QA engineer can act on. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Sweed, Dutchie, Jane or another menu and POS platform, or other regulated e\-commerce. * Technical SEO for large server\-rendered sites. * Cross\-domain or iframe tracking, and browser privacy and consent constraints. * Headless WordPress with ACF. * Server\-side tagging and experimentation platforms. * Metabase, Looker or another BI tool. **What We Offer** ----------------- **Verano Base Pay Range** $85,000 \- $100,000 \+ Bonus Actual pay is based on experience, qualifications, and location of the role. jobs.description: **The role** ------------ You will keep that platform reachable, fast, secure and deployable. Our sites run on WP Engine behind Cloudflare, with menus and checkout powered by Sweed, our e\-commerce and POS platform, and we release to production every week. You will own production access, the edge, CI/CD and the release process, and build the automation that lets the rest of the team ship safely without waiting on you. This is a hands\-on seat on a Scrum team. You write code, review code and take sprint commitments like everyone else. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Access and credentials.** Production credentials and access across our hosting, edge and third\-party services, including rotation and least\-privilege design. * **The edge, as code.** Cloudflare across our brand sites: DNS, TLS, caching, security rules and Workers, with configuration managed in Git and deployed through CI. * **Releases.** The weekly release, hotfixes and rollbacks. Every release is traceable and verified after it ships. * **CI/CD.** GitHub Actions pipelines, required checks and branch protection. Repeated manual checks become automated gates. * **Monitoring and incidents.** Error tracking, uptime and performance monitoring, including our Sweed integration, that alerts when something breaks. You are available around the clock to respond to true emergencies, such as a site outage, and you write blameless incident reviews afterward. * **Performance.** Root\-cause fixes for origin and edge errors, and Next.js caching strategy together with the frontend engineers. * **Dependency security.** Triage advisories by real risk and ship upgrades through review and testing. * **Automation.** Tested internal tooling in Python or TypeScript for GitHub, Jira and our delivery process. * **New brand sites.** Stand up the infrastructure for each new site (repository, hosting, edge, monitoring and access), and turn the launch runbook into automation. * **Contractors.** Direct and review the work of UpWork contractors assigned to platform work. **Your first 90 days** ---------------------- * **Days 1 to 30:** Learn the platform from our runbooks, shadow a release, then take over release preparation, credential management, and Cloudflare and CI/CD work. * **Days 31 to 60:** Run the next scheduled credential rotation, move edge deployments into CI, and clear critical dependency alerts. * **Days 61 to 90:** Improve origin and edge performance against agreed targets, make every deploy verifiable by build, and get delivery metrics measured. **How we work** --------------- We run two\-week sprints and ship weekly. Every change has a ticket and a reviewer, including a DNS record or a cache rule. Pull requests stay small and get reviewed the same day. Blockers are raised the day you hit them, and every retro item becomes a ticket with an owner. AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of how we work every day. We want someone who already works this way, gives those tools good context, and checks their output against the spec rather than trusting a green build. An agent's verdict is never an approval, and credentials never go into prompts. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years of DevOps, platform or SRE work on production web applications. * Cloudflare at production depth, including Workers you have written and deployed. * GitHub Actions and release strategy for a team that ships weekly: tagging, hotfixes, rollback. * Secrets management, credential rotation and least\-privilege access. * Observability with Sentry and an APM such as New Relic or Datadog. * Tested automation in Python or TypeScript. * Scrum team experience, daily use of AI coding tools, and clear writing: runbooks and incident notes a teammate can follow at 2 a.m. **Nice to have** ---------------- * WP Engine or another managed WordPress host. * Next.js in production from the infrastructure side. * Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code tool. * Load testing and DORA metrics. * Jira administration and automation. * Regulated industry or multi\-brand e\-commerce experience. **What We Offer** ----------------- **Verano Base Pay Range** $85,000 \- $100,000 \+ Bonus Actual pay is based on experience, qualifications, and location of the role. Roles may be eligible for annual bonus program based on individual and company performance. **Benefits:** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Product discounts **Physical and Mental Demands** ------------------------------- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to remain in a stationary position, move and/or position oneself, communicate, operate and/or prepare, place, position objects, tools, or controls. The employee must occasionally move packages weighing up to 10 lb. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close observation and the ability to adjust focus. The mental and physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual, with or without reasonable accommodation, to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. **Working Environment** ----------------------- Work is performed in an office environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Vericast is the financial institution (FI) performance partner. We help banks and credit unions drive growth, improve efficiency, increase engagement and navigate change through the power of data, technology and people. Our advanced analytics, data\-driven insights and integrated solution set enable better execution with agility, precision and scale. maintain data warehouse structures, dimensional models, semantic models, curated business datasets, and analytical data assets including SSAS Multidimensional Cubes, SSAS Tabular Models, measures, hierarchies, aggregations, partitions, processing strategies, and performance optimization. * Design and support ETL/ELT pipelines for efficient movement and transformation of operational and reporting data. * Monitor and maintain data quality, integrity, and consistency across reporting environments. * Partner with IT and application teams to identify and implement new data sources. **Business Intelligence \& Reporting Solutions (25%)** * Design, develop, administer, and support enterprise business intelligence solutions including Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, and self\-service analytics capabilities. * Develop reusable KPI frameworks, reporting standards, business rules, calculations, and governed semantic models that processes. * Develop monitoring, validation, reconciliation, and alerting solutions to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, platform reliability, and enterprise performance standards. * Maintain reporting documentation, metadata, data dictionaries, and reporting lifecycle management processes. * **Analytics, Trend Analysis \& Insights (20%)** * Perform trend analysis across contact center operational, financial, workforce, and customer experience metrics. * Analyze volumes, service levels, abandonment rates, productivity, occupancy, callback utilization, queue performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency metrics. * Identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvement. * Develop forecasting models and support workforce planning activities. * Communicate findings and recommendations to operational leaders and executive stakeholders. * Design and monitor key performance indicators supporting business objectives. **AI\-Enabled Analytics \& Innovation (15%)** * Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled analytics solutions to improve reporting automation, insight generation, anomaly detection, and decision support. * Design datasets and semantic models optimized for natural language querying and AI\-powered analytics experiences. * Utilize Microsoft Copilot, Power BI AI capabilities, Microsoft Fabric, and approved enterprise AI platforms to enhance reporting and analytics workflows. * Identify opportunities to automate manual analytics processes through generative AI and workflow automation. * Develop AI\-assisted reporting templates, prompt libraries, and reusable insight\-generation frameworks. * Support implementation of conversational analytics and natural\-language reporting capabilities. * Research emerging AI, machine learning, and analytics technologies and recommend practical business applications. **Business Partnership, Consulting \& Project Support (10%)** * Partner with b  architectures across multiple systems and platforms. * Experience working with APIs, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), enterprise applications, and structured and semi\-structured data sources including JSON, XML, and API payloads, with the ability to parse, transform, validate, and integrate data into data warehouses, semantic models, and reporting solutions. * Proficiency with Business Intelligence tools including Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SSRS, semantic models, dashboards, data visualization, and self\-service analytics best practices. * Experience with programming and scripting languages such as SQL, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar technologies to support data engineering, automation, integrations, and reporting solutions. * Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing methodologies, CI/CD processes, and deployment management. * Experience leveraging AI\-enabled technologies, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI solutions, Large Language Models (LLMs), and semantic models to enhance reporting, analytics, automation, and self\-service data experiences. **COMMUNICATIONS \& CONTACTS** This role regularly communicates with Contact Center Operations, Business Intelligence, IT, Application Development, and external vendors to gather requirements, resolve data and reporting issues, and deliver actionable insights. The position presents analytical findings, recommendations, and reporting outcomes to operational leaders and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical information into clear, business\-focused guidance. **DECISION MAKING** This role exercises independent judgment in designing data models, reporting solutions, integrations, and analytics processes that support operational and strategic business decisions. In this hands\-on builder role within our Data, AI, Risk \& Product organization, you will bridge unstructured knowledge, governed semantic data, and agent execution workflows, partnering directly with global engineering, data, and business teams to ensure every AI action is grounded, authorized, and accurate. **How you’ll make an impact:** ------------------------------ * **Strategy \& Portfolio:** Partner with global product, engineering, and business leaders to prioritize high\-value context initiatives, sequencing workflows based on business impact, agent demand, source readiness, and risk. * **Governed Semantic Layer \& NL\-to\-SQL:** Own the semantic object roadmap for core enterprise entities (e.g., accounts, claims, plans), defining certified measures, join graphs, and Row\-Level Security (RLS) to replace raw schema reasoning and eliminate hallucinations. * **Retrieval \& Grounding:** Establish enterprise standards for federated ingestion, chunking, caching, metadata, and citation enforcement, consolidating legacy knowledge APIs into unified, multi\-tenant interfaces. * **Workflow Context Packs:** Design and deliver production\-ready context packs for critical operational workflows and SOPs, partnering directly with agent teams to inspect retrieval traces, debug failures, and optimize context consumption. * **Quality \& Benchmarks:** Build and run rigorous evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, error taxonomies, and go/no\-go quality gates to benchmark retrieval relevance, query precision, and agent containment. * **Governance \& Value Realization:** Embed auditability, data lineage, least\-privilege access, and responsible AI guardrails into the context layer by design, tracking ROI through API cost reduction, task resolution lift, and operational risk mitigation. **Experience you’ll bring:** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Experience:** Senior\-level Product Management experience owning data platforms, enterprise search/retrieval systems, semantic layers, API products, or internal developer platforms consumed by engineering teams. * **Technical Skills:** Deep understanding of applied generative AI and agentic systems, including advanced RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadata management, grounding, and context window assembly. * **Data Modeling \& SQL:** Strong experience working with structured enterprise data, relational models, certified metrics, and the failure modes of natural\-language querying over raw database schemas. * **Hands\-on Technical Depth:** Demonstrated comfort working directly with technical artifacts—inspecting retrieval traces, reading SQL query plans, reviewing JSON/YAML configurations, and executing API calls. * **AI Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Proven track record of designing and running evaluation harnesses, golden benchmark datasets, error taxonomies, and quantitative quality gates. * **Security \& Governance:** Solid working knowledge of enterprise controls, including authentication/identity, tenant isolation, Row\-Level Security (RLS), audit logging, and data privacy. * **Communication \& Influence:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a demonstrated ability to align and influence global engineering, security, compliance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority. **What will give you an edge:** * Experience with Knowledge Graphs, ontologies, taxonomies, and enterprise entity resolution (MDM). * Hands\-on familiarity with headless BI, metric stores (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Cube), or governed NL\-to\-SQL products. * Domain background in payments, fintech, benefits, Model Context Protocol \- MCP). Proven track record of consolidating or replacing legacy enterprise knowledge management or search systems in active production. * The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $125,300\.00 \- $154,100\.00

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Watsco Inc. is the largest distributor of air conditioning, heating and refrigeration equipment and related parts and supplies in the HVAC/R distribution industry. We serve over 125,000 contractor\-customers through our nearly 700 locations where more than 7,400 team members bring essential, sustainable comfort to families and businesses across the Americas. At Watsco, we recognize our responsibility to help drive the transition to a lower carbon future. That's why we are committed to providing high efficiency, low carbon HVAC equipment and energy\-saving parts and supplies to households and businesses across the Americas. Since January 2020, Watsco's sales of high efficiency equipment has reduced future CO2e emissions by over 19\.2 M MT. Learn more about our impact and how you can become part of this transformation at www.watsco.com/environment **Position Summary** ==================== Seeking an Infrastructure, Cloud \& Identity Engineer to own the architecture, reliability, lifecycle, and modernization of networks, servers, cloud platforms, Microsoft 365, identity, backup, and core infrastructure. The role combines hands\-on operations with automation and project leadership while retaining internal ownership of partner\-delivered solutions. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Administer Active Directory, Entra ID, synchronization/federation, SSPR, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged identity, service accounts, and automated joiner\-mover\-leaver workflows. * Operate Microsoft 365 tenant services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, mail flow, shared resources, licensing, service health, retention configuration, and vendor cases. * Engineer and support physical/virtual servers, hypervisors, storage, file services, DNS, DHCP, certificates, monitoring, capacity, patching, upgrades, migrations, and secure decommissioning. * Own switching, routing, wireless, WAN, VPN, VLANs, IP addressing, network monitoring, configuration backups, firmware lifecycle, and carrier/vendor escalation; coordinate firewall controls with Security. * Administer Azure, AWS, and approved cloud resources, including subscriptions/accounts, networking, identity integration, tagging, monitoring, backup, cost optimization, logging, and infrastructure automation. * Operate backup and disaster\-recovery technology; monitor jobs, protect immutable/offsite copies, test restoration and failover, maintain recovery runbooks, and remediate gaps. * Maintain infrastructure inventory, architecture diagrams, dependency maps, standards, lifecycle plans, support dates, and change/rollback documentation. * Automate repeatable administration using secure, version\-controlled scripts or infrastructure\-as\-code with peer review, monitoring, documentation, and rollback. * Lead network restructuring, server upgrades, identity modernization, cloud migrations, backup modernization, and reliability projects; manage technical partners and require design, as\-built documentation, testing, and knowledge transfer. * Provide Level 2/3 escalation, root\-cause analysis, major\-incident support, vulnerability remediation, and short\-term service\-desk backup without becoming the routine frontline queue. Requirements: **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 5\+ years of progressive infrastructure, systems, cloud, network, or identity engineering experience, including production ownership and complex troubleshooting. * Strong experience with Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, virtualization, DNS/DHCP, backup/recovery, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPN, wireless, and cloud administration. * Experience planning and executing upgrades, migrations, change windows, testing, rollback, monitoring, documentation, and vendor escalations. * Proficiency with PowerShell or comparable automation and a sound understanding of least privilege, hardening, logging, vulnerability remediation, and business continuity. * Ability to participate in scheduled after\-hours maintenance and critical incident response. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with Azure and AWS, hybrid identity, Intune, firewalls, infrastructure\-as\-code, multi\-site networks, immutable backup, and regulated environments. * Relevant Microsoft, Azure, AWS, Cisco/Aruba/Fortinet, VMware/Hyper\-V, or backup\-platform certification. * Experience directing MSPs or professional\-services partners and transferring solutions into operations. **Working Conditions** ====================== This role may require scheduled after\-hours work, participation in incident response, and local travel as stated above. Duties may evolve with business needs. Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Mobile Developer

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Wedgewood Pharmacy, we are dedicated to improving the lives of animals through customized medication and compassionate care. Every role in our organization contributes to helping pets live healthier, happier lives. We are a team driven by purpose, quality, and a shared commitment to animal health. We're seeking a Full Stack Software Development Engineer to help design, develop, and enhance Blue Rabbit, our veterinary web application that enables veterinarians to submit prescriptions to Wedgewood, along with other business\-critical applications. Working closely with our Product and Engineering teams, you'll contribute across the full development stack, including frontend development, backend services, APIs, databases, and integrations with downstream systems. **What you'll do:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain full\-stack applications supporting Blue Rabbit and other Wedgewood technology solutions. * Develop and support backend services, APIs, and integrations with internal and external applications. * Build and enhance frontend functionality to deliver reliable, user\-friendly experiences. * Work with relational and non\-relational databases to support application functionality and data integration. * Collaborate with Product Managers and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. * Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, development, testing, and delivery within two\-week sprint cycles. * Take ownership of assigned development tasks, contributing to larger projects from design through implementation. * Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable, maintainable solutions. * Explore and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies to support evolving business needs. **Who you are:** * A curious problem\-solver who enjoys understanding how systems work and finding effective technical solutions. * An adaptable, motivated learner who is comfortable exploring unfamiliar technologies and expanding your technical skill set. * An independent contributor who takes ownership of your work while recognizing the value of collaboration. * A strong communicator who can explain technical concepts, share ideas, and work effectively with cross\-functional teams. * A detail\-oriented engineer who understands how individual development tasks contribute to larger applications and business objectives. * An organized professional who can manage priorities and deliver quality work in a fast\-paced, Agile environment. **What you've done:** * Earned a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with at least two years of professional software development experience. * Applied object\-oriented programming principles and software engineering fundamentals to develop and maintain applications. * Worked with backend development, APIs, and database interactions as part of full\-stack software projects. * Used SQL databases, including writing queries and understanding how applications interact with data. * Developed applications using programming languages or frameworks such as Node.js, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. * Contributed to projects involving both frontend and backend functionality, with an understanding of how different application components work together. * Demonstrated the ability to learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, or technologies to Experience in veterinary medicine, pharmacy, or healthcare technology is an added advantage. **What's in it for you:** * A comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and flexible spending accounts. * A 401(k) retirement plan with a generous company contribution. * Company\-paid life and disability insurance. * Access to voluntary insurance options, including pet insurance! * A generous paid time off program that increases every year. * Tuition reimbursement. **Why We Do What We Do** At Wedgewood Pharmacy, your work has purpose. We are passionate about what we do and proud to build a workplace where people feel supported, included, and valued. **Our Commitment to Inclusion** Wedgewood Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform (Remote)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform** (Remote) **Overview:** Weedmaps is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to build the AI systems our company runs on: the agents that do real engineering and operational work, and the "AI brain" that gives them trustworthy context about our business. You will work on an autonomous coding agent that picks up Jira tickets, opens pull requests and responds to review feedback; a shared platform (an internal MCP server) that gives every agent common skills, tools and processes; and a knowledge layer that connects our Snowflake semantic layer, internal documentation and a growing knowledge graph so agents and people get consistent answers. Success means agents that are measurably useful, cheap enough to run at scale, and safe to trust with production systems. This role sits on the AI Platform team and partners closely with Developer Experience, Data and product engineering teams across the company. **The impact you'll make:** * Design, build and operate production AI agents, including an autonomous coding agent that works from Jira and Slack, opens PRs, fixes its own CI failures and applies review feedback. * Build the retrieval and context layer behind our "AI brain": embeddings and semantic search, knowledge\-graph modeling, and integration with our Snowflake semantic layer and internal docs, so agents pull the right context in one pass instead of several. * Extend our internal MCP server with shared skills, tools and processes that other teams can reuse, and help product teams bring agents into their own workflows. * Own evaluation: build offline test sets and online metrics that show whether a change to a prompt, model or retrieval step made an agent better or worse, and gate releases on them. * Drive cost and latency down: route work to the cheapest model that can do it, use caching and structured outputs, and track spend per agent and per task on AWS Bedrock. * Harden agents against prompt injection, memory poisoning and over\-broad permissions: least\-privilege tool access, auditable actions, human approval where the risk warrants it. * Instrument agents with tracing and logging so failures can be diagnosed and fixed quickly, and take part in on\-call for the systems you own. * Evaluate new models and tools with a practical eye, adopting what holds up and passing on what doesn't. * Write clear design docs, review code, and mentor other engineers on building with LLMs. **What you've accomplished:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 6 years of professional software development experience, including owning production services end to end. * At least 1 year of hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered features or agents to production (not only prototypes): tool/function calling, prompt design, structured outputs, and handling model failures gracefully. * Experience building retrieval systems: embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking and ranking, and measuring retrieval quality. * Strong proficiency in at least one of Python, TypeScript or Ruby, and comfort working across a polyglot codebase. * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and observability tooling. * A track record of measuring what you build: evals, A/B tests or clear before/after metrics. **Bonus points:** * AWS Bedrock, and experience managing model cost and latency at scale. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or other agent tool frameworks. * Knowledge graphs or semantic layers (for example, Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics or graph databases). * Agents that act on developer workflows: GitHub Actions, Jira and Slack integrations, automated code review or code generation. * LLM security: prompt\-injection defenses, sandboxing, permission models and red\-teaming. * Entity matching or classification at large scale (millions of records) using ML combined with LLM reasoning. * Experience with Ruby on Rails, Elixir or Node.js services. * Experience at a marketplace, e\-commerce or regulated\-industry company. *The base pay range for this position is $180,000\.00 \- $222,000\.00 per year, and a competitive bonus* **2026 US Benefits for Full Time, Regular Employees:** * Physical Health (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * + 100% employer\-paid premium for employees + Up to 80% coverage for dependents + Company HSA contribution with the High Deductible Health Plan * 401(k) Retirement Plan (employer will match contribution up to 3\.5% of employee contribution) * Basic Life, Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance options * Supplemental, voluntary benefits * + Student Loan Repayment/529 Education Savings with a monthly company contribution + FSA (Medical, Dependent, Transit and Parking) + Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance + Critical Illness Insurance + Accident Insurance + Short\- and Long\-term Disability Insurance + Pet Insurance + Identity theft protection + Legal access to a network of attorneys * PTO, paid sick leave, and company holidays (including a 2026 holiday shutdown) * Paid parental leave **Why Work at Weedmaps?** Life at Weedmaps means innovation and heart. Come join us if you care about the plant, the people who love it, and are ready to let your talent shine. We foster a bustling and collaborative culture that revolves around an environment that focuses on the benefits of weed, and the community that supports it. You too can have a hand in shaping the industry's future; ready to roll with us? See how we've grown—our journey, leadership team, and what's next atWeedmaps.com/corporate **About Weedmaps:** Founded in 2008, we've grown from a small startup to a global leader in the cannabis industry. Our dedication to transparency, education, and community has set us apart, and today, we proudly serve cannabis to consumers and businesses in the U.S. and worldwide. "Freedom to choose. Freedom to access. Freedom to enjoy." **Notice to prospective Weedmaps job applicants:** Our team has been made aware of incidents involving LinkedIn, Telegram, and Facebook accounts impersonating Weedmaps recruiters. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Developer – Application & Web Server Platform
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a seasoned **Senior Infrastructure Developer** to join our App and Web Engineering team. You will build reliable Java applications, APIs, and platform services that simplify how application teams provision, configure, validate, and operate enterprise hosting platforms. This role is ideal for a hands\-on developer who writes clean, testable code, understands the operational demands of large\-scale server environments, and treats quality, security, maintainability, and production readiness as core engineering responsibilities. You will lead by example across analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support. You will create modular Java and Spring Boot services, define automated test strategies with QA partners, enforce code\-quality standards in CI/CD, review designs and pull requests, resolve defects, and use production feedback to improve reliability. You will also develop Ansible automation where needed to connect these services with application and web server operations. **In this role, you will:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise Java applications and Spring Boot services that support application and web server platform capabilities. * Build secure, versioned REST APIs for provisioning, configuration, deployment governance, certificate management, validation, and capacity workflows. * Apply object\-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, exception handling, concurrency, dependency management, and performance engineering to produce reliable and maintainable code. * Create comprehensive automated tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, REST Assured, and test containers, covering unit, component, integration, API, regression, and negative scenarios. * Partner with QA engineers to define acceptance criteria, test plans, test data, environment needs, traceability, release validation, and defect\-resolution strategies. * Integrate build, test, security, code coverage, static analysis, and deployment controls into CI/CD pipelines using Maven or Gradle and enterprise delivery tooling. * Use code reviews, quality metrics, observability, root\-cause analysis, and production feedback to prevent defects and continuously improve software reliability. * Develop reusable, idempotent Ansible roles and collections to automate server installation, configuration, JVM tuning, certificate operations, patching, compliance, and policy enforcement. * Build self\-service capabilities that allow development teams to request server instances, deploy applications, configure routing, request certificates, manage JNDI resources, and consume platform metrics. * Participate in Agile planning, estimation, demonstrations, retrospectives, technical design reviews, release readiness reviews, and production support. * Mentor engineers in Java development, automated testing, secure coding, code review, troubleshooting, and modern software engineering practices. **Required Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 4\+ years of software engineering experience delivering production Java applications or backend services * 4\+ years of hands\-on development with Core Java and modern Java versions, including object\-oriented design, collections, streams, exception handling, concurrency, and common design patterns * 4\+ years of experience with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, RESTful services, dependency injection, validation, security, and API design * Experience with Maven or Gradle, Git\-based workflows, pull requests, peer reviews, branching strategies, semantic versioning, and software release management * Experience integrating automated tests, code coverage, static analysis, security scanning, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines * Strong understanding of the SDLC, Agile delivery, secure coding, clean\-code practices, documentation, observability, debugging, root\-cause analysis, and production support * 4\+ years of experience deploying or supporting application and web servers such as Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server, IBM WebSphere Liberty, or NGINX **Desired Qualifications:** * Working knowledge of frontend development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and a modern framework such as Angular or React, including integration with REST APIs and basic UI testing * Experience with test\-driven development, behavior\-driven development, contract testing, test data management, service virtualization, and performance or resilience testing * Experience with code\-quality and security tools such as SonarQube, JaCoCo, Checkstyle, SpotBugs, SAST, dependency scanning, and secrets detection * Experience developing Java services that use JPA or Hibernate, relational databases, messaging platforms, caching, and asynchronous processing * Experience documenting and testing APIs with OpenAPI or Swagger, Postman, and automated API test frameworks * Deep understanding of JVM behavior, memory management, threading, class loading, performance tuning, and application\-server internals * Experience with Kubernetes or OpenShift, containerized Java workloads, and hybrid cloud platforms * Hands\-on experience with observability tools and practices, including structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service\-level indicators * Hands\-on experience developing Ansible automation for infrastructure provisioning and configuration using roles, collections, inventories, variables, templates, and Ansible Vault **Job Expectations:** * This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship * Hybrid work schedule **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities. $87,000\.00 \- $168,000\.00**Benefits** Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits \- Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees. * Health benefits * 401(k) Plan * Paid time off * Disability benefits * Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance * Parental leave * Critical caregiving leave * Discounts and savings * Commuter benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Scholarships for dependent children * Adoption reimbursement **Posting End Date:** 31 Oct 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. jobs.title: Senior Lead Systems Operations Engineer-ITSM AI Specialist
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a **Senior Lead Systems Operations Engineer\-ITSM A****I Specialist** to support the IT Service Management (ITSM) Product organization in designing and accelerating the adoption of AI\-enabled solutions across core service management offerings. This role will work directly with the ITSM Product Manager to identify, design, test, and implement fit\-for\-purpose AI capabilities across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Asset \& Configuration Management (SACM), Business Application Management, and Service Level Management, with an initial emphasis on Incident, Change, and Problem. This individual will serve as a hands\-on solution design leader and trusted advisor, partnering with Product Owners, developers, architects, platform teams, and governance stakeholders to apply the right pattern for the right problem. The role requires strong practical knowledge of AI/ML/GenAI concepts, experience translating business or operational workflows into scalable solution designs, and the judgment to determine when agentic AI is appropriate versus when simpler analytical, deterministic, or API\-based approaches are the better solution. The ideal candidate combines digital product leadership, AI solution design, experimentation, and coaching skills, and is able to accelerate product teams that are still building fluency in AI design patterns and implementation approaches. **In this role, you will:** * Partner directly with the ITSM Product Manager to design and accelerate AI\-enabled capabilities across the ITSM product portfolio, with immediate focus on Incident, Change, and Problem Management * Translate business processes, workflow activities, and user interactions into practical AI\-enabled solution designs, including orchestration patterns, decision points, tools, and implementation approaches * Evaluate and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solution patterns across deterministic automation, predictive models, generative AI, agentic AI, and traditional integrations or APIs * Help define and implement AI use cases that improve customer effort, operational outcomes, and risk controls * Develop tangible solution artifacts such as architecture recommendations, use\-case assessments, design patterns, implementation guidance, pilot recommendations, and measurement approaches * Conduct hands\-on experimentation and prototype evaluation to validate solution feasibility, value, and operational fit * Coach Product Owners and development teams on AI/ML/GenAI concepts, design patterns, and practical implementation tradeoffs * Guide teams in moving from deterministic workflow thinking toward appropriate use of probabilistic and AI\-assisted solutioning where it adds value * Prevent overuse or misuse of agentic AI by ensuring teams select the right technology pattern for the problem rather than defaulting to AI\-first solutions in all cases * Partner with engineering, This is a highly hands\-on technical leadership role for an individual who can bridge modern software architecture, AI engineering, cloud\-native platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise governance. You will architect AI\-enabled systems that operate at enterprise scale across multiple products, regions, and regulatory environments. You will be responsible for establishing the target\-state AI architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, platform capabilities, and implementation guardrails for AI\-assisted audit workflows. The role requires deep expertise in agentic AI systems, retrieval architectures, knowledge graphs, platform modernization, security\-by\-design, and large\-scale SaaS architecture. You are expected to design, build, prototype, review code, establish architectural direction, and coach engineering teams while remaining actively engaged in implementation and technical decision\-making. The scope spans all Audit \& Assurance products across North America and Europe. **What You'll Do** **AI Platform Architecture** * Define the enterprise AI architecture strategy across the Audit \& Assurance portfolio. * Establish reference architectures for: * Agentic workflows * Multi\-agent orchestration * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) * Knowledge graphs * Semantic search * AI\-assisted content generation * AI\-supported analytical workflows * Create reusable AI platform capabilities consumed across multiple products. **Product \& Domain Architecture** * Architect end\-to\-end solutions across: * Audit engagement lifecycle * Planning and risk assessment * Evidence collection and validation * Compliance and standards interpretation * Analytics and anomaly detection * Quality review and sign\-off workflows * Establish bounded contexts, domain\-driven design principles, API strategies, and event contracts. **AI Systems \& Agent Engineering** * Design scalable multi\-agent systems using: * Manager–Executor * Planner–Executor * Blackboard * Event\-driven agent collaboration * Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Define memory, context, tool usage, routing, evaluation, and safety frameworks. **Technical Leadership** * Lead architecture reviews and design governance. * Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). * Coach engineering teams in: * AI architecture * Distributed systems * Performance engineering * Reliability engineering * Architecture trade\-off analysis * Act as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions. **Required Qualifications** * 15\+ years in software engineering and architecture. * 7\+ years designing large\-scale SaaS and distributed systems. * Proven experience architecting enterprise AI systems in production. * Deep expertise in: * Azure * Kubernetes/AKS * Distributed systems * Microservices * Event\-driven architectures * Large\-scale platform modernization * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience with: * C\# * .NET * Python * APIs * Distributed systems * Demonstrated success designing AI\-enabled enterprise applications. **Preferred Qualifications** **AI \& Agentic jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: ### **Engineering Manager** ### **Tucson, AZ** ### **Onsite; Full time** ### **About Our Transition to Ondas Sentinel** World View was recently acquired by Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ: ONDS) and, together with DZYNE Technologies, has joined forces to create Ondas Sentinel. Ondas Sentinel is a next\-generation U.S. defense platform integrating long\-endurance ISR, autonomous systems, counter\-UAS technologies, and mission intelligence. While World View is now part of Ondas Sentinel, we are still legally operating as World View as we complete the formal integration of our systems and processes. As a result, you may see roles cross\-posted across DZYNE and World View, during this transition. All positions represent opportunities within the same combined organization. ### **What does this mean for candidates?** * You’re joining a team that is accelerating the future of autonomous defense. * You’ll be part of a company backed by significant investment, strong growth, and mission\-proven technology. * You’ll work alongside world\-class engineers and innovators who have already delivered thousands of operational flight hours, high\-impact ISR capabilities, leading counter\-UAS systems, and breakthrough autonomous effects. * You’ll help shape a unified platform that enables operators to see more, decide faster, and act with confidence across the modern battlespace. Together, Ondas Sentinel is building something bigger than any one company, a scalable, integrated defense organization designed to meet emerging mission needs with speed, precision, and purpose. If you’re energized by ambitious missions, rapid innovation, and a chance to help define the future of autonomous defense, we’d love to have you on the team. ### **Job Description** We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead execution across the engineering organization. In close partnership with the Chief Engineer and Program Leadership, this role is responsible for delivery planning, team execution, and operational alignment to ensure high\-quality flight systems are delivered on schedule and in accordance with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain requirements. This position serves as a critical link between technical authority and program priorities, facilitating alignment, fostering effective cross\-functional collaboration, and escalating risks or trade\-offs as appropriate to protect delivery, quality, and safety. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Lead, develop, and support engineering teams through clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and an environment in which risks are identified and addressed early. * Oversee execution planning, resource allocation, and delivery across research and development activities and active programs, with clear ownership, priorities, and timelines. * Translate business and technical objectives into practical execution plans informed by capacity, dependencies, manufacturing readiness, test availability, and supply chain constraints. * Partner effectively with Program Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and technical leadership to resolve trade\-offs, improve visibility, and address bottlenecks before they affect program milestones. * Establish and maintain operating cadences that improve predictability, reduce unnecessary execution disruption, and support alignment among technical integrity, delivery objectives, and safety requirements. ### **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. * Experience leading engineering teams in aerospace, defense, or other complex hardware\-focused environments. * Demonstrated capability in execution planning, resource management, and cross\-functional leadership. * Ability to align technical execution with program priorities, manufacturing readiness, and schedule requirements. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting flight systems or other highly integrated hardware products. * Understanding of engineering\-to\-manufacturing and test transition within a regulated or high\-reliability environment. * Experience operating effectively within matrixed organizations or shared\-responsibility leadership models. ### **What We Offer** You will work side by side with experts in emerging technology, gaining exposure to cutting edge ideas and projects that are shaping the future. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance because we believe in taking care of the you as a person, not just a team member. Our Tucson workplace is designed to support collaboration, focus, and well\-being, with an on\-site environment that keeps supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, quality, and program teams closely connected to the mission. We believe in creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives, and every voice is heard. Our commitment to all team members is built upon five core cultural pillars: Engage, Lean In, Create, Care, and Own. Together, these pillars form the foundation of our employee experience while adhering to the highest standards of ethical and sustainable practices. ### **Some Final Notes** The description gives you a sense of what the position involves but is not an exhaustive list. We are a growing and evolving team, which means your responsibilities may shift or expand over time as new opportunities arise. Flexibility and curiosity are part of what makes our work exciting! At Ondas Sentinel, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate belonging and diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from every background and life experience because we know our differences make us stronger. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

results. * Experience managing the lifecycle of technical solutions. * Deep Subject Matter Expertise within the respective system domain products, platforms, processes and architecture. * Broad
