jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer- Go
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (Service Platform \& Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. In this high\-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA's fleet lifecycle at massive scale. This is a hands\-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic "one\-touch" provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat "infrastructure as a distributed system," developing self\-healing capabilities and AI\-driven SRE practices for a global fleet of 100k\+ instances. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Lead the hands\-on development and migration to a workflow\-as\-code platform (Temporal), building replay\-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale * Move the organization beyond "scripted automation" toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually\-consistent distributed system * Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and "self\-correcting" fleet operations * Develop framework\-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered "orchestration\-ready" with reliability hooks built directly into the code * Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet\-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what's needed, navigating seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution. * You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high\-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high\-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team. * You think at scale. You connect your day\-to\-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high\-growth, global organization. * You are resilient and adaptable. You view change as an opportunity and setbacks as temporary. You maintain composure and focus in high\-pressure situations, guiding yourself and your team through complexity with a steady, positive hand. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain * BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with **12\+ years of experience** in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale * Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for **Go** (or deep expertise in Java, C\+\+, or Python with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness. * Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization * Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Proficiency with AI code\-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring and system development * Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high\-scale, stateful management\-plane services * Direct experience building or operating systems with Temporal.io, Cadence, or similar workflow engines \#LI\-YC2 \#LI\-Hybrid At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. *See more information by clicking on the* *Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal* *link.* Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. jobs.description: ### **About Us** Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. than only maintaining them. * Applied knowledge of **clean architecture**: SOLID principles, separation of concerns (SRP), DRY and domain\-driven design. * Proven experience building an application from scratch. * Working knowledge of **React** and CSS (no UI design specialization required). * Experience writing unit and regression tests. * Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams. * Strong in\-person communication, teamwork and the ability to adapt to a corporate environment. * Ability to work in a hybrid model from the Miami Lakes, FL office. * Professional level of English \[confirm engineering culture. * Opportunity to influence technical strategy, especially regarding modern event\-driven architectures and AI integrations. * Collaborative international team with strong We offer competitive salaries, full benefits, a flexible remote work environment, an employee reimbursement program to support enriching your life, EAP, employee discounts, a WFH stipend, an annual allowance for AVB apparel, 401k options, a robust sick time policy, and 5 Floating Holidays per year, along with a minimum of 10 days of vacation time that starts accruing from your first day. In addition, from time to time, our team members will be required to engage in travel to attend AVB’s Annual All\-Employee Meeting, as well as other travel obligations which may be required of the position\- such as meetings with members, attendance at conventions, and other events, where you will represent AVB! We are geared up for growth, are you ready to grow with us? You also back up the team's security lead, covering security operations, alert response, and compliance work in their absence and assisting on major security projects. You are equally comfortable patching a production Linux fleet and working a security finding to closure. You support SaaS production environments that serve AVB's members, collaborate closely with software development teams, and help maintain AVB's PCI DSS compliance. years' experience administering Windows and Linux servers * Experience running patch management for production systems on a recurring schedule * Experience working in a PCI DSS or similarly regulated diagnostics. * Knowledge of general IT infrastructure, networking principles, cybersecurity measures and concerns within a regulatory environment. * Exhibit good decision\-making ability, including jobs.title: Network Engineer

telecommunications equipment. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Identify, research, analyze, diagnose, resolve, and close escalated technical issues accurately and within established service levels. * Provide data center and data hall floor support, including equipment installation, turn\-up, preventive maintenance, upgrades, lease replacements, and decommissioning. * Review log files, assess overall network health, and monitor network performance using SolarWinds NPM, NCM, IPAM, NetFlow, PingPlotter, MIBs, and OIDs. * Respond to network outages and troubleshoot LAN and WAN environments during primary shifts and after\-hours on\-call rotations. * Coordinate with vendors, carriers, manufacturers, and field service resources to support remote sites and resolve incidents requiring advanced support. * Perform incident, problem, configuration, and change management activities. * Support network projects, including solution design, equipment ordering, new\-device configuration, deployment, and lifecycle replacement. * Provide customer support by testing network connections, installing equipment, and completing service activation and turn\-up activities. * Handle second\-level troubleshooting, operating system upgrades, and configuration\-system layout planning. * Schedule and perform maintenance and system upgrades for network infrastructure. * Assist Network Engineering with the design and configuration of switches, routers, firewalls, wireless systems, and load balancers. * Provide comprehensive diagnostics, root\-cause analysis, and accurate problem resolution; document findings for future troubleshooting and analysis. **Service Delivery and Operational Excellence** ----------------------------------------------- * Assess service requests and determine when field resources are required through established incident\-management, dispatch, and service\-desk processes. * Escalate unresolved issues requiring advanced manufacturer or carrier support in accordance with prescribed procedures and service levels. * Monitor service\-desk ticket volume, identify trends, document findings, and ensure timely closure of assigned tickets. * Use ServiceNow and related service\-delivery systems and tools to execute service\-desk activities efficiently. * Follow escalation and exception processes, report current performance, and recommend improvements. * Maintain a client\-focused environment centered on problem prediction, detection, and resolution; proactively remove barriers to meeting client expectations. * Document issues, action plans, and outcomes promptly while meeting client\-satisfaction objectives and internal and external service\-level agreements. * Recommend and support initiatives that simplify, automate, and improve daily service\-delivery operations and the client experience. * Research technology, market, and industry trends and benchmarking data to identify and implement relevant best practices, methodologies, and analytics. * Continuously develop technical and nontechnical capabilities across supported products and services. * Contribute to collaborative relationships across operational teams, departments, and organizational levels. * Meet applicable financial objectives and leadership\-established key performance indicators, taking corrective action when needed. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ================== **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * At least five years of technical support engineering experience in a call\-center environment, with required experience in the technology\-services or managed\-service\-provider industry. * Demonstrated experience supporting data center floor operations and production, high\-availability network environments. * Experience coordinating multiple vendors to support work at remote sites. **Technical Expertise** ----------------------- * Ruckus LAN and WLAN environments, including Ruckus ICX 7150\-48PF access switches and ICX 7650\-48F core jobs.description: At TixTrack, we support our clients by creating superior ticketing solutions for performing arts and cultural institutions through a combination of modern technology, beautifully simple design, and the art of listening. Candidates may be required to travel and/or meet up in\-person from time to time. There may also be an expectation in the future for hybrid work in a local office.* **About You** ------------- * You're curious about how things work and eager to keep growing, whether that means picking up a new language, learning an unfamiliar part of the codebase, or taking on a bigger piece of work. * You take pride in quality. You write tests, make small and safe changes, and try to leave code better than you found it. * You communicate clearly and ask questions early. When you're stuck, you say so, and when you make a technical decision, you can explain why. * You value feedback and collaboration, whether it's a code review, a pairing session, or working with Product and Design to understand the problem behind the work. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build features and fix bugs across the stack, from well\-defined tasks to features you own from design through production, working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers. * Write clean, readable, maintainable code, with automated tests as part of every change. * Work confidently in existing codebases: read before you change, follow established patterns, and make small, safe changes that get reviewed early. * Understand the customer problem behind your work by partnering with Product and Design. * Participate in code reviews by acting on feedback, asking questions to learn, and giving clear, constructive feedback to others. * Follow the team's coding standards and best practices, and suggest improvements where you see them. * Investigate and fix bugs and performance issues, pulling in senior engineers when a problem needs a wider view. * Build with security in mind, including input validation, authorization checks, and error handling. * Add logging, monitoring, and tests to the features you build, and use what they show to improve them. * Pair and mob regularly with teammates to build skills, share context, and help newer engineers get up to speed. * Update technical documentation, such as API contracts and design notes, when your work changes how something behaves. * Contribute to architectural discussions, bringing perspective from the code you work in day to day. * Point out friction in tooling, docs, CI/CD workflows, or team processes, and help fix it. * Take part in production support and incident reviews alongside experienced teammates. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are r orities. **Tools You’ll Use** -------------------- * Microsoft Office * Google Suite * Slack * JIRA **What We Value** ----------------- Find Harmony \- We confidently manage our work priorities and feel comfortable taking time to enjoy life outside of work. Have a Clear View \- We are transparent and honest, understand our roles, and know how we contribute. Be a Fan \- We are passionate about our work and driven to innovate with our customers to solve current and future challenges with new solutions. Welcome All \- We are a diverse group of employees that come together as a team, without ego, and do great work. Perform at Your Best – We are committed to our customers success, always willing to listen and improve, to ensure our products exceed expectations. **How We Work** --------------- **R**adical Curiosity \- We Stay Hungry \- We approach each day with curiosity and accountability; learning, engaging fully, questioning assumptions, connecting our work to the bigger picture, and always keeping the customer at the center. **E**mbrace Change \- We Own Outcomes Together \- We succeed by holding ourselves accountable, collaborating deeply across teams, embracing change, and continuously improving together. **S**eek Solutions \- We Continuously Innovate Together \- We focus on solutions and client value by acting decisively, prioritizing what matters most, and turning ideas into results through rapid, iterative action. **E**mpathy \- We Grow Together \- We listen deeply to our customers and to each other, using data, empathy, and mutual respect to grow stronger together. **T**ransform \- We Raise The Bar \- We set high standards, honor our commitments, and move forward every day with a success mindset, driving continuous improvement and quality for our customers. **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- TixTrack is committed to a workplace where everyone is free from bias, prejudice, discrimination, and harassment. Salaries are commensurate with experience * Eligibility for annual bonus based on performance and company success * 100% of premium paid for medical, dental and vision benefits for employee and dependents, with an HSA\-eligible option (with a $1,000 employer contribution for 2026\) * Company\-paid life insurance * Traditional and Roth 401k plans * Paid parental leave * Learning \& development opportunities with company reimbursement for eligible educational expenses * Working abroad opportunities * Volunteer days off * Flexible scheduling * Up to $300 reimbursement for initial equipment to set up hybrid work environment * Generous PTO and holiday schedule * Remote work environment California Applicants: CCPA/CPRA Notice Right to Work Poster Notice of E\-verify Participation Our team is here to support you throughout the hiring process with reasonable accommodations. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Evaluation Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Turing** ================ Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **Senior Software Engineer, AI Evaluation Infrastructure** ========================================================== We build the infrastructure that frontier AI labs use to evaluate coding agents and language models: benchmark datasets, agent evaluation runs at scale, and automated task quality checks. You would own features across the stack, from the data model and background jobs to the screens our users work in every day. This is a role for an experienced engineer who works independently, makes sound tradeoffs, and turns a loosely defined request into something shipped, tested, and safe to leave alone. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and ship features end to end: data model, API, background workers, and the UI when the change needs it. * Build and improve how agents and models are evaluated: running trials in sandboxed environments, scoring results, and turning thousands of runs into results people can trust. * Improve how benchmark tasks are quality\-checked: verifiers, rubric\-based and LLM\-as\-a\-judge grading, and deciding whether a task is clear, solvable, and fair to score. * Integrate new models, agents, and benchmarks in a way that generalizes, without a special case for each one. * Keep the system fast and reliable as usage grows: efficient queries, safe migrations, and concurrency that holds up under load. * Review teammates' pull requests against our engineering guidelines and help keep the codebase consistent. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building and operating production backend systems, with ownership of at least one service from design through on\-call. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * Strong Python and experience with Django (or a similar framework), PostgreSQL, and a task queue such as Celery. What matters most is having run a real system, not knowing a particular framework. * Hands\-on experience in LLM evaluation, beyond calling a model API. You understand how a benchmark task is built, how an agent trial is scored, and how results are aggregated and compared. Experience with Harbor, Terminal\-Bench, SWE\-bench, Inspect, or a similar harness is a strong plus. * Judgment about task quality. You can spot ambiguous instructions, weak or gameable verifiers, leaked answers, and checks that pass for the wrong reason. * Good tradeoffs. You reach for the smallest design that solves the problem, extend what already exists before adding something new, and can explain what you chose not to build. * Ownership. You take a fuzzy request, find the relevant code, ask questions only when the answer changes the design, and finish the job, including migrations, tests, and edge cases users will hit. * Quick adoption of team conventions. You read the written guidelines and your first pull requests already match them in naming, structure, tests, and error handling. * Comfort with a TypeScript and React frontend when a change is visible there. You don't need to be a frontend specialist. * Clear writing. Your pull request descriptions and design notes explain why, not just what. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience running agents in sandboxed or containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud sandboxes such as Modal or Daytona). * Experience with LLM\-as\-a\-judge or rubric\-based grading, and with reducing judge bias and noise. * Familiarity with coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenHands, and with MCP. * Experience with distributed job scheduling, concurrency limits, or database locking at scale. * Contributions to open\-source evaluation or infrastructure projects. **How we work** --------------- * Written engineering guidelines, applied consistently, with the same review bar for everyone. * Business logic lives in services. Hot paths stay cheap. Lint and tests pass before a pull request is ready. * The same vocabulary in the code, the API, and the UI. * We prefer deleting code to adding it, and simple designs to clever ones. A strong first month looks like several changes merged with light review, and one area of the system you can change confidently without a guide. **Compensation:** $170,000 \- $200,000 Base Salary \+ Equity \#LI\-VC1 **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.
